english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ piɛla’ yino m-pahi kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim la zuɣu m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahigahi Yawɛ tooni.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Ka o ti kɔrigi piɛbila maa luɣ’ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbiri mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la biŋkɔbiri luɣ’ shɛl’ la, luɣ’ kasi shee, dama taali sanyoo sara mini alahichi sanyoo sara nyɛla maligumaana ni su shɛli, ka di simdi ni di be kasi.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Maligumaana maa ni zaŋ ʒim maa shɛli n-ʒe ninvuɣ’ so ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tibinyaɣili min’ o nudirigu nubililɔɣu zuɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu zuɣu.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ ŋun’ maŋmaŋ’ nuzaa ni

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: n-zaŋ o nudirigu nubil’ tim kpa’ shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ o nubil’ ni kpam maa mihi Yawɛ tooni ʒiibuyopɔin.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa zaŋ kpa’ shɛli din kpalim be o nuu ni la n-ʒe ninvuɣ’ so ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu polo tibinyaɣili min’ o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu ni taali sanyoo sara ʒim la zuɣu.

english_verse: and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: ka Maligumaana maa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi bee kawana sara la sara maligu bimbini la zuɣu. Lala ka maligumaana maa yɛn niŋ mali taali ni yibu sanyoo sara ti ninvuɣ’ so ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa, ka o yi daɣiri ni.

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Di lan simdi ka o bo ŋmanʒiɛhi ayi bee yiŋ’ ŋmambihi ayi, o ni ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli, ka bɛ ti zaŋ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka zaŋ ŋun’ la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ la ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o yih’ o daɣiri ni dabisi’ shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Ka o ti kɔrigi taali sanyoo sara piɛbila maa, ka maligumaana maa zaŋ taali sanyoo sara maa ʒim shɛli ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tib’ nyaɣili min’ o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Ka maligumaani maa ti booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ o nuzaa nutal’ ni;

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ o nudirigu nubila n-tim kpa’ shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa lan zaŋ kpa’ shɛli din be o nuu ni maa shɛli ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tibinyaɣili min’ o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu luɣ’ shɛŋa bɛ ni pun niŋ alahichi sanyoo sara binʒim ʒe la.

Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Yino ni ti nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara, ka ŋun’ la mi nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la m-pahi chi sara zuɣu, ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa daalahichi samli Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ’ so ka o ku tooi nyaŋ o daɣiri ni yibu sara maligu zaligu m-bala. Yili ni dukpina Maligibu

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna,

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: “Yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su maa ni, ka n ti zaŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu niŋ so yil’ ni yi ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: di saha yili maa lana ŋun’ cham’ ti yɛli maligumaana, ‘Di ŋmanila dɔr’ shɛli n-lu n yiŋa.’

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun’ doli yili maa dunoli yi, ka yo yili maa zali hal ni daba ayopɔin.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ka maligumaana maa lan kana ti nya, dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa dukpina maa zuɣu,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Ka o chɛ ka bɛ kaɣisi yili maa puuni dukpina zaa, ka va bɛ ni kaɣisi taŋkpa’ shɛli maa ti bahi tiŋ’ maa tariga tampuli zuɣu.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun’ cham’ ti nya, ka dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa ni, di nyɛla dɔr’ biɛɣu n-lu yili maa ni maa, yili maa nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka o wurim yili maa ka va di kuɣa mini di yɔɣira ni di tari zaa ti bahi tiŋ’ maa tariga tampuli zuɣu.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Din pahi nyɛla, ŋunkam daa kpe yili maa ni saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kpar’ li zali la nyɛla ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam dɔni tiŋa yili maa ni, ŋun’ paɣim’ o situra, ka ŋunkam di bindirigu yili maa ni, ŋun’ paɣim’ o situra.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: “Amaa maligumaana maa yi kana ti lihi yili maa, ka dɔro maa bi lan yɛligi pahi yili maa ni bɛ ni lab’ ta li maa nyaaŋa, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun wuhimi ni yili maa nyɛla din ka daɣiri ni, dama dɔro maa naaya.

english_verse: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ yi yɛn yihi yili maa daɣiri ni, ŋun’ zaŋmi noombihi tintiins’ ayi mini sida dari ni mi’ ʒee ni taaŋkɔro,

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: ka kɔrigi noombil’ yino niŋ ko’ viɛlli din be yaɣiri duɣu ni,

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: O ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ noombil’ maa ʒim mini kom maa ni noombil’ nɛɔŋ maa ni sida dari ni taaŋkɔro ni mi’ ʒee maa n-yihi yili maa daɣiri ni m-bala,

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: ka chɛ ka noombil’ nɛɔŋ maa yiɣi yi tiŋ’ maa ni chaŋ mɔɣu ni, ka maligumaana maa yo yili maa alahichi samli, ka di yi daɣiri ni.”

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu zaligu din wuhiri ni di nyɛla daɣiri bee di pala daɣiri.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binshɛli yi yi doo tooni na, din yi o tooni na maa nyɛla daɣiri.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam shihi di ni yi ninvuɣ’ so tooni na maa, dilan’ ŋun’ paɣim’ o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi tuhi nintɔri ka di shihi ninvuɣ’ so ŋun ka daɣiri, dilan’ ŋun’ paɣim’ o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam shihi dilan’ ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ŋunkam ʒi bini maa, ŋun’ paɣim’ o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ’ so tooni na maa yi bi paɣ’ o nuhi ka shihi ninvuɣ’ so, dilan’ ŋun’ paɣ’ o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi shihi yaɣiri laa kam, bɛn’ ŋmam’ li, ka di yi nyɛ dari bini, bɛn’ paɣimi li kom.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ’ so tooni na maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun’ zaŋmi daba ayopɔin niŋ o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa, ka paɣ’ o situra, ka su ko’ viɛlli n-yi daɣiri ni.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Ka dabisi’ shɛli din pahir’ anii dali, ŋun’ bom’ ŋmanʒiɛh’ ayi bee yiŋ’ ŋmambih’ ayi n-ka Yawɛ tooni na Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni nti zaŋ ba ti maligumaana,

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: ka maligumaana maa zaŋ ba mali sara; yino ni nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara, ka ŋun’ la mi nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Ka maligumaana maa yo din yi o tooni na maa samli Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Doo yi chɛ ka o dɔbilim yina, ŋun’ sum’ o niŋgbuŋ zaa kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka o dɔbilim maa yi shihi situra kam mini biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ kam, bɛn’ paɣimi li, ka di ni nyɛ din be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Doo mini paɣ’ yi dɔni, bɛ niriba ayi maa bɛn’ sum’ kom, ka nyɛ bɛn ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Paɣ’ yi nya sɔrilim din nyɛ o ni pun nyari shɛli sahakam, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, ka ŋunkam shih’ o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka Paɣ’ maa yi ʒinila bindoo zuɣu bee binshɛlikam zuɣu, ka dilan’ shihi li, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Ka o mini do’ so yi dɔni, ka o daɣiri maa tabil’ o, doo maa ni be daɣiri ni daba ayopɔin, ka bindo’ shɛlikam zuɣu doo maa ni dɔni ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam shihi binyɛra maa ni be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ni dilan’ paɣ’ o situra ka su kom, ka ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Amaa paɣ’ maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun kalimi daba ayopɔin, di nyaaŋa o ni yi daɣiri ni.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Ka dabisi’ shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali, ŋun’ bom’ ŋmanʒiɛh’ ayi bee yiŋ’ ŋmambih’ ayi n-chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni ti ti maligumaana.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ zaɣ’ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ ŋun’ la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la; ka maligumaana maa mali sanyoo sara yo daɣ’ shɛli din daa yi o ni maa samli Yawɛ sani ti o.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: A ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ maa yi daɣiri ni m-bala, di yi pa lala bɛ ni saɣim m biɛhigu shee din be bɛ sunsuuni ŋɔ ka kpi ni bɛ daɣiri.

english_verse: These are the things you men must do if you become unclean because of an infected penis or if you have a flow of semen. And these are the things you women must do when you become unclean either because of your monthly period or an unusual flow of blood. This is also what you men must do if you have sex with a woman who is unclean.
translation_verse: di lan nyɛla paɣ’ so ŋun nya sɔrilim zaligu ni binshɛli ni yiri do’ so bee paɣ’ so tooni na zaa zaligu, ka lan nyɛ do’ so ŋun mini paɣ’ so ŋun na be daɣiri ni dɔni gba zaligu.

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa: Yɛlim’ a mabia Aduna ni o di kanna luɣ’ kasi shee din be pateesa ŋɔ puuni ŋɔ waawaayili nti zaani Alikauli Adaka pindigu la gbini, di yi pa lala o ni kpi, dama n yirila zahira sagban’ ni di pindigu maa zuɣu.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Amaa Aduna ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka naanyi kpe luɣ’ kasi maa puuni m-bɔŋɔ: O bom’ naɣila’ polli ŋun ni mali alahichi sanyoo sara mini piɛlaa ŋun ni mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: O zaŋm’ binyɛribil’ piɛl’ kasi ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma’ piɛlli, ka zaŋ shɛlɔr’ piɛlli lo o shee ni ka vili bantabiga. Di nyɛla situr’ shɛli din be kasi. O sum’ kom pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Ka o ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ bo bulah’ ayi ti o ka o mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛla’ yino mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa mali ŋun’ maŋmaŋ’ daalahichi sanyoo sara n-yo o min’ o yiŋnim’ daalahichi samli.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ bulah’ ayi maa ti zali Naawuni tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni,

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: ka pihi kuɣa sɔŋ n-lihi nya bulah’ ayi maa sunsuuni, kuɣ’ yini ni ti nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka kuɣ’ yini ti nyɛ Azazɛl dini.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Yawɛ kuɣili ni gbaai bula’ so la m-mali sara.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Amaa Azazɛl kuɣili ni gbaai bula’ so la ŋuna o ni ti zaŋ o la zaɣ’ nɛɔŋ ti Yawɛ n-yo bɛ daalahichi samli, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi mɔɣu ni nti ti Azazɛl.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ’ naɣilaa la na nti mal’ o min’ o yiŋnim’ daalahichi sanyoo sara, ka o ti kɔrigi naɣilaa maa mali ŋun’ maŋmaŋ’ daalahichi sanyoo sara.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ tulaale zim tuɣindi laa m-mooi buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni m-pal’ li, ka niŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla nukurigu pali buyi ŋ-ŋmiri li biɛlabiɛla n-zaŋ li kpe pateesa maa puuni

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: nti zaŋ tulaale zim maa niŋ buɣim maa ni Yawɛ tooni, ka chɛ ka di nyɔhi tuɣi kpe bimpindigu din pili Alikauli Adaka la, di yi pa lala o ni kpi.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubila n-niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni, ka lan zaŋ o nubil’ suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni buyopɔin.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa, ka o kɔrigi niriba maa daalahichi sanyoo sara bulaa la, ka zaŋ o ʒim maa kpe pateesa maa puuni na nti niŋ kaman o ni niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim shɛm maa, ka zaŋ li mihi adaka pindigu la zuɣusaa mini adaka maa tooni,

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: din ni chɛ ka o yihi luɣ’ kasi shee maa daɣiri ni ni Izraɛlnim’ daɣiri mini bɛ biriginsim ni bɛ daalahichi la zaa zuɣu; ka di simdi ka o niŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili din be bɛ sani bɛ daɣiri tuma ni maa lala.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi yi n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti mal’ li ka di be kasi, ka zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini bulaa maa ʒim shɛli n-niŋ binyila din be sara maligu bimbini la ni ti gili.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubil’ suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi li buyopɔin n-yihi li Izraɛlnim’ daɣiri maa ni. Bua ŋun ʒi alahichi kpe yɔɣu

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Ka o yi mali luɣ’ kasi shee maa mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni sara maligu bimbini maa ka di be kasi naai, ŋun’ zaŋm’ bu’ nɛɔŋ la na,

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: ka ŋun’ Aduna ti zaŋ o nuh’ ayi pa bu’ nɛɔŋ maa zuɣu ni, ka kaŋka Izraɛlnim’ tuumbiɛri zaa mini bɛ biriginsim zaa ni bɛ daalahichi zaa n-zaŋ li ʒili bua maa, ka bɛ ni pun pii ninvuɣ’ so zali vo bua maa chaŋ mɔɣu ni.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Ka bua maa ni deei bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa ʒi n-chaŋ tiŋgban’ nɛli ni, ka o ti zaŋ bua maa bahi mɔɣu maa ni.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: ka su kom luɣ’ kasi shee maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ’ binyɛra ye n-yina ti mal’ o sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini niriba sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-yo omaŋmaŋ’ daalahichi mini niriba maa daalahichi samli.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkpam la nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Ka ŋun vo bua la tahi Azazɛl sani la, di simdi ka o paɣ’ o nɛma ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara naɣilaa la mini alahichi sanyoo sara bua la, bɛ ni zaŋ shɛb’ ʒim kpe luɣ’ kasi shee la n-yi bɛ sansani maa ni kpaŋa nti nyo bɛ gbana mini bɛ nimdi ni bɛ bina buɣim.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ka di simdi ni ŋun nyo li maa paɣ’ o situra ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni na. Alahichi samli yɔbu dabisili gbibbu

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam. Gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, di simdi ka yi lo noli ka di tumiya tuma dindali, yinim’ bɛn nyɛ tiŋbihi bee tinzunnim’ bɛn be yi sani,

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: dama dindali maa ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya, ka yihi ya daɣiri ni; yi ni ti yi yi daalahichi zaa daɣiri ni Yawɛ tooni.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka di simdi ka yi ti lo noli; di yɛn nyɛla zaligu sahakam.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ka o leei maligumaana zan’ o ba zaani n-ni ti ye binyɛr’ piɛl’ kasi m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara maa.

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: O ni ti mali luɣ’ kasi shee maa, ka mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka yo maligumaaniba mini niriba maa zaa daalahichi samli.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ka di simdi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam ni bɛ yɔri Izraɛlnim’ daalahichi zaa samli tiri ba yim yuuni puuni. Ka Musa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal’ o shɛm maa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Aduna min’ o bidibisi ni Izraɛlnim’ zaa ni man’ Yawɛ ni zali shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: ka bi zaŋ o ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ dunol’ ni na nti mali sara ti Yawɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ, dilan’ nyɛla ŋun mali taali nyɛvili dibu ni, ka di simdi ni bɛ yihi dilan’ o niriba ni.

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ zaŋ bɛ ni kɔriti binneen’ shɛb’ maani sara mɔɣu ni la ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ŋɔ ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o zaŋ ba mali suhudoo sara maligu.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ binʒim maa kpaai vie Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni la, ka zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim ka di nyɛ din nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan kɔri binyɛra mali alizinnim’ bɛn ŋmani buhi la, bɛ ni daa saɣim bɛmaŋa shɛb’ sani la. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛn nyɛla zaligu bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: ka bi zaŋ li ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ŋɔ ni na ti mal’ li ti Yawɛ, bɛn’ yihim’ dilan’ Yawɛ niriba ni.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Izraɛl ninvuɣ’ so bee saan’ shɛb’ bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ’ so yi ti ŋubi bin’ so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo’ muni, n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi dilan’ zuɣu, ka yih’ o n niriba ni.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Dama niŋgbuŋ nyɛvili bela ʒim puuni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tin ya ni di yo yi nyɛviya tiliginsim samli. Dama ʒim n-nyɛ din yɔri alahichi samli, di ni nyɛ nyɛvili la zuɣu.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ’ so bee saan’ shɛb’ bɛn be yi sani ninvuɣ’ so yi go piɛli gbaai biŋkɔbigu bee nooŋa ŋun ŋubbu bi chihira, dilan’ ŋun’ kɔrigim’ bini maa ʒim bahi tiŋa, ka niŋ taŋkpaɣu pa di zuɣu.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim maa. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, “Miriya ka yi ŋubi binnɛɔŋ kam ʒim, dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim, ka ŋunkam ŋub’ li, bɛn’ yihim’ o o niriba ni.”

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋubi bin’ so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo’ muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dar’ tɔhi binshɛli, dilan’ yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee sana, ŋun’ paɣim’ o situra, ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi leei ŋun ka daɣiri ni.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Amaa o yi bi paɣ’ o situra bee n-su kom, o taali maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, di simdi ni yi niŋ n ni zali ya shɛm n-gbibi n zaligunim’ ka dol’ li.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yi ni so miri ka o ti chɛ ka o min’ o dɔɣira dɔni.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba paɣ’ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: So miri ka o zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa dɔni, o yi nyɛla o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga, bɛ yi dɔɣ’ o la yiŋa bee luɣ’ shɛli polo.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: So miri ka o zaŋ o mapira dɔni, dama o nyɛla a ma dɔɣira ni yɛlimaŋli.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba mabia ŋun nyɛ doo paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ma.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: So miri ka o laɣim paɣ’ min’ o bipuɣiŋga dɔni, ka miri ka o bo o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga, bɛ nyɛla paɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn nyɛ o dɔɣiriba ni yɛlimaŋli. Lala nyɛla zaɣ’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: So miri ka o kpuɣ’ o paɣ’ mabia pah’ o zuɣu saha shɛl’ o paɣ’ maa ni na be o nyɛvili ni maa.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: Paɣ’ yi nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai, nyin’ di mir’ o ni a bo o.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa n-kpɛh’ amaŋ’ daɣiri ni o sani.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ yi bi’ so ti ni bɛ nyo buɣim mali buɣili Molɛk ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi saɣim yi Naawuni yuli. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ka doo bo o dokpee kaman paɣ’ la, di nyɛla din chihira.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-saɣim yimaŋa, dama n ni kariti ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ ka chɛri palo tiri ya ŋɔ zaŋla dimbɔŋɔnim’ saɣim bɛmaŋa.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n-daa darigi di tibili, ka di gbuɣi di niriba maa bahi maa.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Di yi pa lala, yi yi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di ni gbuɣi ya bahi kaman di ni daa gbuɣi zuliya shɛb’ bɛn daa be yi tooni la bahi shɛm la.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu doliya n zaligunima, ka miriya ka yi ti doli ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn daa pun daŋ be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaya din chihiri la, ka miriya ka yi ti zaŋ li saɣim yimaŋa: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnim’ maa zaa: Bɛnya kasi, dama man’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bela kasi.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi jɛm wuna bee ka yimaŋmaŋ’ ti zaŋ binshɛli dooi mali binnana. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Yi yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, yin’ malimiya li ka di nyɛ din ni chɛ ka o deei yi sara maa.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi mali sara, di simdi ka yi ŋub’ li dindali maa bee dindali cheei biɛɣu, ka di shɛli yi guui zani hal ni daba ata dali, yin’ zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Yi yi ŋub’ li daba ata maa dali, di nyɛla din chihira, ka n ku deei li.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋub’ li ni nya tibidarigibo. Dama o saɣim Yawɛ binshɛli din be kasi, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi lala nir’ maa o niriba ni.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin’ di kpuɣiya yi putarisi zaa daatam bee ka yi ti lan labi ti yihi binyiha yi daatam kpuɣibu maa nyaaŋa.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi pɔhi yi puri ni tiwala zaa bee n-gahim yi wain wal’ shɛŋa din lu tiŋa. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi zura bee n-niŋdi tab’ bilikɔnsi bee ŋ-ŋmar’ tab’ ʒiri.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Di ŋmariya ʒiri ka mali n yuli pɔri pɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi dihi yi Naawuni yuli vi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: Miri ka a niŋ a kpee fitiina bee n-fa o. A yi bu so paa ka o tum a tuma, nyin’ di chɛ ka o liɣiri gbe a sani.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Miri ka a yɛli noli ti tikpiralana bee n-zaŋ kuɣili sɔŋ zom tooni ni o tuui li, amaa zom’ a Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: Di niŋdiya din bi tuhi yi saria karibu ni, di niŋya faralan’ nirilim bee n-chɛ yi ni di yɛn niŋ shɛm bundan’ zuɣu, amaa doliya wuntia soli n-kariti saria.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Di yi kpe n-gari kpe m-be kaman munaafichilana a niriba sunsuuni, ka miri ka a yi n-zani a kpee nyɛvili yihibu zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Miri ka a bɔh’ a kpee biɛri bee n-je suli niŋ o, amaa yum’ a kpee kaman amaŋ’ la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Gbibiya n zaligunima. Di chɛliya ka naɣ’ bal’ shɛb’ zuliya du yi naɣinyama. Di biriya bimbira balibu buyi pu’ yin’ ni, yi mi di yɛnya taŋgari binyɛrigu.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o dab’ paɣa ti do’ so, ka bɛ na bi yo o zuɣu bee ka dab’ paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni, ka o dan’ maa lan zaŋ o dɔni, di simdi ka bɛ vihi yɛlli maa. Di bi simdi ka bɛ ku ba, dama paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ taali sanyoo sara piɛlaa maa mali sara Yawɛ tooni o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti paai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-sa tihi balibu kam, di wala ni ti nyɛla din dibu chihiri yi sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din chihiri dibu yi sani hal ni yuma ata, ka di bi simdi ni yi di li.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Ka yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ anahi ni, di wala zaa ni nyɛla wal’ suma ka ni nyɛla wumpaɣibo sara pina Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Amaa yuun’ shɛli din pahiri yuma anu ni, yi ni tooi di di wala, ka lala chɛ ka di woli wala pam tin ya: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ŋub’ nimdi ka ʒim na be di ni. Di ti bɔhimya baɣitali bee sotali.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini ŋmahiŋmahi yimaŋa kpiimba zuɣu bee n-chihi yimaŋ’ chiha. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti leei bukpahinima. Di ti bɔnya bɛ shee din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ya daɣiri ni. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Lumiya bɛn zuɣuri paligi sizuura, ka timiya ninkura jilima, ka zomiya yi Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Sana yi be yi tiŋgban’ ni, yin’ di niŋy’ o zaɣ’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Sana yi be yi sani, yin’ zaŋmiy’ o leei tiŋbia yi sani, ka yur’ o kaman yimaŋmaŋ’ la. Dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi mali sania maŋa ni zahimbu maŋa ni tahi’ maŋa ni kuruwa maŋa: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima: Izraɛl do’ so bee saamba bɛn be Izraɛl do’ so yi ti zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, bɛn’ kum’ o; tiŋ’ maa nim’ bɛn’ labim’ o kuɣa.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Man’ maŋmaŋ’ ni ti pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih’ o n niriba ni, o ni zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk n-ta m biɛhigu shee daɣiri, ka dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi zuɣu.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Ka so yi zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, ka tiŋ’ maa nim’ nya ka sɔɣ’ li ka bi ku o,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: dindina n ni pa n nina lihiri doo maa min’ o yiŋnima, ka ku o mini ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaa dol’ o jɛmdi Molɛk maa.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Ninvuɣ’ so yi ŋmaligi chaŋ jinwariba sani bee bukpahinim’ sani nti doli ba, n ni pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih’ o n niriba ni.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Gbibiya n zaligunima ka tummiya di tuma; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn’ kum’ o, o ni tu o ba bee o ma maa zuɣu, o ʒim yihibu maa taali ʒila o zuɣu.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Doo yi tum zina ni o kpee paɣa, bɛn’ kum’ o mini paɣ’ maa zaa.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o ba paɣ’ dɔni, dilan’ nyɛla ŋun nya o ba zaɣim, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o bia paɣ’ dɔni, bɛn’ kum bɛ niriba ayi maa, bɛ tumla taali bɛ ni nyɛ dɔɣiri yini zuɣu, bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒila bɛ zuɣu.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Doo yi dɔni o do’ kpee kaman paɣ’ la, bɛ niriba ayi maa tum din chihira, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣ’ min’ o bia leeg’ o paɣiba di nyɛla ninvuɣ’ biɛtali, ka di simdi ka bɛ nyo doo maa min’ o paɣiba maa buɣim din ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ’ biɛtali maa ku lan be bɛ sunsuuni.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Paɣ’ yi zaŋ omaŋ’ ti biŋkɔbigu kam ka o gol’ o, bɛn’ kum’ paɣa maa mini biŋkɔbigu maa, kumiya ba, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa ŋun nyɛ o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga dɔni n-nya o zaɣim, ka paɣa maa gba nya o zaɣim, di nyɛla vi tuuni, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi ba bɛ niriba ni. O ni zaŋ o tizɔpaɣ’ dɔni maa zuɣu, di simdi ni bɛ darig’ o tibili.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ paɣ’ so ŋun sɔrilim na bi naai dɔni m-pirig’ o zaɣim, o yihila paɣ’ maa ʒi’ soya zahira, ka paɣ’ maa gba yih’ omaŋmaŋ’ ʒi’ soya zahira, di simdi ka bɛ yihi bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa bɛ daŋ ni.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Miri ka a bo a piriba bee a mapira, dama nir’ yi niŋ lala o dɔɣira ka o bo maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o ŋahiba paɣ’ dɔni, o ŋahiba maa zaɣim ka o nya maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ku dɔɣi bia hal ti kpi.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Doo yi kpuɣ’ o mabia paɣa, o tum zaɣ’ biɛɣu, ka nya o mabia zaɣim, bɛ ku dɔɣi bia.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma, dina n-ni chɛ ka n ni zaŋdi ya kuni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa ti ku gbuɣi ya bahi.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Ka miriya ka yi ti doli n ni kariti zuliya shɛb’ ka chɛri ya ŋɔ kaya, dama bɛ daa tumdila dimbɔŋɔnim’ zaa, dinzuɣu ka n zaɣisi ba.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Amaa n yɛlila yinima: N ni zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔn maa tin ya, ka yi di li fali n-su li. Di nyɛla tiŋgban’ shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun woligi ya ka chɛ zuliya shɛba.

english_verse: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi woligi biŋkɔb’ shɛb’ bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni noombihi shɛb’ bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbigu bee noombil’ bee binshɛli n ni wuhi ni di nyɛla daɣiri la kpɛhi yimaŋ’ daɣiri ni.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi be kasi n sani; dama man’ Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be kasi, ka woligi ya zuliyanim’ ni ni yi nyɛ n dahalali.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Paɣ’ bee doo yi leei jinwara bee bukpaha bɛn’ kum’ o. Bɛn’ labimi ba kuɣa. Bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi bɛmaŋmaŋ’ zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa. Yɛlim’ maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la ni bɛ so miri ka o chaŋ o dɔɣiri so kuyili nti kpe daɣiri ni,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: bee o tizɔpaɣ’ ŋun na ʒi doo, .

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Amaa di bi simdi ka o zaŋ omaŋ’ leei kaman o yidan’ la o niriba sunsuuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim omaŋa.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri sunsuuni bee n-kɔrisi taɣi bɛ teensi bee n-chihi chiha bɛ niŋgbuna ni.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni bɛ be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani ka miri ka bɛ dihi bɛ Naawuni yuli vi; dama bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn zaŋdi bɛ Naawuni bindira n-nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ, dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛ be kasi.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Bɛ miri ka bɛ ti kpuɣi pagɔrili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ’ so bee paɣ’ so ŋun yi o yidan’ yili, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Lihimiya ba kaman bɛn be kasi, dama bɛna n-zaŋdi yi Naawuni bindira maani sara. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi, dama man’ Yawɛ ŋun mali ya ka yi be kasi maa nyɛla ŋun be kasi.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana so bipuɣiŋga yi ti gɔri pagɔrisigu n-dih’ omaŋ’ vi, o ba ka o dihi vi maa, bɛn’ nyom’ o buɣim.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: Maligumaana so ŋun leei kpɛma o tab’ sunsuuni, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni mal’ o kasi n-wolig’ o zali ni o yɛri maligumaana binyɛra miri ka o chɛ ka o zabiri yirimyirim bee n-dari chɛh’ o binyɛra.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: O miri ka o ti chaŋ nir’ ni kpi n-do luɣ’ shɛli. O miri ka o saɣim omaŋa, hal di yi nyɛla o ba bee o ma.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: O miri ka o ti yi luɣ’ kasi shee la n-saɣim o Naawuni luɣ’ kasi shee maa, dama o Naawuni kpa’ shɛli din be kasi ka bɛ boori li bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la nyɛla din be o zuɣu ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Di simdi ka o kpuɣila paɣ’ so ŋun na ʒi doo.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: O di kpuɣi pakoli bee paɣ’ so ŋun yi o yidan’ yili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ’ so bee pagɔrili, amaa o kpuɣim’ o zuliya ni paɣ’ so ŋun na ʒi doo,

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: din ni chɛ ka o ku dih’ o bihi vi o niriba sunsuuni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mal’ o ka o be kasi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa,

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Ŋunkam ti mali dalinli ŋun di mirina, do’ so ŋun nyɛ zoma bee wɔbiga bee ŋun ninni mali dansi bee ŋun bɔɣu yini gari zaɣ’ yini

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: bee do’ so ŋun napɔŋ bee o nuu mali daŋa

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: bee gurugulana bee diɣili bee do’ so ŋun nina bi ne viɛnyɛla bee ŋun mali dɔr’ shɛli din zaɣisiri niŋgbuŋ ni bee ŋun mali yu’ kaɣima bee bɛ ni yihi do’ so lana.’
