translation_verse: Ka Izraɛl paɣ’ bia maa daa tu Naawuni, ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Musa sani. O ma yuli n-daa booni Shɛlomit, o daa nyɛla Dibiri bipuɣiŋga, ka nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nira.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kpɛhi duu, ka guhiri ni Yawɛ ti yɛli ba o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Zaŋm’ ninvuɣ’ so ŋun tu ma maa yihi sansani maa kpaŋa nti chɛ ka bɛn zaa wum o ni tu ma shɛm maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ maa zaa lab’ o kuɣa.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Ŋunkam ti mo Yawɛ, o yi nyɛla Izraɛl tiŋbia bee sana, bɛn kum o, Izraɛlnim’ maa zaa bɛn’ labim’ o kuɣa.’

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: “Ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn’ kum’ o.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun’ bom’ biŋkɔb’ so yo o samli; nyɛvili la nyɛvili.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: “So yi ti o kpee dalinli, bɛn’ niŋm’ o gba o ni niŋ shɛm maa labisi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Tiŋbihi mini saamba zaa zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ’ yini; dama man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim’ maa lala, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ninvuɣ’ so ŋun daa tu Naawuni maa yi bɛ sansani maa kpaŋa nti lab’ o kuɣa. Izraɛlnim’ maa daa tum Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm maa.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: A ni da binshɛli a kpee sani ka di dolila chuɣu maa puhibu nyaaŋa yuma kalinli yaakaza tariga. Ka o mi kɔhi li ti a ka di dol’ a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam yuma shɛm tariga.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni na, tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛn malila di vuhim yuuni Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Amaa yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin ni nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni, di nyɛla Yawɛ vuhim yuuni; di ti biriya yi puri bee n-wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: ni yi niɣi mini biŋkɔb’ shɛb’ bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, binshɛɣukam din ti yɛn bili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na ni ti nyɛla bindirigu.” Nɛma labisi ti yuuni

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Ka goli so ŋun pahir’ ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, yin’ chɛ ka bɛ piɛb’ kikahi pampam. Ka dabisi’ shɛli din nyɛ samli yɔbu dali maa, yin’ chɛliya ka bɛ piɛbi kikahi gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ yuun’ shɛli din pahiri pihinu la leei yuun’ kasi, ka moli yolisim nyabu molo ti bɛnkam be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Di ni ti nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani, ka sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su shɛlikam, ka lab’ o malibu sani.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Dama di nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani; di ni ti nyɛla yuuni din be kasi; yi ni ti dila binshɛŋa din bili mɔɣu ni di yuuni maa.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: “Yuun’ shɛli din nyɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa puuni, sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su binshɛɣukam.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Yuma maa yi galisi, nyin’ pahimi liɣiri, ka yuma maa yi bi galisi, nyin’ filimmi liɣiri maa, dama a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam shɛm ka o kɔhiri tir’ a maa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ŋariti taba, amaa zomiya yi Naawuni, dama man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.” Muɣisigu din be yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin maa ni

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti niŋ bindira ka yi di n-tiɣi, ka be ni ka barina shɛli kani.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: “Ka yi yi bɔhi ‘Ti yi bi biri bee ti yi bi kpuɣi puri atam yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin maa ni, bɔ ka ti ti yɛn dira?’

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: N ni niŋ n daalibarika niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayɔbu maa ni din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yuma ata bindira.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti yɛn biri yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ anii ni, yi ni ti dirila bindir’ kura, ka yi ti kul ni dirila bindir’ kura maa hal ni yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ awɛi, ka bindir’ pala ti naanyi niŋ.” Tiŋgbani labisi ti ŋun su li yɛla

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi zaŋ tiŋgbani kɔhi ti so ka o su li sahakam, dama tiŋgbani maa nyɛla n dini, yi nyɛla tinzunnim’ mini saamba n sani.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni su tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ’ shɛlikam zaa, zalimiya nir’ ni yɛn kɔh’ o tiŋgbani ka ti lan yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛli.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Fara yi gbaag’ a mabia ka o kɔh’ o tiŋgban’ shɛli ti a, o daŋ ni ninvuɣ’ so ŋun pa o zuɣu n-ni kana ti yo o mabia maa ni kɔhi shɛli maa zuɣu ka deei li.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Ka so yi ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋun ni yo ka deei li, dindina omaŋmaŋ’ yi nya liɣiri ka ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: yin’ chɛliya ka o mal’ o ni daa kɔhi li yuun’ shɛli maa zaŋ kana di saha maa laasabu, ka yo laɣ’ shɛli din pahi ti o ni daa kɔhi li ti so maa, ka bɛ labis’ o tiŋgbani ti o.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Amaa o yi ka yiko din ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, dindina o ni kɔhi shɛli maa kul ni kpalim be ŋun da li maa nuu ni hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni. Di yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka bɛ deei li n-labisi ti o.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ka o yi bi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuuni maa puuni, dindina yili din be bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin’ shɛli ni maa ni leela ŋun da li maa dini sahakam o ʒiɛman’ ni, ka di bi simdi ka bɛ ti deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Amaa yiya din be tiŋkpan’ shɛŋa bɛ ni bi me goma gili ni, din’ mini puri din be mɔɣu ni ni ti nyɛla yim, bɛ ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, ka ni ti tooi lan deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Di zaa yoli Lɛvinim’ bɛn tinsi dina, yiya shɛŋa din be bɛ ni su fɔntin’ shɛŋa ni, bɛn’ Lɛvinim’ maa ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛlikam.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Lɛvi so yi bi yo di zuɣu kaman o ni mali soli ni o niŋ shɛm maa, dindina o ni kɔhi yili shɛli bɛ ni su fɔn’ tin’ shɛli ni maa, bɛn’ ti deemi yili maa ti o nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni, dama yiya shɛŋa din be Lɛvinim’ fɔntinsi ni nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli Izraɛlnim’ sani.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amaa pu’ shɛŋa din be bɛ fɔntinsi maa tiŋgban’ ni, di bi simdi ka bɛ kɔhi dina, dama di nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli saha shɛlikam. Faranim’ sama dihibu

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Ka fara yi gbaag’ a mabia ka o ku lan tooi gbib’ omaŋa, nyin’ gbib’ o ka chɛ ka o be a sani kaman sana bee tinzun nir’ la.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Miri ka a zaŋ a liɣiri paŋ o ka bɔri ni a niŋ nyɔri bee n-kɔhi bindirigu ti o ka niŋ nyɔri.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka nyɛ yi Naawuni. Daba chɛ m-bahi

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Ka fara yi gbaag’ a mabia ŋun ʒi m-baɣ’ a, ka o zaŋ omaŋ’ pa talima a sani, nyin’ di chɛ ka o tumdi tuma kaman dabili la,

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: o ni bela a sani kaman padira bee tumtumda n-tumd’ a tuma hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Di saha o min’ o bihi ni yi a sani n-lab’ o dɔɣiriba sani ti ʒin’ o yaannim’ tiŋgban’ ni.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Dama bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdiba, n ni daa yihi shɛb’ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; di bi simdi ka yi kɔhi ba kaman daba la.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Amaa zom’ a Naawuni, ka di zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib’ o.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Yi ni tooi zaŋ ba ti yi bidibisi, ka bɛ di ba fali yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka bɛ leei bɛ ni su shɛba sahakam. Yi ni tooi zaŋ bɛna n-leei yi daba, amaa yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim’ bɛna, di zaŋya ninkuunsi su taba.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: Sana bee tinzun nir’ yi be yi sani ka ti leei bundana, ka yi mabia mi leei faralana, ka zaŋ omaŋa pa talima san’ maa bee tinzun’ nir’ maa bee san’ maa yiŋ’ ninvuɣ’ so sani,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: dindina bɛ ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg’ o o ni zaŋ omaŋ’ pa talima maa nyaaŋa, o mabihi ni yino ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg’ o

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Ka di simdi ni o be o sani yuuni kam kaman padir’ la. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib’ o yi ninni.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ka o yi bi tooi deeg’ omaŋ’ soya ŋɔ zaa puuni, dindina bɛn’ bahim’ o min’ o bihi nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Dama n tumtumdiba n-nyɛ Izraɛlnima. Bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdi’ shɛba n ni daa yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: dindina n ni tin ya sakom saa mibu saha, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bindira niŋ pam, ka yi puri ni tihi wali wala.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Ka n tin ya suhudoo yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka yi ti dɔni tiŋa, ka so ku varisi ya. N ni ti yihi biŋkɔb’ biɛri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti ku lo tɔbu n-kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Ka yi ti kari doli yi dimnima n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi dɔɣi bihi n-nabi pahi, ka n kul gbibi n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl’ la.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Ka n ni ti be yi sani, ka ku lan zaɣisi ya.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: N kul ni be yi sani chana, ka nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi nyɛ n niriba.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni di chɛ ka yi ku lan nyɛ bɛ daba, n kabi yi nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi la, ka chɛ ka yi tooi chana ka yi zuɣuri ʒe tibi. Nol’ zaɣisibu tibidarigibo (Zaligu

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: dimbɔŋɔ ka n yɛn niŋ ya, n ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ya, ka chɛ ka dɔr’ shɛli din bahiri nir’ yoli lu yi zuɣu, dɔr’ shɛli din saɣindi nina ka nyɛ din diri nyɛvili. Ka yi ti biri yi bimbira yoli, dama yi dimnima n-ni ti di li.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka yi dimnim’ ti nyaŋ ya, ka sun ya. Ka yi ti guura ka so bi kariti ya.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim’ yi ti niŋ ka yi bi deei n noli, di saha n ni darigi yi tibili ʒiibuyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: N ni ti saɣim yi ni mali karimbaan’ shɛli nyuri bara maa, ka chɛ ka yi sagbana mi be kaman kurigu la,

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: ka yi tiŋgbani mi ti be kaman tahiʒiɛɣu. Yi ni ti yihi yi yaa tum tuma yoli, ka yi tiŋgbani ku niŋ bindirigu, ka di tihi gba ti ku wali wala.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: Di saha yi yi ti na kul zaɣisi n noli ka ku doli ma, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin kaman yi daalahichi ni galisi shɛm tariga.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: N ni ti chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri lu yi zuɣu, ka bɛ be yi sani n-gbahi yi bihi mini yi niɣi n-chɛ ka yi kalinli filim, ka yi soya bili mɔri.

english_verse: I'll remain your enemy and punish you even worse.
translation_verse: dindina n gba ni chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ’ ni ti ŋmɛn’ ya buyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: N ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu n-kun ya bɔhi biɛri alikauli la zuɣu. Ka yi yi ti zo n-kuli yi fɔntinsi ni, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ yi dimnim’ nuu ni.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: N ni ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro zaɣa, ka paɣiba pia ni ti mali yi bɔrɔbɔro dubil’ yini puuni, ka ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro maa tibisim, ka yi ti ŋub’ li ka bi tiɣi.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: dindina n ni zo ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ’ darigi yi tibili buyopɔin yi daalahichinim’ maa zuɣu.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Ka n ni ti saɣim yi jɛmbu shɛhi zaa, ka wurim yi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina, ka ti zaŋ ya zaɣ’ kpima pa yi buɣ’ kpima zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ya ni n suhu zaa.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ka n ti bahi yi fɔntinsi yoli, ka chɛ ka yi jɛmbu shɛhi leei dabari, ka m baɣa ku lan be yi binyɛra din nyom viɛl’ ni.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: N ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka di ti gari yi dimnim’ bɛn ti yɛn kana ti be di ni.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: N ni ti ŋooi takɔb’ lu yi zuɣu wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb’ ni, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari, ka chɛ ka yi fɔntinsi ti bahi yoli.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Di ni ti yɛn kpalim dabari saha shɛli maa ni zaa di ni ti vuhi vuhim shɛli yi ni daa be nimaani ka di bi nyari yi vuhim dabisa dal’ la.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ti tuuri taba kaman bɛ yɛn zomi yi takɔbi kum ni la, ka so bi kari doli ba, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tuhi yi dimnima.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Ka yi ti kpi tinzunnim’ maa sunsuuni, ka yi dimnim’ maa tiŋgbani ti vali ya.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni bɛn ti kpalim ni ti bahi yoli yi dimnim’ tiŋgbɔna ni bɛ mini bɛ yaannim’ daalahichi zuɣu, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛ yaannim’ maa.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n gba zaɣisi ba ka zaŋ ba tahi bɛ dimnim’ tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, di saha bɛ yi ti siɣisi bɛmaŋ’ bɛ suhuri din mali daɣiri maa ni ka niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: dindina n ni teei n ni daa lo Yaakubu mini Yisahaku ni Ibrahimma alikauli shɛŋa la yɛla, ka lan teei tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Amaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti chɛ ba ka leei dabari dɔni n-di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim saha shɛli bɛ ni ti lan ka di ni maa, dama bɛ ʒiɛm n zaligunima ka zaɣisi n zaligunim’ maa bɛ suhuri ni.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim’ zaa yoli, bɛ yi ti be bɛ dimnim’ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, n ti ku ʒiɛm ba bee n zaɣisi ba din ni chɛ ka n ku bɛ zaa ka saɣim n ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛl’ la, dama man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ zuɣu n ni teei n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim’ alikauli shɛl’ la yɛla, n ni daa yihi shɛb’ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na zuliya pam ninni nti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa mini kaya shɛŋa ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima, so yi po pɔri n-zaŋ daadam ti Yawɛ kaman yi ni zal o da’ shɛli,

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: Ka dilan’ yi nyɛla doo ŋun paai yuun’ pihinu zaŋ chana, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pinaanu, ka paɣ’ mi nyɛ bini pia.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: “Tiŋgbani maa atam bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu, di yi nyɛla tiŋgban’ ni bindira bee tihi wala, di nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka nyɛ din be kasi Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Ka do’ so yi nyɛla faralana ka ku tooi yo yi ni zali da’ shɛli maa, dindina yin’ zaŋmi dilan’ chaŋ maligumaana sani, ka o ti zal’ o daa, maligumaana ni zal’ o daa maa ka di dolila ŋun po pɔri maa dahima ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: “Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb’ so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara tiri Yawɛ, ninsal’ yi zaŋ biŋkɔbigu ti Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb’ so ŋun bi be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni ku zaŋ biŋkɔb’ so mali sara ti Yawɛ, dindina doo maa ŋun’ zaŋm’ biŋkɔbigu maa chaŋ maligumaana sani,

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: “So yi zaŋ o ni di tiŋgban’ shɛli fali yaɣ’ shɛli ti Yawɛ, dindina di daa yɛn dolila di ni yɛn tooi deei bimbira shɛm. Pal’ shɛli din ni biri siŋkaafa tah’ ayi daa ni nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Ka o yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi nɛma labisi ti yuuni puuni yi ni zal’ li da’ shɛli, di daa n-kul yɛn bala.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ yi ti deei puu maa chuɣu puhibu la saha, di ni nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ pu’ shɛli ti Yawɛ. Maligumaana n-ni ti su li.

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: dindina maligumaana ni zali di daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, ka dilan’ ni yo di liɣiri dindali maa ka di leei din be kasi Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka yi labisi puu maa ti bɛ ni daa da li ninvuɣ’ so sani maa, ŋun daa su li, ka di nyɛla o di li la fali maa.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Yi daa kam ni dolila jɛmbu duu sania. Gɛra bini pisi n-ni nyɛ anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ’ yini.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: “Amaa biŋkɔbigu ni tuui dɔɣi bi’ so nyɛla Yawɛ ni su so, di bi simdi ka so ti lan zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, o nyɛla Yawɛ dini.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: “Amaa so yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti Yawɛ zaa, di yi nyɛla daadam bee biŋkɔbigu bee o ni di tiŋgban’ shɛli fali, di bi simdi ni bɛ kɔhi li bee n-yo di zuɣu ka dee’ li, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Yawɛ nyɛla din be kasi zaa.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni zaŋ so ti Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn ku so, so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg’ o, bɛ kul ni ku o mi.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: So yi bɔr’ ni o yo pia kam puuni yim maa zuɣu ka dee’ li, o ni yo di daa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Ka nahu kam mini piɛɣu kam ŋun pahiri pia ka nyɛ biŋkɔbigul’ ni guli so nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ ni daa yi Ijipti chana, di yuma ayi nyaaŋa gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni Sinai mɔɣu ni.

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: dɔbba bɛn zaa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka paai yuun’ pisi bee n-gar’ lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni. A mini Aduna sabimi bɛ yuya kaman bɛ daŋ kam ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa zaŋ bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ yuya ŋɔ

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: n-chɛ ka bɛ laɣim niriba maa zaa na gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayi dahin yini dali, ka bɛ mini bɛ zuliya ti sab’ bɛ yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn paai yuun’ pisi bee n-gari lala

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Lala ka Izraɛlnim’ daa niŋ. Bɛ daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Amaa Lɛvinim’ maa bɛn’ tim’ bɛ suɣa gili alikauli suɣili maa n-gul’ li, ka Naawuni suhu ti ku yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu.”

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim’ ni bɛ daŋ niriba pahi bɛ ni.

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli Musa,

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Lɛvinim’ zuliya kɔŋko ka a ku kali, a mi di sab’ bɛ yuya pahi Izraɛlnim’ ni.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti yɛn sibigi suɣili maa chaŋ, Lɛvinim’ n-yɛn sibigi li; ka yi yi ti yɛn sa li, Lɛvinim’ maa n-yɛn zaŋ li sa. Ka ninvuɣ’ zino yi miri suɣili maa na, yin’ kum’ o.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ bɛn kpalim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zalizali.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: Chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim’ ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zali di ni simdi ni bɛ ʒi luɣ’ shɛŋa mini bɛ yaannim’ dunoya tuutanim’ ni sa luɣ’ shɛŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ suɣa maa noya kpa laɣiŋgu suɣili maa luɣilikam polo.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihinunaayopɔin ni kɔbisinahi.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinu.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim’ zaŋ laɣiŋgu suɣili la be suɣa maa sunsuuni doli kaman bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa maa zali shɛm, ka sokam ʒe o zaashee o tuuta gbini.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim’ kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Niriba bɛn daa be nimaani gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihitanaanu ni kɔbisinahi.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihinahi ni yini ni kɔbisinu.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihinunaata ni kɔbisinahi.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim’ pahi Izraɛlnim’ kalinli ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun zali Musa shɛm la.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ daa kul niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Bɛ ni daa tiri bɛ suɣa ʒiini bɛ tuutanim’ gbini shɛm, lala ka sokam min’ o malibu daa doli chani kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
translation_verse: Aduna bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: O bituuli Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Amaa Nadab mini Abihu bɛn daa kpila Yawɛ tooni, bɛ ni daa zaŋ buɣim shɛli din bi simdi n-nyo sara maligu Sinai Zoli gbini mɔɣu ni la zuɣu. english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

translation_verse: Amaa sabimi Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa yuya n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi maligumaanitali tuma, ka ninvuɣ’ zino yi ka bɛ sanna, yin’ kum’ o.”

english_verse: Moses, I have chosen these Levites from all Israel, and they will belong to me in a special way. translation_verse: dama bikpamba zaa nyɛla n ni su shɛba; n ni daa ku bikpamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka n daa zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni bikpamba bɛn nyɛ ninsalinim’ zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri bikpamba zaa leei n ni su shɛba. Bɛ nyɛla n ni su shɛba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.” Bɛ kali Lɛvinima

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai mɔɣu ni,

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: “Kalim’ Lɛvinima kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm dɔbba bɛn nyɛ kaman gol’ yini zaŋ chana.”

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Lɛvinim’ maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kɔhat bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Mɛrari bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mahili mini Mushi. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Lɛvinim’ zuliya kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa nyɛ Libini daŋ mini Shimɛi daŋ; Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa bala.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa n-daa su Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni mini di nyaaŋa binshɛŋa bɛ ni mali pindi li tuma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su Pateesa shɛli din yili di dunol’ ni

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: mini Pateesa shɛŋa din yili dundɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili pateesa shɛli din daa yili dundɔŋ ni dunol’ ni n-liri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili mini sara maligu bimbin’ la ni di mihi zaŋ tabili di tuuni kam fukumsi.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Amiram yiŋnima mini Izar yiŋnima ni Hiburɔn yiŋnima ni Uziɛl yiŋnima; Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa bala.

english_verse: The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ka Uziɛl bia Ɛlizafan daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa dɔɣirikpɛma.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. translation_verse: Bɛna n-daa su Alikauli Adaka la mini teebuli ni firilatamdigu ni sara maligu bimbina ni la’ shɛŋa maligumaaniba ni daa zaŋdi tumdi tuma la zaŋ tabili Pateesa la ni di tuuni kam fukumsi.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la bia Ɛliɛza n-daa nyɛ Lɛvinim’ kpamba maa zuɣulana; ŋuna n-daa lihiri ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn su luɣ’ kasi shee la.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Mɛrari zuliya n-daa nyɛ Mahilinim’ daŋ mini Mushinim’ daŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Mɛrari zuliya.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Mɛrari zuliya maa dɔɣirikpɛma n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bia Zuriɛl. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila laɣiŋgu suɣili maa nuzaa polo.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Bɛn mi daa yɛn ti bɛ suɣa zali Naawuni jɛmbu shee tooni wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tooni wulimpuhili polo n-daa nyɛ Musa mini Aduna ni o bidibisi.
