english_verse: “And I saw this vision about the Amalekites: Their nation is now great, but it will someday disappear forever.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Balaam daa lihi Amalɛknima, ka tɔɣis’ o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, “Amalɛknima n-daa be zuliya kam tooni, Amaa bɛ bahigu ni ti nyɛla bahi yoli zaa.”

english_verse: “And this is what I saw about the Kenites: They think they're safe, living among the rocks,
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lihi Kɛnnim’ gba, ka tɔɣis’ o daanabitali yɛli, “Yi biɛhigu shee nyɛla barina ni ka luɣ’ shɛli. Yi biɛhigu shee maa ŋmanila tiɛɣu din pa kuɣili zuɣu.

english_verse: but they will be wiped out when Assyria conquers them.
translation_verse: Amaa Ashurinim’ ni ti gbahi yinim’ Kɛnnim’ ti leei daba, ka kun ya.”

english_verse: Ships will come from Cyprus, bringing people who will invade the lands of Assyria and Eber. But finally, Cyprus itself will be ruined.”
translation_verse: Saipurusinim’ ni ti kpe ŋarima kana ti liri ya. Bɛ ni ti nyaŋ Ashurinim’ mini Ɛbanima. Amaa bɛ gba ni ti bahi yoli zaa.”

english_verse: After Balaam finished, he started home, and Balak also left.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Balaam daa yiɣisi kul’ o ya, ka Balak gba ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi.

english_verse: While the Israelites were camped at Acacia, some of the men had sex with Moabite women.
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ ni daa be Akasia saha shɛli ka bɛ daa piligi bɔri Mɔab paɣiba.

english_verse: These women then invited the men to ceremonies where sacrifices were offered to their gods. The men ate the meat from the sacrifices and worshiped the Moabite gods.
translation_verse: Ka paɣiba maa daa booni Izraɛlnim’ maa chani bɛ buɣa maligunim’ ni, ka bɛ ti jɛmdi buɣa maa ka diri di maligu bindira.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with Israel because they had worshiped the god Baal Peor.
translation_verse: Lala ka Izraɛlnim’ daa niŋ kpe Pɛɔr buɣili Baal jɛmbu ni. Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu

english_verse: So he said to Moses, “Take the Israelite leaders who are responsible for this and have them killed in front of my sacred tent where everyone can see. Maybe then I will stop being angry with the Israelites.”
translation_verse: ka o yɛli Musa, “Gbahim’ niriba maa toondaannima n-zaŋ kpana kuhi ba tabili bini zali wuntaŋa man’ Yawɛ tooni, ka n vuui n suhuyiɣisili titali maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.”

english_verse: Moses told Israel's officials, “Each of you must put to death any of your men who worshiped Baal.”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuɣulaannima, “Yi zaa yinoyino kum’ yi ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn kpe Pɛɔr Baal jɛmbu ni maa.”

english_verse: Later, Moses and the people were at the sacred tent, crying, when one of the Israelite men brought a Midianite woman to meet his family.
translation_verse: Musa mini Izraɛlnim’ ni daa be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni n-kumdi saha shɛli maa, ka Izraɛl do’ so daa zaŋ Midian paɣ’ na ti kpe o suɣili ni bɛ zaa ninni.

english_verse: Phinehas, the grandson of Aaron the priest, saw the couple and left the crowd. He found a spear
translation_verse: Ka Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Aduna yaaŋa la daa nya lala ka yiɣisi niriba maa ni kpuɣi kpani

english_verse: and followed the man into his tent, where he ran the spear through the man and into the woman's stomach. The Lord immediately stopped punishing Israel with a deadly disease,
translation_verse: n-doli Izraɛl doo maa ti kpe o duu puuni n-zaŋ kpani maa kuhi Izraɛl doo maa mini paɣ’ maa zaa puya ni ku ba. Ka alɔbo din daa lu Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu maa daa zani tariga.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: “In my anger, I would have wiped out the Israelites if Phinehas had not been faithful to me.
translation_verse: “Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun nyɛ maligumaana Aduna yaaŋa ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni Izraɛlnim’ ni n-zani n zaani mahi n suhu, ka m bi chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili di Izraɛlnima.

english_verse: But instead of punishing them, I forgave them. So because of the loyalty that Phinehas showed, I solemnly promise that he and his descendants will always be my priests.”
translation_verse: ka di nyɛ o min’ o zuliya maligumaanitali alikauli ʒiɛmani kam ni, dama o zab’ nyuli ti o Naawuni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.’ ”

english_verse: The Israelite man that was killed was Zimri son of Salu, who was one of the leaders of the Simeon tribe.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa ku Izraɛl do’ so mini Midian paɣ’ maa yuli n-daa booni Zimiri. O daa nyɛla Salu bia, ka lan nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya niriba dɔɣirikpɛma.

english_verse: And the Midianite woman killed with him was Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite clan leader named Zur.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ ni daa ku Midian paɣ’ so maa mi yuli daa boonila Kɔzibi. O daa nyɛla Zur bipuɣiŋga, ka Zur daa nyɛ o daŋ ni niriba dɔɣirikpɛma Midian.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: “The Midianites are now enemies of Israel, so attack and defeat them! They tricked the people of Israel into worshiping their god at Peor, and they are responsible for the death of Cozbi, the daughter of one of their own leaders.”
translation_verse: bɛ ni daa nahim ya, ka yɔhim ya Pɛɔr yɛla ni la mini Kɔzibi yɛla ni la zuɣu. Kɔzibi daa nyɛla Midian toondaan’ so bipuɣiŋga, ka nyɛ bɛ tizɔpaɣ’ so bɛ ni daa ku Pɛɔr alɔbo la dal’ la.”

english_verse: After the Lord had stopped the deadly disease from killing the Israelites, he said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron,
translation_verse: Alɔbo maa lubu nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini maligumaana Aduna bia Ɛliɛza,

english_verse: “I want you to find out how many Israelites are in each family. Then make a list of every man
translation_verse: “Kalimiya Izraɛlnim’ zaa ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun’ pisi zaŋ chana kaman bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka ni tooi chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu.”

english_verse: Israel was now camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from the town of Jericho. Moses and Eleazar told them
translation_verse: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa yɛli niriba maa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, ka be Jɛriko tooni polo la,

english_verse: Pallu was the father of Eliab
translation_verse: Pallu zuliya n-daa nyɛ Ɛliab.

english_verse: and the grandfather of Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram who had been chosen by the people, but who followed Korah and rebelled against Moses, Aaron, and the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Ɛliab mi zuliya daa nyɛ Nɛmuɛl mini Datan ni Abiram. Datan mini Abiram daa nyɛla niriba ni daa pii shɛba. Bɛna n-daa pahi Kɔra min’ o nyaaŋa zuɣu n-taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ, ka yɛli Musa mini Aduna finafina,

english_verse: That's when the Lord made the earth open up and swallow Dathan, Abiram, and Korah. At the same time, fire destroyed
translation_verse: ka tiŋgbani daa bɔɣi, ka bɛ mini Kɔra zaa lu di ni ka buɣim di bɛ ninvuɣ’ kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka bɛ kpi, ka tiŋgbani maa mum ba niŋ; ka di leei saɣisigu yɛlli ʒiɛya la.

english_verse: But the Korahite clan wasn't destroyed.
translation_verse: Amaa Kɔra zuliya bɛn daa bi kpi.

english_verse: None of the people that Moses and Aaron had counted in the Sinai Desert were still alive,
translation_verse: Amaa Musa mini maligumaana Aduna ni daa pun sab’ Izraɛlnim’ shɛb’ yuya Sinai mɔɣu ni la so daa ka bɛ ni daa sab’ shɛb’ yuya ŋɔ kalinli maa ni.

english_verse: Aaron was the father of Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Aduna bihi n-daa nyɛ Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: “Divide the land of Canaan among these tribes, according to the number of people in each one,
translation_verse: “Pirigim’ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tari niriba maa kaman bɛ yuya kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: I will show you what land to give each tribe, and they will receive as much land as they need, according to the number of people in it.”
translation_verse: Bɛ pihim’ kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn daŋ niriba galisi mini bɛn daŋ niriba pɔra.”

english_verse: as well as the clans of Libni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi, and Korah. Kohath the Levite was the father of Amram,
translation_verse: Lɛvi zuliya niriba m-bɔŋɔ: Libini daŋ niriba mini Hiburɔn daŋ niriba ni Mahili daŋ niriba ni Mushi daŋ niriba ni Kɔra daŋ niriba. Amiram ba n-daa nyɛ Kɔhat.

english_verse: the husband of Levi's daughter Jochebed, who was born in Egypt. Amram and Jochebed's three children were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
translation_verse: Amiram paɣ’ yuli n-daa booni Jokɛbɛd ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi ni daa dɔɣi bipuɣin’ so Ijipti la. Ka Jokɛbɛd daa dɔɣi Aduna mini Musa ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ’ Miriam Amiram yiŋa.

english_verse: But Nadab and Abihu had died when they offered fire that was unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Nadab mini Abihu daa ti zaŋ buɣim din bi viɛla n-nyo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ka kpi.

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar counted the Israelites while they were camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni daa sab’ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ yuya saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim’ Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili yaɣili Jɛriko tooni polo la m-bala.

english_verse: except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun. The Lord had said that everyone else would die there in the desert.
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli ni bɛ ni kpi mɔɣu maa ni. Bɛ ni so daa bi kpalim, naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua kɔŋko.

english_verse: One day his daughters went to the sacred tent, where they met with Moses, Eleazar, and some other leaders of Israel, as well as a large crowd of Israelites. The young women said:
translation_verse: Bɛna n-daa kana ti zani Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba ni salo zaa tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni yɛli,

english_verse: You know that our father died in the desert. But it was for something he did wrong, not for joining with Korah in rebelling against the Lord. Our father left no sons
translation_verse: “Ti ba daa kpila mɔɣu la ni. O daa ka ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn daa laɣim pahi Kɔra zuɣu taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ la kalinli ni, amaa omaŋmaŋ’ daalahichi zuɣu ka o daa kpi; ka mi ka bidibisi.

english_verse: to carry on his family name. But why should his name die out for that reason? Give us some land like the rest of his relatives in our clan, so our father's name can live on.
translation_verse: Ti ba maa ni ka bidibisi maa zuɣu ka o yuli yɛn kpi o daŋ ni maa? Timiya ti ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ti ba maa mabihi sani.”

english_verse: Moses asked the Lord what should be done,
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa ka Yawɛ tooni na.

english_verse: and the Lord answered:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: Zelophehad's daughters are right. They should each be given part of the land their father would have received.
translation_verse: Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya. Timiya ba bɛ tarili bɛ ba mabihi maa sani, ka bɛ ba tarili leei bɛ dini.

english_verse: If he has no daughter, his brothers will inherit the land.
translation_verse: Ka o yi ka bipuɣiŋga, yin’ zaŋmiy’ o fali ti o mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.

english_verse: But if he has no brothers, his father's brothers will inherit the land.
translation_verse: Ka o yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin’ zaŋmiy’ o fali maa ti o ba mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.

english_verse: And if his father has no brothers, the land must be given to his nearest relative in the clan. This is my law, and the Israelites must obey it. Joshua Is Appointed Israel's Leader (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Ka o ba maa yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin’ zaŋmiya o fali maa ti o dɔɣir’ so ŋun nyɛ o talahi nira o daŋ ni, ka o su li. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu Izraɛlnim’ sani kaman Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm.” Bɛ pii Jɔshua zali Musa zaani (Zaligu

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “One day you will go up into the Abarim Mountains, and from there you will see the land I am giving the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Dum’ Abarim zoya din pie tab’ ŋɔ zuɣu ti nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim’ maa.

english_verse: After you have seen it, you will die, just like your brother Aaron,
translation_verse: Ka a yi nya li, a gba ni chaŋ ti pah’ a yaannim’ zuɣu kaman a biɛli Aduna ni pahi bɛ zuɣu shɛm la.

english_verse: because both of you disobeyed me at Meribah near the town of Kadesh in the Zin Desert. When the Israelites insulted me there, you didn't believe in my holy power.”
translation_verse: Dama Izraɛlnim’ ni daa taai duŋ niŋ ma Zin mɔɣu ni la, a daa zaɣisi n yɛligu, ka chɛ ka niriba maa bi nya n kasitali kom la shee.” .

english_verse: “You are the Lord God, and you know what is in everyone's heart. So I ask you to appoint a leader for Israel.
translation_verse: “Nyin’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ, piim’ ninvuɣ’ so leei niriba maa toondana,

english_verse: Your people need someone to lead them into battle, or else they will be like sheep wandering around without a shepherd.”
translation_verse: ka o zaŋdi ba chani tɔbu ni ka zaŋdi ba labirina; ka di chɛ ka nyin’ Yawɛ niriba ku be kaman piɛri bɛn ka gula.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Joshua son of Nun can do the job. Place your hands on him to show that he is the one to take your place.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Piim’ Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun mali biɛrisuŋ la n-zaŋ a nuu pa o zuɣu;

english_verse: Then go with him and tell him to stand in front of Eleazar the priest and the Israelites. Appoint Joshua as their new leader
translation_verse: ka zaŋ o zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini niriba maa zaa tooni n-zaŋ o leei bɛ toondana bɛ zaa ninni.

english_verse: and tell them they must now obey him, just as they obey you.
translation_verse: Zaŋm’ a yiko ŋɔ shɛli ti o, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ zaa deer’ o noli.

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions and took Joshua to Eleazar and the people,
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Jɔshua ti zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini salo maa zaa tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal’ o shɛm maa.

english_verse: then he placed his hands on Joshua and appointed him Israel's leader.
translation_verse: Ka ŋun’ Musa daa zaŋ o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu n-zaŋ o leei toondana kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal’ o ni o niŋ shɛm.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛlabih’ ayopɔin la zaɣ’ yino kam zuɣu.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices will please me.
translation_verse: ka bo zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram yini n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛlabil’ yino kam zuɣu mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛla.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Offer sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, so that I will smell the smoke and be pleased.
translation_verse: Zalim’ Izraɛlnim’ zaligu n-yɛli ba, “M pina din nyɛ bindir’ shɛŋa yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim’ tiri ma ka di nyom niŋdi ma nyaɣisim la, zaŋmiya li tim’ ma di tibu saha.”

english_verse: Each day offer two rams a year old as sacrifices to please me. The animals must have nothing wrong with them;
translation_verse: Ka a lan yɛli ba: Yi ni ti yɛn zaŋdi pin’ shɛŋa nyɔri buɣim dabisili kam tiri Yawɛ ka di nyɛ yi sahakam sara n-nyɛ yuun’ yini piɛlabih’ ayi bɛn ka dansi.

english_verse: Finally, along with each of these two sacrifices, a liter of wine must be poured on the altar as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya di binnyura lita yini sara m-pahi piɛlabil’ yino kam zuɣu, ka booi binnyuri kpiɔŋ bahi luɣ’ kasi shee m-mali binnyura sara ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: On the first day of each month, bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Yi goli kam piligu ni, bomiya naɣilabih’ ayi mini piɛla’ yino ni yuun’ yini piɛlabih’ ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Lan bomiya zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi naɣilaa kam zuɣu; ka lan zaŋ zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛla’ yino zuɣu;

english_verse: Celebrate Passover in honor of me on the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ’ pinaanahi dali nyɛla Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu sara malibu dabisili.

english_verse: The following day will begin the Festival of Thin Bread, which will last for a week. During this time you must honor me by eating bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Goli maa biɛɣ’ pinaanu dali nyɛla chuɣu, yi yɛn ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin.

english_verse: On the first day of this festival, you must rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: Dabisili din daŋ tooni dali yin’ laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun’ shɛli.

english_verse: Bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. And then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya naɣilabih’ ayi mini piɛla’ yino ni yuun’ yini piɛlabih’ ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri chi zim viɛl’ shɛli; ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣila’ yino kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla’ yino zuɣu,

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛlabih’ ayopɔin la zaɣ’ yino kam zuɣu.

english_verse: All of these are to be offered each day of the festival in additional to the regular sacrifices, and the smoke from them will please me.
translation_verse: Ka lan zaŋ bindira nyo buɣim mali sara daba ayopɔin. Di nyɛla din nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani. Niŋmiya li pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di binnyura zuɣu.

english_verse: Then on the last day of the festival, you must once again rest from work and come together for worship. The Sacrifices during the Harvest Festival (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ka di yi ti paai daba ayopɔin dali, yin’ laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun’ shɛli. Puri atam kpuɣibu chuɣu puhibu sara (Lɛvinima

english_verse: On the first day of the Harvest Festival, you must rest from your work, come together for worship, and bring a sacrifice of new grain.
translation_verse: Yi bindiri pala din daŋ niŋbu dabisili din nyɛ yi ni zaŋdi kapala tiri Yawɛ yi dakulɔdakulo churi puhibu ni la dali, yin’ laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya yi tuun’ shɛli.

english_verse: Offer two young bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ san’ la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabih’ ayi mini piɛla’ yino ni yuun’ yini piɛlabih’ ayopɔin.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl’ shɛli, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla’ yino zuɣu;

english_verse: Also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya bula’ yino mali yi daalahichi sanyoo sara.

english_verse: The animals must have nothing wrong with them and are to be sacrificed along with the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Niŋmiya lala pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara zuɣu n-zaŋ di mini di binnyura sara mali sara. Di bi simdi ni bɛ mali dansi.

english_verse: On the first day of the seventh month, you must rest from your work and come together to celebrate at the sound of the trumpets.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,

translation_verse: Zaŋmiya bula’ yino mal’ alahichi sanyoo sara pahi sara shɛli din kpihindi alahichi la mini yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la ni di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu. Suɣa tibu chuɣu puhibu sara (Lɛvinima

english_verse: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.

english_verse: For the next six days of the festival, you will sacrifice one less bull than the day before, so that on the seventh day, seven bulls will be sacrificed. The other sacrifices and offerings must remain the same for each of these days.
translation_verse: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula’ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.

english_verse: On the eighth day, you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: Dabisili din pah’ anii dali, yin’ laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni ka di tumiya tuun’ shɛli.

english_verse: Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Malimiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ san’ la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣila’ yino mini piɛla’ yino ni yuun’ yini piɛlabih’ ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi;

english_verse: You must also offer the proper grain sacrifices and drink offerings of wine with each animal.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa ni piɛbihi la zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: And offer a goat as the sacrifice to ask forgiveness for the people. These sacrifices are made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mali alahichi sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.

english_verse: You must offer all these sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, together with any offerings that are voluntarily given or given because of a promise.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya dimbɔŋɔnim’ maani sara tiri Yawɛ yi churi puhibu ni m-pahi yi pɔri pɔbu sara mini yi suhuyubu sara kaman yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni yi chi sara ni yi binnyura sara ni yi biɛrisuŋ sara la zuɣu.

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel everything the Lord had told him about the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim’ Yawɛ ni zal’ o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam maa zaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to Israel's tribal leaders:
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuliya kam kpamba: Yawɛ ni zali zaligu shɛli m-bɔŋɔ:

english_verse: Suppose a young woman who is still living with her parents makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka paɣa yi po pɔri Yawɛ sani ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o paɣisarilim ni saha shɛl’ o ni be o ba yiŋa,

english_verse: But if he hears about it and objects, then she no longer has to keep her promise. The Lord will forgive her, because her father did not agree with the promise.
translation_verse: Amaa o ba yi bi saɣ’ o ni lo ni o niŋ shɛm maa o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, o ni po pɔ’ shɛŋa min’ o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa shɛli ku zani; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali o ba ni bi saɣi maa zuɣu.

english_verse: Suppose a woman makes a promise to the Lord and then gets married. If her husband later hears about the promise but says nothing, she must do what she said, whether she meant it or not.
translation_verse: ka o yidana maa wum li, ka bi yɛl’ o shɛli o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, dindina o pɔri maa min’ o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa ni zani.

english_verse: But if her husband hears about the promise and objects, she no longer has to keep it, and the Lord will forgive her.
translation_verse: Amaa o yidan’ maa yi bi saɣi li o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, dindina o ni ku o pɔri maa min’ o noli ni daa faag’ o ka o yɛli yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa ni o niŋ shɛl’ la; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali.

english_verse: Widows and divorced women must keep every promise they make to the Lord.
translation_verse: Amaa pakoli bee paɣ’ so ŋun yi dooyili yi po pɔri ni o niŋ shɛli, fashee ka di zani.

english_verse: Suppose a married woman makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka paɣ’ yi po pɔri ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o yidan’ yiŋa,

english_verse: But if he hears about the promise and does object, she no longer has to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her husband would not allow her to keep the promise.
translation_verse: Amaa o yidan’ maa yi zaɣisi li o ni wum di yɛla saha shɛli maa, dindina yɛtɔɣ’ shɛlikam din yi o nol’ ni na zaŋ chaŋ o pɔri maa min’ o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa ku zani; o yidan’ ni zaɣisi li maa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali.

english_verse: Her husband has the final say about any promises she makes to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka o yi po pɔri shɛlikam ni o niŋ shɛli, o yidana mali soli ni o saɣi li bee n-zaɣisi li.

english_verse: If her husband hears about a promise and says nothing about it for a whole day, she must do what she said—since he did not object, the promise must be kept.
translation_verse: Amaa o yidana yi wum pɔri maa yɛla ka bi yɛl’ o shɛli dabisili din paya dali, dindina di wuhiya ni o saɣ’ o ni po pɔ’ shɛŋa min’ o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaa ni o niŋ shɛli maa, o ni daa wum di yɛla saha shɛli ka bi yɛl’ o shɛli maa zuɣu.

english_verse: But if he waits until the next day to stop her from keeping her promise, he is the one who must be punished.
translation_verse: Amaa o yi wum di yɛla ka di niŋ daba yi ha, di nyaaŋa ka o ti yɛn zaɣisi li, dindina paɣ’ maa taali ni ʒi doo maa zuɣu.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave Moses about husbands and wives, and about young daughters who still live at home.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa zaligu shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ doo min’ o paɣa polo ni zaŋ chaŋ doo min’ o bipuɣiŋga ŋun na be o ba yiŋa ka nyɛ paɣisarili polo m-bala.

english_verse: “Before you die, make sure that the Midianites are punished for what they did to Israel.”
translation_verse: “Bɔhimi Midiannim’ biɛri ti Izraɛlnima. Di nyaaŋa n ni deeg’ a nyɛvili.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “The Lord wants to punish the Midianites. So tell our men to prepare for battle.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, “Chɛliya ka yi ni shɛb’ lo kpara n-chaŋ ti tuhi Midiannima m-bɔhi ba biɛri ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: Twelve thousand men were picked from the tribes of Israel, and after they were prepared for battle,
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa pii ninvuɣ’ tuhilituhili Izraɛl zuliya kam ni, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi tɔbbihi tuhi’ pinaayi n-lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔb’ maa ni.

english_verse: Moses sent them off to war. Phinehas the son of Eleazar went with them and took along some things from the sacred tent and the trumpets for sounding the battle signal.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa chɛ ka bɛ ninvuɣ’ tuhilituhili bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na maa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa gbibi Naawuni jɛmbu shee lahi mini kikahi din ni piɛbi boli niriba o nuu ni la chaŋ tɔb’ maa ni.

english_verse: The Israelites fought against the Midianites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. They killed all the men,
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa tuhi Midiannim’ maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm n-ku dɔbba zaa.

english_verse: The Israelites captured every woman and child, then led away the Midianites' cattle and sheep, and took everything else that belonged to them.
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ daa gbahi Midian paɣiba mini bɛ bihi, ka gbahi bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu zaa, ka di bɛ nɛma zaa chaŋ.

english_verse: They also burned down the Midianite towns and villages.
translation_verse: Bɛ daa nyo bɛ fɔntin’ shɛŋa ni bɛ ni daa be mini bɛ sansana zaa buɣim.

english_verse: Israel's soldiers gathered together everything they had taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni di neen’ shɛŋa zaa m-pahi ninsalinim’ mini biŋkɔbiri.

english_verse: Then they returned to their own camp in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, where Moses, Eleazar, and the other Israelite leaders met the troops outside camp.
translation_verse: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa yi bɛ sansani maa ni na chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli.

english_verse: and said, “I can't believe you let the women live!
translation_verse: Musa daa bɔhi ba mi, “Yi chɛla paɣiba ŋɔ zaa ka bi ku ba?

english_verse: You must put to death every boy and all the women who have ever had sex.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kumiya bidibbihi mini paɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn pun baŋ dɔbba la zaa.

english_verse: But do not kill the young women who have never had sex. You may keep them for yourselves.”
translation_verse: Amaa paɣisar’ shɛb’ bɛn na bi baŋ dɔbba la, chɛliya bɛna n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi paɣiba.

english_verse: Then Moses said to the soldiers, “If you killed anyone or touched a dead body, you are unclean and have to stay outside the camp for seven days. On the third and seventh days, you must go through a ceremony to make yourselves and your captives clean.
translation_verse: Ŋunkam ku nira mini ŋunkam shihi kpima, benya sambani ŋɔ ni daba ayopɔin. Yi mini yi ni gbahi ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ na maa zaa malimiya yimaŋa n-niŋ kasi daba ata dali mini daba ayopɔin dali.

english_verse: Then wash your clothes and anything made from animal skin, goat's hair, or wood.”
translation_verse: Malimiya yi binyɛra zaa mini yi binshɛŋa din nyɛ biŋkɔbiri gbana ni buhi kɔbiri binyara zaa ni dari binyara zaa ka di niŋ kasi.”

english_verse: Eleazar then explained, “If you need to purify something that won't burn, such as gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead, you must first place it in a hot fire. After you take it out, sprinkle it with the water that purifies. Everything else should only be sprinkled with the water. Do all of this, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
translation_verse: buɣim ni ku di binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ buɣim ni m-mal’ li ka di niŋ kasi. Amaa faashee ka yi bahi zaŋ kom din maani binyara ka di be kasi paɣi li. Ka binshɛŋa din mi ku tooi kpe buɣim ni, yin’ zaŋmiya kom paɣi li.

english_verse: Wash your clothes on the seventh day, and after that, you will be clean and may return to the camp.” Everything Taken from the Midianites Is Divided
translation_verse: Paɣimiya yi situra daba ayopɔin dali din ni chɛ ka yi be kasi. Di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi kpe sansani ŋɔ ni na.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: Make a list of everything taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals. Then divide them between the soldiers and the rest of the people. Eleazar the priest and the family leaders will help you.
translation_verse: Pirigimiya bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa na maa ʒiibuyi n-zaŋ yim ti tɔbbihi bɛn chaŋ tɔbu ni maa, ka zaŋ yim la mi ti Izraɛlnim’ zaa.

english_verse: From the half that belongs to the soldiers, set aside for the Lord one out of every
translation_verse: Yihimiya li bɛ tarili maa ni n-zaŋ ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza ka o zaŋ mali sara ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: So we want to give the Lord all the gold jewelry we took from the Midianites. It's our gift to him for watching over us and our troops.”
translation_verse: Ka ti zaŋ ti zaa yinoyino ni nya salima binshɛŋa din nyɛ nuhi ni bansi ni zoligɔnim’ ni nintuhi din dihiri gbana zuɣu ni tibikpara ni yɛri na ni ti ti mali sara ti daalahichi zuɣu Yawɛ sani.”

english_verse: women and gave them to Eleazar to be dedicated to the Lord. Then from the half that belonged to the people, Moses set aside one out of every
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa di neen’ shɛŋa na maa puuni binshɛŋa din daa kpalim ka tɔbbihi maa zaŋ li kalinli daa nyɛla piɛri tuhi’ kɔbisiyɔbu ni tuhi’ pisopɔinnaanu

english_verse: and listed everything that had been taken from the Midianites. The list included
translation_verse: ni ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihitanaayi bɛn daa nyɛ paɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn na bi baŋ dɔbba la.

english_verse: and said, “Sir, we have counted our troops, and not one soldier is missing.
translation_verse: nti yɛl’ o, “Tinim’ bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ kali ti ni su tɔbbi’ shɛb’ fukumsi n-nya ka ti zaa beni.

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar accepted the jewelry from the commanders,
translation_verse: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa deei bɛ ni daa zaŋ salima mali binshɛŋa maa zaa.

english_verse: then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others.
translation_verse: ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di nyaaŋa yi ni tooi labina, ka ku mali talahi yɛl’ shɛli Yawɛ mini Izraɛlnim’ sani; ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ leei yi ni su shɛli Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland.
translation_verse: Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba daa mali niɣi pam. Bɛ ni daa nya ka Jaza mini Giliad tiŋgbana simdi niɣi biɛhigu shee,

english_verse: So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said,
translation_verse: ka bɛ daa ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba sanna ti yɛli ba,

english_verse: “The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep,
translation_verse: din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa nyaŋ tin’ shɛŋa nim’ ti Izraɛlnim’ la nyɛla di ni simdi ni niɣi be tiŋgban’ shɛŋa ni; ka tinim’ bɛn nyɛ yi daba ŋɔ mi mali niɣi.”

english_verse: would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own?”
translation_verse: Bɛ daa lan yɛli, “Ka yi nini yi tiɣi tinim’ bɛn nyɛ yi daba ŋɔ, yin’ zaŋmiya tiŋgbani maa ti ti ka di leei ti dini, ka di zaŋya ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.”

english_verse: Moses answered: You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle?
translation_verse: Amaa ka Musa daa bɔhi Gaad mini Rubin zuliya maa, “Yi mabihi maa cham’ ti tuhi tɔbu ka yinim’ kpalim be kpe?

english_verse: If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them.
translation_verse: Bɔzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim’ yɛn chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa su, ka yi bɔri ni yi gbarigi ba?

english_verse: This is exactly what happened when I sent your ancestors from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land.
translation_verse: Lala ka yi yaannim’ daa niŋ n ni daa tim ba ka bɛ yi Kadɛshibarinia chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la.

english_verse: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa chaŋ ti paai Ɛshikol vinvamli ni n-nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa, bɛ daa gbarigila Izraɛlnima ni bɛ di chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa.

english_verse: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli ba, “Yi yi ni niŋ lala, dindina yin’ lomiya kpara Yawɛ nini ŋɔ ni n-chaŋ tɔb’ maa ni.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Giliad maa ti Manaasa bia Makiri ka o ʒini nimaani.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yinim’ alahichinim’ ŋɔ yiɣisimi zani yi yaannim’ zaashee ni yi chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu!

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Yi yi chɛ o dolibu, o ni lan chɛ niriba ŋɔ bahi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka yinima n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn ku ninvuɣ’ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ka Musa sanna ti yɛl’ o, “Ti ni me fɔntinsi kpe n-zaŋ ti bihi niŋ di ni, ka me buzɔna n-zaŋ ti piɛri mini ti buhi niŋ di ni.

english_verse: where they can stay and be safe. Then we'll prepare to fight and lead the other tribes into battle.
translation_verse: Amaa tinim’ ni lo kpara gari Izraɛlnim’ tooni chaŋ ti nya ʒiishee ti ba, ka ti bihi be bɛ ni me goma gili tin’ shɛŋa ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim’ zuɣu la ni.

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: Ti ku lab’ ti yinsi faashee ka Izraɛlnim’ zaa ti nya bɛmaŋmaŋ’ tiŋgbana.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Dama pa ti mini ba n-yɛn deei Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli mini di tooni ha tiŋgbana maa su, tinim’ ni yɛn deei tiŋgban’ shɛŋa su bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ŋɔ na.”

english_verse: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things,
translation_verse: Yi tɔbbia kam yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du Yawɛ ninni chaŋ ti lu o dimnim’ maa zuɣu hal ka o ti kari ba,

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: Amaa yi yi ku niŋ lala, dindina yi tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka biɛhiŋ kani, yi daalahichi maa ku chɛn ya.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: Mɛmiya tinsi ti yi bihi ka me piɛri buzɔna ti yi piɛri mini yi buhi, ka niŋ kaman yi ni lo alikauli ni yi ni niŋ shɛm maa.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli Musa, “Tinim’ bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni niŋ nyini ti dan’ ni zali ti ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ti paɣiba mini ti bihi ni ti piɛri ni buhi ni ti niɣi zaa ni kpalim be Giliad tinsi maa ni.

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Amaa tinim’ bɛn nyɛ a daba bɛn lo kpara ŋɔ zaa ni du n-chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa ti Yawɛ kaman nyin’ ti dan’ ni yɛli shɛm maa.”

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: Musa daa yɛli ba, “Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya bɛn zaa lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔbu ni Yawɛ ninni ŋɔ, yi doli ya gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du, ka yi ti tuhi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, dindina yin’ zaŋmiya Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ti ba ka bɛ su li.

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ yi ku lo kpara pahi yi zuɣu du, yi mini ba zaa tarili ni bela Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.”

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli, “Ti ni niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zali tinim’ bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: Ti ni lo kpara du Yawɛ ninni n-chaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti yɛn su li maa kpalim be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli ŋɔ na.”

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Amɔrinim’ Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi tiŋgbana mini di fɔntinsi ni di tintarisi ni di tiŋgbana maa puuni fɔntinsi zaa ti Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya ni Yisifu bia Manaasa zuliya pirigili la.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Ka Gaad zuliya daa lab’ mali me tin’ shɛŋa din yuya booni Dibɔn mini Atarɔt ni Aroa

english_verse: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation_verse: ni Atirɔtishɔfan ni Jaza ni Jɔgbɛha

english_verse: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
translation_verse: ni Bɛtinimira ni Bɛtiharan, ka me buzɔna zali bɛ piɛri mini buhi, ka me goondahi gil’ li.

english_verse: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation_verse: Ka Rubin zuliya daa lab’ mali me Hɛshibɔn mini Ɛliale ni Kiriataim

english_verse: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
translation_verse: ni Nɛbo ni Baalimiɔn ni Sibima; ka bɛ daa ti bɛ ni me tin’ shɛŋa maa yu’ pala.

english_verse: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.
translation_verse: Ka Makiri zuliya ni ninvuɣ’ so ŋun daa nyɛ Manaasa bia daa chaŋ ti liri Giliadnima ŋ-ŋme n-deei li ka kari Amɔrinim’ bɛn daa be nimaani la.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Ka Manaasa bia Jair daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei tiŋkpan’ shɛŋa, ka bol’ li Havɔtijairi.

english_verse: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_verse: Ka Nɔba daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei Kɛnat mini di tiŋkpansi, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ’ yuli Nɔba boli tinsi maa.

english_verse: As Israel traveled from Egypt under the command of Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Musa mini Aduna ni daa gari tooni zaŋ Izraɛlnima ka bɛ yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni chani kaman tɔbbihi la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: Musa daa sabi bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ’ shɛŋa maa yiniyini yuya sɔŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal’ o shɛm. Bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ’ shɛŋa maa yiniyini ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ daa ti yi Ramɛsis maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Sukɔt.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sukɔt maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Itam din miri tiŋgban’ nɛl’ la.

english_verse: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Itam maa ŋ-ŋmaligi labi Pihahirɔt din be Baalizɛfɔn wulimpuhili polo la nti dɔni miri Migidol.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Pihahirɔt n-chaŋ ti tim teeku sunsuuni gari kpe tiŋgban’ nɛl’ la ni n-daa chaŋ daba ata chandi Itam tiŋgban’ nɛli ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Mara.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Ɛlim maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni miri Teeku Ʒiɛɣu.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu maa shee, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Sin tiŋgban’ nɛl’ ni.

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Alushi maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Rɛfidim, ka kom daa ka nimaani ka niriba maa ni nyu.

english_verse: They left Rephidim and finally reached the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Rɛfidim maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Sinai tiŋgban’ nɛl’ ni.

english_verse: When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Kadɛshi maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hɔr Zoli gbini din miri Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ tintariga la shee.

english_verse: That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month,
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana Aduna daa du Hɔr Zoli maa zuɣu nti kpi nimaani kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal’ o shɛm. Izraɛlnim’ ni daa yi Ijipti na nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pihinahi puuni gol’ so ŋun pahir’ anu dahin yini dali n-daa bala.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
translation_verse: Ka Keenannim’ Naa Arad ŋun daa be Nɛgɛb din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daa wum Izraɛlnim’ kandina damli.

english_verse: and finally in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Abarim zoya maa ni, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili Jɛriko polo la.

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili Jɛriko maa:

english_verse: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan,
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima, “Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni,

english_verse: you must force out the people living there. Destroy their idols and tear down their altars.
translation_verse: yin’ karimiya ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka saɣim bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa mini kuriti mali wun’ shɛŋa zaa, ka wurim bɛ ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ’ shɛŋa zaa.

english_verse: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
translation_verse: Deemiya tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ʒin’ di ni, dama mani n-zaŋ li tin ya ni yi su li.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Pihimiya kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti taba kaman yi daŋ kam ni nyɛ shɛm. Timiya daŋ shɛli din niriba zooi tiŋgbani din galisi, ka ti daŋ shɛli bɛn bi zooi mi tiŋgbani din bi galisi. So kuɣili yi gbaai tiŋgban’ shɛli, o tarili n-yɛn bala. Pirimiya li ti taba kaman yi yaannim’ daŋ kam ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: Amaa yi yi bi kari ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, bɛ ni shɛb’ bɛn yɛn kpalim beni ni bemi kaman dachɔhira la yi nina ni, ka be kaman gɔhi n-kuhiri yi luɣa ni, ka ni muɣisi ya pam yi ni yɛn be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: Ka n ni niŋ ya kaman n ni lo ni n niŋ ba shɛm.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
translation_verse: Zalim’ Izraɛlnim’ zaligu. Yɛlim’ ba, yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya maa tintarisi n-yɛn bɔŋɔ,

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Nudirigu polo tintariga yɛn zaŋla Zin mɔɣu ni m-baɣisi Ɛdom tintariga chaŋ, ka yi tintariga piligu shee yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ wulimpuhili polo.

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: Ka yi tintariga maa ni ŋmaligi nudirigu polo n-zaŋ ti paai Akirabim kunkuni n-zaŋ ti gari Zin, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Kadɛshibarinia nudirigu polo; ka zaŋ nimaani hal ni Hazarada n-gari hal ni Azimɔn.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ka di tintariga maa lan ŋmaligi Azimɔn maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ijipti kulibɔŋ ni m-mali lala hal ni teeku ni.

english_verse: The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Wulinluhili polo tintariga yɛn nyɛla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku duli. Yi wulinluhili polo tintariga n-yɛn bala.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Yi nuzaa polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku duli hal ni Hɔr Zoli gbini.

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: Ka yi lan zaŋ di vulo maa yi Hɔr Zoli maa gbini hal ni Lɛbohamat samban’ ni, ka di tintariga naabu shee yɛn nyɛla Zɛdad.

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa di tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ hal ti paai Zifurɔn, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Hazarɛnan; yi nuzaa polo tintariga n-yɛn bala.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: Yi wulimpuhili polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Hazarɛnan hal ni Shɛfam.

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: Ka tintariga maa ni yi Shɛfam maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ribila din be Ain wulimpuhili polo la, ka tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ chaŋ hal ti paai Kinɛrɛt Teeku din be wulimpuhili polo la naɣiliŋga ni.

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: Ka tintariga maa ni lan kpuɣi ni n-zaŋ hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, di tariga yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ ni. Yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa mini di tintarisi din gil’ li m-bala.

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, “Tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka piri ti tab’ maa m-bɔŋɔ. Dina ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ni o ni zaŋ li ti zuliya awɛi ni pirigili la.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: Dama Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la niriba daa pun deei bɛ tarili.

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: Zuliya ayi ni pirigili maa daa pun deei bɛ tarili ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab’ Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo.” Toondaannim’ shɛb’ bɛn yɛn piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa tari

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: “Ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn yɛn piri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya ka yi su li yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua.

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Niriba ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa zali Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ piri tiŋgbana maa tari Izraɛlnima ka bɛ su li.

english_verse: to say to them: When you receive your tribal lands, you must give towns and pastures to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima ni bɛ piim’ tinsi bɛ ni deei tiŋgban’ shɛŋa la ni n-ti Lɛvinim’ ka bɛ be di ni, ka ti ba biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee tiŋgbana ka di do n-gili tinsi maa.

english_verse: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.
translation_verse: Bɛna n-yɛn be tinsi maa ni ka su li, ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee la nyɛ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri zaa dini.

english_verse: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites
translation_verse: Yi ni yɛn ti Lɛvinim’ tin’ shɛŋa maa puuni, timiya ba tins’ ayɔbu din yɛn nyɛ nir’ ni yɛn ku ninsala ka zo n-kuli di ni tiligi, ka ti ba tinsi pihinahinaayi pahi.

english_verse: by one of the victim's relatives. He will take revengefor his relative's death as soon as he finds you.
translation_verse: Ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ’ kura maa biɛri yi ti nya o, ŋun’ kum’ o.

english_verse: There are to be six of these Safe Towns,
translation_verse: Tins’ ayɔbu ka yi yɛn yihi zali ka di nyɛ yi tiliginsim tinsi maa.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan,
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima, “Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni,

english_verse: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.
translation_verse: yin piimiya tin’ shɛŋa ka di nyɛ tiliginsim tinsi zali. Ka nir’ yi ku ninsal’ sarati kubu, o ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.

english_verse: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.
translation_verse: Tinsi maa yɛn nyɛla nir’ ni yɛn zo n-kuli shɛli n-yi ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri nuu ni, ka lala chɛ ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋun ku ninsala ku kpi hal ti zani salo ni ka bɛ kar’ o saria.

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Tins’ ayɔbu maa yɛn nyɛla Izraɛlnim’ mini saamba bɛn ʒi bɛ sani ni saan’ shɛb’ bɛn gariti tiliginsim tinsi, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala sarati kubu ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: Ka nir’ yi zaŋ kpaa din be o nuu ni ka nyɛ din ni ku nir’ ŋme so ka o kpi, o nyɛla ninvuɣ’ kura; bɛn’ kum’ o.

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: bee n-zaŋ o nuu ŋme o dim’ ku’ o, dindina ŋun ŋme o maa nyɛla ninvuɣ’ kura, ka ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri maa yi nya ninvuɣ’ kura maa, ŋun’ kum’ o.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: dindina niriba bɛn’ zaŋm’ zaligunim’ ni wuhi shɛm kpe ninvuɣ’ kura maa mini ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ’ kubo biɛri maa sunsuuni m-mal li.

english_verse: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Ka niriba maa ni fa ninvuɣ’ kura maa ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri maa nuu ni bahi, ka zaŋ o labisi o ni daa pun be tiliginsim tin’ shɛli’ ni maa, ka o ti be nimaani hal ka bɛ ni daa booi kpam din be kasi bahi maligumaaniba zuɣulaan’ so zuɣu ni ti kpi.

english_verse: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.
translation_verse: ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ’ kura maa biɛri maa ku o, ŋun bɔh’ o biɛri maa ku mali ninvuɣ’ kubo taali.

english_verse: You must stay inside the town until the high priest dies; only then can you go back home.
translation_verse: Dama di simdi ni ninvuɣ’ kura maa kul kpalim be tiliginsim tiŋ’ maa ni hal ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan’ maa ti kpi, amaa maligumaaniba zuɣulan’ maa kum nyaaŋa, ninvuɣ’ kura maa ni tooi lab’ omaŋmaŋ’ ya.

english_verse: The community of Israel must always obey these laws.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔnima n-yɛn nyɛ yi zaligunima yi ni yɛn be luɣ’ shɛlikam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: “Nir’ yi ku ninsala, ka ninvuɣ’ bɔbili di li shɛhira, bɛn’ kum ninvuɣ’ kura maa, amaa di bi tuhi ni bɛ ku so ninvuɣ’ yino shɛhira dibu zuɣu.

english_verse: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!
translation_verse: Amaa miriya ka yi deei binshɛli zali ninvuɣ’ kura ŋun simdi kubu zaani. Ninvuɣ’ kura simdi kubu.

english_verse: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Yi mi miriya ka yi deei binshɛli ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋun zo nti be tiliginsim tiŋ’ ni lab’ ti be o ya ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan’ na bi kpi.

english_verse: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel
translation_verse: Ka Makiri bia Giliad ŋun daa nyɛ Yisifu bia Manaasa yaaŋa la daŋ puuni dunoya dɔɣirikpamba daa ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim’ dunoya dɔɣirikpamba sanna

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: “Yiɣisimiya gbaai soli chaŋ ti siɣi Arinɔn vinvamli ni du. Nyamiya, n zaŋ Sihɔn Amɔri nir’ ŋun nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa ŋɔ min’ o tiŋgbɔŋ niŋ yi nuu ni, ŋmɛmiy’ o tɔbu m-piligi li deebu.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n ni pili n-chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam niriba zɔn ya dabiɛm, bɛ yi wum yi yɛla dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira ka biɛrim pam mali ba.” Izraɛlnim’ nyaŋ Naa Sihɔn (Kalinlinima

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: “Dinzuɣu ka n daa tim tuumba ka bɛ yi Kɛdɛmɔt tiŋgban’ nɛli ni n-chaŋ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn sani nti zaŋ suhudoo yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛl’ o,

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: ‘A yi saɣi ni n tim a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari, n kul yɛn dolila solɔɣu gari, m bi yɛn birigi nudirigu bee nuzaa polo.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: kaman Iso zuliya bɛn be Ɛdom la mini Mɔabnim’ bɛn be Ar la ni daa niŋ ma shɛm hal ka n ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti la ni.’

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: “Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, ‘Nyama, M pun piligi zaŋdi Sihɔn min’ o tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiri ya, piligimiya o tiŋgbɔŋ maa deebu pumpɔŋɔ.’

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu Sihɔn min’ o niriba zaa ni daa yina ti liri ti n-tuhi ti Jahaz,

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ o ti ti, ka ti ku o min’ o bihi ni o niriba zaa.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Zaŋ Aroa din be Arinɔn vinvamli tariga ni la hal ni fɔntin’ shɛli din be vinvamli maa ni la m-mali hal ni Giliad, tiŋ’ daa kani din goma du n-nyaŋ ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa ti ti.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Amaa ti daa bi chaŋ miri Ammɔnnim’ tiŋgbɔŋ la ni zaŋ tabili Jabok kulibɔŋ dul’ la mini fɔntin’ shɛli din daa be zoya tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali shɛm la.”

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, “Di zɔr’ o dabiɛm, dama n zaŋ o min’ o niriba maa zaa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ a nuu ni. Niŋm’ o kaman a ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim’ Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn shɛm la.”

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Ka ti daa ku bɛ zaa, ka ku tiŋ’ kam nima dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi zaa kaman ti ni daa niŋ Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn shɛm la.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Di saha ka ti daa deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul’ la Amɔrinim’ nanim’ maa nuu ni, zaŋ Arinɔn kulibɔŋ ni hal ti paai Hɛrimɔn Zoli gbini.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Fɔntinsi zaa din daa be tintan’ ni mini Giliad zaa ni Bashan zaa zaŋ hal ni Salɛka ni Ɛdirɛi, fɔn’ shɛŋa din daa be Bashan Naa Ogi nam sulinsi ni la.

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ yi ti ti yi mabihi maa vuhim kaman o ni tin ya vuhim shɛm ŋɔ, ka bɛ gba ti nya tiŋgbani ʒini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul’ la ni; di nyaaŋa ka yi ni yino kam naanyi labina ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su li ŋɔ ni.”

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: Ka n daa suhi Yawɛ di saha maa gba yɛli,

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: “Yaa n Duuma Yawɛ, a kul yoli piligimi n-wuhir’ a dabili a galisim min’ a yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, wuni ŋuni n-lee be zuɣusaa bee tiŋgbani zuɣu n-ni tooi tum yiko tuma mini tuun’ kar’ shɛŋa a ni tum ŋɔ?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Chɛ ka n gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ ti nya zoya ni tiŋgban’ viɛlli din be duli maa mini Lɛbanɔn.”

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka bi saɣi ka naɣ’ yɛli ma mi, “Di saɣiya, di lan yɛli ma yɛlli ŋɔ yaha.

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Dum’ Pisiga Zoli zuɣu nti kpuɣ’ a zuɣu lihi bahi wulinluhili polo mini nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo, lihim li viɛnyɛliŋga, dama a ku du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Amaa wuhim’ Jɔshua ka kpaŋs’ o suhu, dama ŋuna n-yɛn leei niriba ŋɔ zuɣulana n-zaŋ ba du nti deei a ni yɛn nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ti ba.

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: “Dinzuɣu ka ti daa kpalim be vinvamli maa ni Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnima, wummiya n ni wuhiri ya zalikpan’ shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ zaa, ka dol’ li din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim’ Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi pahi yɛtɔɣ’ shɛli n ni zali ya zaligu shɛli ŋɔ ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni. Amaa doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya ŋɔ.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: Amaa yinim’ bɛn daa kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim la zaa n-na be yi nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Amaa yirigimiya yimaŋ’ zuɣu, ka gbibiya yi maŋ’ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi ku tam yi nina ni daa nya binshɛŋa la bee n-chɛ ka di yi yi suhuri ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni be yi nyɛviya ni ŋɔ; zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi mini yi yaansi.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Yi ni daa ti zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni Sinai Zoli gbini ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, ‘Laɣimmi niriba maa na ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ wum n yɛligu din ni chɛ ka bɛ luri ma sizuura saha shɛli zaa bɛ ni be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka wuhi bɛ bihi lala.’

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: “Ka yi daa vu m-mirina ti zani zoli maa gbini, ka zoli maa daa taai buɣim n-kpuɣi du sagbana ni, ka sagbana daa zibigi lim li.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim maa sunsuuni; ka yi daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa vuri, amaa ka lee bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, kukoli kɔŋko n-daa kul beni.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: Ka o daa wuhi ya o daalikauli shɛli o ni zali ya ni yi doli, dina n-nyɛ o fukumsi zaligunim’ pia la. Ka o daa sabi li pa kuɣiparilana ayi zuɣu.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zali ma ni n wuhim’ ya zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi maa, ka yi ti gbib’ li yi ni chani ni yi ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli ʒini maa ni. Zuɣu ni kpahibu zaŋ chaŋ buɣa jɛmbu polo

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: “Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisiri ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni Sinai Zoli gbin’ la, yi daa bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋ’ viɛnyɛliŋga

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: din ni chɛ ka yi ku mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛli n-tum alahichi. Di maliya li ŋmahindi bin’ lɔɣu bee bin’ nyaŋ.

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi lihi zuɣusaa nya wuntaŋa mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni zuɣusaa binyara zaa, yin’ miriya ka yi damdi tiŋa n-jɛm li ka di chɛ ka yi birigi. Di nyɛla binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ti ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Amaa Yawɛ n-yihi ya kuriti nyɛligibu daaŋa ni na Ijipti ni yi ti leei omaŋmaŋ’ ni su ninvuɣ’ shɛba kaman yi ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka po pɔri yɛli ma ni n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ŋɔ, ni n ku kpe tiŋgbɔn viɛl’ shɛli ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su la ni.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Dama n ni kpi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni; n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili, amaa yinim’ ni du li chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔn viɛlli maa su.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl’ la yɛla, ka mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya ni di nyɛla din chihiri la.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla buɣim din dira, o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb’ ni, ka yi kalinli ti ku lan galisi Yawɛ ni yɛn kari ya bahi zuliya shɛb’ ni maa.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Nimaani ka yi ni ti jɛmdi wuna din nyɛ kuɣa mini dari, ka nyɛ ninsalinim’ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa, ka di ku tooi nya bee n-wum bee n-di bee n-wum nyom ŋɔ.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔnim’ zaa yi ti paai ya saha shɛli yi nandahima maa ni, yi ni ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani nti deeg’ o yɛligu.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu, o ku chɛn ya bahi bee n-kun ya; o mi ku tam o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim’ alikauli shɛl’ la yɛla.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Bee wun’ so na mi m-buɣisi ni o chaŋ ti pii niriba zuliya shɛli sunsuuni n-zaŋ ba leeg’ o dahalali niriba, ka zaŋ zahimbunim’ mini shihira ni alahiziba tuma ni tɔbu, ka teeg’ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n-wuhi yiko din mali dabiɛm pam kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ shɛm tin ya yi nimbansi ni Ijipti la?

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: O daa chɛ ka o kukoli yi zuɣusaa na ka yi wum li ni di chɛ ka o wuhi ya. O daa wuhi ya o buɣim titali dunia ŋɔ ni, ka yi daa wum o kukoli buɣim sunsuuni.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: O ni daa yuri yi yaannim’ la zuɣu ka o daa pii bɛ bihi bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka daa be yi sani n-yihi ya Ijipti na. O daa zaŋ o yiko

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: n-kari zuliya shɛb’ bɛn daa galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya, ka zaŋ ya na ti zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ tin ya, ka yi su li kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi suhuri ni ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ Naawuni, ka so lan kani pah’ o zuɣu.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Gbibiy’ o zalikpana min’ o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi mini yi bihi biɛrisuŋ zuɣu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya sahakam ŋɔ ni.” Tiliginsim fɔntinsi din be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli Bɛtipɛɔr tooni vinvamli din daa be Amɔrinim’ naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn la tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ŋuna ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim’ daa tuhi nyaŋ saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti na la.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa deeg’ o mini Bashan naa Ogi bɛn daa nyɛ Amɔrinim’ nanim’ ayi bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo maa tiŋgbɔna ʒini,

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: zaŋ Aroa din daa be Arinɔn vinvamli naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ la hal ti paai Siriɔn Zoli ,

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: zaŋ tabili Araba din daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la zaa hal ti taɣi Araba Teeku Pisiga zolɔŋ la ni.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa boli Izraɛlnim’ zaa na ti yɛli ba, “Yinim’ Izraɛlnima, wummiya zalikpan’ shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa n ni wuhiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Bɔhimmiya li ka dol’ li viɛnyɛliŋga.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: “Miri ka a ku ninsala.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa lo ti alikauli Sinai zoli gbini.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Pa ti yaannim’ kɔŋko ka Yawɛ daa lo alikauli ŋɔ, amaa tinim’ bɛn zaa na be ti nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Yi ninni ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim puuni zoli gbini la.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Di saha maa n daa ʒiɛla yi mini Yawɛ sunsuuni ni n zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa maa tɔɣisi ya, dama yi daa zɔrila dabiɛm buɣim maa zuɣu, ka daa bi du zoli maa zuɣu. Ka o daa yɛli,

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: ‘Man’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na.’ ”

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi mali wun’ shɛŋa pahi n zuɣu.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti mali wuni ŋ-ŋmahindi binshɛli din be zuɣusaa bee binshɛli din be tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛli din be kom ni tiŋgbani puuni.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti damdi li tiŋa bee n-jɛm li; dama man’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli, n darigiri ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaɣisi ma bihi tiba bɛ banima taali zuɣu hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir’ ata mini din pahir’ anahi ni.
