translation_verse: ti yɛli ‘Nyama, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ wuhi ti o jilima min’ o galisim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ti wum o kukoli buɣim sunsuuni; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ti nyaya ni Naawuni ni tooi tɔɣisi ninsal’ yɛtɔɣa, ka ninsal’ maa na be o nyɛvili ni.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ bɔzuɣu ka ti lan yɛn bo kum ti timaŋa? Dama buɣim titali ŋɔ ni ti di ti. Ti yi lan wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kukoli pahi, ti ni kpi.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Dama bɛn mali niŋgbuŋ zaa ŋuni n-na mi n-wum Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ kukoli ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni kaman ti ni wum shɛm ŋɔ, ka na be o nyɛvili ni?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Amaŋmaŋ’ cham’ miri ha ti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Di nyaaŋa ka a yɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl’ a shɛm zaa, ka ti wum ka niŋ li.’

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: “Ka Yawɛ daa wum yi ni yɛli ma yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa maa, ka yɛli ma, ‘N wum niriba maa ni yɛl’ a yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa maa, bɛ mali yɛlimaŋli bɛ ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Bɛ yi daa pun mali tɛha ŋɔ tatabo ni bɛ zɔri ma, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunima zaa sahakam, dindina binshɛɣukam naan niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bɛ mini bɛ bihi sani.

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Cham’ ti yɛli ba ka bɛ labi bɛ suɣa ni.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Amaa nyini zanim’ baɣili ma kpe, ka n yɛl’ a fukumsi zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka a zaŋ wuhi ba ka bɛ ti dol’ li n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba ni bɛ su maa ni.’

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya so’ shɛŋa la zaa din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi ti mali nyɛvili wɔɣila tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni ti yɛn su maa ni.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: “Pumpɔŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ma ni n zaŋ wuhi ya ka yi ti doli li yi ni chani ni yi ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu yinim’ Izraɛlnima, wummiya, ka dol’ li viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi nab’ pam pahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ŋɔ ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim’ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: “Izraɛlnima, wummiya: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, kulla Yawɛ kɔŋko.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni yi yu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shia zaa ni yi yaa zaa.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi, ka tɔɣisim’ di yɛla yi yi be yiŋa ni yi yi ti be luɣ’ shɛli polo ni yi yi ti doya ni yi yi ti yiɣisi.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka sabi li pa yi yiŋ’ dunɔpaɣirisi zuɣu mini yi dunɔdaya zuɣu.” Saɣisigu zaŋ chaŋ zaligu zaɣisibu polo

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: “Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ya ti niŋ o ni daa lo yi yaannim’ bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni, tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali fɔntin’ kara din viɛla, ka pa yi ni me shɛŋa

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.

translation_verse: Ka yi ti ku Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ niŋ yi nuu ni la zaa, ka ku zo ba nambɔɣu. Miriya ka yi ti jɛm bɛ wuna, dama di ni ti leei zana yi sani.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi nyaŋ ba, di saha yin’ kumiya bɛ zaa. Di ti lɔnya ba alikauli, yi mi di ti zo ba nambɔɣu.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Dama lala ni chɛ ka yi bihi maa chɛ ma dolibu ka jɛmdi binnana, di saha Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o kun ya yomyom.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Amaa yi ni ti yɛn niŋ ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti daamiya bɛ maligu bimbina luhi, ka wurim bɛ binwɔɣila la, ka chɛ ŋ-ŋmaai bɛ Ashɛrim la luhi tiŋa, ka nyo bɛ wuna buɣim.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Dama yi nyɛla ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn be kasi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii ya dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa sunsuuni n-zaŋ ya leeg’ o niriba bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ’ gahinda.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Di daa nyɛla Yawɛ ni yuri ya, ka gbib’ o ni daa po yi yaannim’ pɔri shɛl’ la zuɣu ka ŋun’ Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n yihi ya dabitim ni, ka fan ya Ijipti naa Firawuna nuu ni bahi maa.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ Naawuni, o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim, ka gbib’ alikauli ni yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn yur’ o ka dol’ o fukumsi zaligunim’ sani zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani tuhili niriba.

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: O darigiri ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaɣis’ o tibili. Yawɛ ku niŋ zinchili zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaɣis’ o tibili darigibu polo.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Yi ni ti mali alibarika gari zuliya kam. Ka dɔɣibu kalinsi ti ku be yi ni bee yi biŋkɔbiri ni.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: O ni yuri ya ka niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi zuliya nabi. english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: “Yi yi wum zaligunim’ ŋɔ ka dol’ li viɛnyɛliŋga, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni gbib’ o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim’ alikauli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ yi sani la.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi ni, ka Ijipti dɔr’ biɛ’ shɛŋa zaa din daa gbahiri ya la, o ku lan chɛ ka di gbahi ya. Amaa o ni chɛ ka di gbahi ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaa jɛn ya.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: “Ka yi yi yɛli yi suhu ni, ‘Zuliyanim’ ŋɔ galisiya gari ti, wula ka ti lee yɛn tooi niŋ kari ba?’

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Di zɔriya ba dabiɛm, kul teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Firawuna mini Ijiptinim’ zaa shɛm la yɛla,

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Din pahi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn daa kpalim mini bɛn daa zo n-tiligi ti kpi.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi zɔri ba, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ka be yi sani ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun galisi ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni kari zuliya shɛb’ bɛn be yi tooni maa zaa biɛlabiɛla; yi ku tooi kari ba naai yomyom, di yi niŋ lala mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb’ biɛri ni ti galisi nyaŋ ya.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: O ni ti zaŋ bɛ nanim’ niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi ti kpihim bɛ yuya dunia ŋɔ ni. So ti ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yɔn ya hal ka yi ti ku bɛ zaa.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: “N ni zaŋ zalikpan’ shɛŋa zaa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be ka nabi, ka chaŋ ti ʒini Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri lo alikauli n-zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim’ la ni.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: O daa chɛ ka kum gbahi ya, ka yi siɣisi yimaŋa ka o zaŋ manna dihi ya, din daa nyɛ yi mini yi yaannim’ ni ʒi shɛli ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni pa bindirigu kɔŋko n-chɛ ka daadam be, amaa yɛtɔɣili kam din yiri Yawɛ nol’ ni na n-chɛ ka daadam be.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Baŋmiya yi suhuri ni ni nir’ ni saɣisir’ o bidibiga shɛm, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ gba saɣisiri ya.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.

translation_verse: “Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya n yɛligu ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni mini yi biɛhigu ni, zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi. Yi yi ʒi yi yinsi puuni, yin’ tɔɣisimiya di yɛla, ka yi yi ti be luɣ’ shɛli polo bee yi yi ti dɔni bee yi yi ti yiɣisi, yin’ tɔɣisimiya di yɛla.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti sab’ li pa yi yinsi dunɔpaɣirisi zuɣu mini yi dunɔdaya zuɣu.

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi dabisa ti nabi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri ni o ni zaŋ ti yi yaannim’ la ni n-yuui nimaani kaman sagbana ni be tiŋgbani zuɣusaa shɛm ŋɔ.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Yi yi ni doli n ni zaŋ fukumsi zalikpan’ shɛŋa zaa zaani ya ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol’ o soya zaa, ka zaŋ yimaŋ’ ti o,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: dindina Yawɛ ni kari zuliya shɛb’ zaa bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ bahi, ka yi ti deei zuliya shɛb’ bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya tinsi su.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Yi napɔna yi ti kul no di luɣ’ shɛlikam di ni leei yi dini. Yi tintariga ni ti zanila Lɛbanɔn tiŋgban’ nɛl’ ni n-zaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni hal ti paai Wulinluhili polo teeku la ni.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: So ti ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yɔn ya. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka yi yɛla gbahi yi ni yɛn chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa nim’ zaa dabiɛm kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: “Nyamiya, n zaŋla alibarika mini noli dibu zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ:

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpan’ shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dina n-nyɛ alibarika maa,

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: ka yi yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana maa, ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ n ni zaani ya ni yi doli so’ shɛli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka chaŋ ti jɛmdi wun’ shɛŋa yi ni bi mi, din’ mi n-nyɛ noli dibu maa.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ yi ti zaŋ ya tahi yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti ʒini maa, yin’ zaŋmiya alibarika ŋɔ ti tam Gɛrizim Zoli zuɣu, ka zaŋya noli dibu ŋɔ mi ti tam Ɛbal Zoli zuɣu.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Yi mi ni di bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo Keenannim’ bɛn be Araba la tiŋgban’ ni. Tiŋgbani din be Giligal tooni polo m-baɣi Mɔre oki tia la.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Yi yi ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili chaŋ ti ʒi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni, yi yi ti ʒini di ni ka be di ni,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: yin’ doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.”

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: “Zaligu shɛŋa yi ni yɛn doli viɛnyɛliŋga Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim’ Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi ʒini di ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be dunia yili m-bɔŋɔ:

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Saɣimmiya yi ni yɛn kari ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ ka deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa buɣa jɛmbu shee zaa, din be zoya zuɣu mini daboya zuɣu ni ti’ maha gbina ni zaa.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Daamiya maligu bimbina la luhi, ka wurim bɛ buɣa bin’ wɔɣila la, ka nyo bɛ wuni Ashɛra binnana la buɣim, ka lala chɛ ka yi kpihim bɛ yuli nimaani.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti doli soya ŋɔ n-jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ’ shɛli leeg’ o jɛmbu shee maa mini yi ya yi waɣa pam, ka yi kɔrigi yi niɣi bee yi biŋkɔbbaligu shɛb’ Yawɛ ni tin ya maa kaman n ni zali ya shɛm, dindina yi ni tooi ŋub’ li saha shɛli yi ni bɔra.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm, lala ka yi ni ti ŋub’ ba, bɛn ka kasi mini bɛn be kasi zaa ni tooi ŋub’ li.

english_verse: But don't eat the blood. It is the life of the animal, so let it drain out on the ground before you eat the meat.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti ŋub’ li, ti kpaamiya li bahi tiŋa kaman kom la.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Di ŋubiya li, ka binshɛɣukam ti niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, yi ni tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani zuɣu.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛŋa nyɔri buɣim la nimdi mini di binʒim mali sara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbini la zuɣu. Kpaamiya yi sara maligu shɛŋa din kpalim binʒim bahi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, amaa yi ni tooi ŋubi di nimdi maa dina.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Doliya n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa sahakam, dama yi yɛn niŋdila din viɛl’ mini din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.” Saɣisigu zaŋ chaŋ buɣa jɛmbu polo

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: “Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti ku yi ni chani ni yi ti deei zuliya shɛb’ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka chɛ ka yi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, yi yi ti deei li ʒini bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: yin’ miriya ka yi ti doli bɛ tuma, ka zana gbahi ya. Di ti bɔhiya bɛ wuna yɛla n-yɛra, “Wula ka niriba ŋɔ daa lee jɛmdi bɛ wuna ŋɔ? Ti gba bɔri ni ti jɛm li.”

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ lala, dama binshɛŋa din chihira ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni je shɛŋa zaa, bɛ niŋdi li tiri bɛ wuna maa, dama hal bɛ daa mi n-zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi nyo buɣim mali bɛ wuna maa.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: Niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Di pahiya shɛli di ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni.

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: yin’ di wumya anabinim’ maa bee bɛn baŋdi zahima gbinni maa yɛtɔɣa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zahindi ya maa ni o nya yi shiri yuri ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhu zaa mini yi shihi zaa.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka lumiy’ o kɔŋko sizuura, ka dol’ o zaligunima, ka deeg’ o noli, ka jɛmiy’ o, ka ʒe o yim.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Di saha Izraɛlnim’ zaa yi ti wum li, dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan tum zaɣ’ biɛɣu lala tatabo yaha.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ yɛli ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ fɔntiŋ’ shɛŋa tin ya ni yi be di ni la tin’ yin’ ni

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: ninvuɣ’ yoya shɛb’ yila yi ni n-chaŋ ti chɛ ka tiŋ’ maa nim’ birigi ka yɛra, ‘Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti jɛm wun’ shɛŋa yi ni bi mi,’

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: di saha yin’ bɔhimiya ka vihi di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga; di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni bɛ tum din chihiri ŋɔ yi sunsuuni,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: yin’ zaŋmiya takɔbi ku tiŋ’ maa nima ka saɣim tiŋ’ maa zaa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni hal ka zaŋ takɔb’ ku bɛ biŋkɔbiri.

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka di ni simdi ni bɛ saɣim binshɛŋa la shɛli ti kpalim be yi nuu ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka Yawɛ chɛ o suhuyiɣisili maa, ka zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka chɛ ka yi zuliya nabi o nambɔzɔbo maa puuni kaman o ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim’ sani shɛm la.

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: Deemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu, ka doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zalikpan’ shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa sani.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Dama yi nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba bɛn be kasi. Yawɛ n-daa pii ya dunia ŋɔ zuliya pam sunsuuni n-leeg’ omaŋmaŋ’ niriba.

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Yi ni tooi ŋubi noombil’ kam ŋun be nyam.

english_verse: Don't eat any disgusting animals.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi di binshɛŋa din chihiri dibu.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Biŋkɔbigu kam ŋun mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, ka nyɛ ŋun gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin’ ŋubimiy’ o.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Amaa biŋkɔb’ shɛb’ bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, ka bɛ takarifiɛma bi wɔrigi, yin’ di ŋubiya ba. Bɛna n-nyɛ laakuma mini soonsi ni ŋɔŋa, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa bɛ ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Di ŋubiya kuruchunima, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, amaa bɛ bi gbuɣiri ŋubira, dinzuɣu bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani. Miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ nimdi, yi mi di ti shihi bɛ zaɣ’ kpima.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Yin’ ni tooi di binshɛŋa zaa bɛn be kom ni n-nyɛ: binshɛɣukam bɛn mali gɔhi mini paɣiri.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Amaa binshɛɣukam bɛn ka gɔhi mini paɣiri, yin’ di ŋubiya ba. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Ka binshɛb’ bɛn mali kpiŋkpama ka be nyam, yin’ ŋubimiya ba.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: Binshɛɣukam ŋun kpi nyiŋgo’ muni, yin’ di ŋubiy’ o, yi ni tooi zaŋ o ti tinzunnim’ bɛn be yi tinsi ni ka bɛ ŋubi bee yi ni tooi zaŋ o kɔhi tinzun nira zuɣu, dama yinima nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba bɛn be kasi. Miriya ka yi zaŋ bubil’ ma bihim duɣ’ o. Pirigibu bupia zuɣu yim zaligu

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni yi yihi yi ni kpuɣi atam shɛli yi puri ni pirigibu bupia puuni yim zuɣu zali yuuni kam.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni yi ti di li la Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni o ni pii luɣ’ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd’ o la. Yi ni tooi di yi puri atam pirigibu bupia zuɣu yim mini yi wain ni yi kpam ni yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi bi’ shɛb’ zaa din ni chɛ ka yi bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu sahakam.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi biɛhigu shee wɔɣa, ka yi ku tooi zaŋ li chaŋ nimaani, ka di nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii tin’ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd’ o nimaani wɔɣilim maa zuɣu,

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: nti zaŋ li da yi suhu ni bɔri shɛli; yi ni tooi da niɣi bee piɛri bee wain bee dam din mali kpiɔŋ bee yi suhu ni kul bɔri shɛli, ka yi mini yi yinsinim’ ti di li nimaani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti tam Lɛvinim’ bɛn be yi tinsi maa ni la yɛla, dama bɛ ka tarili bee fali yi sani.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Yuma ata kam puuni, zaŋmiya yi puri atam pirigibu bupia zuɣu yim sɔŋ yi tinsi ni,

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: ka Lɛvinim’ bɛn ka tarili bee fali yi sani la mini tinzunnim’ bɛn be yi sani ni kpibisi ni pakoya bɛn be yi tinsi ni gba di n-tiɣi, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: So yi be yi ni n-nyɛ ŋun ka, ka nyɛ yi ʒilɛl’ ni nira m-be yi tin’ shɛl’ ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni, yin’ di kuuya yi nini niŋ’ o bee n-kpibi yi nuu zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ka maa polo.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku li m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋunkam samli dol’ o ʒiʒiinikpee, ŋun’ kum’ li, ka di lan yɛli ni o ʒiʒiinikpee maa yom’ li, dama bɛ moli Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum’ sama saha shɛli molo.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Tinzun’ nira yi di a samli, a ni tooi bɔh’ o dee’ li, amaa a mabia ŋun be yi ʒilɛl’ ni ŋuna, di simdi ni a ku san’ shɛli din be a min’ o sunsuuni.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni kaman o ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la, yi ni ti dihi zuliyanim’ pam samli; amaa yinim’ ti ku paŋ shɛli. Yi ni ti su zuliyanim’ pam, amaa bɛn’ ti ku sun ya.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biɛm tɛha kpɛhi yi suhu ni, ka yɛli ni yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin ka nyɛ samli kubu yuuni la bi lan waɣa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi kuui yi nini niŋ yi ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ka maa, ka bi ti o shɛli. Yi ʒiʒiinikpee maa yi fabili niŋ Yawɛ, yi ni kpe taali ni.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Timiya ni yi suhu zaa, ka yi yi yɛn niŋ li yin’ di ŋumdiya yi kparima ni, dama dimbɔŋɔ n-ni chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma mini yi ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Amaa o yi mali daŋa, ka di nyɛ dan’ titali, kaman o yi nyɛ napombara bee o yi nyɛ zoma, yin’ di zaŋy’ o mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.

english_verse: If any of you buy Israelites as slaves, you must set them free after six years.
translation_verse: Bɛ yi kɔhi a ʒilɛl’ ni Yɛhudia doo bee paɣa a zuɣu, ka o tum tuma ti a yuma ayɔbu, yuun’ shɛli din pahira ayopɔin ni, nyin’ bahimi dilana ka o chaŋ.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Ka a yi bahi a dabili ni o chaŋ, nyin’ di chɛ ka o chaŋ ni nu’ zaŋa.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka a ti o Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a binshɛŋa zaa la ni shɛli. A ni tooi piig’ a biŋkɔbbaligu ti o bee a puu atam bee a wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain ti o ni a suhu zaa.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Amaa a dabili maa yi yɛl’ a, ‘N ku chaŋ ka chɛ a, ka di nyɛla o ni yur’ a mini a yiŋnima yi ni gbib’ o viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: dindina nyin’ bom’ peeŋkpaa n-zaŋ o tibili tabili dunoli naŋgbanyee n-chib’ li voli, ka o nyɛ a dabili sahakam. Zaŋ chaŋ a dabili ŋun nyɛ paɣ’ gba polo, di simdi ni a niŋ o lala.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: Yi niɣi ni tuui dɔɣi naɣilabihi shɛb’ mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣ’ la’ shɛb’ zaa, yin’ zaŋmiya ba ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ. Di zaŋya yi naɣilabihi tuulinim’ tum tuma, yi mi di chɛnya yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi bi’ shɛb’ kɔbiri.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni yi mini yi yinsinim’ ti zaŋdi ba chani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ’ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd’ o maa nti kɔriti ba ŋubiri Yawɛ tooni yuuni kam.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Yi ni tooi ŋub’ ba yi tinsi ni, bɛn be nyam mini bɛn bi be nyam zaa yi ni tooi ŋub’ ba kaman yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm la.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Amaa miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ ʒim; yi ni ti kpaai li mi bahi tiŋgban’ ni kaman kom la.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Puhimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu Abib goli ni, dama Abib goli maa ni yuŋ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kul doliya zaligu ni wuhi shɛm kɔŋko din’ ni chɛ ka yi be, ka ti ʒini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Yi ni ti ŋubiri la bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi la hal ni daba ayɔbu, ka dabisi’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin dali, di simdi ni yi ti laɣim jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di ti tumiya tuun’ shɛli dindali maa. Puri atam kpuɣibu chuɣu (Yibu

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbihi bee niɣi mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ luɣ’ shɛli ŋun’ Yawɛ ni pii ni bɛ jɛmd’ o la.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin’ shɛŋa tin ya maa tin’ shɛli ni.

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: Amaa ti malimiya li la luɣ’ shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii ni yi jɛmd’ o nimaani kɔŋko, ka yi ni ti mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maa zaawuni wuntan’ luhili saha, yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl’ la saha.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti duɣi li ŋubi luɣ’ shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii maa n-yi biɛɣu asiba, yin’ labimiya yi suɣa ni.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: Yi mi miriya ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣa me binwɔɣinli zali, dimbɔŋɔnim’ nyɛla Naawuni ni je shɛŋa.

english_verse: After you have finished the grain harvest and the grape harvest, take your sons and daughters and all your servants to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Celebrate the Festival of Shelters for seven days. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. The Lord will give you big harvests and make you successful in everything you do. You will be completely happy, so celebrate this festival in honor of the Lord your God. Three Festivals at the Place of Worship (Exodus
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ’ shɛli maa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi puri atam mini yi ni tum tuun’ shɛlikam zaa ni. Ka di simdi ni yi shiri puhi chuɣu maa.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti sa Ashɛra tia baɣili yi ni ti yɛn me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbin’ shɛl’ la.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you start your grain harvest,
translation_verse: Yi yi ti piligi kachɛɣu dahin’ shɛli, yin’ piligimiya kali dindali maa hal ni bakɔi ayopɔin,

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Ka yi mini yi bidibisi ni yi bipuɣinsi ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba ni yi dabipaɣiba ni Lɛvinim’ bɛn be yi tinsi ni ni saamba ni kpibisi ni pakoya bɛn be yi sani ti mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, luɣ’ shɛli ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii leeg’ o jɛmbu shee maa.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di simdi ni sokam ti ti o yaa tariga kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni shɛm. Yɛlimaŋli saria karibu soli

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: Yi zuliya ni dɔbba zaa ni laɣim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani o ni yɛn pii luɣ’ shɛli maa buta yuuni puuni. Bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi chuɣu puhibu ni mini dakulɔdakulo chuɣu puhibu ni ni suɣa tibu chuɣu puhibu ni. Di bi simdi ni bɛ ti ka Yawɛ sanna ni nu’ zaŋa.

english_verse: After you are settled in the towns that you will receive from the Lord your God, the people in each town must appoint judges and other officers. Those of you that become judges must be completely fair when you make legal decisions, even if someone important is involved. Don't take bribes to give unfair decisions. Bribes keep people who are wise from seeing the truth and turn honest people into liars.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti ti nimmira yɛlimaŋli, yi mi di ti zaŋ gaŋbu bee birapu dibu kpɛhi yi bebu ni, dama birapu dibu nyɛla din chɛ ka baŋda nina bi ne, ka chɛ ka bɛn mali yɛlimaŋli kɔŋdi yɛlimaŋli.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu bee piɛɣu ŋun mali daŋ’ mini binshɛɣukam din bi niŋ kamaata mali sara ti ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din chihiri ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: bɛ yi yɛli ya di yɛla bee yi yi wum di yɛla, ka yi vihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni din chihiri maa shiri tumiya Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni,

english_verse: But you will need two or three witnesses—one witness isn't enough to prove a person guilty. Get rid of those who are guilty of such evil. Take them outside your town gates and everyone must stone them to death. But the witnesses must be the first to throw stones. Difficult Cases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di simdi ni shɛhiranim’ maa n-nyɛ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn ni daŋ zaŋ bɛ nuhi niŋ bɛ ni yɛn ku ninvuɣ’ so maa kubu ni, di nyaaŋa ka sokam naanyi zaŋ bɛ nuhi kpɛhi di ni. Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Ka niriba zaa wum di yɛla, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan niŋ tipawumli yaha. Wuhibu zaŋ chaŋ Naa polo

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni ti dee’ li su n-ʒini di ni ka yɛli, “Ti ni bo naa ka o su ti kaman zuliya kam bɛn gil’ ti ŋɔ ni mali nanim’ shɛm,”

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: yɛlimaŋli, yi ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii ninvuɣ’ so n-leei yi naa ka o sun ya. Yi ni tooi zaŋ yi zuliya ni nira n-leei yi naa. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ tinzun nira ŋun pa yi mabia n-leei yi naa.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Hal di yi niŋ lala ŋun’ di laɣim yuri pam lo bee n-chɛ ka niriba maa labi Ijipti ni bɛ ti laɣim yuri pam na ti pahi; dama Yawɛ daa yɛliya, “Di lan labiya nimaani yaha.”

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Di mi bi simdi ni o ti kpuɣi paɣiba pam niŋ o paɣiba, di yi niŋ lala o suhu ni lɛbigi. O mi di ti va anzinfa bee salima pam mali.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Ka o yi ti ʒin’ o nam ʒiishee, ŋun chɛ ka bɛ yaai zaligu ŋɔ niŋ litaafi ni Lɛvinim’ bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ninni ti o,

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: ka di be o sani, ka o karindi li dabisili kam o biɛhigu ni din ni chɛ ka o bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu, ka doli yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa din be zaligu ŋɔ ni mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi viɛnyɛliŋga.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: Ka lala chɛ ka o ku duh’ omaŋ’ yaɣ’ o mabihi maa sani, ka mi ku birigi fukumsi zaligu maa n-kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo din ni chɛ ka o min’ o zuliya ti di nam yuui Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: N ni chɛ ka anabi ŋun be kaman nyini ŋɔ yi bɛmaŋmaŋ’ niriba maa ni na m-be bɛ sani, ka n zaŋ n zilinli niŋ anab’ maa nol’ ni, ka o ti yɛri ba n ni zal’ o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam zaa.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka bɛ zaa dihili ni ti nyɛla dɛde hal bɛ ni mali tarili bɛ dɔɣiriba ni kɔhiri bɛ daŋ ni neen’ shɛŋa ni la zaa yoli. Saɣisigu zaŋ chaŋ chɛfiritali tuma polo

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: Lɛvinim’ bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Lɛvi zuliya niriba maa zaa ti ku mali tarili bee fali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɛ ni ti dirila sara binshɛŋa din nyɛ Yawɛ dini.

english_verse: because he has promised to provide for them in this way.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ ku mali fali bɛ mabihi sani, Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ fali kaman o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛm la.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Maligumaaniba ni su shɛli niriba maa sani n-nyɛ: Ŋunkam yɛn mali sara, ka di nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, di simdi ka o yihi bimbɔɣigbini mini yɛno ni bimpuli ti maligumaana.

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya yi kawaan’ daŋda mini yi wain daŋda ni yi kpa’ daŋda ni yi ni tuui chɛ biŋkɔbiri kɔb’ shɛŋa ti o.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii Lɛvi yi zuliya zaa ni ni o min’ o bihi zani zaŋ ŋun’ Yawɛ yuli tumdi tuma sahakam.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: Lɛvi zuliya ni nira yi yi tin’ shɛl’ ni o ni pun be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-ka Yawɛ ni yɛn pii luɣ’ shɛli na ,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: dindina o ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ yuli tum tuma kaman o Lɛvi tab’ zaa ni zaani Yawɛ tooni tumdi tuma nimaani shɛm.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni, yin’ miriya ka yi ti tumdi zuliya shɛb’ bɛn be nimaani tuun’ shɛŋa din tumbu chihiri la.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Dama ŋunkam niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnima nyɛla Yawɛ ni bi bɔri so, binyɛra din chihiri ŋɔ niŋbu zuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daŋ kariti ba maa.

english_verse: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things! A Prophet like Moses Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di simdi ni yi kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim. Naawuni lo alikauli ni o ni tim anabi na

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Dama yi ni yɛn kari zuliya shɛb’ maa nyɛla bɛn doli baɣisi mini bihiŋmɛriba yɛligu, amaa yinim’ bɛna, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bi saɣi ni yi niŋ lala.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka anabi yi yimaŋmaŋ’ niriba ni na kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ti wummiya anabi maa yɛligu.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Yi ni daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ dahin’ shɛli yi ni daa laɣim Sinai Zoli gbini la yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, “Ti yi lan wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kukoli pahi bee n-nya buɣim titali ŋɔ yaha, ti ni kpi.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, “Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam ti zaɣisi anab’ maa ni yɛn zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa maa wumbu, mmaŋmaŋ’ ni ti kari dilan’ saria.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Amaa anabi so ŋun ti zaŋ wuna yuya tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa bee anab’ so ŋun zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa n ni bi zal’ o ni o tɔɣisi, di daanab’ maa ni kpi.

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Yi ni tooi bɔhi yimaŋa, ‘Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ baŋ yɛtɔɣ’ shɛli Yawɛ ni bi yɛli?’

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Anabi yi zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ’ shɛli ka di bi niŋ bee ka shɛli bi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, di pala Yawɛ ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ’ shɛli: Anabi maa n-kul ŋme nyɔɣu n-tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa; yin’ di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya.”

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: ka yi yi ti doli n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka dol’ o soya sahakam, dindina yi ni tooi pii fɔntins’ ata pahi tins’ ata maa zuɣu,

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti kari ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ zuliya shɛb’ tiŋgbɔŋ tiri ya maa, ka yi yihi ba, ka ʒini bɛ fɔntinsi ni n-kpe m-be bɛ yiya ni,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: Di yi nyɛla nir’ min’ o kpee chaŋla mɔɣu ni ni bɛ ti ŋma dari, ka o ti yaai kpaŋ ni o ŋmaai tia luhi, ka kpan zuɣu ŋooi n-ŋme o kpee maa ka o kpi, ŋun ku o maa ni tooi zo n-kuli fɔntinsi ŋɔ tin’ yin’ ni tiligi.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Amaa tiŋ’ maa shee yi waɣa, ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri maa ni ti zo m-paag’ o ni suhuyiɣisili pam n-ku ŋun ku nir’ maa, hal bɛ ni bi kari saria n-wuhi ni o simdila kubu maa, dama dimdi pun bi be bɛ niriba ayi maa sunsuuni.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi piim’ fɔntins’ ata maa.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: ka lala chɛ ka yi ku ku ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn ka taali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ʒim yihibu taali ʒi yi zuɣu.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Amaa dimdi yi be so min’ o kpee sunsuuni, ka o do’ n-gu o nti chaŋ ti lir’ o ku dilana ka zo n-kuli fɔntinsi ŋɔ tin’ yin’ ni,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: dindina ŋun ku nir’ maa ya kpamba bɛn’ timmi tiŋ’ maa ni ti zaŋ o na ti ti ŋun yɛn bɔh’ o biɛri, ka bɛ ku o.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zo o nambɔɣu. Amaa yihimiya ninvuɣ’ so ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani. Kurimbuni tiŋgban’ tarisi

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin’ ti miriya ka yi vuɣi yi kpee tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha niriba ni daa kpa shɛli, ka di be bɛ ni yɛn piri tiŋgban’ shɛŋa tin ya la ni. Zaŋ chaŋ shɛhira dibu polo

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Ninvuɣ’ yino shɛhira dibu bi saɣi ni bɛ wuhi ni nir’ mali taali bee galimi zaŋ chaŋ taali shɛlikam tumbu polo naɣila niriba ayi bee niriba ata shɛhira dibu ka yi ni doli n-wuhi ni nir’ mali taali.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Shɛhira dira ŋun nyɛ nia biɛɣulana yi kana ti wuhi ni so tum tuumbiɛɣu,

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti lo tɔb’ chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka nya bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam gari yi tɔbbihi, yin’ di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la be yi sani.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti yɛn kpe tɔb’ maa tuhibu ni, yin’ chɛliya ka maligumaaniba kana ti zani tooni n-tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, “Izraɛlnima wummiya, yi vu m-miri ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnim’ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi ni sɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Dama yi mini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi yi dimnim’ maa, ka o chɛ ka yi di nasara.”

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin’ kpamba mi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, “So beni m-me yili palli ka na bi suhi Naawuni ka kpe di ni? O labimi kul’ o yili maa ni, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb’ maa ni ka so ti suhi Naawuni ka kpe o yili maa ni.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee ko o wain tihi puu ka na bi di di wala? Dilan’ labimi kul’ o yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb’ maa ni ka so di di nyaɣisim maa.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee bo paɣa ka bɛ na bi kulis’ o na? Dilan’ labimi kuli yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb’ maa ni ka so kpuɣ’ o paɣ’ maa.”

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Ka sapashin’ kpamba maa yi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa maa naai, sapashinnim’ bɛn’ leemi bɛn su tɔbbihi maa fukumsi.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Amaa di yi nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ’ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ tinsi tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin’ di ti chɛnya binvuhirigu kam;

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: kumiya bɛ zaa, Hitinim’ mini Amɔrinim’ ni Keenannim’ ni Pɛrizinim’ ni Hivinim’ ni Jɛbusinima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ ku wuhi ya ka yi tum bɛ ni tumdi tuun’ shɛŋa zaa tiri bɛ buɣa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ti tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti teei gili tin’ shɛli ni yi tuhi deei li ka di ti yuui, yin’ di ŋmahi di tiwala tihi bahi. Yi ni tooi di di wala, amaa miriya ka yi ti ŋmahi li luhi. Tihi din be puri ni maa nyɛla ninsalinima ka yi kana ti teei gil’ li?

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Yi ni tooi ŋma ti’ shɛŋa yi ni mi ka di bi wandi wala. Yi ni tooi ŋma li n-zaŋ li mali bindura tabili tiŋ’ maa gooni din ni chɛ ka yi tooi kpe di ni ti nyaŋ ba.

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: Yi yi nya ka ninsal’ kpi n-do mɔɣu ni ka yi bi mi ŋun ku o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ka yi su li maa ni,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: dindina yi kpamba mini sariakaritiba bɛn cham’ ti buɣisi o ni do luɣ’ shɛli maa zaŋ chaŋ fɔntin’ shɛŋa din miri nimaani wɔɣilim,

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: ka fɔntin’ shɛli din ti miri kpim’ maa ni do luɣ’ shɛli maa kpamba ni bo naɣisa’ so bɛ ni na ʒi n-zaŋ tum tuma bee n-zaŋ dapua pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu.

english_verse: They and some of the priests will take this cow to a nearby valley where there is a stream, but no crops. Once they reach the valley, the leaders will break the cow's neck. The priests must be there, because the Lord your God has chosen them to be his special servants at the place of worship. The Lord has chosen them to bless the people in his name and to be judges in all legal cases, whether property or injury is involved.
translation_verse: Di saha ka maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Lɛvi bidibisi la ni kana, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii ba ni bɛ tumd’ o tuma, ka zaŋdi ŋun’ Yawɛ yuli suhiri alibarika niŋdi niriba ni, ka bɛ ni yɛli shɛm n-nyɛ din ŋmaari naŋgbankpeeni mini tab’ liribu yɛtɔɣa zaa.

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: ka yɛli, “Ti nuhi ka doo ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ni bee n-di di shɛhira.

english_verse: But since an innocent person was murdered, we beg you, our Lord, to accept this sacrifice and forgive Israel. We are your people, and you rescued us. Please don't hold this crime against us.” If you obey the Lord and do these things, he will forgive Israel. Marrying a Woman Taken Prisoner in War Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ n-yihi ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali yi sunsuuni. Dama di simdi ni yi niŋ din tuhi Yawɛ sani. Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni tuhi tɔbu gbahi paɣ’ shɛb’ polo

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi gbahi ba daba,

english_verse: One of these prisoners may be a beautiful woman, and you may want to marry her. But first you must bring her into your home, and have her shave her head, cut her nails, get rid of her foreign clothes, and start wearing Israelite clothes. She will mourn a month for her father and mother, then you can marry her.
translation_verse: ka yeeg’ o dabitim binyɛrigu, ka o niŋ a yiŋa goli muni n-kum o banim’ min’ o manim’ kuli. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa a ni tooi zaŋ o niŋ a paɣa, ka a leeg’ o yidana ka o mi leeg’ a paɣa.

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Amaa a nini yi ti bi tiɣ’ o, nyin’ bahim’ o ka o chaŋ, ka di zaŋ o kɔhi. Di bi simdi ni a niŋ o kaman dabili la, a ni zaŋ o dɔni m-baŋ o daashil’ la zuɣu. Zaŋ chaŋ bikpɛm’ sani fali polo

english_verse: Suppose a man has two wives and loves one more than the other. The first son of either wife is the man's first-born son, even if the boy's mother is the wife the man doesn't love. Later, when the man is near death and is dividing up his property, he must give a double share to his first-born son, simply because he was the first to be born. A Son Who Rebels Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Amaa di simdi ni o baŋ ni o bidib’ tuuli nyɛla o ni bi yur’ paɣ’ so la bidibiga maa, ka pirig’ o ni su shɛli maa ʒiibuyi zuɣu ti o, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ o kpiɔŋ saha bia, ka bituuli tarili nyɛla o dini. Zaŋ chaŋ bi’ so ŋun zaɣis’ o ba noli polo

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: Ka do’ so yi mali bidibiga ŋun nyɛ tipawumlilana ŋun bi deer’ o ba min’ o ma noli, ka bɛ yi darig’ o tibili o ni bi deeri bɛ yɛligu zuɣu,

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: dindina o ba min’ o ma maa bɛn’ gbaam’ o n-zaŋ o tahi bɛ ya kpamba sani nti zaŋ o zali tiŋ’ maa dunɔdali ni,

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: ka yɛli tiŋ’ maa kpamba maa, “Ti bia ŋɔ nyɛla tipawumlilana ni nɔzaɣisira; o bi deeri ti noli; o nyɛla pulaandana ni danyura.”

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di saha tiŋ’ maa dɔbba zaa bɛn’ labim’ o kuɣa ku o. Lala ka yi ni niŋ n-yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim’ zaa wum di yɛla ka dabiɛm gbahi ba. Zaligu shɛŋa din pahi

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: So yi tum taali din simdi ni bɛ ku o, ka bɛ zaŋ o yili tia ku o,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: yin’ di chɛ ka o gbe tia maa zuɣu, amaa yin’ sɔɣimiy’ o dindali maa, dama bɛ ni yili ninvuɣ’ so mia nyɛla Naawuni noli ni di so, di bi simdi ni yi ta Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa daɣiri.

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ka a nya a mabia nahu bee o piɛɣu ni chaŋ yirigi ka a baɣa ka o ni; di simdi ka a taɣ’ o labisi ti ti o lana.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Ka o lan’ maa yi be katiŋa bee a yi bi mi o lana, dindina nyin’ taɣim’ o kul’ a yiŋa, ka o ti be a sani hal ka o lan’ maa ti bɔh’ o yɛla, ka a zaŋ o ti o.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋ lala, di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee situra lala. A ʒiʒiinikpee binshɛɣukam yi bɔrigi, ka a nya li, di simdi ni a niŋ lala, di bi simdi ka a zaɣis’ o sɔŋbu.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys that carry heavy loads can stumble and fall, and be unable to get up by themselves. So as you walk along the road, help anyone who is trying to get an ox or donkey back on its feet. Don't Pretend To Be the Opposite Sex Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ka a nya a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋa bee o nahu ni lu n-do sol’ ni ka a baɣa kani, di simdi ni a sɔŋ yiɣis’ o zali.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Paɣ’ bi simdi ni o ye doo situra, ka doo gba bi simdi ka o ye paɣ’ situra, dama ŋunkam niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima, di nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yi yi me yil’ palli, yin’ niŋm’ bini kɔɣili yi mɔpilli ti tuui, di yi pa lala so yi yi di zuɣu luna kpi o ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi yili maa zuɣu.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti biri bimbir’ shɛli gari yi wain tihi puu ni, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi ni biri binshɛli maa mini wain tihi maa wala zaa.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu mini buŋa n-tabili taba ni bɛ ko.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti ye bɛ ni zaŋ piɛkɔbiri mini gali piɛlli gari tab’ wuɣi situr’ shɛŋa.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Niŋmiya bin’ zusanim’ niŋ yi ni yɛri situr’ shɛŋa naŋgbambiya anahi. Zaligu zaŋ chaŋ paɣ’ mini doo tab’ laɣimbu kasitali polo

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣisaribila n-zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa, di nyaaŋa ka o lan je o,

english_verse: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, “I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.”
translation_verse: ka ŋma ʒiri ni o saɣim’ o yuli yɛra, “N daa kpuɣila paɣ’ ŋɔ, amaa ka m min’ o ti dɔni, ka m bi nya o paɣipalitali shihira.”

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: Di saha paɣisarili maa ba min’ o ma bɛn’ zaŋmi paɣ’ maa paɣipalitali shihira na ti wuhi tiŋ’ maa kpamba dunɔdali gbini.

english_verse: Her father will say, “I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her
translation_verse: Ka paɣ’ maa ba maa yɛli kpamba maa, “N daa zaŋla m bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti doo ŋɔ ka o niŋ o paɣa, amaa ka o ti bi lan bɔr’ o,

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: ka ŋma ʒiri pa o pumpɔŋɔ yɛra, ‘N daa bi nya paɣipalitali shihirili yi bia maa sani.’ Amaa n-nyɛ m bipuɣiŋga maa paɣipalitali shihira.” Di saha ka bɛ zaŋ tani yɛrigi sɔŋ tiŋ’ maa kpamba maa tooni.

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Ka tiŋ’ maa kpamba maa zaŋ doo maa ti darig’ o tibili,

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: Amaa o ni yɛli shɛm maa yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka shɛhira shɛli kani din wuhiri ni paɣisarili maa daa nyɛla ŋun pali,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: dindina bɛn’ yihim’ paɣisarili maa na ti zal’ o ba yiŋ’ dunɔdali gbini, ka tiŋ’ maa ni dɔbba lab’ o kuɣa ku o, dama o tum vi tuuni din nyɛ pagɔrisigu gɔbu o ba yiŋa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi gbaai do’ so ka o zaŋ o kpee paɣ’ doya, yin’ kumiya bɛ niriba ayi maa; doo maa min’ o ni zaŋ paɣ’ so doya maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: If a man is caught in town having sex with an engaged woman who isn't screaming for help, they both must be put to death. The man is guilty of having sex with a married woman. And the woman is guilty because she didn't call for help, even though she was inside a town and people were nearby. Take them both to the town gate and stone them to death. You must get rid of the evil they brought into your community.
translation_verse: yin’ zaŋmiya bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa yi n-ti zali tiŋ’ maa dunɔdali gbini n-labi ba kuɣa ku ba. Yi ni ku paɣisarili maa, dama o daa bi kuhi ni bɛ zo o kuŋa tiŋ’ puuni maa, ka ku doo maa mi, dama o saɣim o kpee paɣa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: Amaa doo yi chirigi paɣ’ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti doo mɔɣu ni n-gbaag’ o goli, dindina do’ so ŋun gol’ o maa kɔŋko ka bɛ ni ku.

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi niŋ paɣisarili maa shɛli. Paɣisarili maa bi tum tuun’ shɛli din simdi kubu; dama yɛlli ŋɔ ŋmanila doo ni yi chaŋ ti lir’ o kpee n-ku o la.

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: Dama mɔɣu ni ka o daa nya o, ka bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ’ so ti doo maa daa naan tooi kuhi ni bɛ sɔŋ o, amaa so daa kani ŋun ni fa o bahi.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: Doo yi chirigi bɛ ni bi zaŋ paɣisaribil’ so ti doo n-zaŋ o dɔni ka bɛ gbahi ba,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: Doo miri ka o kpuɣ’ o ba paɣa n-filim’ o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o nya o ba zaɣim.

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ŋmahim do’ so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai do’ so yoli, o bi simdi ni bɛ deeg’ o niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Pagɔr’ bia bi simdi ni o be Yawɛ niriba ni, hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, di bi simdi ni bɛ chɛ ka o bia kpe Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ni bɛ deei Ammɔn nira bee Mɔab nira niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, soli kani ni bɛ deei bɛ zuliya niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni,

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini kom na ti tuhi ya soli saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la zuɣu mini bɛ ni daa lan da Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛɔr ŋun yi Pɛtɔr din be Mɛsopoteemia na bia la ni o ti yɛli noli tin ya la zuɣu.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti bɔri bɛ biɛrisuŋ bee m-bɔri bɛ tɔŋbu saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be yi nyɛvili ni.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi siŋ Ɛdomnim’ ni so, dama bɛ nyɛla yi mabihi, miriya ka yi siŋ Ijiptinima, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba m-be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Zaŋ hal ni ʒiɛmani din pahiri buta ni, yi ni tooi deei bɛ ni dɔɣi bi’ shɛba niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni. Tɔbbihi sansani kasi biɛhigu

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti chaŋ ti dɔni ni yi tuhi yi dimnima, yin’ gbaamiya yimaŋa ni zaɣ’ biɛɣu kam zaa.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Ka do’ so yi ti zahim zahindi yuŋ’ mahig’ omaŋa, dindina ŋun yim’ sansani maa ni, ka di lan kpe sansani maa ni na.

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: Amaa zaawuni yi ti paai, ŋun’ sum’ kom, ka wuntaŋ’ yi ti lu, o ni tooi lan labi sansani maa ni na.
