english_verse: Terah decided to move from Ur to the land of Canaan. He took along Abram and Sarai and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran. But when they came to the city of Haran, they settled there instead.
translation_verse: Ka Tɛra daa zaŋ o bia Ibram min’ o yaaŋa Lɔt ni Ibram paɣa Zarai m-pah’ omaŋ’ zuɣu, ka bɛ yi Ur din be Kalidianim’ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Haran n-kpalim ʒini nimaani.

english_verse: The Lord said to Abram: Leave your country, your family, and your relatives and go to the land that I will show you.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Ibram, “Yim’ a ya ŋɔ min’ a ba yiŋa ni a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ sani n-chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛl’ ni n ni yɛn wuh’ a.

english_verse: I will bless you and make your descendants into a great nation. You will become famous and be a blessing to others.
translation_verse: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya galisi pam. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a yuli du pam, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ gba ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.

english_verse: I will bless those who bless you, but I will put a curse on anyone who puts a curse on you. Everyone on earth will be blessed because of you.
translation_verse: Ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, n gba ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni. Ka ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn yɛli noli ti a, n gba ni yɛli noli ti ba. Ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.”

english_verse: Abram went as far as the sacred tree of Moreh in a place called Shechem. The Canaanites were still living in the land at that time,
translation_verse: ka Ibram daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ Shɛkɛm ti ʒini Mɔre oki tia gbini. Keenannima n-daa be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni di saha maa.

english_verse: but the Lord appeared to Abram and promised, “I will give this land to your family forever.” Abram then built an altar there for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Ibram sanna ti yɛl’ o, “N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya.” Di saha ka Ibram daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani zali Yawɛ ŋun daa ka o sani maa na.

english_verse: Abram traveled to the hill country east of Bethel and camped between Bethel and Ai, where he built another altar and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi nimaani n-chaŋ ti ti o suɣili Bɛtɛl wulimpuhili polo zoli zuɣu ʒini; ka chɛ Bɛtɛl bahi wulinluhili polo, ka chɛ Ai mi bahi wulimpuhili polo. Ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ nimaani gba n-jɛmd’ o di gbini.

english_verse: Later, Abram started out toward the Southern Desert. Abram in Egypt
translation_verse: Ka Ibram daa lan gbaai chandi zaŋ kpa Nɛgɛb polo. Ibram chaŋ Ijipti

english_verse: The crops failed, and there was no food anywhere in Canaan. So Abram and his wife Sarai went to live in Egypt for a while. But just before they got there, Abram said, “Sarai, you are really beautiful!
translation_verse: O ni daa ti yɛn kpe Ijipti saha shɛli ka o yɛl’ o paɣ’ Zarai, “M mi ni a nyɛla paɣ’ viɛlli, ka a lihibu mali kɔre.

english_verse: When the Egyptians see you, they will murder me because I am your husband. But they won't kill you.
translation_verse: Ka Ijiptinim’ yi ti nya a, bɛ ni yɛli, ‘O paɣa m-bala’, ka ku ma ka chɛ a.

english_verse: Please save my life by saying you are my sister.”
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ ba ni a nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa, ka bɛ niŋ ma nirilim a zuɣu, ka tiligi n nyɛvili a zuɣu.”

english_verse: As soon as Abram and Sarai arrived in Egypt, the Egyptians noticed how beautiful she was.
translation_verse: Ka Ibram ni daa ti kpe Ijipti, Ijiptinim’ daa shiri nyaya ka paɣ’ maa nyɛla paɣ’ viɛlli.

english_verse: The king's officials told him about her, and she was taken to his house.
translation_verse: Firawuna kpambaliba ni daa nya o, bɛ daa paɣ’ o pam Firawuna sani. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Firawuna yiŋa.

english_verse: The king was good to Abram because of Sarai, and Abram was given sheep, cattle, donkeys, slaves, and camels.
translation_verse: Ka Firawuna daa niŋ Ibram nirilim viɛnyɛliŋga Zarai zuɣu. O daa ti Ibram piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni bundibisi ni bunnyama ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnima.

english_verse: Because of Sarai, the Lord struck the king and everyone in his palace with terrible diseases.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo dɔriti gbaai Firawuna min’ o yiŋnima, Ibram paɣ’ Zarai maa zuɣu.

english_verse: Finally, the king sent for Abram and said to him, “What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me Sarai was your wife?
translation_verse: Ka Firawuna daa boli Ibram na nti bɔh’ o, “Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ma lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi yɛli ma ni o nyɛla a paɣa?

english_verse: Why did you make me believe she was your sister? Now I've married her. Take her and go! She's your wife.”
translation_verse: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni o nyɛla a tizɔpaɣa, ka n zaŋ o niŋ m-paɣa? Dinzuɣu n-nyɛ a paɣa! Zaŋm’ o chaŋ.”

english_verse: So the king told his men to let Abram and Sarai take their possessions and leave.
translation_verse: Ka Firawuna daa bah’ o niriba noli, ka bɛ zaŋ Ibram min’ o paɣa ni o ni mali binshɛlikam zaa yihi soli.

english_verse: Abram and Sarai took everything they owned and went to the Southern Desert. Lot went with them.
translation_verse: Ka Ibram min’ o paɣa daa zaŋ bɛ ni su binshɛlikam zaa n-yi Ijipti chaŋ Nɛgɛb, ka Lɔt daa dol’ o chaŋ.

english_verse: Abram was very rich. He owned many cattle, sheep, and goats, and had a lot of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Ibram daa mali buni pam. O daa mali biŋkɔbiri mini anzinfa ni salima.

english_verse: Abram moved from place to place in the Southern Desert. And finally, he went north and set up his tents between Bethel and Ai,
translation_verse: Ka o daa yi Nɛgɛb n-chaŋ hal ti paai Bɛtɛl luɣ’ shɛli o ni daa tuui kpa o tanti suɣili zali piligu ni, ka di be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni la.

english_verse: where he had earlier camped and built an altar. There he worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: O ni daa tuui me sara maligu bimbini zali luɣ’ shɛl’ la; nimaani ka Ibram daa jɛm Yawɛ.

english_verse: Lot, who was traveling with him, also had sheep, goats, and cattle, as well as his own family and slaves.
translation_verse: Ka Lɔt ŋun daa doli Ibram maa gba daa mali biŋkɔbbaligu mini niɣi ni tantinima,

english_verse: Abram said to Lot, “We are close relatives. We shouldn't argue, and our men shouldn't be fighting one another.
translation_verse: Ka Ibram daa yɛli Lɔt, “Di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe m min’ a sunsuuni; a mi di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe a biŋkɔbiguliba mini m biŋkɔbiguliba sunsuuni, dama ti nyɛla dɔɣim.

english_verse: There is plenty of land for you to choose from. Let's separate. If you go north, I'll go south; if you go south, I'll go north.”
translation_verse: Pa palo n-kul do a tooni ŋɔ? Woligim’ ka chɛ ma. A yi zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo, n ni zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo; ka a yi zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo, m mi ni zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo.”

english_verse: This happened before the Lord had destroyed the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. And when Lot looked around, he saw there was plenty of water in the Jordan Valley. All the way to Zoar the valley was as green as the garden of the Lord or the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ka Lɔt daa kpuɣ’ o zuɣu lihi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili polo n-nya ka kom kul tɛli di vinvamli ni luɣ’ shɛlikam zaa, ka di be kaman Yawɛ tihi puu la bee m-be kaman Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ’ shɛli din be Zɔa polo la. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa naanyi ti saɣim Sɔdom mini Gomɔra la.

english_verse: So Lot chose the whole Jordan Valley for himself, and as he started out toward the east, he and Abram separated.
translation_verse: Ka Lɔt daa pii Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili vinvamli polo maa n-daa zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo. Bɛ ni daa woligi shɛm m-bala.

english_verse: Abram stayed in the land of Canaan. But Lot settled near the cities of the valley and put up his tents not far from Sodom,
translation_verse: Ka Ibram daa be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Lɔt mi be vinvamli maa ni fɔntinsi ni, ka daa ti yiɣisi n-zaŋ o tanti suɣili chaŋ ti kpa Sɔdom.

english_verse: where the people were evil and sinned terribly against the Lord. Abram Moves to Hebron
translation_verse: Di saha Sɔdomnim’ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ’ biɛri ni bɛn tumd’ alahichi pam Yawɛ sani. Ibram kuli Hiburɔn

english_verse: After Abram and Lot had gone their separate ways, the Lord said to Abram: Look around to the north, south, east, and west.
translation_verse: Ibram mini Lɔt ni daa woligi maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram, “Kpuɣim’ a zuɣu lihi a ni ʒe luɣ’ shɛli ŋɔ nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo ni wulinluhili polo.

english_verse: I will give you and your family all the land you can see. It will be theirs forever!
translation_verse: A ni nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa zaa, n ni zaŋ li ti a zuliya ka bɛ su li sahakam.

english_verse: I will give you more descendants than there are specks of dust on the earth, and someday it will be easier to count those specks of dust than to count your descendants.
translation_verse: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya ti bemi kaman bihigu la, ka nir’ yi ni tooi kali bihigu, o ni ti tooi kal’ a zuliya gba.

english_verse: Now walk back and forth across the land, because I am going to give it to you.
translation_verse: Yiɣisim’ doli tiŋgbɔŋ maa wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ nya, n ni zaŋ li ti a.”

english_verse: Abram took down his tents and went to live near the sacred trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Ibram daa vuɣ’ o tanti suɣili n-chaŋ ti kpa Mamri oki ti’ shɛŋa din be Hiburɔn la gbini; ka daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani jɛm Yawɛ.

english_verse: About this time, King Amraphel of Babylonia, King Arioch of Ellasar, King Chedorlaomer of Elam, and King Tidal of Goiim
translation_verse: Shiina Naa Amirafɛl mini Ɛlasa Naa Ariok ni Ɛlam Naa Chɛdolaoma ni Goiim Naa Tidal

english_verse: attacked King Bera of Sodom, King Birsha of Gomorrah, King Shinab of Admah, King Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, a city also known as Zoar.
translation_verse: daa ti lo tɔbu bɛ ʒiɛman’ ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Sɔdom Naa Bɛra mini Gomɔra Naa Birisha ni Adima Naa Shinab ni Zɛbɔiim Naa Shɛmɛba ni Bɛla bee Zɔa naa.

english_verse: King Chedorlaomer and his allies had ruled these last five kings for twelve years, but in the thirteenth year the kings rebelled and joined forces in Siddim Valley, which is now covered by the southern part of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Bɛ daa jɛm Chɛdolaoma la yuun’ pinaayi, amaa yuun’ shɛli din daa pahiri yuun’ pinaata la ni ka bɛ daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku lan jɛm o.

english_verse: A year later King Chedorlaomer and his allies attacked and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, and the Emites in Shaveh-Kiriathaim.
translation_verse: Yuun’ shɛli din daa ti pahiri yuun’ pinaanahi ni, ka Chɛdolaoma mini na’ shɛb’ bɛn daa sɔŋd’ o daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Rɛfaim din be Ashitɛrɔtikarinaim tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Zuzim din be Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni Ɛmim din be Shavɛkiriataim tiŋgbɔŋ ni

english_verse: They also defeated the Horites in the hill country of Edom, as far as El-Paran, near the desert.
translation_verse: ni Hɔrinim’ bɛn be Ɛdom zoya ni la n-doli ba hal ni Ɛliparan din be mɔɣu ni tintariga la shee.

english_verse: They went back to the city of Enmishpat, better known as Kadesh. Then they captured all the land that belonged to the Amalekites, and they defeated the Amorites who were living in Hazazon-Tamar.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lab’ Ɛnmishipat bɛ ni booni luɣ’ shɛli Kadɛshi la. Ka bɛ daa tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛk tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim’ mini Amɔrinim’ bɛn daa be Hazazɔntarima la zaa.

english_verse: At Siddim Valley, the armies of the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela fought the armies of King Chedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Babylonia, and King Arioch of Ellasar. The valley
translation_verse: ka bɛ mini Ɛlam Naa Chɛdolaoma ni Goiim Naa Tidal ni Shiina Naa Amirafɛl ni Ɛlasa Naa Ariok ti gbaai tab’ tuhibu. Nanima anahi mini nanima anu n-daa lu tab’ zuɣu maa.

english_verse: was full of tar pits, and when the troops from Sodom and Gomorrah started running away, some of them fell into the pits. Others escaped to the hill country.
translation_verse: Kootaali tandɔri n-daa kul yɛrigi Siddim vinvamli maa ni; ka Sɔdom mini Gomɔra nanim’ la daa ŋmaligi guuri ka bɛ ni shɛb’ faai lu kootaali tandɔri maa ni, ka bɛn kpalim mi zo nti du zoli.

english_verse: Their enemies took everything of value from Sodom and Gomorrah, including their food supplies.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ dimnim’ maa daa kana ti kpuɣi bɛn’ Sɔdomnim’ mini Gomɔranim’ maa nɛma mini bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa chaŋ.

english_verse: They also captured Abram's nephew Lot, who lived in Sodom. They took him and his possessions and then left.
translation_verse: Hal bɛ daa gbaai Lɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Ibram tizo bia la gba, ka zaŋ o nɛma pahi chaŋ.

english_verse: At this time Abram the Hebrew was living near the oaks that belonged to Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his brothers Eshcol and Aner were Abram's friends. Someone who had escaped from the battle told Abram
translation_verse: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino ŋun daa zo n-tiligi daa kana ti yɛli Ibram ŋun daa nyɛ Hiburu nira ka be Mamri ŋun daa nyɛ Amɔri nir’ la oki tihi gbini. Mamri min’ o mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛshikol mini Anɛr la daa nyɛla Ibram zɔnima.

english_verse: that his nephew Lot had been taken away. Three hundred and eighteen of Abram's servants were fighting men, so he took them and followed the enemy as far north as the city of Dan.
translation_verse: Ibram ni daa wum ni bɛ tuhi gbaag’ o dɔɣim maa chaŋ maa, ka o daa zaŋ o tɔbbi’ shɛb’ bɛ ni daa dɔɣ’ o yiŋ’ puuni, ka bɛ nyɛ tɔbutuhiri’ biinsi la ninvuɣ’ kɔbisita ni pisaayika n-kari bɛ naba hal ti paai Dan.

english_verse: That night, Abram divided up his troops, attacked from all sides, and won a great victory. But some of the enemy escaped to the town of Hobah north of Damascus,
translation_verse: Ka Ibram daa pirigipirig’ o tɔbbihi maa n-chaŋ ti liri ba yuŋ ŋ-ŋme n-kari ba hal ti paai Hɔba din be Damaskus nuzaa polo la.

english_verse: and Abram went after them. He brought back his nephew Lot, together with Lot's possessions and the women and everyone else who had been captured. Abram Is Blessed by Melchizedek
translation_verse: Ka o daa va bɛ nɛma zaa, ka zaŋ o dɔɣim Lɔt min’ o nɛma gba ni ninvuɣ’ shɛba ni paɣiba m-pahi labina. Mɛlikizɛdɛk niŋ alibarika niŋ Ibram ni

english_verse: Abram returned after he had defeated King Chedorlaomer and the other kings. Then the king of Sodom went to meet Abram in Shaveh Valley, which is also known as King's Valley.
translation_verse: Ibram ni daa nyaŋ Chɛdolaoma mini na’ shɛb’ bɛn be o sani ka labirina saha shɛli, ka Sɔdom naa daa chaŋ ti tuh’ o soli Shave vinvamli ni bɛ ni daa booni luɣ’ shɛli Naa Vinvamli la.

english_verse: King Melchizedek of Salem was a priest of God Most High. He brought out some bread and wine
translation_verse: Ka Salɛm Naa Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋun daa lan nyɛ Zallakudura Naa maligumaana la daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini wain na nti ti Ibram;

english_verse: and said to Abram: “I bless you in the name of God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
translation_verse: ka suhi alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛli, “Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ niŋm’ alibarika niŋ Ibram ni!

english_verse: All praise belongs to God Most High for helping you defeat your enemies.” Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
translation_verse: Ti paɣiri Zallakudura Naa ŋun chɛ ka a nyaŋ a dimnim’ ŋɔ!” Ka Ibram daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa pia puuni zaɣ’ yiniyini yihi Mɛlikizɛdɛk zaka.

english_verse: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “All I want are my people. You can keep everything else.”
translation_verse: Ka Sɔdom naa maa daa yɛli Ibram, “Zaŋm’ niriba ŋɔ ti ma, amaa ka mali nɛma ŋɔ zaa.”

english_verse: Abram answered: The Lord God Most High made the heavens and the earth. And I have promised him
translation_verse: Amaa ka Ibram daa yɛli, “M pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ

english_verse: that I won't keep anything of yours, not even a sandal strap or a piece of thread. Then you can never say that you are the one who made me rich.
translation_verse: ni n ku zaŋ a gali bee a namdili mia bee a ni su binshɛlikam, ka a ti yɛli, ‘Mani n-chɛ ka Ibram leei bundana.’

english_verse: Let my share be the food that my men have eaten. But Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre went with me, so give them their share of what we brought back.
translation_verse: N ku zaŋ binshɛli naɣila n nachimba ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn doli ma chaŋ la ni pun di shɛl’ la; amaa naɣ’ chɛ ka Anɛr mini Ɛshikol ni Mamri n-yihi bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli di ni.”

english_verse: Later the Lord spoke to Abram in a vision, “Abram, don't be afraid! I will protect you and reward you greatly.”
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔnim’ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram ʒii nyabu puuni, “Ibram, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal’ a, n ni gbib’ a ka chɛ ka a laara ti galisi pam.”

english_verse: But Abram answered, “Lord All-Powerful, you have given me everything I could ask for, except children. And when I die, Eliezer of Damascus will get all I own.
translation_verse: Ka Ibram daa bɔhi, “Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, bɔ ka a yɛn ti ma? Nyama, n na ka bia, ka daɣila Ɛliɛza ŋun nyɛ Damaskus nir’ la nti yɛn di n fali?”

english_verse: You have not given me any children, and this servant of mine will inherit everything.”
translation_verse: Ibram daa lan yɛli, “Nyama, a ni bi ti ma bia maa zuɣu, bɛ ni dɔɣi dab’ so n yiŋ’ puuni la nti yɛn di n fali.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “No, he won't! You will have a son of your own, and everything you have will be his.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛl’ o, “Pa ŋuna nti yɛn di a fali; amaŋmaŋ’ bia nti yɛn di a fali.”

english_verse: Then the Lord took Abram outside and said, “Look at the sky and see if you can count the stars. That's how many descendants you will have.”
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yi samban’ ni ti yɛl’ o, “Kpuɣim’ a zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa n-kali saŋmarisi, a yi ni tooi kali ba.” Di saha ka o daa yɛl’ o, “Lala ka a zuliya ti yɛn be.”

english_verse: Abram believed the Lord, so the Lord was pleased with him and accepted him. The Lord Makes Another Promise to Abram

translation_verse: Amaa ka Sɔdomnim’ maa yɛl’ o, “Miligim’ ka ti ti palo. A nyɛla sana kpe, ka bɔri ni a wuhi ti ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm? A yi bi baŋ ti ni niŋ a din bie n-gari ti ni yɛn niŋ ba shɛm.” Ka bɛ daa kul dihiri Lɔt na hal ti paai dunoli m-bɔri ni bɛ ŋme n-kab’ li.

english_verse: But the two angels in the house reached out and pulled Lot safely inside.

english_verse: The two angels said to Lot, “The Lord has heard many terrible things about the people of Sodom, and he has sent us here to destroy the city. Take your family and leave. Take every relative you have in the city, as well as the men your daughters are going to marry.”

english_verse: Lot went to the men who were engaged to his daughters and said, “Hurry up and get out of here! The Lord is going to destroy this city.” But they thought he was joking, and they laughed at him.
translation_verse: Ka Lɔt daa yi n-chaŋ ti yɛl’ o deennim’ bɛn daa yɛn kpuɣ’ o bipuɣinsi la, “Yiɣisimiya n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, dama Yawɛ yɛn saɣim li mi.” Amaa ka o deennim’ maa daa zaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ asahi.

english_verse: Early the next morning the two angels tried to make Lot hurry and leave. They said, “Take your wife and your two daughters and get away from here as fast as you can! If you don't, every one of you will be killed when the Lord destroys the city.”
translation_verse: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka malaikanim’ maa kpam Lɔt jaande yɛra, “Yiɣisim’ zaŋ a paɣ’ min’ a bipuɣins’ ayi bɛn be a sani ŋɔ n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, di yi pa lala, yaŋɔnim’ ni yɛn nya tibidarigibo shɛli maa ni tabili ya.”

english_verse: At first, Lot just stood there. But the Lord wanted to save him. So the angels took Lot, his wife, and his two daughters by the hand and led them out of the city.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Lɔt daa bi lɛbira, ka Yawɛ daa zo ba nambɔɣu n-chɛ ka malaikanim’ maa gbah’ o min’ o paɣ’ ni o bipuɣins’ ayi maa nuhi ni n-vo ba yihi tiŋ’ maa tariga ti zali.

english_verse: When they were outside, one of the angels said, “Run for your lives! Don't even look back. And don't stop in the valley. Run to the hills, where you'll be safe.”
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba na ti zali maa nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, “Zomiya tiligi! Yi mi miriya ka yi ŋmaligi lihi yi nyaaŋa bee n-zani vinvamli ŋɔ ni luɣ’ shɛli. Kul zomiya ti du zoya ŋɔ ha, di yi pa lala, buɣim ni din ya.”

english_verse: Lot answered, “You have done us a great favor, sir. You have saved our lives, but please don't make us go to the hills. That's too far away. The city will be destroyed before we can get there, and we will be killed when it happens.

english_verse: There's a town near here. It's only a small place, but my family and I will be safe, if you let us go there.”

english_verse: When God destroyed the cities of the valley where Lot lived, he remembered his promise to Abraham and saved Lot from the terrible destruction. Moab and Ammon
translation_verse: Naawuni ni daa saɣindi vinvamli ni tinsi maa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa teei Ibrahimma yɛla, ka yihi Lɔt o ni daa saɣindi tin’ shɛŋa din nyɛ Lɔt ni daa ʒi luɣ’ shɛl’ la n-tilig’ o. Mɔabnim’ mini Ammɔnnim’ Piligu

english_verse: Lot was afraid to stay on in Zoar. So he took his two daughters and moved to a cave in the hill country.
translation_verse: Ka Lɔt min’ o bipuɣins’ ayi la daa ti yiɣisi Zɔa n-chaŋ ti du zoya zuɣu n-kpe m-be vokabili ni, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o be Zɔa.

english_verse: One day his older daughter said to her sister, “Our father is old, and there are no men anywhere for us to marry.

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and the older daughter got in bed with him, but he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ, ka bipuɣin’ kpɛm’ maa daa kpe ka o min’ o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.

english_verse: The next day the older daughter said to her sister, “I slept with my father last night. We'll get him drunk again tonight, so you can sleep with him, and we can each have a child.”
translation_verse: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka bipuɣin’ kpɛm’ maa yɛli biasan’ la, “Nyama, Mam’ mini m ba sa dɔniya yuŋ la, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti lan niŋ wain maa ti o yuŋ ŋɔ, ka a gba kpe o sani ka a min’ o ti dɔni, ka di chɛ ka ti nam zuliya o sani zali.”

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and this time the younger sister slept with him. But once again he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa lan niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ; ka biasani maa gba daa kpe ka o min’ o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.

english_verse: The older daughter named her son Moab, and he is the ancestor of the Moabites.
translation_verse: Ka bipuɣin’ kpɛm’ maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol’ o yuli Mɔab. O yaansi n-nyɛ Mɔabnim’ bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.

english_verse: The younger daughter named her son Benammi, and he is the ancestor of the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Ka biasan’ la gba daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol’ o yuli Bɛnammi. O yaansi n-nyɛ Ammɔnnim’ bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.

english_verse: he told everyone that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛli ni o paɣ’ Zara nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa. Ka Gɛra Naa Abimilɛk daa tim ti zaŋ Zara na.

english_verse: But God came to Abimelech in a dream and said, “You have taken a married woman into your home, and for this you will die!”
translation_verse: Amaa ka Naawuni daa ka Abimilɛk sanna zahindi puuni yuŋ ti yɛl’ o, “Nyama, a nyɛla kpima, a ni kpuɣi paɣ’ so la na zuɣu; dama o nyɛla do’ so paɣa.”

english_verse: Abimelech said to the Lord, “Don't kill me! I haven't slept with Sarah. Didn't they say they were brother and sister? I am completely innocent.”
translation_verse: Pa omaŋmaŋa n-yɛli ma ni o nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa? Ka paɣ’ maa maŋmaŋ’ gba yɛli ma ni o nyɛla o tizɔdoo. M bi tum taali n tɛha ni, ka mi bi zaŋ n nuhi tum taal’ shɛli.”

english_verse: Her husband is a prophet. Let her go back to him, and his prayers will save you from death. But if you don't return her, you and all your people will die.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, labisim’ doo maa paɣa ti o; dama o nyɛla anabi, ka o suhi Naawuni ti a ka a be. Amaa a yi bi labis’ o ti o, nyin’ baŋmi ni biɛhiŋ kani a min’ a ni su ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ zaa ni kpi.”

english_verse: Early the next morning Abimelech sent for his officials, and when he told them what had happened, they were frightened.
translation_verse: Ka Abimilɛk daa daŋ yibu asibaasi m-bol’ o kpambaliba na nti zaŋ yɛla maa zaa yɛli ba, ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam.

english_verse: Abimelech then called in Abraham and said: Look what you've done to us! What have I ever done to you? Why did you make me and my nation guilty of such a terrible sin?
translation_verse: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa boli Ibrahimma na nti bɔh’ o, “Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ti lala? Taal’ bɔ ka n lee tum’ a ka a ti chɛ ka m mini n nam ŋɔ tum alahichi titali ŋɔ? A niŋ ma di ni bi simdi ni nir’ niŋ o kpee shɛm.”

english_verse: Abraham answered: I did it because I didn't think any of you respected God, and I was sure that someone would kill me to get my wife.
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, “N daa tɛhimi ni so ka kpe n-zɔri Naawuni, ka tɛhi ni bɛ ni ku ma m paɣ’ maa zuɣu, dina n-chɛ ka n niŋ lala maa.

english_verse: When God made us leave my father's home and start wandering, I told her, “If you really love me, then tell everyone that I am your brother.”
translation_verse: Ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka n yi m ba yiŋa n-chani gindi ŋɔ puuni, ka n yɛl’ o, ‘A ni yɛn niŋ ma nirilim shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Ti yi ti paai luɣ’ shɛlikam, nyin’ yɛlimi ni n nyɛla a tizɔdoo.’ ”

english_verse: After Abimelech had given Abraham some sheep, cattle, and slaves, he sent Sarah back
translation_verse: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa zaŋ piɛri mini naɣilahi ni dabidɔbba ni paɣiba ti Ibrahimma, ka zaŋ o paɣ’ Zara gba labisi ti o.

english_verse: Meanwhile, God had kept Abimelech's wife and slaves from having children. But Abraham prayed, and God let them start having children again.
translation_verse: Dama Ibrahimma paɣ’ Zara zuɣu, Yawɛ daa ŋarila Abimilɛk yiŋ’ paɣiba maa bidɔɣibo soya.

english_verse: Although Abraham was very old, Sarah had a son exactly at the time God had said.
translation_verse: Ka Zara daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ti Ibrahimma o ninkurilim ni, saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa pun yɛl’ o la.

english_verse: and when the boy was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, just as God had commanded.
translation_verse: O bia Yisahaku maa daba anii dali ka ŋun’ Ibrahimma daa gun’ o kaman Naawuni ni daa zal’ o shɛm.

english_verse: and Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. And now everyone will laugh with me.
translation_verse: Ka Zara daa yɛli, “Naawuni bo lari ti ma, ka ŋunkam zaa wum di yɛla ni la n-sɔŋ ma.”

english_verse: Who would have dared to tell Abraham that someday I would have a child? But in his old age, I have given him a son.”
translation_verse: Zara daa lan yɛli, “Ŋuni n-daa naan yɛli Ibrahimma ni bihi ni ti mɔɣi man’ Zara biha. Amaa m bahi dɔɣi bia ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni.”

english_verse: The time came when Sarah no longer had to nurse Isaac, and on that day Abraham gave a big feast. Hagar and Ishmael Are Sent Away
translation_verse: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi, ka bɛ ŋmaag’ o bihili, ka Ibrahimma daa puhi chuɣu dahin’ shɛli Yisahaku ni daa ŋmaai bihili maa. Bɛ kari Haga mini Ishimail

english_verse: One day, Sarah noticed Hagar's son Ishmael playing, and she said to Abraham, “Get rid of that Egyptian slave woman and her son! I don't want him to inherit anything. It should all go to my son.”
translation_verse: Ka Zara daa yɛli Ibrahimma, “Karim’ dab’ paɣ’ ŋɔ min’ o bia ŋɔ, dama dab’ paɣ’ maa bia maa mini m bia Yisahaku ku laɣim di fali.”

english_verse: But God said, “Abraham, don't worry about your slave woman and the boy. Just do what Sarah tells you. Isaac will inherit your family name,
translation_verse: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, “Di chɛ ka a bia maa min’ a dab’ paɣ’ maa yɛla muɣis’ a. Zara ni kul yɛl’ a ni a niŋm’ shɛlikam zaa, nyin’ niŋm’ o ni yɛl’ a shɛm maa, dama Yisahaku zuɣu ka a zuliya yɛn yɛligi.”

english_verse: but the son of the slave woman is also your son, and I will make his descendants into a great nation.”

english_verse: God blessed Ishmael, and as the boy grew older, he became an expert at hunting with his bow and arrows. He lived in the Paran Desert, and his mother chose an Egyptian woman for him to marry. A Peace Treaty

english_verse: About this time Abimelech and his army commander Phicol said to Abraham, “God blesses everything you do!

english_verse: Abraham gave Abimelech some sheep and cattle, then the two men made a peace treaty.
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ piɛri mini niɣi ti Abimilɛk, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa lo tab’ alikauli.

english_verse: Abraham separated seven female lambs from his flock of sheep,
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa wolig’ o piɛsah’ ayopɔin zali bɛ ko.

english_verse: Abraham replied, “I want you to accept these seven lambs as proof that I dug this well.”
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl’ o, “Deem’ piɛsah’ ayopɔin ŋɔ n nuu ni, ka di wuhi ni a di ma shɛhira ni mani n-daa gbi kɔbiliga ŋɔ.”

english_verse: So they called the place Beersheba, because they made a treaty there.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Bɛrishiiba; dama nimaani ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa laɣim po pɔri.

english_verse: When the treaty was completed, Abimelech and his army commander Phicol went back to the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Lala ka bɛ daa lo tab’ alikauli Bɛrishiiba. Di nyaaŋa ka Abimilɛk min’ o sapashin’ kpɛm’ Fikol daa lab’ kuli Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: Then Abraham lived a long time as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa ʒini Filistianim’ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-nyɛ sana n-yuui pam.

english_verse: Some years later God decided to test Abraham, so he spoke to him. Abraham answered, “Here I am, Lord.”
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa ti yɛn zahim Ibrahimma ka bol’ o, “Ibrahimma!” Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, “N-nyɛ ma.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Go get Isaac, your only son, the one you dearly love! Take him to the land of Moriah, and I will show you a mountain where you must sacrifice him to me on the fires of an altar.”
translation_verse: Ka Naawuni yɛl’ o, “Zaŋm’ a bigaŋ’ Yisahaku so a ni yuri pam la n-chaŋ Mɔria tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la nimaani n ni ti yɛn wuh’ a zo’ shɛli zuɣu.”

english_verse: So Abraham got up early the next morning and chopped wood for the fire. He put a saddle on his donkey and set out with Isaac and two servants for the place where God had told him to go.
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi m-pa o buŋ’ nyaampara, ka zaŋ o nachimba ayi min’ o bia Yisahaku pah’ omaŋ’ zuɣu, ka bo dari pahi ni o ti mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-daa yi n-chaŋ katiŋa Naawuni ni daa wuh’ o luɣ’ shɛli maa.

english_verse: Three days later Abraham looked off in the distance and saw the place.
translation_verse: Di daba ata dali ka Ibrahimma daa ti lihi nya o ni chani luɣ’ shɛli maa ka di be katiŋ’ ha.

english_verse: He told his servants, “Stay here with the donkey, while my son and I go over there to worship. We will come back.”

english_verse: Isaac said, “Father, we have the coals and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice?” “My son,” Abraham answered, “God will provide the lamb.” The two of them walked on, and
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl’ o, “M bia, Naawuni maŋmaŋ’ ni ti ti piɛ’ so ti ni yɛn zaŋ mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa.” Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa kul dol’ tab’ chana.

english_verse: when they reached the place that God had told him about, Abraham built an altar and placed the wood on it. Next, he tied up his son and put him on the wood.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai luɣ’ shɛli Naawuni ni daa wuh’ o maa, ka Ibrahimma me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani, ka zaŋ dari maa pa di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga. Di saha ka o daa lo o bia Yisahaku maa mihi n-zaŋ o pa bimbini maa zuɣu dari maa zuɣu.

english_verse: He then took the knife and got ready to kill his son.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa teeg’ o nuu kpuɣi sua ni o kɔrig’ o bia maa.

english_verse: But the Lord's angel shouted from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am!” he answered.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika daa be alizanda ni ka bol’ o, “Ibrahimma, Ibrahimma!” Ka o saɣi yɛli, “N-nyɛ ma.”

english_verse: “Don't hurt the boy or harm him in any way!” the angel said. “Now I know that you truly obey God, because you were willing to offer him your only son.”
translation_verse: Ka malaika maa yɛl’ o, “Miri ka a zaŋ a nuu shihi bia maa bee n-niŋ o shɛli; dama pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni a shiri zɔri Naawuni hal ka bi mɔŋ o a bigaŋ’ ŋɔ.”

english_verse: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught by its horns in the bushes. So he took the ram and sacrificed it instead of his son.
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa kpuɣ’ o zuɣu ŋmaligi lihi n-nya piɛlaa ka o ʒiɛya, ka o yila shɛbi tiwula ni. Ka Ibrahimma daa chaŋ ti gbaai piɛlaa maa na nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka chɛ o bia maa.

english_verse: Abraham named that place “The Lord Will Provide.” And even now people say, “On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.”
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa boli nimaani yuli, “Yawɛ ni tahi na.” Ka niriba na kul booni li lala hal ni zuŋɔ. “Yawɛ zol’ la zuɣu, ŋun’ Yawɛ ni tahi na.”

english_verse: The Lord's angel called out from heaven a second time:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa be alizanda ni ka boli Ibrahimma pahi buyi

english_verse: You were willing to offer your only son to the Lord, and so he makes you this solemn promise,
translation_verse: n-yɛli, “Man’ Yawɛ yɛliya ni a ni bi mɔŋ ma a bigaŋ’ ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni ŋmaligi po mmaŋa

english_verse: “I will bless you and give you such a large family, that someday your descendants will be more numerous than the stars in the sky or the grains of sand along the seashore. They will defeat their enemies and take over the cities where their enemies live.
translation_verse: ni n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nabi m-be kaman saŋmarisi mini teeku noli bihigu la. Ka a zuliya maa ni ti deei bɛ dimnim’ tinsi su;

english_verse: You have obeyed me, and so you and your descendants will be a blessing to all nations on earth.”
translation_verse: ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti nya alibarika la bɛ zuɣu; a ni deei n noli maa zuɣu.”

english_verse: Abraham and Isaac went back to the servants who had come with him, and they returned to Abraham's home in Beersheba. The Children of Nahor
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa lab’ o nachimba maa sani ka o mini ba ti lab’ kuli Bɛrishiiba, ka Ibrahimma ti kpalim be nimaani. Nahɔr zuliya

english_verse: Nahor also had another wife. Her name was Reumah, and she had four sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
translation_verse: Ka Nahɔr mam ŋun yuli daa booni Riuma la mi daa dɔɣi Tɛba mini Gaham ni Tahash ni Maaka.

english_verse: he went to the Hittites and said,
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yiɣis’ o kpim’ maa sani n-chaŋ ti yɛli Hitinima,

english_verse: “I live as a foreigner in your land, and I don't own any property where I can bury my wife. Please let me buy a piece of land.”
translation_verse: “N nyɛla sana m-be yi sani, timiya ma luɣ’ shɛli ka n zaŋ li leei n kpiimba sɔɣibu shee n-zaŋ n kpim’ ŋɔ ti sɔɣi nimaani.”

english_verse: “Sir,” they answered, “you are an important man. Choose the best place to bury your wife. None of us would refuse you a resting place for your dead.”
translation_verse: “Ti dana, wummi ti ni yɛn yɛl’ a shɛm ŋɔ, A nyɛla zuɣulaan’ titali ti sani. Ti ni so ku mɔŋ’ a o siliga bee n-yɛl’ a ni a di sɔɣ’ a kpima. Dinzuɣu piim’ a ni bɔri ti silisi ŋɔ ni shɛli n-zaŋ a kpim’ maa sɔɣi di ni.”

english_verse: and replied, “If you are willing to let me bury my wife here, please ask Zohar's son Ephron
translation_verse: ka yɛli ba, “Yi yi ni saɣi ka n sɔɣi n kpim’ maa kpe, yin’ wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ. Balimmiya Zɔhar bia Ɛfurɔn,

english_verse: to sell me Machpelah Cave at the end of his field. I'll pay what it's worth, and all of you can be witnesses.”
translation_verse: ka o zaŋ Makipɛla siliga din be o palo la tariga la ti ma yi ninni; ka n yo o di liɣiri ka di leegi n dini, ka m mali n kpiimba sɔɣiri nimaani.”

english_verse: Ephron was sitting there near the city gate, when Abraham made this request, and he answered,
translation_verse: Ɛfurɔn maŋmaŋ’ daa ʒila o tab’ Hitinim’ maa sani; ka ŋun’ Ɛfurɔn daa yɛli Ibrahimma o tab’ Hitinim’ bɛn zaa daa ʒi tiŋ’ maa dunoli shee maa sani,

english_verse: “Sir, the whole field, including the cave, is yours. With my own people as witnesses, I freely give it to you as a burial place for your dead.”
translation_verse: “N dana, wummi n ni yɛn yɛl’ a shɛm ŋɔ, n zaŋ palo maa mini siliga din be di ni maa zaa ti a n niriba ŋɔ ninni ni a sɔɣ’ a kpim’ maa nimaani.”

english_verse: Once again, Abraham bowed down
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa lan damdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim’ tiŋa,

english_verse: and said to Ephron, “In front of these witnesses, I offer you the full price, so I can bury my wife. Please accept my offer.”
translation_verse: ka yɛli Ɛfurɔn niriba maa zaa ninni, “Amaa a yi di saɣi n naan yo a palo maa liɣiri. Saɣimi dee’ li, ka n zaŋ n kpim’ maa ti sɔɣi nimaani.”

english_verse: So Abraham buried his wife Sarah in Machpelah Cave that was in the field
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ o paɣ’ Zara nti sɔɣi sil’ shɛli din daa be Makipɛla palo din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: Abraham was now a very old man. The Lord had made him rich, and he was successful in everything he did.
translation_verse: Ibrahimma daa kurigiya pam, ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ni.

english_verse: One day, Abraham called in his most trusted servant and said to him, “Solemnly promise me
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛl’ o yiŋ’ nachin’ kpɛm’ ŋun su o binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi, “Zaŋm’ a nuu niŋ n gbalipina lɔŋni,

english_verse: in the name of the Lord, who rules heaven and earth, that you won't choose a wife for my son Isaac from the people here in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: ka n chɛ ka a po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni a ku kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim’ shɛb’ ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga n-ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for him from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: Amaa ni a ni chaŋla n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ’ na ti ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.”

english_verse: But the servant asked, “What if the young woman I choose refuses to leave home and come here with me? Should I send Isaac there to look for a wife?”
translation_verse: Ka o nachin’ kpɛm’ maa daa bɔh’ o, “Ka paɣ’ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o doli ma kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛl’ ni a ni be ŋɔ na, man’ zaŋm’ a bia maa kulis’ a ya maa?”

english_verse: “No!” Abraham answered. “Don't ever do that, no matter what.
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl’ o, “Miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.

english_verse: The Lord who rules heaven brought me here from the land where I was born and promised that he would give this land to my descendants forever. When you go back there, the Lord will send his angel ahead of you to help you find a wife for my son.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ma m ba yiŋa ni n dɔɣiri’ tiŋ’ ni na, ka po n-yɛli ma, ‘N ni ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya.’ O ni tim o malaika ka o daŋ a tooni, ka a chaŋ nimaani ti kpuɣi paɣ’ na nti ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa.

english_verse: If the woman refuses to come along, you don't have to keep this promise. But don't ever take my son back there.”
translation_verse: Amaa paɣ’ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o dol’ a na, dindina a yi m pɔri ŋɔ taali ni; ka lee miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.”

english_verse: So the servant gave Abraham his word that he would do everything he had been told to do.
translation_verse: Ka Ibrahimma nachin’ kpɛm’ maa daa zaŋ o nuu niŋ Ibrahimma gbalipina lɔŋni, ka po pɔri zaŋ chaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa polo.

english_verse: Soon after that, the servant loaded ten of Abraham's camels with valuable gifts. Then he set out for the city in northern Syria, where Abraham's brother Nahor lived.
translation_verse: Di saha ka nachin’ kpɛm’ maa daa zaŋ o dan’ Ibrahimma laakumnim’ pia, ka deei pin’ suma balibu kam o sani n-yiɣisi chaŋ Nahɔr ya din be Mɛsopoteemia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.

english_verse: When he got there, he let the camels rest near the well outside the city. It was late afternoon, the time when the women came out for water.
translation_verse: Saha shɛli paɣiba ni siɣiri kuliga zaawuni ka o daa chɛ ka laakumnim’ maa gbani tiŋ’ tariga kɔbiliga gbini.

english_verse: The servant prayed: You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships. Please keep your promise to him and let me find a wife for Isaac today.
translation_verse: Ka o daa yɛli, “Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan’ Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir’ a, tim ma nasara zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka niŋ n dan’ Ibrahimma nirilim maŋli.

english_verse: The young women of the city will soon come to this well for water,
translation_verse: N ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka yaŋɔ paɣisara ti kana ni bɛ ti ŋɔŋ kom.

english_verse: and I'll ask one of them for a drink. If she gives me a drink and then offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen and that you have kept your promise to my master.
translation_verse: N yi ti yɛli bɛ ni paɣisar’ so, ‘N suhir’ a, suum’ a koyuli ŋɔ zali ka n nyu,’ ka o saɣi ka yɛli, ‘Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n tooi shɛl’ na ti ti a laakumnim’ ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu;’ nyin’ chɛ ka ŋuna n-nyɛ a ni bɔri ni so niŋ a dabili Yisahaku paɣ’ maa. Dina n-ni chɛ ka m baŋ ni a niŋ n dan’ maa nirilim maŋli.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant ran to her and said, “Please let me have a drink of water.”
translation_verse: Di saha ka nachin’ kpɛm’ maa daa guui ti tuh’ o soli yɛl’ o, “N suhir’ a, tim ma a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ka n nyu.”

english_verse: “I'll be glad to,” she answered. Then she quickly took the jar from her shoulder and held it while he drank.
translation_verse: Ka Ribɛka daa suug’ o koyuli maa na yomyom gbibi ka yɛl’ o, “N dana, nyuma.”

english_verse: After he had finished, she said, “Now I'll give your camels all the water they want.” She quickly poured out water for them, and she kept going back for more, until his camels had drunk all they wanted.
translation_verse: Ka o daa kpaai kom maa n-niŋ laakumnim’ maa kɔnyuribin’ ni yomyom, ka lan guui lab’ kɔbiliga maa ni ni o ti ŋɔŋ na yaha n-daa ŋɔŋ kom ti o laakumnim’ maa zaa.

english_verse: Abraham's servant did not say a word, but he watched everything Rebekah did, because he wanted to know for certain if this was the woman the Lord had chosen.
translation_verse: Ka nachin’ kpɛm’ maa daa kul maag’ o ni n-lihir’ o ni o nya Yawɛ chɛ ka o dila nasara o chandi maa ni maa bee.

english_verse: The servant had brought along an expensive gold ring and two large gold bracelets. When Rebekah had finished bringing the water, he gave her the ring for her nose and the bracelets for her arms.
translation_verse: Laakumnim’ maa ni daa nyu kom maa naai, ka nachin’ kpɛm’ maa zaŋ nyee ni baŋa din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu pirigili mini bans’ ayi din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu bupia ti o ni o pir’ o nuhi ni,

english_verse: Then he said, “Please tell me who your father is. Does he have room in his house for me and my men to spend the night?”
translation_verse: ka yɛl’ o, “Wuhim’ ma a ba ni nyɛ so. Duri be a ba yiŋa ka ti ni gbe nimaani?”

english_verse: She answered, “My father is Bethuel, the son of Nahor and Milcah.
translation_verse: Ka Ribɛka daa yɛl’ o, “N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga.”

english_verse: We have a place where you and your men can stay, and we also have enough straw and feed for your camels.”
translation_verse: O daa lan yɛli, “Ti mali taɣitaɣi mini mɔri, ka palo beni ka yi ni gbe.”

english_verse: Then the servant bowed his head and prayed,
translation_verse: Ka nachin’ kpɛm’ maa daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ

english_verse: Rebekah ran straight home and told her family everything.
translation_verse: Ka paɣisarili maa daa guui chaŋ ti zaŋ yɛlli ŋɔ yɛl’ o ma yiŋnima.

english_verse: Her brother Laban heard her tell what the servant had said, and he saw the ring and the bracelets she was wearing. So Laban ran out to Abraham's servant, who was standing by his camels at the well.
translation_verse: Leeban ni daa nya nintua la mini bansi la, ka wum o tizɔpaɣa Ribɛka ni yɛli ni doo maa yɛl’ o shɛm zuɣu, ka o daa guui chaŋ doo maa sani nti nya ka o ʒiɛla laakumnim’ maa sani kɔbiliga maa gbini.

english_verse: Then Laban said, “The Lord has brought you safely here. Come home with me. There's no need for you to keep on standing outside. I have a room ready for you in our house, and there's also a place for your camels.”
translation_verse: Ka o daa yɛli nachin’ kpɛm’ maa, “Nyin’ ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ daalibarika nir’ ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kpalim ʒe sambani ŋɔ ni? Kpɛmina, dama m pun mali duu zal’ a, ka mali laakumnim’ ŋɔ gba biɛhigu shee zali.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant went home with Laban, where Laban's servants unloaded his camels and gave them straw and feed. Then they brought water into the house, so Abraham's servant and his men could wash their feet.
translation_verse: Ka nachin’ kpɛm’ maa daa chaŋ ti kpe yili maa ni, ka Leeban daa paai laakumnim’ maa ʒiya, ka niŋ taɣitaɣi mini mɔri ti o ni o ti laakumnim’ maa. Di nyaaŋa ka Leeban daa tooi kom na ti ti o mini bɛn daa be o sani ni bɛ paɣi bɛ naba.

english_verse: After that, they brought in food. But the servant said, “Before I eat, I must tell you why I have come.” “Go ahead and tell us,” Laban answered.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ bindirigu na ti zali nachin’ kpɛm’ maa ni o di, ka o yɛli, “Di yi pa ni n yɛlila daliri din tahi ma na, n ku di bindirigu maa.” Ka Leeban yɛl’ o, “Yɛlima.”

english_verse: The servant explained: I am Abraham's servant.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli, “N nyɛla Ibrahimma nachin’ kpɛma.

english_verse: The Lord has been good to my master and has made him very rich. He has given him many sheep, goats, cattle, camels, and donkeys, as well as a lot of silver and gold, and many slaves.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ n dan’ maa ni pam ka o leei bundana. O ti o piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni anzinfa mini salima ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnim’ ni bunsi.

english_verse: Sarah, my master's wife, didn't have any children until she was very old. Then she had a son, and my master has given him everything.
translation_verse: Ka n dan’ maa paɣ’ Zara dɔɣi bidibiga ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni; ka n dan’ maa zaŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ti o bia maa.

english_verse: I solemnly promised my master that I would do what he said. And he told me, “Don't choose a wife for my son from the women in this land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Ka o daa chɛ ka m po pɔri ka o yɛli ma, ‘Miri ka a kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim’ shɛb’ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa;

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for my son from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: amaa chamila n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ’ na ti ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa.’

english_verse: I asked my master, “What if the young woman refuses to come with me?”
translation_verse: Ka n daa bɔhi n dan’ maa, ‘Ka paɣ’ yi ti bi saɣi n-doli ma na?’

english_verse: My master answered, “I have always obeyed the Lord, and he will send his angel to help you find my son a wife from among my own relatives.
translation_verse: Amaa ka o daa yɛli ma, ‘Yawɛ so n ni doli ŋɔ ni chɛ ka a min’ o malaika doli chaŋ, ka ti a nasara ka a kpuɣi paɣa n yaannim’ ya ni n dɔɣiriba sanna ti ti m bia maa.

english_verse: When I came to the well today, I silently prayed, “You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships, so please lead me to a wife for his son
translation_verse: “Ka n ni di paai kɔbiliga maa gbinna zuŋɔ, ka n yɛli, ‘Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan’ Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, a yi ni ti ma nasara n chandi ŋɔ ni,

english_verse: while I am here at the well. When a young woman comes out to get water, I'll ask her to give me a drink.
translation_verse: n ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka paɣisar’ so yi ti kana ni o ti ŋɔŋ kom, ka n yɛl’ o, “N suhir’ a, niŋm’ a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ti ma ka n nyu,”

english_verse: If she gives me a drink and offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen.”
translation_verse: ka o yɛli ma, “Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ ti a laakumnim’ ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu,” nyin’ chɛ ka ŋuna n-nyɛ nyin’ Yawɛ ni bɔri ni so leei n-dan’ bia paɣa maa.’

english_verse: Even before I had finished praying, Rebekah came by with a water jar on her shoulder. When she had filled the jar, I asked her for a drink.
translation_verse: Yɛtɔɣa maa di na kul bela n suhu ni, ka Ribɛka paana, ka o koyuli tam o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu, ka o gari siɣi kɔbiliga maa ni ti ŋɔŋ kom na. Ka n yɛl’ o, ‘N suhir’ a, tim ma kom ka n nyu.’

english_verse: She quickly lowered the jar from her shoulder and said, “Have a drink. Then I'll get water for your camels.” So I drank, and after that she got some water for my camels.
translation_verse: Ka o dii suug’ o koyuli maa o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu na ti ma ka yɛli, ‘Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ shɛli ti a laakumnim’ ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu.’ Ka n di nyu ka chɛ ka o ŋɔŋ na ti ti n laakumnim’ maa gba ka bɛ nyu.

english_verse: I asked her who her father was, and she answered, “My father is Bethuel the son of Nahor and Milcah.” At once I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms.
translation_verse: Di saha ka m bɔh’ o, ‘Ŋun’ bia n-lee nyɛ a?’ Ka o yɛli ma, ‘N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga.’ Ka n zaŋ nintua m-pir’ o, ka zaŋ bansi pir’ o.

english_verse: Then I bowed my head and gave thanks to the God my master Abraham worships. The Lord had led me straight to my master's relatives, and I had found a wife for his son.
translation_verse: Di saha ka n di zaŋ n zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ, ka paɣi ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan’ Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋun wuhi yɛlimaŋli so’ shɛli n ni yɛn doli kpuɣi ŋuna n dan’ maa dɔɣim bipuɣiŋga nti ti o bia maa.

english_verse: Now please tell me if you are willing to do the right thing for my master. Will you treat him fairly, or do I have to look for another young woman?
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu yi yi ni niŋ n dan’ maa din tuhi ni din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, yin’ yɛlim’ ma, ka yi yi ku niŋ o, yin’ lan yɛlim’ ma. Ka n zaŋ kpa n nudirigu polo bee n nuzaa polo.”

english_verse: Laban and Bethuel answered, “The Lord has done this. We have no choice in the matter.
translation_verse: Ka Leeban mini Bɛtuɛl daa yɛl’ o, “Yɛlli ŋɔ ni yila Yawɛ sani ŋɔ na, dindina ti ku tooi yɛl’ a din bie bee din viɛl’ zaŋ chaŋ di polo.

english_verse: Take Rebekah with you; she can marry your master's son, just as the Lord has said.”
translation_verse: Nyama, n-nyɛ Ribɛka, zaŋm’ o kuli nti chɛ ka o leeg’ a dan’ bia maa paɣa kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.”

english_verse: Then he gave clothing, as well as silver and gold jewelry, to Rebekah. He also gave expensive gifts to her brother and her mother.
translation_verse: Di saha ka nachin’ kpɛm’ maa daa yihi anzinfa mini salima binyara ni chinchina ti Ribɛka; ka ti o tizɔdoo maa min’ o ma gba nachiinsi binshɛŋa din liɣiri galisi pam.

english_verse: Abraham's servant and the men with him ate and drank, then spent the night there. The next morning they got up, and the servant told Rebekah's mother and brother, “I would like to go back to my master now.”
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o mini ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn daa dol’ o la daa naanyi di ka nyu, ka gbe nimaani. Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka o yiɣisi ka yɛli ba, “N suhiri soli ni n labi n dan’ sani.”

english_verse: “Let Rebekah stay with us for a week or ten days,” they answered. “Then she may go.”
