translation_verse: Paɣipuulan’ ti ku zaŋ bahi, ka paɣiŋoo mi ti ku be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni tin ya nyɛvili wɔɣila.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Puhimiya yi ni biri bindir’ shɛŋa din daŋ niŋbu kpuɣibu chuɣu. “Yuuni yi ti giligi ka yi kpuɣi yi puri atam zaa naai, yin’ puhimiya yi puri atam kpuɣibu chuɣu.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi dɔbba zaa laɣindi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ tooni buta yuuni puuni.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: “Puhimiya n churi siɣimsiɣim buta yuuni puuni.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni yi puhiri Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu kaman n ni daa zali ya shɛm la. Ŋubimiya bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin Abib goli puuni, dama goli maa ni ka yi daa yi Ijipti na. Di bi simdi ni so ka n sanna ni nu’ zaŋa.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir’ daŋda din viɛla n-ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu na. “Miriya ka yi zaŋ bubil’ bee piɛbil’ ma bihim duɣ’ o.” Alikaulinim’ mini Wuhibu

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: “N ni tim malaika na ka o ti be yi tooni n-guli ya yi chandi maa ni hal ti zaŋ ya paai n ni mali luɣ’ shɛli zali ya la ni.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Gbilisimiya tibili n-wumm’ o yɛligu ka di zaɣisiy’ o noli, dama yi yi birigi, o ku chɛ yi taali, dama n yuli be o ni.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: M malaika maa yi ti gari tooni n-zaŋ ya tahi Amɔrinim’ mini Hitinim’ ni Pɛrizinim’ ni Keenannim’ ni Hivinim’ ni Jɛbusinim’ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n ti ku ba ka chɛ ka yi ʒini nimaani,

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Yi yi jɛmdi man’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi bindira mini yi kom ni, ka yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi kɔbili ni.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: “N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai yi mini ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛnkam yɛn tuhi, ka bɛ birim, ka chɛ ka yi dimnim’ ŋmaligi guui ka chɛn ya.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: N ni chɛ ka tabilakpihi daŋ yi tooni nti dim kari Hivinim’ mini Keenannim’ ni Hitinima ka chɛ soli tin ya.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: M bi yɛn kari ba yuun’ yini puuni, ka tiŋgbani maa doya yoli, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yɛligi nti muɣisi ya.

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: N kul yɛn kariti ba la biɛlabiɛla hal ka yi daadam biɛligu ti nabi n-su tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: Ka n ni zali yi tiŋgbɔŋ tariga la Teeku Ʒiɛɣu noli zaŋ hal ni Filistianim’ Teeku noli, ka lan zaŋ tiŋgban’ nɛli ni hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli tariga. Dama n ni ti zaŋ di niriba maa niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi kari ba.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini ba lo alikauli bee n-lo bɛ buɣa la alikauli.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “A mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin dumiya zoli ŋɔ n-ka n sanna nti zani kpaŋ’ jɛm ma.

english_verse: but you are to come near. Don't let anyone else come up.”
translation_verse: Nyin’ Musa kɔŋko n-ni miri man’ Yawɛ; bɛ ni so di ti mirina; niriba maa di pah’ a zuɣu du na.”

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa kana ti yɛli niriba maa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm min’ o ni zali shɛm zaa, ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim garigi yɛli, “Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li.”

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa sabi Yawɛ yɛligu maa zaa sɔŋ, ka daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asiba me sara maligu bimbini zali zoli maa gbini, ka sa bin’ wɔɣila pinaayi ka di zani Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la zaani.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka o daa tim Izraɛl nachimba ka bɛ chaŋ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa kɔri naɣilahi mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa taɣi ʒim maa pirigili niŋ taha ni zali, ka zaŋ di pirigili din kpalim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alikauli zaligu kundi la na ti karim li ka niriba maa wum ka yɛli, “Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li, ka deeg’ o noli.”

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa zaŋ ʒim maa mihi niriba maa ka yɛli, “Nyamiya, Yawɛ ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛl’ la ʒim, di nyɛla din doli o ni yɛli ya yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa maa zaa.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin maa daa du zoli maa zuɣu

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: nti nya Izraɛlnim’ Naawuni maa, ka o naba tiŋli daa ŋmanila bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni booni kuɣ’ shɛŋa safaya la mal’ li. Di daa kul nɛmi kaman sagbana ni yi kani ka zuɣusaa ne shɛm la.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Naawuni daa bi ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ’ zuɣuri maa, ka bɛ daa nya o, ka di ka nyu. Musa be Sinai Zoli zuɣu

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Dum’ zoli maa ka n sanna nti guhiri nimaani, ka n zaŋ n ni sabi n zaligunim’ niŋ kuɣ’ parilan’ shɛŋa ni niriba maa wuhibu zuɣu la ti a.”

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa min’ o sɔŋda Jɔshua daa lu soli, ka Musa daa du Naawuni zoli maa zuɣu.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli kpamba maa, “Yinim’ kpalimmiya be kpe n-guhi ti hal ka ti ti lab’ yi sanna. Aduna mini Hur be yi sani, ka ŋunkam mali yɛl’ shɛli, ŋun’ cham’ bɛ sani.”

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa daa du Zoli maa zuɣu, ka sagbani limsi li.

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa siɣi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu na, ka sagbani maa daa limsi li hal ni daba ayɔbu; dabisi’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin dali, ka o daa boli Musa sagbani maa ni.

english_verse: blue, purple, and red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: ni gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan’ piɛl’ viɛlli ni buhi kɔbiri

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnim’ ni bɛ zaŋm’ pina ti ma. Ŋunkam suhu yu ni o ti pini, nyin’ deem’ li ti ma.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: A ni yɛn deei pin’ shɛŋa bɛ sani m-bɔŋɔ: Salima mini anzinfa ni daanya

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;
translation_verse: ni firila kpam ni tulaale shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi maani kpa’ shɛli din boori bahiri niriba zuɣu mini tulaale zim din nyom viɛla

english_verse: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.
translation_verse: ni oniɣisi kuɣa ni kuɣ’ shɛŋa din ni niŋ pa binyɛribil’ din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la zuɣu mini nyolɔrigu la zuɣu.

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Chɛ ka bɛ me luɣ’ kasi shee ti ma din ni chɛ ka m be bɛ sani.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Ka yi niŋ salima alali niŋ di puuni mini di nyaaŋa zaa, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Malimiya salima bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di naba anahi ni, yaɣ’ yini bans’ ayi yaɣ’ din’ la mi bansi ayi,

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka salima pa di zuɣu.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ dapuhi maa tu bansi din be adaka maa luɣa ni la ni n-kpuɣiri li.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Chɛ ka chɛrubi yino be di yɔrigu maa tariga yaɣ’ yini polo, ka yino la mi be di tariga yaɣ’ din’ la polo. Chɛrubinim’ mini yɔrigu maa ni ti nyɛla bin’ yini di yaɣa maa zaa.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Ka a ti zaŋ n ni yɛn sabi alikauli shɛli ti a la niŋ adaka maa puuni, ka zaŋ di yɔrigu maa yo di noli.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka n ti ka a sanna nimaani, chɛrubinim’ ayi bɛn be Alikauli Adaka yɔrigu maa zuɣu la sunsuuni nti tɔɣis’ a n ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa ti a ka a ti Izraɛlnim’ maa yɛtɔɣa.” Bɔrɔbɔro shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara tiri Naawuni teebuli (Yibu

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: ka mali naŋgbaŋkuɣila ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu niŋ li, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Zaŋmi salima mali bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di yaɣa anahi maa gbaya anahi la.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu m-mal’ li kpuɣiri teebuli maa.

english_verse: Make a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered gold
translation_verse: “Zaŋmi salima alali mali firilatamdigu, ka zaŋ matarika kuri firilatamdigu maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu mini di mundili, ka di mini di lahi ni bintira kɔtomsi mini tipum kɔtomsi zaa din be di ni ti nyɛ zaɣ’ yini.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Ka di bintira kɔtomsi maa mini di jaba maa ni firilatamdigu maa ti nyɛ zaɣ’ yini, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ matarika kuri salin’ shɛli din nyɛ alali.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya salima alali mali di buɣim saligbabirisi mini di buɣim moorisi.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi mal’ li ka di be kaman n ni daa wuh’ a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.”

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: “Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan’ piɛl’ viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka bo gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ li yili suɣili maa dunoli.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Di simdi ni tan’ tolinli kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita pinaata, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi. Di simdi ka tan’ tolima maa zaa buɣisibu ti nyɛ yim.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: “Zaŋmiya tampiɛl’ viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tan’ tolima pia m-mali m biɛhigu shee, ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain, n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi chɛrubinim’ pa di zuɣu.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ tana anu she n-tuɣi taba di ko, ka she tana ayɔbu la gba tuɣi taba ka kpabi tan’ shɛli din pah’ ayɔbu la ka di niŋ diba ayi, ka yi zaŋ li pa m biɛhigu shee maa tooni polo.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi mini teeku ni biŋkɔb’ bal’ shɛb’ gbana pili pa di zuɣu.

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa yɔrigu yo n-zaŋ li zali luɣ’ kasi zaa luɣ’ kasi shee maa.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari m-mali dapaɣa niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pihinahi, dapaɣili kam diba ayi.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: M biɛhigu shee suɣili maa nyaaŋa zaŋ lab’ wulinluhili polo, di simdi ka yi mali dapaɣa ayɔbu niŋ li,

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ ban’ yini gɔhi li tabili taba zuɣusaa polo, amaa ka chɛ ka di zaŋ siɣi tiŋ’ na woligi taba; lala ka yi ni ti niŋ diba ayi maa zaa, ka di niŋ lɔrisi ayi maa.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Di zaa ni ti nyɛla dapaɣa anii mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pinaayɔbu; ka dapaɣili kam tam diba ayi zuɣu.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ m biɛhigu shee maa zali kaman n ni daa pun wuh’ a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ teebul’ la zali pateesa maa nyaaŋa, ka zaŋ firilatamdigu la zali tuhi teebuli maa zaŋ labi nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ teebuli maa zali nuzaa polo.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ pateesa maa yili bansi maa, ka zaŋ Alikauli Adaka la na ti zali di puuni, ka pateesa maa woligi luɣ’ kasi shee ka chɛ luɣ’ kasi zaa luɣ’ kasi shee la.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Ŋmahimiya gɔpiɛliga daantalis’ anu n-niŋ salima pa di zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi n-gɔhigɔhi pateesa maa n-zaŋ li yili daantalisi maa, ka zaŋ daanya mali daantalisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba anu.”

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ li tu bansi maa ni din ni chɛ ka dapuhi maa be sara maligu bimbini maa yaɣ’ ayi polo saha shɛli yi yi ti ʒiri li chana.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Mɛmiya duɣuri n-zaŋdi tampiligim niŋdi di puuni, ka mali soobuya mini taha ni dirijaba ni lahi din ni niŋdi buɣim. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ daanya mali di lahi mini duɣuri zaa.

english_verse: Halfway up the altar build a ledge around it, and cover the bottom half of the altar with a decorative bronze grating. Then attach a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ li zali sara maligu bimbini naŋgbaŋkuɣila la lɔŋni, ka di du m-paai sara maligu bimbini maa pirigili tariga zaŋ siɣi tiŋ’ polo.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya dari mali sara maligu bimbini maa, ka di puuni nyɛ zaɣ’ yɔɣu. Malimiya li kaman n ni daa wuh’ a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.” Binshɛli din yɛn gili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili (Yibu

translation_verse: “Zalim’ Izraɛlnim’ ka bɛ bɔri olivi kpa’ viɛlli na nti niŋdi firila ni din ni chɛ ka firila maa kul ne n-ʒiɛya sahakam.

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: Di simdi ka di mali daanya daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tam binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi, amaa ban’ shɛŋa din yɛn yili daantalisi maa mini di dapuhi dina, zaŋmiya anzinfa mal’ li.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka dundɔŋ maa dunɔdali ti mali pateesa’ shɛli din nyɛ tan’ piɛl’ viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi, ka yi zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan’ piɛli viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu ka di ti mali daantalis’ anahi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba anahi.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ka m biɛhigu shee maa duɣuri mini di lahi zaa zaŋ tabili di kpahi mini dundɔŋ maa kpahi zaa ti nyɛ daanya binyɛra.” Bɛn su firila lihibu (Lɛvinima

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: Aduna min’ o bidibisi nti yɛn nyɔri firila maa zaani Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni pateesa din be Alikauli Adaka tooni polo la kpaŋa zaawuni hal ni asiba. Di ni ti nyɛla zaligu shɛli din kul ni beni sahakam, ka di simdi ni Izraɛlnim’ ti dol’ li ʒiɛmani kam ni.”

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: “Piim’ a mabia Aduna min’ o bidibisi Izraɛlnim’ ni, n-chɛ ka bɛ yi n ka a sanna ti leei m maligumaaniba, n-tumdi n tuma; Aduna min’ o bidibisi bɛn yuya booni Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Ka a boli tuumbaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ n ni zaŋ baŋsim ti na nti chɛ ka bɛ she binyɛra ti Aduna ka o leei m maligumaana.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni yɛn she binyɛr’ shɛŋa maa n-nyɛ: Nyolɔrigu mini binyɛribil’ din yɛri pari zuɣusaa ni alichɛbba ni bɛ ni wuɣi zabba shɛli ni bantabiga ni shɛlɔrigu. Di simdi ka bɛ she binyɛra din be kasinim’ ŋɔ n-ti a mabia Aduna min’ o bidibisi ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi ti ti baŋdiba maa salima mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan’ piɛl’ viɛlli.

english_verse: Put two onyx stones in gold settings, then attach one to each of the shoulder straps. On one of these stones engrave the names of Israel's first six sons in the order of their birth. And do the same with his remaining six sons on the other stone. In this way Aaron will always carry the names of the tribes of Israel when he enters the holy place, and I will never forget my people.
translation_verse: Ka a ti zaŋ kuɣa maa niŋ binyɛribil’ din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan’ tolima la ni, ka di leei kuɣ’ shɛŋa yi ni yɛn mali teeri Izraɛl bidibisi maa yɛla. Ka bɛ yuya maa ti pa Aduna bɔɣusapima ayi zuɣu saha shɛl’ o yi ti be Yawɛ tooni, ka di nyɛ bɛ yɛla teebu shihirili.

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: ka zaŋ salima alali m-mali zoligɔnim’ ayi n-ŋmɛl’ li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li ga kuɣa maa ni yɛn taɣili binshɛŋa ni maa.” Nyolɔrigu (Yibu

english_verse: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.
translation_verse: “Di simdi ka a ti mali sariakaribo nyolɔrigu viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni yɛn she binyɛribil’ din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛm, di simdi ka a ti zaŋ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan’ piɛl’ viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mal’ li.

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣ’ viɛla pie taba kulis’ anahi zuɣu. Yi ni ti zaŋ kuɣ’ viɛl’ shɛŋa bɛ ni booni kanɛlian mini kirisolait ni ɛmɛrald m-pie taba kul’ shɛli din daŋ tooni,

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: ka zaŋ tɛkɔisi mini safaya ni daimɔnd m-pie taba kul’ shɛli din pahir’ ayi,

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: ka zaŋ jɛsint mini agɛt ni amɛtisit m-pie taba kul’ shɛli din pahir’ ata,

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: ka lan zaŋ bɛril mini oniɣisi ni jasipa m-pie taba kul’ shɛli din pahir’ anahi la. Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ li niŋ salima bintabindisi la ni.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Ka a ti zaŋ salima gabis’ ayi maa noya gɔhi salima bintaɣindisi la, ka di be o binyɛribil’ din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan’ tolima la tooni.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: “Ka a ti zaŋ tan’ sabilifaa n-she alichɛbba shɛli zuɣu o ni yɛn yɛri binyɛribila la para.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: A yi zaŋ salima buɣilimbuɣilimbila yili, ka a zaŋ pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi yili pa di zuɣu; ka zaŋ salima kɔtomsi ni pumpɔrinchiya m-mali lala hal ti gili alichɛbba maa tiŋli zaa.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ li yɛri saha shɛl’ o yi ti yɛn tum tuma, ka o yi ti kpɛri luɣ’ kasi shee Yawɛ tooni bee o yi ti yirina, di ni chaɣisiri ka bɛ wumdi di vuri din ni chɛ ka o ku kpi.

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Ka a ti zaŋ mi’ sabilifaa n-lo li tabili bantabiga la, ka di ti be bantabiga maa tooni polo.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Ka di ti pa Aduna gbɛɣu zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka Aduna ti deei taali shɛli din ni be Izraɛlnim’ ni zaŋ bɛ pin’ kasi shɛŋa zaa na ni bɛ ti mali sara kasi maa ni ʒi. Di simdi ka di kul pa o gbɛɣu zuɣu sahakam din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ niŋ ba nirilim.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: “Ka a ti she zabbanim’ mini shɛlɔriti ni zuɣupila n-ti Aduna bidibisi. Di simdi ka a mal’ li ka di nyɛla bɛ jilima mini bɛ nachiinsi situra.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Ka a ti zaŋ li yɛl’ a mabia Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa, ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni n-zaŋ ba leei maligumaaniba, ka chɛ ka bɛ be kasi din ni chɛ ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Ka a ti she jinjɛŋŋmahi ti ba ka di limsi bɛ zaɣim, ka di wɔɣilim ti zaŋ bɛ shɛhi ni hal ti paai bɛ gbalipina ni.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi ti sɔr’ li kpɛri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni saha shɛlikam bee bɛ yi ti ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna ni bɛ ti tum tuma luɣ’ kasi shee la din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku kpe taali ni ka kpi. Dimbɔŋɔ ni ti nyɛla zaligu Aduna min’ o zuliya bɛn ti yɛn zan’ o zaani o kalinsi nyaaŋa ʒiɛmani kam ni la sani.”

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni a ti kɔrigiri naɣilaa dabisili kam m-maani alahichi sanyoo sara. Di lan simdi ka a maani alahichi kpihimbu sara maligu bimbini maa kasitali zuɣu; ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu m-mal’ li ka di niŋ kasi.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋɔri maha shɛŋa din ka dabindi ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka bɛ niŋ kpam pa di zuɣu. Zaŋmi alikama zim viɛlli mali di zaa.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Ka a ti zaŋ di zaa niŋ piɛ’ yin’ ni n-zaŋ di mini naɣilaa maa mini piɛlah’ ayi maa na.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: “Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa n-ka Naawuni min’ o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili shee dunol’ ni na nti chɛ ka bɛ su kom.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Ka a zaŋ binyɛra yɛli Aduna. Dina n-nyɛ: zabbanim’ mini alichɛbba ni binyɛribil’ din yɛri pari zuɣusaa ni nyolɔrigu; ka zaŋ binyɛribil’ din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛlɔrigu lo o.

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa’ shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi bah’ o zuɣu ni,

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka a zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa samban’ ni na nti chɛ ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni,

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: ka a naanyi kɔrig’ o Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol’ ni,

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ a nubil’ suɣi naɣilaa maa ʒim n-zaŋ niŋ sara maligu bimbini binyila la; ka kpaai ʒi’ shɛli din kpalim sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini ni tam binshɛŋa zuɣu la lɔŋni.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Amaa naɣilaa maa nimdi min’ o gbaŋ ni o nyɔri dina, zaŋm’ li yi yi sansani maa kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim, dama din’ nyɛla alahichi sara maligu.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ piɛla’ yino n-chɛ ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni,

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka a kɔrig’ o n-zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam zaa.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Ka ŋmahi piɛlaa maa, ka paɣ’ o nyɔri min’ o biɛhi n-zaŋ li pahi nimdi maa mini binzuɣu la zuɣu

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: n-nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, dama di nyɛla sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ ka di nyom nyɛ din tiɣir’ o nini.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka a lan zaŋ piɛla’ ŋun’ la na nti chɛ ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni,

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka a kɔrigi piɛlaa maa, ka zaŋ o ʒim shɛli n-laɣi Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa nudiriti tib’ nyaɣa mini bɛ nudiriti nubihilɔri ni bɛ nudiriti napombihilɔri, ka kpaai ʒi’ shɛli din kpalim vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam zaa.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Ka a zaŋ ʒim din be sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu maa mini kpa’ shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-mihi Aduna min’ o binyɛra ni o bidibisi maa mini bɛ binyɛra din ni chɛ ka o min’ o binyɛra maa be kasi, ka o bidibisi maa mini bɛ binyɛra gba be kasi.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: “Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ piɛlaa maa kpam min’ o zuli ni kpam ni o nyɔri kpam ni o saba ni o yaannina ayi ni di kpam ni o nudirigu gbalipuɣili, dama o nyɛla maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa.

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: n-zaŋ di zaa niŋ Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ bɛ nuhi maa gahigahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei nuhi gahibu sara Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: “Ka a zaŋ Aduna maligumaana leebu piɛlaa nyɔɣu polo n-gahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka di leeg’ a tarili.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Ka o bi’ so yi ti leei maligumaana n-zan’ o ba zaani, o yi ti yɛn ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ ni na nti tum o tuma luɣ’ kasi ŋɔ shee, ŋun’ yɛm’ binyɛra maa daba ayopɔin.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: “Ka a ti zaŋ maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa maa nimdi duɣi luɣ’ kasi shee maa.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ka a chɛ ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa ŋubi nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro shɛli din be piɛɣu puuni la Naawuni min’ o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili ŋɔ dunol’ ni.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni bɛ kɔŋko nti di bindir’ shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara bɛ maligumaaniba leebu saha maa. Amaa di bi simdi ka ŋun pa maligumaana ti di li, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: “Di simdi ka a zaŋ daba ayopɔin tum Aduna min’ o bidibisi maligumaaniba leebu tuma kaman n ni zal’ a shɛm maa.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Zaŋm’ daba ayopɔin mali alahichi sanyoo sara, sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka sara maligu bimbini maa leei din be kasi zaa. Ka binshɛɣukam yi ti shihi sara maligu bimbini maa, di ni leei din be kasi.” Dabisili kam sara maligu (Kalinlinima

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya piɛbil’ yino mali sara asiba, ka ti zaŋ piɛbil’ ŋun’ la mi mali zaawuni.

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti lan zaŋ lala binyɛra maa m-pahi piɛbil’ ŋun la zuɣu m-mali sara zaawuni kaman yi ni pun mali shɛm asiba la. Ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim, ka di nyom tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: N ni ti mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ mini sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ ka di be kasi, ka lan mali Aduna min’ o bidibisi la gba ka bɛ be kasi, ka tumdi maligumaaniba tuma tiri ma.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: N ni ti be Izraɛlnim’ sani n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti be bɛ sani. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.”

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Ka a ni yɛn mali tulaale zim maa shɛm maa, miri ka a ti mali di tatabo n-leeg’ amaŋmaŋ’ dini. Zaŋm’ li leei din be kasi, ka nyɛ Yawɛ dini.

english_verse: Mix four liters of olive oil with the following costly spices: six kilograms of myrrh, three kilograms of cinnamon, three kilograms of cane, and six kilograms of cassia. Measure these according to the official standards. Then use this sacred mixture
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ li gari taba kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm la, ka di leei din be kasi, ka nyɛ kpa’ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: “Zaŋm’ gɔpiɛliga dari mali yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbi’ shɛli zuɣu.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Ka a ti zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa zali pateesa shɛli din yili Alikauli Adaka tooni la mi tooni. Alikauli Adaka maa ni be luɣ’ shɛli maa n-nyɛ luɣ’ shɛli n ni yɛn kahigi mmaŋ’ wuh’ a.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti tuɣili tulaale zim din bi be kasi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu. Yi mi di zaŋya biŋkɔbigu nyo buɣim bee n-zaŋ bindir’ kuma mali sara di zuɣu bee m-booi wain bahi di zuɣu.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Di simdi ka Aduna zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu ʒim niŋ di binyila maa zuɣu yim yuuni puuni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni. Di simdi ka o niŋdi lala yuuni kam din ni chɛ ka di yi daɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla din be kasi zaa man’ Yawɛ sani.” Bɛ ni yɛn yɔri farigu Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili zuɣu shɛm

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: “A yi ti yɛn kali Izraɛlnim’ maa, nyin’ chɛ ka sokam yo shɛli ti man’ Yawɛ bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka alɔbo ku lu bɛ zuɣu saha shɛli a yi ti kaani ba.

english_verse: , whether rich or poor, must pay me the same amount of money, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa ti mal’ li paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka a ti deei nyɛviya tiliginsim liɣiri maa Izraɛlnim’ sani n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li tum tuma Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni, ka di leei yi nyɛviya tiligibu sara maligu, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ kul teeri di yɛla Yawɛ sani.” Daanya tahili

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam ti mali di tatabo ni o zaŋ niŋ o tulaale, bɛn’ yihimi dilan’ o niriba laɣiŋgu ni.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa,

english_verse: Make a large bronze bowl and a bronze stand for it. Then put them between the altar for sacrifice and the sacred tent, so the priests can wash their hands and feet before entering the tent or offering a sacrifice on the altar. Each priest in every generation must wash himself in this way, or else he will die right there. The Oil for Dedication and Ordination (Exodus

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.

translation_verse: O mi o ni yɛn ŋmahi kuɣ’ viɛla shɛm kpɛhi binyara ni, ka lan mi dari zaŋ kpe m-mali binyɛra mini nuhi tuumbaŋsim kam.

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Nyama, m piila Ahisamak bia Oholiab ŋun nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nir’ la pah’ o zuɣu, ka lan ti tuumbaŋdiba zaa yiko ni bɛ mali binshɛɣukam zaa n ni zal’ a ni a mali, dina n-nyɛ:

english_verse: the sacred tent with its furnishings, the sacred chest with its place of mercy, the table with all that is on it, the lamp with its equipment, the incense altar, the altar for sacrifices with its equipment, the bronze bowl with its stand, the beautiful priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons, the oil for dedication and ordination services, and the sweet-smelling incense for the holy place. translation_verse: ni kpa’ shɛli din yɛn boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni yi ni yɛn zaŋdi tulaale zim shɛli din nyom viɛl’ tuɣindi luɣ’ kasi shee la. Di simdi ka bɛ tum n ni zal’ a ni a tum shɛlikam zaa.” Jɛmbu dabisili nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima, ‘Gbibiya n jɛmbu dabisili la, dama dina n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili m mini ya sunsuuni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni din ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man’ Yawɛ m-mali ya ka yi be kasi.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu n-tum tuma, amaa dabisi’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin la nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili ni yɛlimaŋli, ka lan nyɛ Yawɛ dabisili din be kasi. Ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋun tum tuma dindali maa, bɛn’ kum’ o.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Di nyɛla shihirili shɛli din kul ni be m mini Izraɛlnim’ sunsuuni. Man’ Yawɛ daa zaŋla daba ayɔbu n-nam zuɣusaa mini dunia, ka vuhi daba ayopɔin dali, ka n ni maai.’ ”

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu naai, ka o daa zaŋ alikauli kuɣ’ parilana ayi ti o. Naawuni daa zaŋla o nubila n-sabi sabbu pa di zuɣu.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “N nya niriba maa ka bɛ nyɛla tipawumlinima.

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu pina na; ka niriba maa daa ʒini tiŋa ni bɛ di ka nyu, ka yiɣisi diɛmdi kɔr’ biɛri mini vi diɛma.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Lɛvi bidibisi maa, “Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, yi mali yimaŋa m-be kasi ni yi tumdi Yawɛ tuma, yi zaa yinoyino bidibisi mini yi mabihi kubu ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka yi nya alibarika zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.”

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Niriba maa ni daa nya ka Musa yuui zoli maa zuɣu ka na bi siɣina maa, ka bɛ daa laɣim ka Aduna sanna ti yɛl’ o, “Yiɣisim’ mali buɣili ti ti ka o gari tooni n-zaŋ ti chaŋ, dama Musa ŋun daa zaŋ ti yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa ŋuna, ti bi mi din niŋ o.”

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Ka Aduna daa yɛli ba, “Yihimiya salima tibikpara din be yi paɣiba tiba ni mini yi bipuɣinsi tiba ni ni din be yi bidibisi sani n-zaŋ na ti ti ma.”

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Ka o daa deei salima maa n-zaŋ li nyɛligi mali salima naɣilabila. Ka niriba maa daa yɛli, “Izraɛlnima, yi buɣili ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Aduna ni daa nya li ka o me maligu bimbini zali di gbini, ka moli molo yɛli, “Biɛɣuni ti sa yɛn puhila Yawɛ chuɣu.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Siɣim’ yomyom, dama a ni daa zaŋ a ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa saɣim bɛmaŋa.

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Bɛ pun chɛ n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ doli so’ shɛl’ la, ka malila naɣibila n-jɛmdi li, ka maani maligu tiri li, ka yɛli, ‘Izraɛlnima, yi buɣili ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bɔŋɔ.’ ”

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛli ma, ka n yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa. Amaa nyin’ ŋuna, n ni chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi n-niŋ zuliya titali.”

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa yɛli, “Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi a ni daa zaŋ’ a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini yiko n-yih’ a ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa zuɣu?

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka Ijiptinim’ maa yɛli ni a daa lola a niriba maa zaɣ’ biɛɣu zuɣu ka a zaŋ ba chaŋ zoya ni ni a ti ku ba kpihim bɛ birili dunia yili? Yihim’ a suhuyiɣisili titali ŋɔ a suhu ni, ka chɛ a niriba ŋɔ zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa niŋbu.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Teem’ a daba Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu yɛla. Amaŋmaŋa n-daa po pɔri yɛli ba, ‘N ni chɛ ka yi zuliya galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ka n ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli zaa n ni zaŋ lɔn ya alikauli ŋɔ ti ba, ka bɛ di li fali hal ni saha din ka bahigu.’ ”

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ o ni lo ni o niŋ o niriba maa zaɣ’ biɛ’ shɛli maa niŋbu.

english_verse: Moses went back down the mountain with the two flat stones on which God had written all of his laws with his own hand, using both sides of the stones.
translation_verse: Naawuni n-daa mali bimparilana maa, ka sabbu maa nyɛ Naawuni sabbu, ka o daa chirigi li pa bimparilana maa zuɣu.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Jɔshua ni daa ti wum niriba ni yɔri vuri, ka o yɛli Musa, “Niriba yɔrila tɔb’ tuhibu vuri sansani maa ni.”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Amaa ka Musa yɛl’ o, “Vuri maa pala niriba ni di nasara ka yɔri vu’ shɛli, di mi pala niriba ni kɔŋ nasara ka yɔri vu’ shɛli, amaa n wumla yila yilibu vuri.”

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Musa ni daa ti kul kana ti miri suɣa maa gbini n-nya naɣibila maa, ka nya bɛ ni wari waa maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam, ka o daa zaŋ bimparilana din daa be o nuu ni maa bahi zoli maa gbini ka di ŋma.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa mali naɣibil’ so maa nyo buɣim m-baɣisi li ka di niŋ zim, ka o zaŋ li niŋ kom ni n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ maa nyu li.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa bɔhi Aduna, “Wula ka niriba maa lee niŋ a, ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ tum tuumbiɛ’ titali ŋɔ?”

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna garigi yɛl’ o, “N dana, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi pam bahi n zuɣu, a mi ni niriba maa suhuri zaa kul yɛla zaɣ’ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu.

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Bɛ daa yɛli ma mi, ‘Malim’ buɣili ŋun yɛn be ti tooni ti ti, dama Musa ŋun daa yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa ŋuna, ti bi mi din niŋ o.’ ”

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Ka n daa yɛli ba, “Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋunkam mali salima yihi li na. Ka bɛ daa yihi li na ti ti ma, ka n zaŋ li bahi buɣim ni, ka naɣibil’ ŋɔ yina.”

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa daa kana ti zani sansani maa dunɔdali ni ka yɛli, “Ŋunkam be Yawɛ polo, ŋun’ kam’ n sanna.” Ka Lɛvi bidibisi zaa daa laɣimna ti zani gil’ o.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Ka o daa yɛli ba “Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim’ Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, ‘Sokam zaŋm’ o takɔbi nyaɣ’ o luɣili zuɣu n-chaŋ gili sansani ŋɔ ni zaa n-kpe suɣili kam puuni, ka sokam ti ku o mabia ni o mini ŋun doli ni o ʒiʒiinikpee.’ ”

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Ka Lɛvi bidibisi maa daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm, ka bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ dindali maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba tusaata.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Musa yɛli niriba maa, “Yi tum alahichi titali. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n ni chaŋ Yawɛ sani nti suh’ o, di pa shɛli o ni chɛ yi daalahichi maa.”

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa labi Yawɛ sani ti yɛl’ o, “Yɛlimaŋli, niriba ma tum alahichi titali, dama bɛ zaŋla salima mali buɣili.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Pumpɔŋɔ n suhir’ a mi ni a chɛli bɛ taali, ka a yi ku chɛ bɛ taali maa, dindina nyin’ kpihimmi n yuli a ni sab’ li niŋ litaafi shɛl’ ni la.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Ŋunkam tum alahichi n sani, dilan’ yuli ka n ni kpihim litaafi maa ni.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, cham’ ti zaŋ n niriba maa chaŋ n ni daa wuh’ a luɣ’ shɛli maa. Nyama, m malaika ni be a tooni. Amaa bɛ tibidarigibo biɛɣu yi ti neei, n ni darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.”

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu niriba maa zuɣu bɛ ni daa chɛ ka Aduna mali naɣibil’ so la zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “A min’ a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ zaa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, yiɣisimiya chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa po pɔri Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu sani yɛli, ‘N ni zaŋ li ti yi zuliya la ni.’

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: Chamiya ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali anfaani mini atam maa ni, amaa n ku doli ya chaŋ nimaani. Di yi pa lala n ni ti kun ya sol’ ni, dama yi nyɛla tipawumlinima.”

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ daa yɛlila Musa, “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnim’ maa, ‘Yi nyɛla tipawumlinima, n yi lan doli ya biɛla pahi n ni ti kun ya. Dinzuɣu yihimiya salima nɛma din be yi ni, ka m baŋ n ni yɛn niŋ ya shɛm.’ ”

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ maa daa yihi salima nɛma din be bɛ ni zaa Sinai Zoli gbini, ka bi lan zaŋ li niŋ bɛmaŋa. Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili yɛla

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Musa daa yi zaŋdila suɣili maa nti tiri zaani kpaŋ’ katiŋ’ ha ka chɛ sansani maa. O daa booni li la Yawɛ chirigibu shee, ka ŋunkam daa yi bɔri ni o bɔhi Yawɛ baŋ shɛli, o chanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini sansani maa kpaŋ’ maa ha.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yi ti kul chani suɣili maa ni niriba zaa yiɣisirimi, ka sokam ʒe o suɣili dunol’ ni lihir’ o hal ka o ti kpe suɣili maa puuni.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Lala ka Yawɛ daa yi zaani Musa tooni n-tɔɣisir’ o yɛtɔɣa kaman nir’ ni tɔɣisir’ o zo yɛtɔɣa shɛm la. Musa daa yi ti yi suɣili maa ni n-labi sansani maa ni, o sɔŋda Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Nan bia, ka nyɛ nachimbil’ la n-daa yi kpalindi be suɣili maa ni. Naawuni lo alikauli ni o ni be o niriba sani

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, “Nyama, nyini n-daa yɛli ma, ‘Zaŋmi n niriba ŋɔ na,’ a mi daa bi chɛ ka m baŋ a ni yɛn tim so na ka m min’ o ti chaŋ, amaa di zaa yoli ka a yɛli ma, ‘M mi a viɛnyɛliŋga, ka n nini lan tiɣ’ a.’

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir’ a mi, a nini yi shiri tiɣi ma, nyin’ wuhim’ ma a soya din ni chɛ ka m baŋ a, ka a nini maan tiɣi ma pahi. Lan teema ni niriba maa nyɛla a niriba.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Ka o daa yɛli Musa, “Mmaŋmaŋ’ n yɛn dol’ a chaŋ, ka ti a vuhim.”

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Ka Musa yɛl’ o, “A yi ku doli ti chaŋ, nyin’ di chɛ ka ti yiɣisi kpe.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Dama a yi bi dol’ ti chaŋ, wula ka bɛ ni ti baŋ ni a nini tiɣi m min’ a niriba ŋɔ? Ka bɔ n-leei yɛn woligi m min’ a niriba ŋɔ biɛhigu ka chɛ dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa biɛhigu?”

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Ninvuɣ’ so sa di dol’ a duna, miri ka a chɛ ka ninvuɣ’ so sa be zoli maa zuɣu luɣ’ shɛlikam zaa. Miri ka a sa chɛ ka biŋkɔbbaligu bee niɣi ŋub’ mɔri zoli maa gbini.”

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa kpe kuɣ’ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la n-daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-zaŋ kuɣ’ parilana ayi maa gbib’ o nuu ni n-du Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl’ o shɛm maa.

translation_verse: ka yɛli, “Yaa n Duuma, n suhir’ a, a nini yi tiɣi ma, nyin’ be ti sani ti chandi maa ni, hal ti ni kul nyɛ tipawumlinim’ maa zaa yoli, chɛl’ ti tuumbiɛri mini ti daalahichi maa taali, ka zaŋ ti leeg’ a niriba.” Bɛ lan neei bɛ daalikauli (Yibu

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: “Di simdi ni yi dɔbba zaa kani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ka nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sanna buta yuuni puuni.

translation_verse: “Di bi simdi ka yi jɛm wuna, dama man’ Yawɛ ŋun yuli booni Nyuli ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: “Miriya ka yi ti me buɣili zali yimaŋa.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Nyama, n ni kari Amɔrinim’ mini Keenannim’ ni Hitinim’ ni Pɛrizinim’ ni Hivinim’ ni Jɛbusinima, ka chɛ palo tin ya.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini yi ni chani ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa lo tab’ alikauli. Yi yi niŋ lala, di ni leei tɔŋ yi sani.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Amaa lee ti wurimmiya bɛ maligu bimbina, ka kabisi bɛ binwɔɣila, ka wurim bɛ buɣili Ashɛra la.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: Dama yi mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba yi lo tab’ alikauli, ka bɛ ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa, ka mal’ li, bɛ ni boli ya ka yi ti di di maligu bindira,

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: “Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum tuma, amaa dabisi’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin dali, yin’ vuhimiya. Hal di yi nyɛla kɔbu saha mini puri atam kpuɣibu saha, yin’ vuhimiya.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Puhimiya dakulɔdakulo churi mini ka’ daŋda chɛbu chuɣu ni wuuni atam kpuɣibu chuɣu.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Dama n ni kari zuliya shɛb’ bɛn be yi tooni, ka yɛligi yi tiŋgbani, ka chɛ ka so ti ku niŋ yi tiŋgbani maa kɔre.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: “Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ dabindi niŋ n sara maligu ʒim ni, yi mi di chɛ ka Yaɣigari chuɣu sara nimdi zani kaai biɛɣu.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: “Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir’ daŋda din viɛla n-tahi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ duu na. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbaligu bihim duɣi bɛ bihi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa “Sabimi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ sɔŋ, dama yɛtɔɣa maa ka n zaŋ lo a mini Izraɛlnim’ alikauli.”

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu n-gbibi alikauli bimparilana ayi la o nuu ni siɣina. Musa daa bi mi ni o ninni nyaɣisira, o mini Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu.

translation_verse: Aduna mini Izraɛlnim’ zaa ni daa nya Musa ka o ninni nyaɣisira maa ka bɛ zɔri ni bɛ mir’ o.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Musa daa boli ba, ka Aduna mini bɛ laɣiŋgu zuɣulaannim’ zaa daa ka o sanna, ka o ti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa.

translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim’ maa zaa daa laɣim Musa sanna ka o ti zaŋ Yawɛ ni daa yɛl’ o zaligu shɛŋa yɛla Sinai Zoli zuɣu maa ti ba.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: Amaa Musa daa yi chaŋ Yawɛ sani ni o min’ o ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, o piligirila sariga maa o ninni, naɣila o ti yina. Ka o daa yi yina ti yɛli Izraɛlnim’ Naawuni ni yɛl’ o shɛm,

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.

translation_verse: O mi o ni yɛn ŋmahi kuɣ’ viɛla shɛm kpɛhi binyɛra ni ka ni tooi zaŋ dari kpe m-mali nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuuni kam.

english_verse: The Lord is urging him and Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to teach others.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: amaa sagbani maa daa yi bi vuui, bɛ bi chani shɛli naɣila di yi ti vuui chana ka bɛ chana.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ sagbani maa daa kul bela o biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa wuntaŋ’ ni, yuŋ mi ka buɣim be sagbani maa puuni Izraɛlnim’ zaa ninni bɛ chandi maa zaa ni.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: O ti zaŋm’ o nuu pa sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni din ni chɛ ka Naawuni deei li ka di leeg’ o daalahichi sanyoo sara maligu.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o kɔrigi nahu maa, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ binʒim maa ti ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ li mihi gili Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol’ ni.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Ka o shi sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah’ o,

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: ka Aduna bihi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa mali buɣim, ka malimali dari viɛnyɛla niŋ buɣim maa ni.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Amaa di simdi ka o ti zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi dina. Ka maligumaana zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla piɛɣu bee bua, di simdi ka di nyɛla piɛlaa bee bulaa ŋun ka daŋa,

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka o ti kɔrig’ o sara maligu bimbini la nuzaa polo Yawɛ tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa ti zaŋ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Amaa di simdi ka o ti zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi dina, ka chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu n-ti Yawɛ, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani la.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: Ka so yi yɛn zaŋ noombihi nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ŋun’ zaŋmila ŋmanʒiɛhi bee yiŋ’ ŋmambihi.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ o ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna nti ŋmɛli ŋmaag’ o zuɣu, ka tɔɣi o ʒim bahi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka zaŋ o nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka o ti yih’ o fiɛɣu min’ o kɔbiri bahi sara maligu bimbini maa wulimpuhili polo luɣ’ shɛli bɛ ni kpaari tampiligim bahiri la.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: So yi yɛn zaŋ chi bee kawana na ti mali sara, ŋun’ zaŋm’ li niɛm zim, ka bo kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pahi di zuɣu

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: n-zaŋ li ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la sanna. Ka maligumaana ŋun yɛn mali sara maa tooi zim viɛlli maa mini kpam ni firanki tulaale zim maa zaa nukurigu pali n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim, ka di nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Ka zim shɛli din kpalim ni leei Aduna min’ o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ li nyo buɣim m-mali sara ti Yawɛ maa zuɣu.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: Ka so yi zaŋ chi bee kawana mali maha na ti mali sara, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl’ shɛli ni m-mal’ li, ka dabindi ka di ni bee karikaasi shɛli din ka dabindi ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam niŋ shɛli ni.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Ka sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ tahilaa chim shɛli, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl’ shɛli ni, ka dabindi ka di ni.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti ŋmahiŋmahi li ka booi kpam niŋ di ni, dama di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Ka yi sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni duɣi bindir’ shɛli tahilaa puuni, di simdi ka di nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka kpam be di ni,

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: ka yi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ. Yi yi zaŋ li ti ti maligumaana, o mi ni zaŋ li chaŋ sara maligu bimbini gbini.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ni niŋ di shɛli nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani la shihirili.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Ka din kpalim leei Aduna min’ o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi zaŋ dabindi gari chi bee kawana sara ti Yawɛ, dama di bi simdi ni yi zaŋ dabindi bee shiri nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Yi bindir’ daŋda dina, yi ni tooi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ, amaa di bi simdi ka yi nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ni di leei din nyom viɛla.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Yi yi zaŋ kawaan’ daŋda bee ka’ daŋda na ni yi ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, yin’ zaŋmiya zaɣ’ maha n-chim li niɛm zim.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ka niŋya kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ti niŋ binchimda zim maa shɛli mini kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim maa zaa nyo buɣim n-yihi di chihili. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: Ka so yi yɛn gbaag’ omaŋmaŋ’ naɣikpahi ni naɣinyaŋ bee naɣilaa m-mali suhudoo sara maligu, di simdi ka o zaŋla naɣ’ so ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka dilan’ zaŋ o nuhi pa nahu maa zuɣu ni ka kɔrig’ o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ni yaannina ayi mini kpam din be di ni zaa ni binsabili yaɣ’ shɛli din viɛl’ pahi n-nyo buɣim kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim, ka di pa dari zuɣu m-be sara maligu bimbini zuɣu la, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani la.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ka so yi zaŋla o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛɣu bee bua ni o mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ, ka di nyɛla biŋkɔb’ lɔɣu bee zaɣ’ nyaŋ, di simdi ka o zaŋla ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ka so yi zaŋla piɛ’ polli ni o mali sara maa, dindina ŋun’ malimi li Yawɛ tooni,

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ o nuu pa o biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig’ o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Naawuni la.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ni binyaannina ayi la mini di biŋkpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ’ shɛli din viɛl’ pahi o ni yɛn yihi yaannin’ shɛŋa maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li mali sara.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi bindir’ shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bua, ŋun malimi li Yawɛ tooni,

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig’ o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ bindir’ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara din nyom viɛl’ ti Yawɛ. Biŋkpam zaa nyɛla Yawɛ dini.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ka yi ti ŋubi biŋkpam bee binʒim yi ni be luɣ’ shɛlikam zaa, dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu din ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: ka ŋun’ maligumaana maa ti zaŋ o nubil’ tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yili luɣ’ kasi shee la tooni.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: O ti zaŋm’ o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig’ o luɣ’ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb’ shɛb’ bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim Yawɛ san’ la, ka di leei alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
