english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana zaŋ o nubil’ suɣi ʒim maa n-zaŋ li vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin’ shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi’ shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu nyɔri buɣim sara maligu bimbin’ shɛli zuɣu la naba zaashee.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima ni bɛ so yi bi yuri ka tum birigi n ni zali ya ni yi di tum shɛl’ la n-tum alahichi,

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: di yi nyɛla bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni n-tum alahichi maa, ka di taali meei niriba maa, di saha ŋun’ zaŋmi naɣilabil’ polli ŋun ka dalinli m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka o ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la dunol’ ni na Yawɛ tooni nti zaŋ o nuu pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi naɣilaa maa Yawɛ tooni.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Di saha ka maligumaana maa booi ʒim maa shɛli bahi binyila din be tulaale din nyom viɛl’ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu la ni Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni, ka kpaai naɣilaa maa ʒi’ shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin’ shɛli zuɣu ka di be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni la naba zaashee.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: di simdi ka o zaŋ naɣila’ muni maa zaa yi kpaŋa bɛ biɛhigu maa shee n-chaŋ luɣ’ shɛli din be kasi shee, bɛ ni kpaari tampiligim bahiri shɛli polo nti zaŋ li pa dari zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim, di simdi ka o nyo li buɣim maa bɛ ni kpaari tampiligim bahiri luɣ’ shɛli maa.

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: bɛ yi ti baŋ bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛli maa saha shɛli, bɛ laɣiŋgu maa bɛn’ zaŋmi naɣila’ polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu. Di simdi ka bɛ zaŋ o ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini na.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Ka laɣiŋgu maa ni kpamba ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni Yawɛ tooni, ka bɛ kɔrig’ o Yawɛ tooni maa.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ka bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: nti zaŋ o nubil’ tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yiliya la tooni.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ ʒim maa shɛli niŋ sara maligu bimbin’ shɛli din be Yawɛ tooni la zuɣu binyila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni la, ka kpaai ʒi’ shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin’ shɛli zuɣu ka di be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni la gbini.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ka o zaŋ naɣilaa maa yi kpaŋa bɛ biɛhigu maa shee nti nyo buɣim kaman o ni di nyo o tuuli naɣilaa la shɛm la, di nyɛla zama alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: o yi ti baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa, ŋun’ bom’ bulaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti mali sara.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana ni zaŋ o nubil’ suɣi ʒim maa n-zaŋ vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin’ shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi’ shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu nyɔri buɣim sara maligu bimbin’ shɛli zuɣu la gbini.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ka di simdi ka o ti nyo di biŋkpam zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman suhudoo sara maligu la din ni chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo alahichi maa samli ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: Ka di yi nyɛla tarimba ni yino bi yuri ka tum birigi Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di niŋ binshɛŋa la n-kpe taali ni,

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: o yi baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛl’ maa, ŋun’ bom’ bunyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli m-mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ’ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb’ shɛb’ bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Ka o ti yihi di biŋkpam zaa kaman bɛ ni yihiri suhudoo sara maligu biŋkpam shɛm la, ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei din nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani, ka maligumaana maa zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli, ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: Ka o yi yɛn zaŋla piɛɣu na ti mali sara, ŋun’ zaŋmi piɛnyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli na

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: nti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo piɛɣu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig’ o mali alahichi sanyoo sara luɣ’ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb’ shɛb’ bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara la.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Di saha ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o nubil’ tim alahichi sanyoo maligu ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ti vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim sara maligu bimbin’ shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi’ shɛli din kpalim bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ka o ti yihi biŋkpam zaa kaman bɛ ni yihiri suhudoo sara maligu piɛɣu biŋkpam shɛm la; ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la zuɣu, ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa samli, ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Bee o yi shihi daadam daɣiri, din’ dee yi kul nyɛ daɣ’ shɛlikam din chɛ ka ninsal’ bi be kasi ka bi baŋ li, o yi ti baŋ li o mali taali.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: Bee nir’ yi yaag’ o noli po yiriŋ ni o ni niŋ zaɣ’ biɛɣu bee zaɣ’ viɛlli, nir’ yi po pɔri kam yiriŋ ka bi baŋ, o yi ti baŋ, o mali taali di puuni.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Ka so yi tum taali zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim’ shɛli polo, di simdi ni o zani yim zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum taal’ shɛli maa polo,

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: ka bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛnyaŋ bee bunyaŋ na nti ti Yawɛ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka di leeg’ o daalahichi maa sanyoo sara maligu, ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: O ti zaŋm’ ba na ti ti maligumaana, ka o ti daŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maa malibu. O ti ŋmɛlimi kabi ŋmani maa nyiŋgoli, amaa o di ti ŋmɛli ŋmaag’ o zuɣu,

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmani maa ʒim shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ʒi’ shɛli din kpalim yi m-bahi sara maligu bimbini maa gbini, di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: Ka dilan’ yi ku tooi nyaŋ ŋmanʒiɛh’ ayi bee yiŋ’ ŋmambihi ayi maa, ŋun’ bom’ zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini na ti mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu. O di ti niŋ kpam bee firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, dama di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ li ka maligumaana sanna, ka maligumaana maa ti too’ li nukurigu pali n-yihi di chihili maa n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la zuɣu; di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Lala ka maligumaana maa yɛn niŋ m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara o zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zaɣ’ yini kam polo, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ. Ka din kpalim nyɛ maligumaaniba dini kaman chi bee kawana sara yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. Samli yɔbu sara maligunima

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: “So yi bi pal’ o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ binyara din be kasi la polo, ka tum alahichi, ka di nyɛla o bi yurimi, ŋun bom’ o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka a ti zaŋ jɛmbu duu sania la zahim o nya o liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm. Di nyɛla taali sanyoo sara maligu.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o binyɛr’ piɛlli ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma’ piɛlli n-va buɣim mini di sara maligu maa ka chɛ tampiligim shɛli sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini maa luɣili zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: bee so binshɛli yi bɔrigi ka o pihi li ka ŋma ʒiri zaŋ chaŋ di polo bee m-pɔri ʒiri pɔri zaŋ chaŋ niriba ni tumdi binshɛŋa zaa ka di nyɛ alahichi polo

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: “Aduna min’ o bidibisi ni ti yɛn mali sara maligu shɛli ti Yawɛ dahin’ shɛli bɛ yi ti zaŋ bɛ ni so leei maligumaana m-bɔŋɔ: Zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini kaman bɛ ni kul maani biŋkuma sara maligu shɛm la, ka o ti zaŋ di pirigili mali asiba, ka zaŋ pirigili mali zaawuni.

english_verse: In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong. Daily Sacrifices (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli Yawɛ sani, ka o ni niŋ binshɛŋa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o kpe taali ni maa kpihim.” Bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu shɛli zaa buɣim

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaaniba bidibiga kam ni tooi ŋub’ li, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni duɣ’ li yaɣiri duɣ’ shɛl’ ni maa, di simdi ka yi ŋma li. Ka di yi nyɛ kurigu duɣu, di simdi ka yi nan’ li, ka niŋ kom suui li.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: Zalim’ Aduna min’ o bidibisi zaligu yɛli: Yi ni yɛn zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim zaligu m-bɔŋɔ. Yi ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim simdi ni di be daaŋa ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu yuŋ zaa hal ni biɛɣ’ asiba, ka yi chɛ ka sara maligu bimbini zuɣu buɣim la kul dira.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o yeeg’ o binyɛra maa ka taɣi binyɛr’ shɛŋa ye n-zaŋ tampiligim maa yi bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti sɔŋ luɣ’ shɛli din be kasi.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu buɣim la kul dira; di bi simdi ni di kpi. Di simdi ka maligumaana niŋdi dari pahiri buɣim maa ni asiba kam, ka maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la sariasaria pari di zuɣu, ka zaŋ di suhudoo sara maligu la biŋkpam pari di zuɣu nyɔri buɣim.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi chɛ ka buɣim kul be sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu dira sahakam, di bi simdi ni di kpi. Kawana mini chi sara maligu

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: Kawana bee chi sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi maa ni ti zaŋ li mali sara Yawɛ sani sara maligu bimbini maa tooni.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ ni yino ti tooi biŋkuma sara maligu maa zim viɛlli nukurigu pali mini di kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim din be biŋkuma sara maligu maa ni nti nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu n-yihi di chihili maa, ka di leei din nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Bɛ ti zaŋm’ li mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi. Mani n-zaŋ li ti ba ka di nyɛ bɛ tarili bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti ma maa ni, di nyɛla binshɛli din be kasi zaa kaman alahichi sanyoo bee taali sanyoo sara la.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Ka Aduna zuliya ni bidibiga kam ni tooi di li kaman di ni zali shɛm yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka binshɛɣukam din shihi li ni niŋ kasi Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ kpam chim li mahilaa ni zaɣ’ bihi, ka a gar’ li viɛnyɛliŋga n-zaŋ li mali sara shɛli din nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: Each of Aaron's descendants who is ordained as a priest must perform this ceremony and make sure that the bread is completely burned on the altar. None of it may be eaten! Sacrifices for Sin (Leviticus
translation_verse: Maligumaana yi zaŋ kawana bee chi na ti mali sara, di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim, di bi simdi ni bɛ di li.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Aduna min’ o bidibisi la, alahichi sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb’ shɛba bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara Yawɛ tooni luɣ’ shɛl’ la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana so ŋun ti zaŋ li mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa ni ti ŋub’ li. O ti ŋubim’ li luɣ’ kasi shee Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dundɔŋ ni.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Binshɛɣukam yi shihi di nimdi maa di gba ni leei din be kasi. Ka di ʒim yi tɔɣ’ vie binyɛrigu, di simdi ka yi paɣi di ni tɔɣ’ vie binyɛr’ shɛli maa luɣ’ kasi shee.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔb’ so ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili puuni nti yo alahichi samli luɣ’ kasi shee, di bi simdi ka so ŋubi di nimdi maa. Di simdi ni yi nyo li la buɣim.”

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-mali sara ti Yawɛ. Di nyɛla taali sanyoo sara maligu.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ka o ti yihi bɔrɔbɔro kpil’ yini sara maligu kam puuni n-zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka di leei maligumaana ŋun zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu maa ʒim kpaai vie maa dini.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Nimdi din shihi binshɛli din bi be kasi bi simdi ni bɛ ŋub’ li. Di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ li nyo buɣim. Ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaa be kasi ni tooi ŋubi Yawɛ suhudoo sara maligu nimdi,

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: Taali sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Luɣ’ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu shɛli nyɔri buɣim biŋkɔbiri la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti taali sanyoo biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ bɛ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini luɣilikam.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Bɛ zaŋm’ di biŋkpam zaa mali sara, di zuli ni kpam mini kpam din pili namanama

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ni yaannina ayi mini di kpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ’ shɛli din viɛl’ pahi binyaannin’ shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Maligumaana bidibbil’ kam ni tooi ŋub’ li. Di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋub’ li la luɣ’ kasi shee, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: Taali sanyoo sara maligu maa mini alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmanila taba. Di zaa zaligu nyɛla zaɣ’ yini. Maligumaana ŋun mali di sara maa n-su li.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana yi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti so, ŋun’ maligumaana maa n-su o ni mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Bɛ ni zaŋ kawana bee chi m-mali sara maligu shɛlikam, kpam yi be di ni bee kpam yi ka di ni, di nyɛla Aduna bidibisi la zaa dini, di ni kul nyɛ yino dini shɛm, lala ka di nyɛ ŋun’ la gba dini. Suhudoo sara maligu

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: Ka so yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, di zaligu m-bɔŋɔ:

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: O yi yɛn malila wumpaɣibo sara maligu, ŋun zaŋm’ bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim ni mali mah’ shɛŋa, ka dabindi ka di ni mini karikaasi shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam niŋ ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl’ shɛl’ ni mali mah’ shɛŋa m-mali wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Ka di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋubi o ni mali suhudoo sara maligu shɛli, ka di nyɛ o wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa nimdi zaa o ni mal’ li dahin’ shɛli maa. O di ti chɛ di shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ’ asiba.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla alikauli palibu sara maligu bee o suhuyubu sara maligu, bɛ ni tooi ŋubi di nimdi maa o ni mali sara maa dahin’ shɛli maa, ka shɛli yi guui zani neei biɛɣu bɛ ni tooi ŋub’ li;

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ yi ŋub’ o suhudoo sara maligu maa nimdi daba ata maa dali, dilan’ sara maligu maa ku lan gbaai, ka bɛ ku kal’ li kpɛhi sara maligu ni, di ni ti nyɛla din bi be kasi, ka ŋun ti ŋub’ li ni ti ʒi di zambu.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka so yi shihi binshɛli din bi be kasi, di yi nyɛla ninsal’ daɣiri bee biŋkɔb’ so ŋun bi be kasi bee binshɛli dinkam bi be kasi ka ŋubi Yawɛ suhudoo sara maligu nimdi, bɛn yihim’ dilan’ o daŋ ni.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima, ‘Di ŋubiya biŋkpam, nahu kpam bee piɛɣu kpam bee bua kpam.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Yi ni tooi zaŋ biŋkɔb’ so ŋun kpi o zuɣu biŋkpam bee mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni gbaai biŋkɔb’ so biŋkpam tum tuun’ shɛli, amaa miriya ka yi ŋub’ li.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Dama ŋunkam ŋubi bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔb’ so nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ biŋkpam, bɛn’ yihim’ dilan’ o daŋ ni.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Din pahi nyɛla, miriya ka yi di binʒim kam yi ni be luɣ’ shɛli zaa, noonsi ʒim bee biŋkɔbiri ʒim.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋunkam ti di binʒim kam, bɛn’ yihim’ dilan’ o daŋ ni.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: ka o ni yihi bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛli nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ la n-gbib’ li omaŋmaŋ’ nuu ni na. O ti zaŋm’ biŋkpam mini bimbihili na, ka bɛ ti zaŋ bimbihili maa gahigahi ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ tooni.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Maligumaana ni ti zaŋ biŋkpam maa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, amaa bimbihili maa din’ ni ti nyɛla Aduna min’ o bidibisi la dini.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun zaŋ suhudoo sara maa binʒim mini biŋkpam mali sara maa ni ti su nudirigu gbali, ka di leeg’ o tarili.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Dama mani n-yihi bɛ ni zaŋ bimbihili shɛli gahigahi la mini bɛ ni zaŋ nudirigu gbali shɛli mali Izraɛlnim’ suhudoo sara la Izraɛlnim’ sani n-zaŋ li ti Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa, ka di leei bɛ ni su shɛli ʒiɛman kam ni.

english_verse: These are the ceremonies for sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessing or his forgiveness, as well as the ceremonies for those sacrifices that demand a payment and for the sacrifices that are offered when priests are ordained.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛŋa nyɔri buɣim maani sara mini kawana ni chi sara maligu ni alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ni taali sanyoo sara maligu ni maligumaana leebu sara maligu ni suhudoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Dina ka Yawɛ daa zali Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu saha shɛl’ o ni daa zali Izraɛlnim’ ni bɛ zaŋm’ bɛ sara maligunim’ na ti ti ŋun’ Yawɛ Sinai mɔɣu ni la.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bimbihili gahigahi ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ tooni. Dina n-daa nyɛ Musa tarili maligumaana leebu piɛlaa maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun’ Musa shɛm.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Zaŋmi Aduna min’ o bidibisi ni binyɛra la ni bɛ ni boori kpa’ shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la ni alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa ni piɛlah’ ayi ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu,

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ka boli laɣiŋgu maa niriba zaa ka bɛ ka Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol’ ni na.”

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, “Yawɛ ni zali ni ti niŋ shɛm m-bala.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa na nti chɛ ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛ ni.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: Ka o daa zaŋ binyɛribil’ din yɛri gbinni yɛl’ o, ka zaŋ shɛlɔrigu lo o, ka zaŋ zabba yɛl’ o, ka zaŋ binyɛribil’ din yɛri pari zuɣusaa yɛl’ o, ka zaŋ balati lo o.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: O daa lan zaŋ nyolɔrigu lo o pahi, ka zaŋ Urim mini Tumim niŋ di ni;

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: ka daa lan zaŋ bantabiga vil’ o, ka zaŋ salima bimparilan’ din be kasi niŋ di tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun’ Musa shɛm.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa’ shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi li bahi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni la zuɣu m-mali di zaa.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Ka zaŋ di shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin, ka booi kpam maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa mini di zuɣu lahi ni di kɔniŋdi bini ni di naba zaashee zuɣu m-mali di zaa kasi.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka o daa booi kpam maa bahi Aduna zuɣu ni m-mal’ o ka o niŋ kasi.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi la na nti zaŋ zabbanim’ yɛli ba, ka zaŋ shɛlɔriti lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ zuɣupila pil’ ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun’ Musa shɛm.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa na, ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa kɔrig’ o n-taɣ’ o ʒim zaŋ o nubil’ suɣi li n-zaŋ li ti niŋ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila la ni zaa gili m-mal’ li ka di niŋ kasi, ka kpaai ʒim maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee m-mal’ li ka di niŋ kasi, ka leei bɛ ni ni tooi mali alahichi sanyoo sara luɣ’ shɛli.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yihi biŋkpam din daa be namanama ni zaa mini binsabili yaɣ’ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina mini di biŋkpam n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Amaa naɣilaa maa min’ o gbaŋ ni o nimdi ni o bindi dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun’ Musa shɛm.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa na ni bɛ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa kɔrig’ o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi, ka Musa daa zaŋ piɛlaa maa zaa nyo buɣim, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa ŋun pahi ayi ka nyɛ maligumaana leebu piɛlaa la na. Ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa kɔrig’ o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa shɛli niŋ Aduna nudirigu polo tibinyaɣili min’ o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi maa na ka Musa ti niŋ binʒim maa niŋ bɛ nudiriti tibinyaɣa ni mini bɛ nudiriti polo nubihilɔri ni bɛ nudiriti polo napombihilɔri. Ka Musa daa kpaai ʒim maa vie sara maligu bimbini maa.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ biŋkpam mini zugbini kpam ni biŋkpam din zaa be namanama ni ni binsabili yaɣ’ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina ayi mini di biŋkpam ni nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili,

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: ka pii mah’ shɛŋa din ka dabindi la zaɣ’ yini mini bɔrɔbɔro din mali kpam zaɣ’ yini ni karikaasi zaɣ’ yini piɛ’ shɛli din ʒe Yawɛ tooni la puuni n-zaŋ li pa biŋkpam la mini nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili la zuɣu.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka o daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yihi li bɛ nuhi ni n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei Maligumaana leebu sara maligu din nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa’ shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la mini binʒim din daa be sara maligu bimbini zuɣu la m-mihi Aduna ni o binyɛra, ka lan zaŋ li mih’ o bidibisi la ni bɛ binyɛra. Lala ka o daa niŋ m-mali Aduna min’ o binyɛra ni o bidibisi maa mini bɛ binyɛra kasi.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa, “Duɣimiya nimdi maa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol’ ni ŋ-ŋubi di mini bɔrɔbɔro din nyɛ maligumaana leebu pina, ka be piɛɣu puuni la kaman n ni daa zali zaligu yɛli, ‘Aduna min’ o bidibisi n-nyɛ bɛn ni ti ŋub’ li la.’

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Ka di bi simdi ni yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol’ maa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, dama daba ayopɔin ka ti yɛn zaŋ leei ya maligumaaniba.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Yawɛ n-zali ni ti niŋ ti ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka ti yo yi daalahichi samli.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Yi kul ni kpalim bela Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ maa ni wuntaŋ’ ni mini yuŋ tumdi Yawɛ ni zali ya shɛm hal ni daba ayopɔin, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama Yawɛ n-zali ma lala.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛlikam zaa maa.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Daba anii dali ka Musa daa boli Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛl kpamba na

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: nti yɛli Aduna, “Zaŋm’ naɣila’ polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛlaa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Di simdi ni bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn ka dalima, ka a zaŋ ba mali sara ti Yawɛ.”

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Ka yɛli Izraɛlnima, “Zaŋmiya bulaa mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ naɣibil’ ŋun paai yuuni mini piɛbil’ ŋun paai yuuni m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la;

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ naɣilaa mini piɛlaa ni zim shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri m-mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ tooni, dama zuŋɔ Yawɛ ni yi zahira yi sani.”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Musa ni zali ni bɛ zaŋ binshɛŋa maa zaa na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka niriba maa zaa daa vu m-miri ti zani Yawɛ tooni.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli, “Dimbɔŋɔ ka Yawɛ zali ya ni yi niŋ, ka ŋun’ Yawɛ jilima yi zahira yi sani.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, “Mirimi sara maligu bimbini gbinna nti mal’ a daalahichi sanyoo sara min’ a ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim yo amaŋmaŋ’ daalahichi mini niriba maa daalahichi samli, ka zaŋ niriba maa sara na nti yo bɛ daalahichi samli kaman Naawuni ni zali shɛm.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna daa miri sara maligu bimbini maa nti kɔrigi omaŋmaŋ’ daalahichi sanyoo naɣila’ polli maa,

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: ka o bidibisi daa taɣi binʒim ti o, ka o zaŋ o nubil’ tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ʒe sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila la, ka kpaai binʒim maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Amaa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa biŋkɔbigu kpam min’ o binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ’ shɛli din viɛla, o daa zaŋ li nyola buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman Naawuni ni daa zali Musa shɛm.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Nimdi mini gbaŋ dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa ti nyo li buɣim.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka o daa kɔrigi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la biŋkɔbigu, ka Aduna bidibisi daa taɣi binʒim n-zaŋ ti o, ka o kpaai li vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa nim’ kpillikpilli mini zuɣu ti o, ka o nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Ka o daa paɣi bimbiɛhi mini namanama n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ niriba maa sara maligu maa na nti yihi niriba alahichi sanyoo sara shɛli din daa nyɛ bua la n-kɔrig’ o zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara kaman tuuli alahichi sanyoo sara maligu la.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na nti zaŋ li mali kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ka o daa zaŋ zim sara maligu nti tooi li pal’ o nuu n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim asiba la zuɣu.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna daa lan kɔri naɣilaa mini piɛlaa bɛn daa nyɛ niriba maa suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri la, ka o bidibisi maa daa taɣi binʒim zaŋ ti o, ka o kpaai li vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.

english_verse: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver
translation_verse: Ka o daa zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa biŋkpam ni zugbini kpam ni kpam din pili namanama ni binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ’ shɛli din viɛla.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Amaa biha maa mini nudirigu gbalipuɣa dina Aduna daa zaŋ li mi gahigahi Yawɛ tooni ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi kaman Musa ni daa zali shɛm.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Aduna daa duh’ o bɔɣiri zuɣusaa kpa niriba maa polo n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka daa yi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni suhudoo sara malibu shee maa siɣina.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni. Bɛ ni daa ti yi suɣili maa ni na, bɛ daa suhila alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni; ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi zahira niriba maa zaa sani.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ sanna ti di bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini biŋkpam la zaa sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu; niriba maa zaa ni daa nya li, ka bɛ tahi ka lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Nadab mini Abihu bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la daa zaŋ bɛ tulaale zim tuɣindi bina m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ buɣim din bi be kasi mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka di pa o ni wuhi ba shɛm.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee na ti di ba ka bɛ kpi Yawɛ tooni.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, “Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wuhi ni n nyɛla ŋun be kasi ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn miri ma sani, ka chɛ ka sokam nya n jilima.” Ka Aduna daa kul shini.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa boli Mishɛl mini Ɛlizafan bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bapira Uziɛl bidibisi la na n ti yɛli ba, “Mirimiya na ti kpuɣi yi mabihi maa luɣ’ kasi shee ŋɔ yi ti biɛhigu shee ŋɔ kpaŋa.”

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna min’ o bidibisi Ɛliɛza mini Itama, “Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi zabiri yirimyirim bee n-dari chahi yi binyɛra, yi yi niŋ lala yi ni kpi, ka Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi salo ŋɔ zaa zuɣu. Amaa yi mabihi Izraɛlnim’ zaa ni tooi kum Yawɛ ni chɛ ka buɣim di n-ku shɛb’ maa kuli.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ŋɔ ni, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama bɛ ni boori Yawɛ kpa’ shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la be yi ni.” Ka bɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa. Maligumaaniba zaligu

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “A min’ a bidibisi yi yɛn kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ ni, yin’ di nyu wain bee binnyɔr’ kpiɔŋ, yi yi niŋ lala yi ni kpi; di nyɛla zaligu din kul ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni sahakam.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Nyini n-yɛn wuhiri binshɛŋa din be kasi mini binshɛŋa din bi be kasi ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri mini binshɛŋa din pa daɣiri.

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: Ka a ni wuhi Izraɛlnim’ zaa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa ka o mi zaŋ ti ba la.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna min’ o bidibisi Ɛliɛza mini Itama bɛn daa kpalim la, “Zaŋmiya zim sara din guui ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la na nti di li sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ luɣili ni, di niŋya dabindi niŋ di ni, dama di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Dimiya li luɣ’ kasi shee, dama di nyɛla a min’ a bidibisi maa dihili bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni, dama lala ka o zali ma.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni zaŋ biŋgbalipuɣ’ shɛli maa mini bɛ ni zaŋ bimbihi’ shɛli gahigahi maa, bɛ ti zaŋm’ li pahi bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ biŋkpa’ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara la zuɣu na ka bɛ ti zaŋ li gahi, ka di leei gahibu sara Yawɛ tooni, ka di leeg’ a min’ a bidibisi bɛn be a sani ni su shɛli, ka niŋ yi dihili sahakam kaman Yawɛ ni zali shɛm.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa ti bɔhi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu bua la yɛla, ka nya ka bɛ pun zaŋ o nyo buɣim, ka o suhu yiɣisi bahi Ɛliɛza mini Itama bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi bɛn daa kpalim maa zuɣu ka o bɔhi ba,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi ŋubi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ’ kasi shee ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din nyɛ kasi zaa. Naawuni zaŋ li mi tin ya ni yi yihi niriba maa taali ni ka mali bɛ taali ni yibu maa sanyoo sara Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Nyamiya, bɛ bi zaŋ o ʒim kpe luɣ’ kasi shee na, di di kul simdi ni yi ŋub’ li luɣ’ kasi ŋɔ shee kaman n ni daa zali shɛm la.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Ka Aduna daa yɛli Musa, “Nyama, zuŋɔ ka bɛ mali bɛ daalahichi sanyoo sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, amaa di zaa yoli ka yɛla ŋ-ŋɔ ti paai ma! N yi di di alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋɔ zuŋɔ Yawɛ naan saɣi lala?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa wum lala ka saɣi ti li.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: Biŋkɔb’ so ŋun mali takarifiɛma, ka o takarifiɛma maa wɔrigi, ka o gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin’ ŋubimiya lala biŋkɔbigu maa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binneen’ shɛba yi ni yɛn diri biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa be dunia ni n-nyɛ:

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Amaa binneembihi zaa bɛn mali paɣiri, ka mali nab’ anahi nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb’ dibu.

english_verse: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: ka ŋunkam kpuɣi bɛ zaɣ’ kpima, ŋun paɣim’ o situra ka kul be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bina yi sani.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: ni sabisigu ni yuɣu ni baandɔɣu ni bankalansilli ni gumachuɣu.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim’ zaa nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bina yi sani binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋgbani ni maa puuni, ka ŋunkam shihi bɛ zaɣ’ kpiŋ ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ ni zaɣ’ yino yi lu yaɣiri duɣu ni, binshɛɣukam din be di puuni leela daɣiri, ka di simdi ka yi ŋma li.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Ka bindirigu kam din be di puuni ka nyɛ kom ni kpaai bahi shɛli zuɣu nyɛla din ni leei daɣiri, ka binnyurigu kam din yi duɣu maa puuni na ni leei daɣiri.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ka binyɛra maa zaɣ’ kpiŋ yaɣ’ shɛli yi lu binshɛli zuɣu di ni leei zaɣ’ daɣiri, di yi nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro duu bee daaŋa yin’ wurimmiya li, di leei daɣiri, ka kul ni nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Amaa kulibɔŋ bee kɔbil’ shɛli din mali kom, din’ nyɛla din ka daɣiri. Amaa binshɛɣukam din shihi binkpiŋ ni leei din nyɛ daɣiri.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ zaɣ’ kpiŋ yaɣ’ shɛli yi lu bimbir’ shɛŋa yi ni yɛn biri zuɣu, bimbira maa ni viɛla.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Amaa kom yi be bimbira maa ni ka bɛ zaɣ’ kpiŋ yaɣ’ shɛli lu di zuɣu, bimbira maa leei daɣiri bini yi sani.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni diri biŋkɔb’ so kam yi kpi, ŋunkam shihi zaɣ’ kpiŋ maa ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam ŋub’ o zaɣ’ kpiŋ maa ŋun’ paɣim’ o situra, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ŋunkam gba kpuɣi zaɣ’ kpiŋ maa, ŋun’ paɣim’ o situra ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti di biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban’ ni ŋɔ n-filim yimaŋa, ka miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka bɛ saɣim ya, di yi pa lala yi ni leei bɛn be daɣiri ni.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi. Miriya ka yi zaŋ biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban’ ni ŋɔ saɣim yimaŋa.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Dama man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi.

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: din ni chɛ ka yi woligi bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni bɛn viɛla, ka lan baŋ yin’ ni di binnamdi’ so ŋun mali nyɛvili ni yin’ ku di binnamdi’ so ŋun mali nyɛvili.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima: Paɣ’ yi niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Daba anii dali bɛ ni guni bia maa.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: “Paɣ’ maa yi dɔɣila bipuɣiŋga, o ni be daɣiri ni biɛɣu pinaanahi kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la. Di nyaaŋa o paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dabisa yɛn nyɛla biɛɣu pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Ka o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa maa yi ti naai, di yi nyɛ bidibiga ka o dɔɣi bee bipuɣiŋga, ŋun’ bom’ piɛbil’ ŋun paai yuuni nti ti maligumaana Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni, ka o mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka lan bo ŋmambila bee ŋmanʒee m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li mali sara maa Yawɛ tooni n-yo paɣa maa daalahichi samli, di nyaaŋa ka paɣa maa ni yi o paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri maa ni. Zaligu ŋɔ gbibila paɣ’ so ŋunkam dɔɣi bia di yi nyɛla bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Ka paɣa maa yi ku tooi nyaŋ piɛbila, dindina ŋun bom’ ŋmanʒiɛh’ ayi bee yiŋ’ ŋmambih’ ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ yino mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka zaŋ yino la mi mali alahichi sanyoo sara. Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo paɣa maa daalahichi samli, ka o yi daɣiri ni.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: Do so niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ yi mali bimmɔriŋ bee yum bee dalinli, ka di ti leei niŋgbuŋ dɔro o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina bɛn zaŋm’ o tahi Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la sani bee o bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ni yino sani.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ti lihi dalinli maa ni be o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu luɣ’ shɛli maa, ka dɔro maa ni be o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu luɣ’ shɛli maa kɔbiri yi paligi, ka dɔro maa kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, dindina di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔro. Ka maligumaana yi lih’ o naai, ŋun’ yɛlim’ ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Amaa dalinli maa yi piɛl’ o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, ka bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔbiri din be dalinli maa ni bi paligi, maligumaana maa ŋun’ zaŋmi dɔro maa lana niŋ duu daba ayopɔin

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ka maligumaana maa lan lih’ o daba ayopɔin maa dali. O yi lihi nya ka dɔro maa bi yɛlig’ o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, dindina ŋun lan zaŋm’ o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa lan lih’ o daba ayopɔin maa dali yaha, ka dɔro maa ni be luɣ’ shɛli maa yi sabigi, ka dɔro maa bi yɛlig’ o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun’ yɛlim’ ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, di kul nyɛla yum, ka o ni paɣ’ o situra ka nyɛ ŋun ka daɣiri ni.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: ka maligumaana maa ti lan lih’ o, ka yum maa yi yɛlig’ o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim’ ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: Ka so yi mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu maa, bɛn’ zaŋm’ o ka maligumaana sanna,

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: ka maligumaana maa ti lih’ o, bimmɔriŋ piɛlli yi be o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu din chɛ ka nimaani kɔbiri leei zaɣ’ piɛla ka mari na be bimmɔriŋ maa ni,

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ni lihi yum maa ka yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, yum nyɛla daɣiri, dama di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: ka maligumaana maa ti lih’ o, yum maa yi paligi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun’ yɛlim’ ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, o shiri nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: di nyaaŋa bimpiɛlli bee din mooi ka piɛla yi ti be wuliɛɣu maa ni, dindina bɛn zaŋm’ li wuhi maligumaana.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di nyɛla din kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di kɔbiri paligi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim’ ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu n-zaŋ kpe bintɔrili maa ni maa.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di zuɣu kɔbiri maa bi paligi, ka di mi bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, amaa ka nyɛla din sabigi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋm’ o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Ka di yi yɛligi o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun’ yɛlim’ ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla dɔr’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Amaa saŋkpambil’ maa yi kul kpalim bela luɣ’ yini, ka bi yɛligi, di nyɛla bintɔrili maa wuliɛɣu m-bala, ka di simdi ka maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: Bee di yi nyɛla buɣim nyooi so ka buɣim yum maa ti liɣisi zaɣ’ piɛlli din mooi bee zaɣ’ piɛlli.

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Di simdi ka maligumaana lihi li, ka liɣisibu maa ni kɔbiri yi nyɛ zaɣ’ piɛla ka liɣisibu maa kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, dindina niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu n-dolisi kpe buɣim yum maa ni maa. Di simdi ni maligumaana yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di ni kɔbiri bi piɛla, ka di mi bi kpe puuni, amaa ka sabigi, maligumaana maa ŋun kparim’ o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin,

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa yi lih’ o daba ayopɔin maa dali, ka di nyɛla din yɛligir’ o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun’ yɛlim’ ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Amaa di liɣisibu maa yi kul kpalim be luɣ’ yini, ka bi yɛligi gil’ o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, amaa ka sabigi, di nyɛla bimmɔriŋ din yi buɣim yum maa ni na, ka di simdi ni maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla buɣim wuliɛɣu.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: Doo bee paɣ’ yi mali yum o zuɣu ni bee o teeŋa ni,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: di simdi ni maligumaana lihi yum maa, di yi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di ni kɔbiri niŋ zaɣ’ dɔzim ka balisibalisi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun’ yɛlim’ ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni; di nyɛla dɔr’ shɛli din loora, ka nyɛ zuɣu ni bee teeŋa ni dɔr’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa yi lihi niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr’ shɛli din zaɣisir’ maa, ka di bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔb’ sabila ka di ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun’ zaŋmi ninvuɣ’ so ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr’ shɛli din zaɣisir’ maa niŋ duu hal ni daba ayopɔin,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: dindina di simdi ka dilan’ pini. Amaa o di pini dɔr’ shɛli din zaɣisir’ maa ni be luɣ’ shɛli maa, ka maligumaana maa lan zaŋ ninvuɣ’ so ŋun mali dɔr’ shɛli din zaɣisir’ maa niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: dindina maligumaana maa ni lih’ o, ka dɔr’ shɛli din zaɣisir’ maa yi yɛlig’ o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, di bi lan simdi ni maligumaana yuli ni o nya kɔb’ shɛli din nyɛ dɔzim maa, dilan’ nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: Doo bee paɣa yi mali dalima o niŋgbuŋ ni ka di nyɛ zaɣ’ piɛla,

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Ka doo gbɛɣu zabiri min’ o tapaɣisi kɔbiri yi guhi, o malila gbɛ’ palo, amaa o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: O zaŋm’ binyɛribil’ piɛl’ kasi ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma’ piɛlli, ka zaŋ shɛlɔr’ piɛlli lo o shee ni ka vili bantabiga. Di nyɛla situr’ shɛli din be kasi. O sum’ kom pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Ka o ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ bo bulah’ ayi ti o ka o mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛla’ yino mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa mali ŋun’ maŋmaŋ’ daalahichi sanyoo sara n-yo o min’ o yiŋnim’ daalahichi samli.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ bulah’ ayi maa ti zali Naawuni tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni,

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: ka pihi kuɣa sɔŋ n-lihi nya bulah’ ayi maa sunsuuni, kuɣ’ yini ni ti nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka kuɣ’ yini ti nyɛ Azazɛl dini.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Yawɛ kuɣili ni gbaai bula’ so la m-mali sara.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Amaa Azazɛl kuɣili ni gbaai bula’ so la ŋuna o ni ti zaŋ o la zaɣ’ nɛɔŋ ti Yawɛ n-yo bɛ daalahichi samli, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi mɔɣu ni nti ti Azazɛl.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ’ naɣilaa la na nti mal’ o min’ o yiŋnim’ daalahichi sanyoo sara, ka o ti kɔrigi naɣilaa maa mali ŋun’ maŋmaŋ’ daalahichi sanyoo sara.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ tulaale zim tuɣindi laa m-mooi buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni m-pal’ li, ka niŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla nukurigu pali buyi ŋ-ŋmiri li biɛlabiɛla n-zaŋ li kpe pateesa maa puuni

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: nti zaŋ tulaale zim maa niŋ buɣim maa ni Yawɛ tooni, ka chɛ ka di nyɔhi tuɣi kpe bimpindigu din pili Alikauli Adaka la, di yi pa lala o ni kpi.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubila n-niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni, ka lan zaŋ o nubil’ suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni buyopɔin.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa, ka o kɔrigi niriba maa daalahichi sanyoo sara bulaa la, ka zaŋ o ʒim maa kpe pateesa maa puuni na nti niŋ kaman o ni niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim shɛm maa, ka zaŋ li mihi adaka pindigu la zuɣusaa mini adaka maa tooni,

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: din ni chɛ ka o yihi luɣ’ kasi shee maa daɣiri ni ni Izraɛlnim’ daɣiri mini bɛ biriginsim ni bɛ daalahichi la zaa zuɣu; ka di simdi ka o niŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili din be bɛ sani bɛ daɣiri tuma ni maa lala.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi yi n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti mal’ li ka di be kasi, ka zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini bulaa maa ʒim shɛli n-niŋ binyila din be sara maligu bimbini la ni ti gili.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubil’ suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi li buyopɔin n-yihi li Izraɛlnim’ daɣiri maa ni. Bua ŋun ʒi alahichi kpe yɔɣu

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Ka o yi mali luɣ’ kasi shee maa mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni sara maligu bimbini maa ka di be kasi naai, ŋun’ zaŋm’ bu’ nɛɔŋ la na,

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: ka ŋun’ Aduna ti zaŋ o nuh’ ayi pa bu’ nɛɔŋ maa zuɣu ni, ka kaŋka Izraɛlnim’ tuumbiɛri zaa mini bɛ biriginsim zaa ni bɛ daalahichi zaa n-zaŋ li ʒili bua maa, ka bɛ ni pun pii ninvuɣ’ so zali vo bua maa chaŋ mɔɣu ni.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Ka bua maa ni deei bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa ʒi n-chaŋ tiŋgban’ nɛli ni, ka o ti zaŋ bua maa bahi mɔɣu maa ni.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: ka su kom luɣ’ kasi shee maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ’ binyɛra ye n-yina ti mal’ o sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini niriba sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-yo omaŋmaŋ’ daalahichi mini niriba maa daalahichi samli.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkpam la nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Ka ŋun vo bua la tahi Azazɛl sani la, di simdi ka o paɣ’ o nɛma ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara naɣilaa la mini alahichi sanyoo sara bua la, bɛ ni zaŋ shɛb’ ʒim kpe luɣ’ kasi shee la n-yi bɛ sansani maa ni kpaŋa nti nyo bɛ gbana mini bɛ nimdi ni bɛ bina buɣim.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ka di simdi ni ŋun nyo li maa paɣ’ o situra ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni na. Alahichi samli yɔbu dabisili gbibbu

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam. Gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, di simdi ka yi lo noli ka di tumiya tuma dindali, yinim’ bɛn nyɛ tiŋbihi bee tinzunnim’ bɛn be yi sani,

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: dama dindali maa ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya, ka yihi ya daɣiri ni; yi ni ti yi yi daalahichi zaa daɣiri ni Yawɛ tooni.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka di simdi ka yi ti lo noli; di yɛn nyɛla zaligu sahakam.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ka o leei maligumaana zan’ o ba zaani n-ni ti ye binyɛr’ piɛl’ kasi m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara maa.

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
