translation_verse: O ni ti mali luɣ’ kasi shee maa, ka mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka yo maligumaaniba mini niriba maa zaa daalahichi samli.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ka di simdi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam ni bɛ yɔri Izraɛlnim’ daalahichi zaa samli tiri ba yim yuuni puuni. Ka Musa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal’ o shɛm maa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Aduna min’ o bidibisi ni Izraɛlnim’ zaa ni man’ Yawɛ ni zali shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: ka bi zaŋ o ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ dunol’ ni na nti mali sara ti Yawɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ, dilan’ nyɛla ŋun mali taali nyɛvili dibu ni, ka di simdi ni bɛ yihi dilan’ o niriba ni.

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ zaŋ bɛ ni kɔriti binneen’ shɛb’ maani sara mɔɣu ni la ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ŋɔ ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o zaŋ ba mali suhudoo sara maligu.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ binʒim maa kpaai vie Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni la, ka zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim ka di nyɛ din nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: Don't ever turn from me again and offer sacrifices to goat-demons. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan kɔri binyɛra mali alizinnim’ bɛn ŋmani buhi la, bɛ ni daa saɣim bɛmaŋa shɛb’ sani la. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛn nyɛla zaligu bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: ka bi zaŋ li ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ŋɔ ni na ti mal’ li ti Yawɛ, bɛn’ yihim’ dilan’ Yawɛ niriba ni.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Izraɛl ninvuɣ’ so bee saan’ shɛb’ bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ’ so yi ti ŋubi bin’ so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo’ muni, n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi dilan’ zuɣu, ka yih’ o n niriba ni.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Dama niŋgbuŋ nyɛvili bela ʒim puuni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tin ya ni di yo yi nyɛviya tiliginsim samli. Dama ʒim n-nyɛ din yɔri alahichi samli, di ni nyɛ nyɛvili la zuɣu.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ’ so bee saan’ shɛb’ bɛn be yi sani ninvuɣ’ so yi go piɛli gbaai biŋkɔbigu bee nooŋa ŋun ŋubbu bi chihira, dilan’ ŋun’ kɔrigim’ bini maa ʒim bahi tiŋa, ka niŋ taŋkpaɣu pa di zuɣu.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim maa. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, “Miriya ka yi ŋubi binnɛɔŋ kam ʒim, dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim, ka ŋunkam ŋub’ li, bɛn’ yihim’ o o niriba ni.”

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋubi bin’ so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo’ muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dar’ tɔhi binshɛli, dilan’ yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee sana, ŋun’ paɣim’ o situra, ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi leei ŋun ka daɣiri ni.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Amaa o yi bi paɣ’ o situra bee n-su kom, o taali maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, di simdi ni yi niŋ n ni zali ya shɛm n-gbibi n zaligunim’ ka dol’ li.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yi ni so miri ka o ti chɛ ka o min’ o dɔɣira dɔni.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba paɣ’ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: So miri ka o zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa dɔni, o yi nyɛla o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga, bɛ yi dɔɣ’ o la yiŋa bee luɣ’ shɛli polo.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: So miri ka o zaŋ o mapira dɔni, dama o nyɛla a ma dɔɣira ni yɛlimaŋli.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba mabia ŋun nyɛ doo paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ma.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: So miri ka o laɣim paɣ’ min’ o bipuɣiŋga dɔni, ka miri ka o bo o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga, bɛ nyɛla paɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn nyɛ o dɔɣiriba ni yɛlimaŋli. Lala nyɛla zaɣ’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: So miri ka o kpuɣ’ o paɣ’ mabia pah’ o zuɣu saha shɛl’ o paɣ’ maa ni na be o nyɛvili ni maa.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: Paɣ’ yi nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai, nyin’ di mir’ o ni a bo o.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa n-kpɛh’ amaŋ’ daɣiri ni o sani.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ yi bi’ so ti ni bɛ nyo buɣim mali buɣili Molɛk ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi saɣim yi Naawuni yuli. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ka doo bo o dokpee kaman paɣ’ la, di nyɛla din chihira.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-saɣim yimaŋa, dama n ni kariti ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ ka chɛri palo tiri ya ŋɔ zaŋla dimbɔŋɔnim’ saɣim bɛmaŋa.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n-daa darigi di tibili, ka di gbuɣi di niriba maa bahi maa.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Di yi pa lala, yi yi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di ni gbuɣi ya bahi kaman di ni daa gbuɣi zuliya shɛb’ bɛn daa be yi tooni la bahi shɛm la.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu doliya n zaligunima, ka miriya ka yi ti doli ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn daa pun daŋ be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaya din chihiri la, ka miriya ka yi ti zaŋ li saɣim yimaŋa: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnim’ maa zaa: Bɛnya kasi, dama man’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bela kasi.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi jɛm wuna bee ka yimaŋmaŋ’ ti zaŋ binshɛli dooi mali binnana. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Yi yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, yin’ malimiya li ka di nyɛ din ni chɛ ka o deei yi sara maa.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi mali sara, di simdi ka yi ŋub’ li dindali maa bee dindali cheei biɛɣu, ka di shɛli yi guui zani hal ni daba ata dali, yin’ zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Yi yi ŋub’ li daba ata maa dali, di nyɛla din chihira, ka n ku deei li.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋub’ li ni nya tibidarigibo. Dama o saɣim Yawɛ binshɛli din be kasi, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi lala nir’ maa o niriba ni.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin’ di kpuɣiya yi putarisi zaa daatam bee ka yi ti lan labi ti yihi binyiha yi daatam kpuɣibu maa nyaaŋa.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi pɔhi yi puri ni tiwala zaa bee n-gahim yi wain wal’ shɛŋa din lu tiŋa. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi zura bee n-niŋdi tab’ bilikɔnsi bee ŋ-ŋmar’ tab’ ʒiri.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Di ŋmariya ʒiri ka mali n yuli pɔri pɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi dihi yi Naawuni yuli vi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: Miri ka a niŋ a kpee fitiina bee n-fa o. A yi bu so paa ka o tum a tuma, nyin’ di chɛ ka o liɣiri gbe a sani.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Miri ka a yɛli noli ti tikpiralana bee n-zaŋ kuɣili sɔŋ zom tooni ni o tuui li, amaa zom’ a Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: Di niŋdiya din bi tuhi yi saria karibu ni, di niŋya faralan’ nirilim bee n-chɛ yi ni di yɛn niŋ shɛm bundan’ zuɣu, amaa doliya wuntia soli n-kariti saria.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Di yi kpe n-gari kpe m-be kaman munaafichilana a niriba sunsuuni, ka miri ka a yi n-zani a kpee nyɛvili yihibu zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Miri ka a bɔh’ a kpee biɛri bee n-je suli niŋ o, amaa yum’ a kpee kaman amaŋ’ la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Gbibiya n zaligunima. Di chɛliya ka naɣ’ bal’ shɛb’ zuliya du yi naɣinyama. Di biriya bimbira balibu buyi pu’ yin’ ni, yi mi di yɛnya taŋgari binyɛrigu.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o dab’ paɣa ti do’ so, ka bɛ na bi yo o zuɣu bee ka dab’ paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni, ka o dan’ maa lan zaŋ o dɔni, di simdi ka bɛ vihi yɛlli maa. Di bi simdi ka bɛ ku ba, dama paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ taali sanyoo sara piɛlaa maa mali sara Yawɛ tooni o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti paai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-sa tihi balibu kam, di wala ni ti nyɛla din dibu chihiri yi sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din chihiri dibu yi sani hal ni yuma ata, ka di bi simdi ni yi di li.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Ka yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ anahi ni, di wala zaa ni nyɛla wal’ suma ka ni nyɛla wumpaɣibo sara pina Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Amaa yuun’ shɛli din pahiri yuma anu ni, yi ni tooi di di wala, ka lala chɛ ka di woli wala pam tin ya: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ŋub’ nimdi ka ʒim na be di ni. Di ti bɔhimya baɣitali bee sotali.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini ŋmahiŋmahi yimaŋa kpiimba zuɣu bee n-chihi yimaŋ’ chiha. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti leei bukpahinima. Di ti bɔnya bɛ shee din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ya daɣiri ni. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Lumiya bɛn zuɣuri paligi sizuura, ka timiya ninkura jilima, ka zomiya yi Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Sana yi be yi tiŋgban’ ni, yin’ di niŋy’ o zaɣ’ biɛɣu.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Sana yi be yi sani, yin’ zaŋmiy’ o leei tiŋbia yi sani, ka yur’ o kaman yimaŋmaŋ’ la. Dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi mali sania maŋa ni zahimbu maŋa ni tahi’ maŋa ni kuruwa maŋa: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima: Izraɛl do’ so bee saamba bɛn be Izraɛl do’ so yi ti zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, bɛn’ kum’ o; tiŋ’ maa nim’ bɛn’ labim’ o kuɣa.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Man’ maŋmaŋ’ ni ti pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih’ o n niriba ni, o ni zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk n-ta m biɛhigu shee daɣiri, ka dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi zuɣu.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Ka so yi zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, ka tiŋ’ maa nim’ nya ka sɔɣ’ li ka bi ku o,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: dindina n ni pa n nina lihiri doo maa min’ o yiŋnima, ka ku o mini ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaa dol’ o jɛmdi Molɛk maa.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Ninvuɣ’ so yi ŋmaligi chaŋ jinwariba sani bee bukpahinim’ sani nti doli ba, n ni pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih’ o n niriba ni.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Gbibiya n zaligunima ka tummiya di tuma; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn’ kum’ o, o ni tu o ba bee o ma maa zuɣu, o ʒim yihibu maa taali ʒila o zuɣu.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Doo yi tum zina ni o kpee paɣa, bɛn’ kum’ o mini paɣ’ maa zaa.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o ba paɣ’ dɔni, dilan’ nyɛla ŋun nya o ba zaɣim, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o bia paɣ’ dɔni, bɛn’ kum bɛ niriba ayi maa, bɛ tumla taali bɛ ni nyɛ dɔɣiri yini zuɣu, bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒila bɛ zuɣu.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Doo yi dɔni o do’ kpee kaman paɣ’ la, bɛ niriba ayi maa tum din chihira, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣ’ min’ o bia leeg’ o paɣiba di nyɛla ninvuɣ’ biɛtali, ka di simdi ka bɛ nyo doo maa min’ o paɣiba maa buɣim din ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ’ biɛtali maa ku lan be bɛ sunsuuni.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Paɣ’ yi zaŋ omaŋ’ ti biŋkɔbigu kam ka o gol’ o, bɛn’ kum’ paɣa maa mini biŋkɔbigu maa, kumiya ba, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa ŋun nyɛ o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga dɔni n-nya o zaɣim, ka paɣa maa gba nya o zaɣim, di nyɛla vi tuuni, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi ba bɛ niriba ni. O ni zaŋ o tizɔpaɣ’ dɔni maa zuɣu, di simdi ni bɛ darig’ o tibili.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ paɣ’ so ŋun sɔrilim na bi naai dɔni m-pirig’ o zaɣim, o yihila paɣ’ maa ʒi’ soya zahira, ka paɣ’ maa gba yih’ omaŋmaŋ’ ʒi’ soya zahira, di simdi ka bɛ yihi bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa bɛ daŋ ni.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Miri ka a bo a piriba bee a mapira, dama nir’ yi niŋ lala o dɔɣira ka o bo maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Doo yi zaŋ o ŋahiba paɣ’ dɔni, o ŋahiba maa zaɣim ka o nya maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ku dɔɣi bia hal ti kpi.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Doo yi kpuɣ’ o mabia paɣa, o tum zaɣ’ biɛɣu, ka nya o mabia zaɣim, bɛ ku dɔɣi bia.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma, dina n-ni chɛ ka n ni zaŋdi ya kuni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa ti ku gbuɣi ya bahi.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Ka miriya ka yi ti doli n ni kariti zuliya shɛb’ ka chɛri ya ŋɔ kaya, dama bɛ daa tumdila dimbɔŋɔnim’ zaa, dinzuɣu ka n zaɣisi ba.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Amaa n yɛlila yinima: N ni zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔn maa tin ya, ka yi di li fali n-su li. Di nyɛla tiŋgban’ shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun woligi ya ka chɛ zuliya shɛba.

english_verse: That's why you must make a difference between animals and birds that I have said are clean and unclean—this will keep you from becoming disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi woligi biŋkɔb’ shɛb’ bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni noombihi shɛb’ bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbigu bee noombil’ bee binshɛli n ni wuhi ni di nyɛla daɣiri la kpɛhi yimaŋ’ daɣiri ni.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi be kasi n sani; dama man’ Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be kasi, ka woligi ya zuliyanim’ ni ni yi nyɛ n dahalali.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Paɣ’ bee doo yi leei jinwara bee bukpaha bɛn’ kum’ o. Bɛn’ labimi ba kuɣa. Bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi bɛmaŋmaŋ’ zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa. Yɛlim’ maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la ni bɛ so miri ka o chaŋ o dɔɣiri so kuyili nti kpe daɣiri ni,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: bee o tizɔpaɣ’ ŋun na ʒi doo, .

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Amaa di bi simdi ka o zaŋ omaŋ’ leei kaman o yidan’ la o niriba sunsuuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim omaŋa.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri sunsuuni bee n-kɔrisi taɣi bɛ teensi bee n-chihi chiha bɛ niŋgbuna ni.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni bɛ be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani ka miri ka bɛ dihi bɛ Naawuni yuli vi; dama bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn zaŋdi bɛ Naawuni bindira n-nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ, dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛ be kasi.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Bɛ miri ka bɛ ti kpuɣi pagɔrili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ’ so bee paɣ’ so ŋun yi o yidan’ yili, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Lihimiya ba kaman bɛn be kasi, dama bɛna n-zaŋdi yi Naawuni bindira maani sara. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi, dama man’ Yawɛ ŋun mali ya ka yi be kasi maa nyɛla ŋun be kasi.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana so bipuɣiŋga yi ti gɔri pagɔrisigu n-dih’ omaŋ’ vi, o ba ka o dihi vi maa, bɛn’ nyom’ o buɣim.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: Maligumaana so ŋun leei kpɛma o tab’ sunsuuni, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni mal’ o kasi n-wolig’ o zali ni o yɛri maligumaana binyɛra miri ka o chɛ ka o zabiri yirimyirim bee n-dari chɛh’ o binyɛra.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: O miri ka o ti chaŋ nir’ ni kpi n-do luɣ’ shɛli. O miri ka o saɣim omaŋa, hal di yi nyɛla o ba bee o ma.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: O miri ka o ti yi luɣ’ kasi shee la n-saɣim o Naawuni luɣ’ kasi shee maa, dama o Naawuni kpa’ shɛli din be kasi ka bɛ boori li bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la nyɛla din be o zuɣu ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Di simdi ka o kpuɣila paɣ’ so ŋun na ʒi doo.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: O di kpuɣi pakoli bee paɣ’ so ŋun yi o yidan’ yili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ’ so bee pagɔrili, amaa o kpuɣim’ o zuliya ni paɣ’ so ŋun na ʒi doo,

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: din ni chɛ ka o ku dih’ o bihi vi o niriba sunsuuni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mal’ o ka o be kasi.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa,

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Ŋunkam ti mali dalinli ŋun di mirina, do’ so ŋun nyɛ zoma bee wɔbiga bee ŋun ninni mali dansi bee ŋun bɔɣu yini gari zaɣ’ yini

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: bee do’ so ŋun napɔŋ bee o nuu mali daŋa

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: bee gurugulana bee diɣili bee do’ so ŋun nina bi ne viɛnyɛla bee ŋun mali dɔr’ shɛli din zaɣisiri niŋgbuŋ ni bee ŋun mali yu’ kaɣima bee bɛ ni yihi do’ so lana.’

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Amaa o di ti miri sariga la gbinna bee n-ka sara maligu bimbini la gbinna, dama o nyɛla ŋun mali dalinli, ka lala chɛ ka o ku dihi n luɣ’ kasi shee ŋɔ vi; dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.”

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛlnim’ zaa lala.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa ni bɛ gbaam’ bɛmaŋ’ ka chɛ Izraɛlnim’ ni zaŋ bin’ kasi shɛŋa na ti ti ma la din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: If any of you are unclean when you accept an offering for me, I will no longer let you serve as a priest.
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ ba, “Yi bihi zaa bɛn be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni so yi ti mali daɣiri ka miri binyɛr’ kasi shɛŋa Izraɛlnim’ ni zaŋ ti man’ Yawɛ la, n ni yihi dilana n sani. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.”

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Aduna bihi ni ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu bee ʒim ni yiri so ni mir’ ka o di bin’ yɛr’ kasinim’ la, faashee o ti yi daɣiri ni. Ŋunkam ti shihi bin’ shɛli din nyɛ daɣiri ka di nyɛla kpima ka o shihi bee do’ so ŋun dɔbilim yi o tooni na,

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Wuntaŋ’ yi ti lu saha shɛli ka o ni yi daɣiri ni, di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi di bin’ kasinim’ la, dama o bindirigu m-bala.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: O miri ka o di biŋkɔb’ so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo’ muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dari tɔhi biŋkɔb’ so, ka di kpɛh’ o daɣiri ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka bɛ gbibi n zaligunima, di yi pa lala bɛ yi birigi li, bɛ ni kpe alahichi ni di zuɣu ka kpi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: Ŋun pa maligumaana zuliya miri ka o di sara maligu kasi la. Sana yi be maligumaana yiŋa bee maligumaana yi bu so paa, o bi simdi ni o di sara maligu kasi maa.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Maligumaana bipuɣiŋga yi kuli do’ so ŋun pa maligumaana, ŋun miri ka o lan di sara maligu kasinim’ maa.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Amaa maligumaana bipuɣiŋga yi na bi dɔɣi bia ka niŋ pakoli bee n-yi o yidan’ yiŋa n-lab’ o ba yiŋ’ na ti ʒiya kaman o ni daa nyɛ bia shɛm la, o ni tooi di o ba bindirigu maa, amaa ninvuɣ’ so ŋun pa maligumaana yiŋ’ nira, ŋun’ miri ka o di li.

english_verse: and anyone else who accidentally does so, must pay for the food plus a fine of
translation_verse: Ka do’ so yi bi yuri ka di bin’ kasi maa, ŋun’ bom’ di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ bin’ kasi maa ti ti maligumaana.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi zaŋ binshɛli din mali daŋa m-mali sara, dama n ku deei li yi sani.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: So miri ka o ti ta Izraɛlnim’ ni zaŋ pin’ kasi shɛŋa na ti mali sara ti Yawɛ la daɣiri,

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: ka chɛ ka bɛ di bɛ pin’ kasinim’ maa, ka di kpɛhi ba alahichi ni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Aduna min’ o bidibisi la ni Izraɛlnim’ zaa, ‘Izraɛl ninvuɣ’ so bee saan’ shɛb’ bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi zaŋ o sara na, ka di nyɛla pɔri sanyoo sara bee omaŋmaŋ’ suhu yubu sara ni o ti nyo buɣim ti Naawuni,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: So yi mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, ka di nyɛla o yɛn yola o ni po pɔr’ shɛli samli bee o kul yɛn malila o suhu yubu sara, ka di nyɛla o piila o niɣi ni bee o piɛri ni na, n yi ni deei li, di simdi ka o nyɛla ŋun viɛl’ zaa. Di bi simdi ka o mali daŋa.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Naɣilaa bee piɛlaa ŋun gbali bee o bɔɣu zaɣ’ yini wɔɣ’ gari di tab’ maa bee n-nyɛ zaɣ’ jia n-gari di tab’ maa, yi ni tooi zaŋ o na ti mali yi suhu yubu sara, amaa yi yi zaŋ o mali sara ni yi yo yi ni po pɔr’ shɛli samli, n ku deei li.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Yi mi di deeya biŋkɔbigu tinzun nir’ sani n-zaŋ o mali sara shɛli din nyɛ yi Naawuni bindirigu sara la. Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali dansi; bɛ ni mali ba tumdi din bi tu kamaata zuɣu, n ku deei ba yi sani.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Bɛ yi dɔɣi naɣibila bee piɛbila bee bubila, di simdi ka o be o ma sani n-niŋ daba ayopɔin, ka daba anii zaŋ chana, yi yi zaŋ o nyo buɣim mali sara ti man’ Yawɛ, n ni deei li.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, yin’ di kɔrigiy’ o min’ o bia maa zaa dahin yini.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi yɛn mali wumpaɣibo sara ti man’ Yawɛ, yin’ malimiya li din ni chɛ ka n deei li yi sani.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ka di simdi ka yi di di zaa din dali maa, di bi simdi ka yi guui shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ’ asiba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: “Dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi gbibi n zaligunima ka dol’ li: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima, yi ni yɛn puhiri chu’ shɛŋa ka di nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasinim’ yi sani, ka nyɛ man’ Yawɛ ni zali chu’ shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Daba ayɔbu ka yi ni zaŋ tum tuma, amaa dabisi’ shɛli din pahiri daba ayopɔin nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili titali, ka nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di bi simdi ni yi tum tuma dindali, di nyɛla Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili yi ni be luɣ’ shɛlikam zaa.

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti tum tuun’ shɛli dindali, dama di nyɛla sanyoo dali, ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Gol’ tuuli biɛɣ’ pinaanahi dali zaawuni nyɛla yi ni yɛn zaŋdi Yaɣigari chuɣu pina tiri Yawɛ saha shɛli.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Amaa malimiya bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ hal ni daba ayopɔin, dabisi’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin n-nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali, Miriya ka yi tum tuma dindali.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima, Yi yi ti paai tiŋ’ shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya maa ni nti kpuɣi di tiŋgbani maa daatam, yin’ zaŋmiya yi ni kpuɣi atam shɛli maa bindir’ tuuli kam bɔbili na ti ti maligumaana;

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Ka yi zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-nyo buɣim mali chi sara din nyom viɛl’ ti Yawɛ. Ka binnyurigu sara din yɛn pahi di zuɣu n-nyɛ wain lita yini.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Ka di bi simdi ni yi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro bee kawaan’ chimda bee zaɣ’ maha hal ni dindali maa, naɣila yi ti zaŋ Naawuni sara maligu maa na pɔi. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni luɣ’ shɛlikam zaa yi ni be.” Puri atam kpuɣibu chuɣu (Kalinlinima

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Di ti tumiya tuma, di nyɛla zaligu yi ʒiɛmani kam ni sahakam yi ni be luɣ’ shɛlikam zaa.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni zaŋ yi bimbɔba maa na ti mali gahibu sara vuhim dabisi’ shɛli dali maa neei biɛɣu, yin’ kalimiya dabisa hal ti paai bakɔi ayopɔin dɛde,

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ yi biɛhigu shee bɔrɔbɔro kpil’ ayi shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ zim kuruwa ayi malina, ka bɛ ti zaŋ gahi. Di simdi ka di ti nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka yi ti niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni, ka di leei bindir’ tuuli shɛli yi ni zaŋ ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ yuun’ yini piɛbihi ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi mini naɣilaa ni piɛlahi ayi m-pahi bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu na, ka di ti niŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la m-pahi di kawana mini chi sara maligu zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ li nyo buɣim ka di leei din nyom viɛl’ Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Ka yi zaŋ bulaa mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka zaŋ piɛlabihi ayi bɛn paai yuun’ yini m-mali suhudoo sara.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ di mini bindir’ pala bɔrɔbɔro ni piɛbihi ayi n-gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara Yawɛ sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka bɛ zaŋ ti maligumaana maa.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Dindali maa di simdi ka yi moli molo, ka laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka di tumiya tuma, di nyɛla zaligu ʒiɛmani kam ni yi biɛhigu shee zaa.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin’ di kpuɣiya putariga bindira, yi mi di ti labiya ti yihi binyiha di ni yaha. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Mani Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni. Yuun’ palli chuɣu (Kalinlinima

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayopɔin ŋɔ biɛɣu pia dali ni nyɛla sanyoo dali, ka di ni ti nyɛla yi laɣiŋgu kasi saha, ka di simdi ni yi ti lo noli, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Di ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka yi ni ti lo noli goli maa daba awɛi dali zaawuni. Yi ni ti gbibila yi Vuhim Dabisili maa zaawuni hal ti lan paai zaawuni.” Suɣa chuɣu (Kalinlinima

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Ti zaŋmiya ti’ viɛla wala mini abie tihi vari ni ti’ shɛŋa din mali vari wulikpana ni kul’ tihi na di piligu dali maa nti wuhi yi suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni hal ni daba ayopɔin.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnim’ zaa: Gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayopɔin maa biɛɣ’ pinaanu dali, zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin m-puhi Naawuni chuɣu din nyɛ suɣa tibu chuɣu la.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Di piligu dali ti nyɛla laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di ti tumiya yi dabisili kam tuma dindali maa.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: daba ayopɔin m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ. Dabisi’ shɛli din pahir’ anii dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, di nyɛla laɣiŋgu tibisili; di ti tumiya tuma dindali maa.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: m-pahi Yawɛ vuhim dabisa la mini yi pina ni yi ni po pɔri shɛŋa sara ni yi suhuyubu sara shɛŋa yi ni maani tiri Yawɛ la zaa zuɣu.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: “Gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayopɔin maa biɛɣ’ pinaata dali, yi yi ti kpuɣi tiŋgbani maa puri atam, yin’ zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin m-puhi Yawɛ chuɣu maa. Di piligu gba ni ti nyɛla vuhim dabisi’ tibisili dali, ka di daba anii dali gba ni ti nyɛla vuhim dabisi’ tibisili dali.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi li ka di leei Naawuni chuɣu yuuni puuni. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka di simdi ka yi gbib’ li la gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayopɔin maa ni.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Yi ni ti be suɣa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin. Izraɛl tiŋbihi zaa ni ti bela suɣa ni.

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ka yi ʒiɛmannim’ ti baŋ ni n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim’ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, n daa chɛ ka bɛ bela suɣa ni. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.”

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ ni zali chu’ shɛŋa puhibu maa n-wuhi Izraɛlnima.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun bom’ so yo o zuɣu, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn’ kum’ o.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: Zalim’ Izraɛlnim’ ni bɛ bom’ bɛ ni dooi olivi kpa’ shɛli din nyɛ alali na nti niŋdi firilanim’ maa puuni din ni chɛ ka firilanim’ maa diri saha shɛlikam.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Di simdi ka o ti zaŋ firilanim’ maa tamtam salima firilatamdigu maa zuɣu ka di doli soli Yawɛ tooni sahakam. Bɛ ni zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro shɛli mali sara ti Naawuni

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Ka a ti zaŋ zim viɛlli mali bɔrɔbɔro kpil’ pinaayi. Zaŋm’ zim kilɔgiram yini m-mali bɔrɔbɔro kpilli kam.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Ka a zaŋ li sɔŋ pie taba kulis’ ayi salima teebuli la zuɣu. Kul’ yini kam zuɣu zaɣ’ kpil’ ayɔbu.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Ka a zaŋ firanki tulaale zim alali pahi kul yini kam zuɣu, ka yi ti zaŋ li pahi bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka di leei shɛhira.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Vuhim Dabisili dali kam, Aduna ni zaŋdi li zaani ka di doli soli Yawɛ tooni kaman lzraɛlnim’ ʒiɛyimtali, ka di leei alikauli sahakam.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Ka di ni ti nyɛla Aduna min’ o bidibisi la ni su shɛli, ka bɛ ni ti di li luɣ’ kasi shee la, dama di nyɛla o tarili din be kasi zaa, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ puuni; ka di nyɛla o ni su shɛli sahakam. Tibidarigibo din tuhi ka daɣiri ka di ni

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛl paɣ’ bia maa daa tu Naawuni, ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Musa sani. O ma yuli n-daa booni Shɛlomit, o daa nyɛla Dibiri bipuɣiŋga, ka nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nira.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kpɛhi duu, ka guhiri ni Yawɛ ti yɛli ba o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Zaŋm’ ninvuɣ’ so ŋun tu ma maa yihi sansani maa kpaŋa nti chɛ ka bɛn zaa wum o ni tu ma shɛm maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ maa zaa lab’ o kuɣa.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Ŋunkam ti mo Yawɛ, o yi nyɛla Izraɛl tiŋbia bee sana, bɛn kum o, Izraɛlnim’ maa zaa bɛn’ labim’ o kuɣa.’

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: “Ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn’ kum’ o.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun’ bom’ biŋkɔb’ so yo o samli; nyɛvili la nyɛvili.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: “So yi ti o kpee dalinli, bɛn’ niŋm’ o gba o ni niŋ shɛm maa labisi.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Tiŋbihi mini saamba zaa zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ’ yini; dama man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim’ maa lala, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ninvuɣ’ so ŋun daa tu Naawuni maa yi bɛ sansani maa kpaŋa nti lab’ o kuɣa. Izraɛlnim’ maa daa tum Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm maa.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: A ni da binshɛli a kpee sani ka di dolila chuɣu maa puhibu nyaaŋa yuma kalinli yaakaza tariga. Ka o mi kɔhi li ti a ka di dol’ a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam yuma shɛm tariga.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni na, tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛn malila di vuhim yuuni Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Amaa yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin ni nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni, di nyɛla Yawɛ vuhim yuuni; di ti biriya yi puri bee n-wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: ni yi niɣi mini biŋkɔb’ shɛb’ bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, binshɛɣukam din ti yɛn bili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na ni ti nyɛla bindirigu.” Nɛma labisi ti yuuni

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Ka goli so ŋun pahir’ ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, yin’ chɛ ka bɛ piɛb’ kikahi pampam. Ka dabisi’ shɛli din nyɛ samli yɔbu dali maa, yin’ chɛliya ka bɛ piɛbi kikahi gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.

english_verse: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti zaŋ yuun’ shɛli din pahiri pihinu la leei yuun’ kasi, ka moli yolisim nyabu molo ti bɛnkam be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Di ni ti nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani, ka sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su shɛlikam, ka lab’ o malibu sani.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Dama di nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani; di ni ti nyɛla yuuni din be kasi; yi ni ti dila binshɛŋa din bili mɔɣu ni di yuuni maa.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: “Yuun’ shɛli din nyɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa puuni, sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su binshɛɣukam.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Yuma maa yi galisi, nyin’ pahimi liɣiri, ka yuma maa yi bi galisi, nyin’ filimmi liɣiri maa, dama a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam shɛm ka o kɔhiri tir’ a maa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ŋariti taba, amaa zomiya yi Naawuni, dama man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.” Muɣisigu din be yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin maa ni

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti niŋ bindira ka yi di n-tiɣi, ka be ni ka barina shɛli kani.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: “Ka yi yi bɔhi ‘Ti yi bi biri bee ti yi bi kpuɣi puri atam yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin maa ni, bɔ ka ti ti yɛn dira?’

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: N ni niŋ n daalibarika niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayɔbu maa ni din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yuma ata bindira.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti yɛn biri yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ anii ni, yi ni ti dirila bindir’ kura, ka yi ti kul ni dirila bindir’ kura maa hal ni yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ awɛi, ka bindir’ pala ti naanyi niŋ.” Tiŋgbani labisi ti ŋun su li yɛla

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi zaŋ tiŋgbani kɔhi ti so ka o su li sahakam, dama tiŋgbani maa nyɛla n dini, yi nyɛla tinzunnim’ mini saamba n sani.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni su tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ’ shɛlikam zaa, zalimiya nir’ ni yɛn kɔh’ o tiŋgbani ka ti lan yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛli.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Fara yi gbaag’ a mabia ka o kɔh’ o tiŋgban’ shɛli ti a, o daŋ ni ninvuɣ’ so ŋun pa o zuɣu n-ni kana ti yo o mabia maa ni kɔhi shɛli maa zuɣu ka deei li.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Ka so yi ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋun ni yo ka deei li, dindina omaŋmaŋ’ yi nya liɣiri ka ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: yin’ chɛliya ka o mal’ o ni daa kɔhi li yuun’ shɛli maa zaŋ kana di saha maa laasabu, ka yo laɣ’ shɛli din pahi ti o ni daa kɔhi li ti so maa, ka bɛ labis’ o tiŋgbani ti o.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Amaa o yi ka yiko din ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, dindina o ni kɔhi shɛli maa kul ni kpalim be ŋun da li maa nuu ni hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni. Di yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka bɛ deei li n-labisi ti o.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ka o yi bi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuuni maa puuni, dindina yili din be bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin’ shɛli ni maa ni leela ŋun da li maa dini sahakam o ʒiɛman’ ni, ka di bi simdi ka bɛ ti deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Amaa yiya din be tiŋkpan’ shɛŋa bɛ ni bi me goma gili ni, din’ mini puri din be mɔɣu ni ni ti nyɛla yim, bɛ ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, ka ni ti tooi lan deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Di zaa yoli Lɛvinim’ bɛn tinsi dina, yiya shɛŋa din be bɛ ni su fɔntin’ shɛŋa ni, bɛn’ Lɛvinim’ maa ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛlikam.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Lɛvi so yi bi yo di zuɣu kaman o ni mali soli ni o niŋ shɛm maa, dindina o ni kɔhi yili shɛli bɛ ni su fɔn’ tin’ shɛli ni maa, bɛn’ ti deemi yili maa ti o nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni, dama yiya shɛŋa din be Lɛvinim’ fɔntinsi ni nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli Izraɛlnim’ sani.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amaa pu’ shɛŋa din be bɛ fɔntinsi maa tiŋgban’ ni, di bi simdi ka bɛ kɔhi dina, dama di nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli saha shɛlikam. Faranim’ sama dihibu

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Ka fara yi gbaag’ a mabia ka o ku lan tooi gbib’ omaŋa, nyin’ gbib’ o ka chɛ ka o be a sani kaman sana bee tinzun nir’ la.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Miri ka a zaŋ a liɣiri paŋ o ka bɔri ni a niŋ nyɔri bee n-kɔhi bindirigu ti o ka niŋ nyɔri.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka nyɛ yi Naawuni. Daba chɛ m-bahi

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Ka fara yi gbaag’ a mabia ŋun ʒi m-baɣ’ a, ka o zaŋ omaŋ’ pa talima a sani, nyin’ di chɛ ka o tumdi tuma kaman dabili la,

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: o ni bela a sani kaman padira bee tumtumda n-tumd’ a tuma hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Di saha o min’ o bihi ni yi a sani n-lab’ o dɔɣiriba sani ti ʒin’ o yaannim’ tiŋgban’ ni.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Dama bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdiba, n ni daa yihi shɛb’ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; di bi simdi ka yi kɔhi ba kaman daba la.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Amaa zom’ a Naawuni, ka di zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib’ o.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Yi ni tooi zaŋ ba ti yi bidibisi, ka bɛ di ba fali yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka bɛ leei bɛ ni su shɛba sahakam. Yi ni tooi zaŋ bɛna n-leei yi daba, amaa yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim’ bɛna, di zaŋya ninkuunsi su taba.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: Sana bee tinzun nir’ yi be yi sani ka ti leei bundana, ka yi mabia mi leei faralana, ka zaŋ omaŋa pa talima san’ maa bee tinzun’ nir’ maa bee san’ maa yiŋ’ ninvuɣ’ so sani,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: dindina bɛ ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg’ o o ni zaŋ omaŋ’ pa talima maa nyaaŋa, o mabihi ni yino ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg’ o

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Ka di simdi ni o be o sani yuuni kam kaman padir’ la. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib’ o yi ninni.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ka o yi bi tooi deeg’ omaŋ’ soya ŋɔ zaa puuni, dindina bɛn’ bahim’ o min’ o bihi nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Dama n tumtumdiba n-nyɛ Izraɛlnima. Bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdi’ shɛba n ni daa yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: dindina n ni tin ya sakom saa mibu saha, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bindira niŋ pam, ka yi puri ni tihi wali wala.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Ka n tin ya suhudoo yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka yi ti dɔni tiŋa, ka so ku varisi ya. N ni ti yihi biŋkɔb’ biɛri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti ku lo tɔbu n-kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Ka yi ti kari doli yi dimnima n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi dɔɣi bihi n-nabi pahi, ka n kul gbibi n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl’ la.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Ka n ni ti be yi sani, ka ku lan zaɣisi ya.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: N kul ni be yi sani chana, ka nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi nyɛ n niriba.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni di chɛ ka yi ku lan nyɛ bɛ daba, n kabi yi nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi la, ka chɛ ka yi tooi chana ka yi zuɣuri ʒe tibi. Nol’ zaɣisibu tibidarigibo (Zaligu Teebu

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: dimbɔŋɔ ka n yɛn niŋ ya, n ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ya, ka chɛ ka dɔr’ shɛli din bahiri nir’ yoli lu yi zuɣu, dɔr’ shɛli din saɣindi nina ka nyɛ din diri nyɛvili. Ka yi ti biri yi bimbira yoli, dama yi dimnima n-ni ti di li.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka yi dimnim’ ti nyaŋ ya, ka sun ya. Ka yi ti guura ka so bi kariti ya.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim’ yi ti niŋ ka yi bi deei n noli, di saha n ni darigi yi tibili ʒiibuyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: N ni ti saɣim yi ni mali karimbaan’ shɛli nyuri bara maa, ka chɛ ka yi sagbana mi be kaman kurigu la,

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: ka yi tiŋgbani mi ti be kaman tahiʒiɛɣu. Yi ni ti yihi yi yaa tum tuma yoli, ka yi tiŋgbani ku niŋ bindirigu, ka di tihi gba ti ku wali wala.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: Di saha yi yi ti na kul zaɣisi n noli ka ku doli ma, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin kaman yi daalahichi ni galisi shɛm tariga.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: N ni ti chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri lu yi zuɣu, ka bɛ be yi sani n-gbahi yi bihi mini yi niɣi n-chɛ ka yi kalinli filim, ka yi soya bili mɔri.

english_verse: I'll remain your enemy and punish you even worse.
translation_verse: dindina n gba ni chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ’ ni ti ŋmɛn’ ya buyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: N ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu n-kun ya bɔhi biɛri alikauli la zuɣu. Ka yi yi ti zo n-kuli yi fɔntinsi ni, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ yi dimnim’ nuu ni.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: N ni ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro zaɣa, ka paɣiba pia ni ti mali yi bɔrɔbɔro dubil’ yini puuni, ka ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro maa tibisim, ka yi ti ŋub’ li ka bi tiɣi.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: dindina n ni zo ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ’ darigi yi tibili buyopɔin yi daalahichinim’ maa zuɣu.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Ka n ni ti saɣim yi jɛmbu shɛhi zaa, ka wurim yi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina, ka ti zaŋ ya zaɣ’ kpima pa yi buɣ’ kpima zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ya ni n suhu zaa.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ka n ti bahi yi fɔntinsi yoli, ka chɛ ka yi jɛmbu shɛhi leei dabari, ka m baɣa ku lan be yi binyɛra din nyom viɛl’ ni.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: N ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka di ti gari yi dimnim’ bɛn ti yɛn kana ti be di ni.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: N ni ti ŋooi takɔb’ lu yi zuɣu wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb’ ni, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari, ka chɛ ka yi fɔntinsi ti bahi yoli.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Di ni ti yɛn kpalim dabari saha shɛli maa ni zaa di ni ti vuhi vuhim shɛli yi ni daa be nimaani ka di bi nyari yi vuhim dabisa dal’ la.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ti tuuri taba kaman bɛ yɛn zomi yi takɔbi kum ni la, ka so bi kari doli ba, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tuhi yi dimnima.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Ka yi ti kpi tinzunnim’ maa sunsuuni, ka yi dimnim’ maa tiŋgbani ti vali ya.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni bɛn ti kpalim ni ti bahi yoli yi dimnim’ tiŋgbɔna ni bɛ mini bɛ yaannim’ daalahichi zuɣu, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛ yaannim’ maa.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n gba zaɣisi ba ka zaŋ ba tahi bɛ dimnim’ tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, di saha bɛ yi ti siɣisi bɛmaŋ’ bɛ suhuri din mali daɣiri maa ni ka niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: dindina n ni teei n ni daa lo Yaakubu mini Yisahaku ni Ibrahimma alikauli shɛŋa la yɛla, ka lan teei tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Amaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti chɛ ba ka leei dabari dɔni n-di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim saha shɛli bɛ ni ti lan ka di ni maa, dama bɛ ʒiɛm n zaligunima ka zaɣisi n zaligunim’ maa bɛ suhuri ni.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim’ zaa yoli, bɛ yi ti be bɛ dimnim’ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, n ti ku ʒiɛm ba bee n zaɣisi ba din ni chɛ ka n ku bɛ zaa ka saɣim n ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛl’ la, dama man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ zuɣu n ni teei n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim’ alikauli shɛl’ la yɛla, n ni daa yihi shɛb’ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na zuliya pam ninni nti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa mini kaya shɛŋa ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima, so yi po pɔri n-zaŋ daadam ti Yawɛ kaman yi ni zal o da’ shɛli,

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: Ka dilan’ yi nyɛla doo ŋun paai yuun’ pihinu zaŋ chana, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pinaanu, ka paɣ’ mi nyɛ bini pia.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: “Tiŋgbani maa atam bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu, di yi nyɛla tiŋgban’ ni bindira bee tihi wala, di nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka nyɛ din be kasi Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Ka do’ so yi nyɛla faralana ka ku tooi yo yi ni zali da’ shɛli maa, dindina yin’ zaŋmi dilan’ chaŋ maligumaana sani, ka o ti zal’ o daa, maligumaana ni zal’ o daa maa ka di dolila ŋun po pɔri maa dahima ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: “Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb’ so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara tiri Yawɛ, ninsal’ yi zaŋ biŋkɔbigu ti Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb’ so ŋun bi be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni ku zaŋ biŋkɔb’ so mali sara ti Yawɛ, dindina doo maa ŋun’ zaŋm’ biŋkɔbigu maa chaŋ maligumaana sani,

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: “So yi zaŋ o ni di tiŋgban’ shɛli fali yaɣ’ shɛli ti Yawɛ, dindina di daa yɛn dolila di ni yɛn tooi deei bimbira shɛm. Pal’ shɛli din ni biri siŋkaafa tah’ ayi daa ni nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Ka o yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi nɛma labisi ti yuuni puuni yi ni zal’ li da’ shɛli, di daa n-kul yɛn bala.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ yi ti deei puu maa chuɣu puhibu la saha, di ni nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ pu’ shɛli ti Yawɛ. Maligumaana n-ni ti su li.

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: dindina maligumaana ni zali di daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, ka dilan’ ni yo di liɣiri dindali maa ka di leei din be kasi Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka yi labisi puu maa ti bɛ ni daa da li ninvuɣ’ so sani maa, ŋun daa su li, ka di nyɛla o di li la fali maa.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Yi daa kam ni dolila jɛmbu duu sania. Gɛra bini pisi n-ni nyɛ anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ’ yini.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: “Amaa biŋkɔbigu ni tuui dɔɣi bi’ so nyɛla Yawɛ ni su so, di bi simdi ka so ti lan zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, o nyɛla Yawɛ dini.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: “Amaa so yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti Yawɛ zaa, di yi nyɛla daadam bee biŋkɔbigu bee o ni di tiŋgban’ shɛli fali, di bi simdi ni bɛ kɔhi li bee n-yo di zuɣu ka dee’ li, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Yawɛ nyɛla din be kasi zaa.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni zaŋ so ti Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn ku so, so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg’ o, bɛ kul ni ku o mi.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: So yi bɔr’ ni o yo pia kam puuni yim maa zuɣu ka dee’ li, o ni yo di daa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Ka nahu kam mini piɛɣu kam ŋun pahiri pia ka nyɛ biŋkɔbigul’ ni guli so nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ ni daa yi Ijipti chana, di yuma ayi nyaaŋa gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni Sinai mɔɣu ni.

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: dɔbba bɛn zaa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka paai yuun’ pisi bee n-gar’ lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni. A mini Aduna sabimi bɛ yuya kaman bɛ daŋ kam ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa zaŋ bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ yuya ŋɔ

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: n-chɛ ka bɛ laɣim niriba maa zaa na gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayi dahin yini dali, ka bɛ mini bɛ zuliya ti sab’ bɛ yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn paai yuun’ pisi bee n-gari lala

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Lala ka Izraɛlnim’ daa niŋ. Bɛ daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Amaa Lɛvinim’ maa bɛn’ tim’ bɛ suɣa gili alikauli suɣili maa n-gul’ li, ka Naawuni suhu ti ku yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu.”

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim’ ni bɛ daŋ niriba pahi bɛ ni.

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli Musa,

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Lɛvinim’ zuliya kɔŋko ka a ku kali, a mi di sab’ bɛ yuya pahi Izraɛlnim’ ni.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship.
