They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti yɛn sibigi suɣili maa chaŋ, Lɛvinim’ n-yɛn sibigi li; ka yi yi ti yɛn sa li, Lɛvinim’ maa n-yɛn zaŋ li sa. Ka ninvuɣ’ zino yi miri suɣili maa na, yin’ kum’ o.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ bɛn kpalim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zalizali.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: Chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim’ ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zali di ni simdi ni bɛ ʒi luɣ’ shɛŋa mini bɛ yaannim’ dunoya tuutanim’ ni sa luɣ’ shɛŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ suɣa maa noya kpa laɣiŋgu suɣili maa luɣilikam polo.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihinunaayopɔin ni kɔbisinahi.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinu.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim’ zaŋ laɣiŋgu suɣili la be suɣa maa sunsuuni doli kaman bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa maa zali shɛm, ka sokam ʒe o zaashee o tuuta gbini.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim’ kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Niriba bɛn daa be nimaani gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihitanaanu ni kɔbisinahi.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihinahi ni yini ni kɔbisinu.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ’ tuhi’ pihinunaata ni kɔbisinahi.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim’ pahi Izraɛlnim’ kalinli ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun zali Musa shɛm la.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ daa kul niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Bɛ ni daa tiri bɛ suɣa ʒiini bɛ tuutanim’ gbini shɛm, lala ka sokam min’ o malibu daa doli chani kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
translation_verse: Aduna bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: O bituuli Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Amaa Nadab mini Abihu bɛn daa kpila Yawɛ tooni, bɛ ni daa zaŋ buɣim shɛli din bi simdi n-nyo sara maligu Sinai Zoli gbini mɔɣu ni la zuɣu. translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

translation_verse: Amaa sabimi Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa yuya n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi maligumaanitali tuma, ka ninvuɣ’ zino yi ka bɛ sanna, yin’ kum’ o.”

english_verse: Moses, I have chosen these Levites from all Israel, and they will belong to me in a special way. translation_verse: dama bikpamba zaa nyɛla n ni su shɛba; n ni daa ku bikpamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka n daa zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni bikpamba bɛn nyɛ ninsalinim’ zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri bikpamba zaa leei n ni su shɛba. Bɛ nyɛla n ni su shɛba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.” Bɛ kali Lɛvinima

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai mɔɣu ni,

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: “Kalim’ Lɛvinima kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm dɔbba bɛn nyɛ kaman gol’ yini zaŋ chana.”

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Lɛvinim’ maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kɔhat bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Mɛrari bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mahili mini Mushi. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Lɛvinim’ zuliya kaman bɛ yaannim’ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa nyɛ Libini daŋ mini Shimɛi daŋ; Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa bala.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa n-daa su Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni mini di nyaaŋa binshɛŋa bɛ ni mali pindi li tuma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su Pateesa shɛli din yili di dunol’ ni

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: mini Pateesa shɛŋa din yili dundɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili pateesa shɛli din daa yili dundɔŋ ni dunol’ ni n-liri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili mini sara maligu bimbin’ la ni di mihi zaŋ tabili di tuuni kam fukumsi.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Amiram yiŋnima mini Izar yiŋnima ni Hiburɔn yiŋnima ni Uziɛl yiŋnima; Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa bala.

english_verse: The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ka Uziɛl bia Ɛlizafan daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa dɔɣirikpɛma.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Bɛna n-daa su Alikauli Adaka la mini teebuli ni firilatamdigu ni sara maligu bimbina ni la’ shɛŋa maligumaaniba ni daa zaŋdi tumdi tuma la zaŋ tabili Pateesa la ni di tuuni kam fukumsi.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la bia Ɛliɛza n-daa nyɛ Lɛvinim’ kpamba maa zuɣulana; ŋuna n-daa lihiri ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn su luɣ’ kasi shee la.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Mɛrari zuliya n-daa nyɛ Mahilinim’ daŋ mini Mushinim’ daŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Mɛrari zuliya.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Mɛrari zuliya maa dɔɣirikpɛma n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bia Zuriɛl. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila laɣiŋgu suɣili maa nuzaa polo.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Bɛn mi daa yɛn ti bɛ suɣa zali Naawuni jɛmbu shee tooni wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tooni wulimpuhili polo n-daa nyɛ Musa mini Aduna ni o bidibisi. translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa kali Lɛvinim’ shɛb’ zaa bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ kali ba kaman sokam ni o daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm la, bɛ dɔbba zaa bɛn daa nyɛ gol’ yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tuhi’ pisinaayi. Lɛvinim’ zani bidibikpamba zaani

translation_verse: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Sabimi Izraɛlnim’ bidibikpamba zaa bɛn nyɛ gol’ yini zaŋ chani yuya, ka kali ba.

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, Zaŋmi Lɛvinim’ zaa ti ma ka chɛ Izraɛlnim’ bidibikpamba zaa, ka zaŋ Lɛvinim’ niɣi ti ma ka chɛ Izraɛlnim’ niɣi ni tuui dɔɣi naɣibihi shɛb’ zaa.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa kali Izraɛlnim’ bidibikpamba zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal’ o shɛm.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: “Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Zaŋm’ Lɛvinim’ zali Izraɛlnim’ bidibikpamba zaa zaani, ka zaŋ Lɛvinim’ niɣi zali Izraɛlnim’ niɣi zaani, ka Lɛvinim’ maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.

english_verse: But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ bidibikpamba kalinli ni zooi gari Lɛvinim’ kalinli kaman ninvuɣ’ kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaata la zuɣu,

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: di simdi ni yi bo anzinfa laɣibaligu diba anu din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaligu ni wuhi anzinfa laɣibaligu shɛm tariga

translation_verse: n-yo bidibikpamba bɛn kalinli pani maa zuɣu Aduna min’ o bidibisi sani.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni daa nyɛla bɛ lihiri binshɛŋa din be kasi pam la.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: “Saha shɛli yi yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ, Aduna min’ o bidibisi bɛn’ kpɛm’ suɣili maa ni nti yiligi pateesa shɛli din yiliya la n-zaŋ li pili Alikauli Adaka la.

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: “Bɛ lan zaŋm’ chinchin’ sabilitim pili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili bɔrɔbɔro teebul’ la, ka zaŋ lahi mini tulaale zim lahi ni la’ shɛŋa ni binnyur’ shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara la tam di zuɣu; ka zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro shɛli din simdi ni di kul be nimaani sahakam la gba pa di zuɣu.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Bɛ lan zaŋm’ chinchin’ sabilitim pili firilatamdigu la mini di firilanim’ ni di firiladuhirisi ni firilakpihindisi ni di tahipɔna ni di kpam ni be kpaŋman’ shɛŋa ni;

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ di mini di nɛma zaa pɔbi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ ni, ka zaŋ li tam amaŋka dapuhi zuɣu.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: “Bɛ lan zaŋm’ chinchin’ sabilitim pili salima sara maligu bimbin’ la, ka yɛrigi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil’ li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Bɛ lan zaŋm’ la’ shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni mali tumdi tuma Luɣ’ kasi shee la n-guri chinchin’ sabilitim ni, ka zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil’ li n-zaŋ li niŋ amaŋka maa ni.

translation_verse: ka zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu neen’ shɛŋa din nyɛ buɣim moori binyara mini gbabɔnima ni soobuya ni taha ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu nɛma zaa pa di zuɣu, ka yɛrigi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil’ li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Bɛ yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ, ka Aduna min’ o bidibisi la zaŋ binyara pili Luɣ’ kasi shee la mini di nɛma zaa naai, di nyaaŋa Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn’ kpuɣim nɛma maa ʒi, amaa bɛ miri ka bɛ shihi neen’ shɛŋa din nyɛ kasi la, bɛ yi niŋ lala, bɛ ni kpi.” Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa ni yɛn ʒi Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa neen’ shɛŋa m-bala.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: “Maligumaana Aduna bia Ɛliɛza n-yɛn su firila kpam mini tulaale zim ni sahakam sara maligu chi ni bɛ ni mali kpa’ shɛli boori bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la ni binshɛɣukam zaa din nyɛ Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa dini zaŋ tabili binshɛɣukam zaa din be di puuni ni Luɣ’ kasi shee la mini di lahi fukumsi.”

english_verse: The Kohathites must not go near or even look at the sacred objects until Aaron and his sons have covered those objects. If they do, their entire clan will be wiped out. So make sure that Aaron and his sons go into the tent with them and tell them what to carry. The Duties of the Gershonite Clans
translation_verse: amaa ka di chɛ ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa ti kpe nti lihi binshɛŋa din nyɛ kasi maa hal biɛla gba, di yi niŋ lala, bɛ ni kpi.” Maligumaana Gɛrishɔn zuliya tuma ni nyɛ shɛli

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:

english_verse: The Gershonites will be responsible
translation_verse: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma nyɛla jɛmbu tuma mini ʒiʒibo.

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: Bɛna n-yɛn ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee pateesanim’ mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni di bimpindigu ni biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ din yɛn pa di zuɣusaa la ni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol’ ni pateesa la.

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: Bɛna n-lan yɛn su dundɔŋ ni pateesanim’ mini pateesa shɛli din daa yili dundɔŋ din gili Naawuni jɛmbu shee dunoli ni sara maligu bimbin’ la ni di mihi ni neen’ shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni mali tumdi di tuma. Bɛ niŋm’ binyara maa zaa kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ niŋ li shɛm zaa.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib’ ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma. Mɛrari daŋ niriba bɛn nyɛ Lɛvinim’ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Bɛ tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nyɛla bɛ ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee dasara mini di kuruwɔɣila ni daantalisi ni di binzahi

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: ni dundɔŋ din gil’ la pilanim’ mini di binzahi ni kpahi ni mihi ni di nɛma zaa ni di neen’ kparisi zaa; ka a boli sokam zaa yuli n-wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn ʒi neen’ shɛŋa.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Mɛrari zuliya maa tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib’ ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm zuɣu ka o daa zali sokam o ni yɛn tum tuun’ shɛli bee o ni yɛn ʒi ʒi’ shɛli. Lala ka o daa kali ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun’ Musa shɛm.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Yihim’ bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa yi biɛhigu shee, ka bɛ ku ta bɛ biɛhigu shee din nyɛ n ni be bɛ sani luɣ’ shɛli maa daɣiri.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima, doo bee paɣ’ yi bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka tum o kpee taali, dilan’ maa leei ŋun tum alahichi.

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: Di simdi ni dilan’ kahig’ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa wuhi, ka yo o ni tum taal’ shɛli maa samli zaa, ka lan yo di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi n-zaŋ li ti o ni tum so taali maa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ka o ni tum so taali maa dɔɣiri so yi kani ka o ni zaŋ taali tumbu samli maa yo o, ŋun’ zaŋm’ li ti Yawɛ, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti maligumaana m-pahi piɛla’ so bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali sara ŋun tum taali maa zuɣu la.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Sokam zaa pin’ shɛŋa din be kasi nyɛla o ni su shɛli, ka so yi zaŋ binshɛli na ti ti maligumaana, di nyɛla ŋun’ maligumaana maa dini.” Yidaampaɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn yidaannim’ zilisi ba

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: nyuli yi kpe o yidan’ maa suhu ni ka o zab’ nyuli o paɣ’ maa ni tum daɣiri tuuni maa zuɣu bee o yi zab’ nyuli n-zilisi ni o paɣ’ maa tum daɣiri tuuni maa ka o mi bi tum li;

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: dindina doo maa ŋun’ zaŋm’ o paɣ’ maa tahi maligumaana sani. Di simdi ni o bo di sara maligu na paɣ’ maa zuɣu, dina n-nyɛ: chi zim kilɔgiram yini na. O di booi kpam niŋ di ni, o mi di niŋ tulaale zim niŋ di ni, dama di nyɛla zilisigu chi sara maligu, chi sara maligu shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ teei taali tumbu yɛla.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: “Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa zaŋ paɣ’ maa mirina ti zali Yawɛ tooni;

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ka booi kom din be kasi niŋ laa ni, ka tooi taŋkpaɣu din do Naawuni jɛmbu shee tiŋgban’ ni n-zaŋ li niŋ kom maa ni.

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa sabi tibidarigibo maa yɛla niŋ litaafi ni m-paɣ’ li niŋ kɔtɔɣu maa ni

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: n-chɛ ka paɣ’ maa nyu kɔtɔɣu din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na. Ka ko’ shɛli din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na ni kpe paɣ’ maa ni n-ti o biɛrim pam.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana maa deei nyuli zabbu sara chi zim maa paɣ’ maa nuu ni n-zaŋ li gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu;

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: ka tooi chi zim maa nukurigu pali kaman di ni wuhi shɛm n-zaŋ li niŋ buɣim ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, di nyaaŋa ka o chɛ ka paɣ’ maa zaŋ kom maa nyu.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Amaa paɣ’ maa yi bi tum daɣiri tuma, ka nyɛla ŋun ka taali, dindina di ku niŋ o shɛli, o ni tooi dɔɣi bihi.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: bee zilisigu yi kpe doo suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ o paɣ’ polo zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: o ni zaŋ paɣ’ maa ti zali Yawɛ tooni, ka maligumaana karim zaligu maa yɛla zaa bahi paɣ’ maa zuɣu.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Ka doo maa yi taali ni, amaa ka paɣ’ maa ŋun’ taali ʒi o zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: Doo bee paɣ’ yi ti po pɔri din nyɛ Nazari pɔri ni o wolig’ omaŋ’ ti Yawɛ,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: ŋun’ woligim’ omaŋ’ ka chɛ wain mini binnyuri kpɛma, ka di nyu bɛ ni zaŋ wain tihi komihigu mali shɛli bee binnyuri kpeen’ shɛli, o mi di nyu wain tiwala kom bee n-di di zaɣ’ maha bee di zaɣ’ kuma.

english_verse: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.
translation_verse: “O ni yɛn nyɛ Nazari nir’ dabisa shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa puuni, o miri ka o pini o zuɣu hal ka o ni wolig’ omaŋ’ ti Yawɛ saha shɛli maa ti gari. Di simdi ka o be kasi, ka chɛ ka o zabiri zooi wɔɣawɔɣa.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: O ni wolig’ omaŋ’ ti Yawɛ dabisa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni, o di miri kpima.

english_verse: not even that of your father, mother, brother, or sister. That would make you unclean. Your hair is the sign that you are dedicated to me, so remain holy.
translation_verse: Dabisa shɛŋa puuni zaa o ni wolig’ omaŋ’ maa, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: “Ka so yi do m-baɣ’ o ka ti kpi n-libig’ o, ka di chɛ ka o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa bi lan be kasi, dindina ŋun’ pinim’ o zuɣu maa o ni ti yɛn yi daɣiri ni dahin’ shɛli. O pinim’ li daba ayopɔin dali.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: O bom’ ŋman’ ʒiɛh’ ayi bee yiŋ’ ŋman’ bih’ ayi na nti ti maligumaana Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni daba anii dali,

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ ŋman’ yino mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ŋun’ la mi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, o ni shihi kpima n-tum alahichi shɛl’ la zuɣu. Ka o lan mal’ o zuɣu maa ka di be kasi dindali maa,

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: ka wolig’ omaŋ’ ti Yawɛ o ni yɛn nyɛ Nazari nir’ dabisa shɛŋa puuni maa zaa, ka bo yuun’ yini piɛlaa na ti mali sara taali tumbu zuɣu; o ni daa pun niŋ shɛl’ la din kpalim la yoli, dama daɣiri ta o ni daa pun mal’ o zuɣu shɛli ka di be kasi la.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: “Nazari nir’ zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: saha shɛl’ o ni zaŋ wolig’ omaŋ’ maa tariga yi ti paai, bɛn’ zaŋm’ o na ti zali Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni,

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: ka o zaŋ o pini ti Yawɛ. O bom’ yuun’ yini piɛlaa ŋun ka galimi, ka bɛ zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka bo yuun’ yini piɛnyaŋ ŋun ka galimi, ka bɛ zaŋ o mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka o lan bo piɛlaa ŋun ka galimi, ka bɛ zaŋ o mali suhudoo sara.

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: O lan bom’ bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu pali mini bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛlli shɛli maha ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam pa shɛli zuɣu ni chi sara, ni binnyura sara.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Ka maligumaana zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka mali Nazari nir’ maa daalahichi sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Nazari nir’ maa pini o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol’ ni, ka zaŋ o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri maa niŋ biɛrisuŋ sara maligu la buɣim ni.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: “Bɛ yi duɣi nimdi maa, Maligumaana ŋun’ yihim’ piɛ’ bɔɣu, ka pii maha din ka dabindi la zaɣ’ yini piɛɣu ni, ka pii karikaasi din ka dabindi la zaɣ’ yini n-zaŋ li niŋ Nazari nir’ maa nuhi ni o ni zaŋ o zuɣu shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri pinibu nyaaŋa.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Di saha ka maligumaana maa zaŋ li gahi zuɣusaa, di nyɛla sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni mali gahiri zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni. Lala bina maa nyɛla din be kasi ka nyɛ maligumaana dihili m-pahi piɛ’ nyɔɣu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la mini gbalipaɣ’ shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ mali maligu la. Di nyaaŋa Nazari nir’ maa ni tooi nyu wain.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Aduna min’ o bidibisi, ŋ-ŋɔ ka yi yɛn suhiri alibarika niŋdi Izraɛlnim’ ni: yɛlimiya ba,

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: ‘Yawɛ niŋm’ alibarika niŋ yi ni ka gbib’ ya;

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Yawɛ zaŋm’ o nina lihi ya, ka niŋ ya nirilim.

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ neem’ o nina lihi ya ka tin ya suhudoo.’

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: “Lala ka bɛ ni zaŋ n yuli suhi alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim’ ni, ka n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.”

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛl zuɣulaannim’ bɛn nyɛ bɛ yaannim’ dunoya ni dɔɣirikpamba mini bɛ ni daa kali zuliya shɛb’ la zuɣulaannim’ daa mali sara.

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: Bɛ daa zaŋla Tɔrokɔnima ayɔbu mini naɣilahi pinaayi din daa nyɛ bɛ sara na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni. Zuɣulaannim’ ayi kam daa laɣim sula tɔroko’ yini, ka bɛ ninvuɣ’ yino kam su naɣila’ yino. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba mali sara Yawɛ jɛmbu suɣili tooni.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: “Deem’ pina maa bɛ sani n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinima kaman sokam tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaŋ ba tum suɣili maa ni tuma.”

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa deei tɔrokɔnim’ maa mini naɣilahi maa n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim’ maa.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: ka daa zaŋ tɔrokɔnim’ anahi mini naɣilah’ anii ti Mɛrari bihi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka maligumaana Aduna bia Itama nyɛ bɛ tuma zuɣulana.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ daa bi ti Kɔhat bihi la shɛli, dama bɛna n-daa su ni bɛ zaŋ neen’ shɛŋa din be kasi la buɣi bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Zuɣulaan’ yino kam zaŋm’ o pina na ti malimi sara dahin yini kam, sara maligu bimbini maa zaŋ ti Naawuni la zuɣu.”

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Dabisili din pah’ awɛi dali, Gidiɔni bia Abidan ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya zuɣulan’ la n-daa mali sara.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Saha shɛli Musa ni daa kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni ni o mini Yawɛ ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa la, ka o daa wum kukol’ shɛli Alikauli Adaka yɔrigu la zuɣusaa chɛrubinim’ ayi la sunsuuni ka di tɔɣisir’ o yɛtɔɣa.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Aduna, ‘A yi ti zaŋ firilanim’ ayopɔin la zali, nyin’ chɛ ka di ne firilatamdigu la tooni.’ ”

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa mali firilatamdigu maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ daa zaŋla matarika ŋmɛnŋme salima n-zaŋ mal’ li; di gbinni zaŋ ti paai di zuɣusaa tipuma kɔtomsi la, matarika ka bɛ daa zaŋ ŋmɛnŋme m-mal’ li. Yawɛ ni daa wuhi Musa ni o mali firilatamdigu maa shɛm, lala ka o daa mal’ li. Bɛ mali Lɛvinim’ kasi ka zaŋ ba ti Naawuni

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa,

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: A ni yɛn niŋ ba shɛm mali ba kasi m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋm’ ko’ shɛli din yihiri nir’ daɣiri ni la mihi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ piliŋ pini bɛ niŋgbuna ni kɔbiri zaa, ka paɣi bɛ situra m-mali bɛmaŋ’ kasi.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa, ka a chɛ ka bɛ bo naɣilabila mini sara maligu zim viɛlli shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri, ka a mi bo naɣilabil’ so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani alahichi sanyoo sara la.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ka a zaŋ Lɛvinim’ maa na ti zali laɣiŋgu suɣili la tooni, ka laɣim Izraɛlnim’ zaa na.

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: Ka Aduna zaŋ Lɛvinim’ maa zali Yawɛ tooni kaman Izraɛlnim’ ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahi zuɣusaa, ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi tum Yawɛ tuma.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Ka Lɛvinim’ maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilahi maa zuɣuri ni, ka yi zaŋ zaɣ’ yino mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ŋun’ la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ Lɛvinim’ maa daalahichi zuɣu.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: “Di saha ka a chɛ ka Lɛvinim’ maa zani Aduna min’ o bidibisi la tooni, ka a zaŋ ba ti Yawɛ kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Lala ka a yɛn niŋ woligi Lɛvinim’ maa Izraɛlnim’ ni, ka Lɛvinim’ maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: A yi mali Lɛvinim’ maa kasi, ka zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la, di nyaaŋa bɛ ni tooi kpe laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni ti tum tuma.

english_verse: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.
translation_verse: Dama bɛ yihi ba la Izraɛlnim’ puuni n-zaŋ ba ti ma zaa ka n deei ba leei n ni su shɛba, ka chɛ Izraɛlnim’ bidibikpamba.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Dama Izraɛlnim’ ni tuui dɔɣi bi’ shɛb’ zaa zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri tuuli bihi nyɛla n ni su shɛba. N ni daa ku bikpamba zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl’ la, ka n daa mali ba kasi ti mmaŋa.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Amaa n zaŋla Lɛvinim’ maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnim’ bikpamba zaa.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Din pahi nyɛla n zaŋ Lɛvinim’ maa mi kaman pin’ shɛli din yi Izraɛlnim’ sanna n-ti Aduna min’ o bidibisi la ni bɛ tumdi tuma Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni tiri Izraɛlnima, ka maani sara tiri ba, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ maa yi ti kana ti miri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la, ka alɔbo shɛli ku lu bɛ zuɣu.”

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Lɛvinim’ maa daa mali bɛmaŋ’ yi alahichi ni, ka paɣi bɛ binyɛra, ka Aduna daa zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi gahiri zuɣusaa la zali Yawɛ tooni, ka mali sara ti ba bɛ daalahichi zuɣu m-mali ba kasi.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim’ maa daa kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nti sɔŋ Aduna min’ o bidibisi maa n-tum tuma. Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvinim’ maa polo, lala ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ ba.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa,

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: Bɛ sɔŋmi bɛ mabihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni ka bɛ tumdi bɛ tuma, amaa ka lee di lan zaŋ bɛ nyɔɣu yo di tuun’ shɛli. Lala ka a yɛn niŋ Lɛvinim’ maa n-wuhi ba bɛ tuma.”

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai mɔɣu ni bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la nyaaŋa yuma ayi puuni gol’ so ŋun daŋ tooni la ni n-yɛli,

english_verse: to say to the people, “Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: “Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di puhibu saha.

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Gol’ ŋɔ biɛɣ’ pinaanahi dali zaawuni doliya di kaya ni di zaligunim’ zaa soli m-puhi li di puhibu saha.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa gol’ so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ’ pinaanahi dali zaawuni Sinai mɔɣu maa ni. Yawɛ ni daa kul zali Musa shɛlikam zaa, lala ka Izraɛlnim’ daa shiri niŋ.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ ni shɛb’ daa shihila kpima, ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku tooi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa dindali maa. Bɛna n-daa ka Musa mini Aduna sanna dindali maa

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: nti yɛli Musa, “Ti shihila kpima ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka bɔzuɣu ka tinim’ ku tooi pahi Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu n-zaŋ Yawɛ pini na ti ti o di tibu saha?”

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, “Guhimiya ka m-bɔhi Yawɛ wum o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi polo.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ lan yɛli Musa,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: “Yɛlim’ Izraɛlnima ni bɛ ni so bee bɛ dɔɣiriba yi shihi kpima ka leei bɛn bi be kasi bee bɛ yi gomi chaŋ katiŋa, bɛ ni tooi puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Bɛ puhim’ chuɣu maa ka di di bindirigu mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni vari din to gol’ so ŋun pah’ ayi biɛɣ’ pinaanahi dali.

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: Bɛ di chɛ ka di shɛli kpalim ka biɛɣu neei paai li bee ŋ-ŋma di kɔbili. Bɛ doli Yaɣigari chuɣu maa zaligu puhi li.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Amaa ninvuɣ’ so ŋun be kasi, ka bi go ka mi bi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa, bɛn’ yihim’ dilan’ n niriba ni, o ni bi mali Yawɛ sara maa di saha la zuɣu, ka o daalahichi kpalim’ o zuɣu.

english_verse: Anyone, including foreigners who live among you, can celebrate Passover, if they follow all the regulations. The Cloud over the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ka sana yi be yi ni, ka bɔri ni o puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa, ŋun’ doli Yaɣigari chuɣu maa kaya mini di zaligu soli puhi li. Yinim’ tiŋbihi mini saamba bɛn be yi ni zaa doliya zaligu yini.” Sagbani din be kaman buɣim (Yibu

english_verse: As soon as the sacred tent was set up, a thick cloud appeared and covered it. The cloud was there each day, and during the night, a fire could be seen in it.
translation_verse: Lala ka di daa kul be, sagbani maa daa kul pil’ li mi wuntaŋ’ ni, ka be kaman buɣim la yuŋ.

english_verse: The Lord used this cloud to tell the Israelites when to move their camp and where to set it up again. As long as the cloud covered the tent, the Israelites did not break camp. But when the cloud moved, they followed it, and wherever it stopped, they camped and stayed there,
translation_verse: Hal sagbani maa daa yi kpalim ʒe Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa zuɣusaa dabisi’ gbaliŋ gba, Izraɛlnim’ maa kul dolila Yawɛ zaligu maa ka ku yiɣisi chaŋ.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Sagbani maa daa yi kpalim ʒiɛya daba ayi bee goli bee di daa yi kpalim ʒe Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa yuui, Izraɛlnim’ maa kul kpalindimi doya ka bi chana; amaa di daa yi ti vuui saha shɛli, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi.

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ matarika ŋ-ŋmɛnŋme li mal’ li; ka yi mal’ li piɛbiri laɣindi niriba, ka mal’ li piɛbiri ka bɛ yiɣisira chana.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Bɛ yi ti piɛbi kikah’ ayi maa saha shɛli, niriba maa zaa bɛn’ laɣimm’ a sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol’ ni.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ yi ti piɛbi zaɣ’ yini kɔŋko, di saha zuɣulaannim’ bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim’ dɔɣirikpamba la bɛn’ laɣimm’ a sanna.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: Ka a yi ti lan chɛ ka bɛ piɛbi kika’ biɛɣu pahi buyi, bɛn suɣa be nudirigu polo la bɛn’ yiɣisim’ gbaai chandi. Bɛ yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ saha shɛlikam, bɛn’ piɛbimi kika’ biɛɣu maa.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Amaa saha shɛli niriba maa yi ti yɛn laɣimmi, yin’ piɛbimi kikaa maa, amaa ka di piɛb’ li kika’ biɛɣu piɛbbu.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Maligumaana Aduna bidibisi mi n-yɛn piɛbiri kikahi maa. “Kikahi maa n-yɛn nyɛ yi kali soli bini yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Saha shɛli yi yi ti lo tɔbu yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni yi tuhi yi dimnim’ bɛn muɣisiri ya, di saha yin’ piɛbimiya kika’ biɛɣu, ka lala chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ teei yi yɛla, ka tiligi ya yi dimnim’ maa nuu ni.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Yi suhupiɛlli dabisa dali mini yi churi puhibu ni ni yi goya piligu ni, piɛbimiya kikahi maa bahi yi sara shɛŋa yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini yi biɛrisuŋ sara zuɣu; dina n-yɛn chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ teei yi yɛla. Man’ Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.” Izraɛlnim’ yiɣisiya

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Yuun’ shɛli din daa pahir’ ayi puuni gol’ so ŋun pahir’ ayi biɛɣ’ pisi dali ka sagbani maa daa vuui alikauli biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa.

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ maa daa yiɣisi Sinai mɔɣu ni n-doli tab’ gbilligbilli chana; ka sagbani maa daa chaŋ ti kpalim zani Paran mɔɣu ni.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi gbaai bɛ tuuli chandi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba shɛm.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Juda zuliya n-daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta daŋ yiɣisi doli tab’ gbilligbilli gbaai chandi. Aminadab bia Nashɔn n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Ka Zua bia Nɛtanɛl nyɛ Isaka zuliya zuɣulana;

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: ka Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya zuɣulana.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa wurim Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma sɔŋ, ka Gɛrishɔn mini Mɛrari zuliya bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma la daa yiɣisi gbaai chandi.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Ka Rubin zuliya daa yiɣisi zaŋ bɛ tuuta doli tab’ gbilligbilli pa bɛ zuɣu. Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Ka Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya zuɣulana;

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: ka Diuɛl bia Ɛliasaf nyɛ Gaad zuliya zuɣulana.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba daa kpuɣi neen’ shɛŋa din be kasi la ʒi n-gbaai chandi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa ti sa pɔi ka bɛ naanyi paai ni.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Ka Ifriim zuliya daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta yiɣisi doli tab’ gbilligbilli paya. Ammihud bia Ɛlishama n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: ka Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl daa nyɛ Manaasa zuliya zuɣulana;

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: ka Gidiɔni bia Abidan daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya zuɣulana.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Di saha ka Dan zuliya bɛn daa be nyaaŋa ka nyɛ niriba maa zaa guliba la daa yiɣisi paya. Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: ka Okiran bia Pagiɛl daa nyɛ Asha zuliya zuɣulana;

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: ka Inan bia Ahira mi nyɛ Naftali zuliya zuɣulana.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ daa yi yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ ka doli tab’ gbilligbilli chani shɛm m-bala.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Ka Musa daa yɛl’ o paɣ’ tizɔdoo Hɔbab ŋun daa nyɛ o deemba Riuɛl Midian nir’ bia la, “Ti yiɣisiri kunila luɣ’ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa yɛl’ ti, ‘N ni zaŋ li tin ya la ni’. Dol’ ti, ka ti ti niŋ a zaɣ’ viɛlli; dama Yawɛ pun lo Izraɛlnim’ zaɣ’ viɛlli niŋbu alikauli.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka o yɛl’ o, “N ku chaŋ; n ni labi n dɔɣiriba sani ni n tiŋgbɔŋ ni.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Ka o daa yɛli, “N suhir’ a, di chɛ ti, dama nyini m-mi ti ni yɛn dooni luɣ’ shɛli mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, leemi ti sowuhira.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Ka din pahi nyɛla a yi dol’ ti chaŋ, Yawɛ yi ti niŋ ti zaɣ’ viɛl’ shɛlikam, lala ka ti gba ni niŋ a.” Izraɛlnim’ yiɣisiya chana

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Di saha ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Yawɛ zoli maa gbini n-lu soli chaŋ daba ata chandi; ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la n-daŋ tooni chaŋ daba ata chandi ni di ti bo dooshee ti ba.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Saha shɛlikam bɛ daa yi ti kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa chana, Musa yɛrimi, “Yawɛ, yiɣisim’ chɛ ka a dimnim’ wurim, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn je a ŋmalig’ a tooni guui.”

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa yi ti suui li zali, o yɛrimi, “Yawɛ labimi Izraɛlnim’ tuhituhi zuɣa ŋɔ sanna.”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Ka niriba maa daa ti ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Yawɛ bɛ yɛlimuɣisira zuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa wum li, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka buɣim taai bɛ sani n-di bɛ suɣa maa gulinyaansi luɣ’ shɛŋa.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Amaa ka niriba maa daa kuhi niŋ Musa; ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ka buɣim maa kpi.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Tabɛra, Yawɛ buɣim ni daa di bɛ sani maa zuɣu. Musa pii zuɣulaannim’ pisopɔin

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Ninvuɣ’ yoya bɛn daa be bɛ ni daa kpiri kɔre pam; ka Izraɛlnim’ gba daa lan kum ka yɛli, “Ti bi zaɣisi ka ti di nya nimdi ŋubi.

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Ti teei ti ni daa yi ŋubiri zahim shɛli yoli Ijipti la mini kukombanim’ ni watamilo ni gabo ni alibarisa ni tafarinom la yɛla;

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: amaa pumpɔŋɔ ti gbarigimi, ka binshɛli kani n-naɣ’ pahila manna shɛli ti ni kul lihiri ŋɔ.”

english_verse: and tasted like something baked with sweet olive oil. It appeared at night with the dew. In the morning the people would collect the manna, grind or crush it into flour, then boil it and make it into thin wafers.
