translation_verse: Amaa dimdi yi be so min’ o kpee sunsuuni, ka o do’ n-gu o nti chaŋ ti lir’ o ku dilana ka zo n-kuli fɔntinsi ŋɔ tin’ yin’ ni,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: dindina ŋun ku nir’ maa ya kpamba bɛn’ timmi tiŋ’ maa ni ti zaŋ o na ti ti ŋun yɛn bɔh’ o biɛri, ka bɛ ku o.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zo o nambɔɣu. Amaa yihimiya ninvuɣ’ so ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani. Kurimbuni tiŋgban’ tarisi

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin’ ti miriya ka yi vuɣi yi kpee tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha niriba ni daa kpa shɛli, ka di be bɛ ni yɛn piri tiŋgban’ shɛŋa tin ya la ni. Zaŋ chaŋ shɛhira dibu polo

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Ninvuɣ’ yino shɛhira dibu bi saɣi ni bɛ wuhi ni nir’ mali taali bee galimi zaŋ chaŋ taali shɛlikam tumbu polo naɣila niriba ayi bee niriba ata shɛhira dibu ka yi ni doli n-wuhi ni nir’ mali taali.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Shɛhira dira ŋun nyɛ nia biɛɣulana yi kana ti wuhi ni so tum tuumbiɛɣu,

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti lo tɔb’ chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka nya bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam gari yi tɔbbihi, yin’ di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la be yi sani.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti yɛn kpe tɔb’ maa tuhibu ni, yin’ chɛliya ka maligumaaniba kana ti zani tooni n-tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, “Izraɛlnima wummiya, yi vu m-miri ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnim’ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi ni sɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Dama yi mini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi yi dimnim’ maa, ka o chɛ ka yi di nasara.”

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin’ kpamba mi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, “So beni m-me yili palli ka na bi suhi Naawuni ka kpe di ni? O labimi kul’ o yili maa ni, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb’ maa ni ka so ti suhi Naawuni ka kpe o yili maa ni.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee ko o wain tihi puu ka na bi di di wala? Dilan’ labimi kul’ o yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb’ maa ni ka so di di nyaɣisim maa.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee bo paɣa ka bɛ na bi kulis’ o na? Dilan’ labimi kuli yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb’ maa ni ka so kpuɣ’ o paɣ’ maa.”

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Ka sapashin’ kpamba maa yi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa maa naai, sapashinnim’ bɛn’ leemi bɛn su tɔbbihi maa fukumsi.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Amaa di yi nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ’ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ tinsi tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin’ di ti chɛnya binvuhirigu kam;

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: kumiya bɛ zaa, Hitinim’ mini Amɔrinim’ ni Keenannim’ ni Pɛrizinim’ ni Hivinim’ ni Jɛbusinima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ ku wuhi ya ka yi tum bɛ ni tumdi tuun’ shɛŋa zaa tiri bɛ buɣa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ti tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti teei gili tin’ shɛli ni yi tuhi deei li ka di ti yuui, yin’ di ŋmahi di tiwala tihi bahi. Yi ni tooi di di wala, amaa miriya ka yi ti ŋmahi li luhi. Tihi din be puri ni maa nyɛla ninsalinima ka yi kana ti teei gil’ li?

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Yi ni tooi ŋma ti’ shɛŋa yi ni mi ka di bi wandi wala. Yi ni tooi ŋma li n-zaŋ li mali bindura tabili tiŋ’ maa gooni din ni chɛ ka yi tooi kpe di ni ti nyaŋ ba.

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: Yi yi nya ka ninsal’ kpi n-do mɔɣu ni ka yi bi mi ŋun ku o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ka yi su li maa ni,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: dindina yi kpamba mini sariakaritiba bɛn cham’ ti buɣisi o ni do luɣ’ shɛli maa zaŋ chaŋ fɔntin’ shɛŋa din miri nimaani wɔɣilim,

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: ka fɔntin’ shɛli din ti miri kpim’ maa ni do luɣ’ shɛli maa kpamba ni bo naɣisa’ so bɛ ni na ʒi n-zaŋ tum tuma bee n-zaŋ dapua pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu.

english_verse: They and some of the priests will take this cow to a nearby valley where there is a stream, but no crops. Once they reach the valley, the leaders will break the cow's neck. The priests must be there, because the Lord your God has chosen them to be his special servants at the place of worship. The Lord has chosen them to bless the people in his name and to be judges in all legal cases, whether property or injury is involved.
translation_verse: Di saha ka maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Lɛvi bidibisi la ni kana, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii ba ni bɛ tumd’ o tuma, ka zaŋdi ŋun’ Yawɛ yuli suhiri alibarika niŋdi niriba ni, ka bɛ ni yɛli shɛm n-nyɛ din ŋmaari naŋgbankpeeni mini tab’ liribu yɛtɔɣa zaa.

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: ka yɛli, “Ti nuhi ka doo ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ni bee n-di di shɛhira.

english_verse: But since an innocent person was murdered, we beg you, our Lord, to accept this sacrifice and forgive Israel. We are your people, and you rescued us. Please don't hold this crime against us.” If you obey the Lord and do these things, he will forgive Israel. Marrying a Woman Taken Prisoner in War Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ n-yihi ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali yi sunsuuni. Dama di simdi ni yi niŋ din tuhi Yawɛ sani. Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni tuhi tɔbu gbahi paɣ’ shɛb’ polo

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi gbahi ba daba,

english_verse: One of these prisoners may be a beautiful woman, and you may want to marry her. But first you must bring her into your home, and have her shave her head, cut her nails, get rid of her foreign clothes, and start wearing Israelite clothes. She will mourn a month for her father and mother, then you can marry her.
translation_verse: ka yeeg’ o dabitim binyɛrigu, ka o niŋ a yiŋa goli muni n-kum o banim’ min’ o manim’ kuli. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa a ni tooi zaŋ o niŋ a paɣa, ka a leeg’ o yidana ka o mi leeg’ a paɣa.

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Amaa a nini yi ti bi tiɣ’ o, nyin’ bahim’ o ka o chaŋ, ka di zaŋ o kɔhi. Di bi simdi ni a niŋ o kaman dabili la, a ni zaŋ o dɔni m-baŋ o daashil’ la zuɣu. Zaŋ chaŋ bikpɛm’ sani fali polo

english_verse: Suppose a man has two wives and loves one more than the other. The first son of either wife is the man's first-born son, even if the boy's mother is the wife the man doesn't love. Later, when the man is near death and is dividing up his property, he must give a double share to his first-born son, simply because he was the first to be born. A Son Who Rebels Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Amaa di simdi ni o baŋ ni o bidib’ tuuli nyɛla o ni bi yur’ paɣ’ so la bidibiga maa, ka pirig’ o ni su shɛli maa ʒiibuyi zuɣu ti o, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ o kpiɔŋ saha bia, ka bituuli tarili nyɛla o dini. Zaŋ chaŋ bi’ so ŋun zaɣis’ o ba noli polo

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: Ka do’ so yi mali bidibiga ŋun nyɛ tipawumlilana ŋun bi deer’ o ba min’ o ma noli, ka bɛ yi darig’ o tibili o ni bi deeri bɛ yɛligu zuɣu,

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: dindina o ba min’ o ma maa bɛn’ gbaam’ o n-zaŋ o tahi bɛ ya kpamba sani nti zaŋ o zali tiŋ’ maa dunɔdali ni,

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: ka yɛli tiŋ’ maa kpamba maa, “Ti bia ŋɔ nyɛla tipawumlilana ni nɔzaɣisira; o bi deeri ti noli; o nyɛla pulaandana ni danyura.”

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di saha tiŋ’ maa dɔbba zaa bɛn’ labim’ o kuɣa ku o. Lala ka yi ni niŋ n-yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim’ zaa wum di yɛla ka dabiɛm gbahi ba. Zaligu shɛŋa din pahi

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: So yi tum taali din simdi ni bɛ ku o, ka bɛ zaŋ o yili tia ku o,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: yin’ di chɛ ka o gbe tia maa zuɣu, amaa yin’ sɔɣimiy’ o dindali maa, dama bɛ ni yili ninvuɣ’ so mia nyɛla Naawuni noli ni di so, di bi simdi ni yi ta Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa daɣiri.

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ka a nya a mabia nahu bee o piɛɣu ni chaŋ yirigi ka a baɣa ka o ni; di simdi ka a taɣ’ o labisi ti ti o lana.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Ka o lan’ maa yi be katiŋa bee a yi bi mi o lana, dindina nyin’ taɣim’ o kul’ a yiŋa, ka o ti be a sani hal ka o lan’ maa ti bɔh’ o yɛla, ka a zaŋ o ti o.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋ lala, di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee situra lala. A ʒiʒiinikpee binshɛɣukam yi bɔrigi, ka a nya li, di simdi ni a niŋ lala, di bi simdi ka a zaɣis’ o sɔŋbu.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys that carry heavy loads can stumble and fall, and be unable to get up by themselves. So as you walk along the road, help anyone who is trying to get an ox or donkey back on its feet. Don't Pretend To Be the Opposite Sex Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ka a nya a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋa bee o nahu ni lu n-do sol’ ni ka a baɣa kani, di simdi ni a sɔŋ yiɣis’ o zali.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Paɣ’ bi simdi ni o ye doo situra, ka doo gba bi simdi ka o ye paɣ’ situra, dama ŋunkam niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima, di nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yi yi me yil’ palli, yin’ niŋm’ bini kɔɣili yi mɔpilli ti tuui, di yi pa lala so yi yi di zuɣu luna kpi o ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi yili maa zuɣu.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti biri bimbir’ shɛli gari yi wain tihi puu ni, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi ni biri binshɛli maa mini wain tihi maa wala zaa.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu mini buŋa n-tabili taba ni bɛ ko.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti ye bɛ ni zaŋ piɛkɔbiri mini gali piɛlli gari tab’ wuɣi situr’ shɛŋa.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Niŋmiya bin’ zusanim’ niŋ yi ni yɛri situr’ shɛŋa naŋgbambiya anahi. Zaligu zaŋ chaŋ paɣ’ mini doo tab’ laɣimbu kasitali polo

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣisaribila n-zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa, di nyaaŋa ka o lan je o,

english_verse: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, “I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.”
translation_verse: ka ŋma ʒiri ni o saɣim’ o yuli yɛra, “N daa kpuɣila paɣ’ ŋɔ, amaa ka m min’ o ti dɔni, ka m bi nya o paɣipalitali shihira.”

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: Di saha paɣisarili maa ba min’ o ma bɛn’ zaŋmi paɣ’ maa paɣipalitali shihira na ti wuhi tiŋ’ maa kpamba dunɔdali gbini.

english_verse: Her father will say, “I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her
translation_verse: Ka paɣ’ maa ba maa yɛli kpamba maa, “N daa zaŋla m bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti doo ŋɔ ka o niŋ o paɣa, amaa ka o ti bi lan bɔr’ o,

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: ka ŋma ʒiri pa o pumpɔŋɔ yɛra, ‘N daa bi nya paɣipalitali shihirili yi bia maa sani.’ Amaa n-nyɛ m bipuɣiŋga maa paɣipalitali shihira.” Di saha ka bɛ zaŋ tani yɛrigi sɔŋ tiŋ’ maa kpamba maa tooni.

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Ka tiŋ’ maa kpamba maa zaŋ doo maa ti darig’ o tibili,

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: Amaa o ni yɛli shɛm maa yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka shɛhira shɛli kani din wuhiri ni paɣisarili maa daa nyɛla ŋun pali,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: dindina bɛn’ yihim’ paɣisarili maa na ti zal’ o ba yiŋ’ dunɔdali gbini, ka tiŋ’ maa ni dɔbba lab’ o kuɣa ku o, dama o tum vi tuuni din nyɛ pagɔrisigu gɔbu o ba yiŋa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi gbaai do’ so ka o zaŋ o kpee paɣ’ doya, yin’ kumiya bɛ niriba ayi maa; doo maa min’ o ni zaŋ paɣ’ so doya maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: If a man is caught in town having sex with an engaged woman who isn't screaming for help, they both must be put to death. The man is guilty of having sex with a married woman. And the woman is guilty because she didn't call for help, even though she was inside a town and people were nearby. Take them both to the town gate and stone them to death. You must get rid of the evil they brought into your community.
translation_verse: yin’ zaŋmiya bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa yi n-ti zali tiŋ’ maa dunɔdali gbini n-labi ba kuɣa ku ba. Yi ni ku paɣisarili maa, dama o daa bi kuhi ni bɛ zo o kuŋa tiŋ’ puuni maa, ka ku doo maa mi, dama o saɣim o kpee paɣa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: Amaa doo yi chirigi paɣ’ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti doo mɔɣu ni n-gbaag’ o goli, dindina do’ so ŋun gol’ o maa kɔŋko ka bɛ ni ku.

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi niŋ paɣisarili maa shɛli. Paɣisarili maa bi tum tuun’ shɛli din simdi kubu; dama yɛlli ŋɔ ŋmanila doo ni yi chaŋ ti lir’ o kpee n-ku o la.

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: Dama mɔɣu ni ka o daa nya o, ka bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ’ so ti doo maa daa naan tooi kuhi ni bɛ sɔŋ o, amaa so daa kani ŋun ni fa o bahi.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: Doo yi chirigi bɛ ni bi zaŋ paɣisaribil’ so ti doo n-zaŋ o dɔni ka bɛ gbahi ba,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: Doo miri ka o kpuɣ’ o ba paɣa n-filim’ o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o nya o ba zaɣim.

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ŋmahim do’ so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai do’ so yoli, o bi simdi ni bɛ deeg’ o niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Pagɔr’ bia bi simdi ni o be Yawɛ niriba ni, hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, di bi simdi ni bɛ chɛ ka o bia kpe Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Di bi simdi ni bɛ deei Ammɔn nira bee Mɔab nira niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, soli kani ni bɛ deei bɛ zuliya niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni,

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini kom na ti tuhi ya soli saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la zuɣu mini bɛ ni daa lan da Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛɔr ŋun yi Pɛtɔr din be Mɛsopoteemia na bia la ni o ti yɛli noli tin ya la zuɣu.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti bɔri bɛ biɛrisuŋ bee m-bɔri bɛ tɔŋbu saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be yi nyɛvili ni.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi siŋ Ɛdomnim’ ni so, dama bɛ nyɛla yi mabihi, miriya ka yi siŋ Ijiptinima, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba m-be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Zaŋ hal ni ʒiɛmani din pahiri buta ni, yi ni tooi deei bɛ ni dɔɣi bi’ shɛba niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni. Tɔbbihi sansani kasi biɛhigu

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Yi yi ti chaŋ ti dɔni ni yi tuhi yi dimnima, yin’ gbaamiya yimaŋa ni zaɣ’ biɛɣu kam zaa.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Ka do’ so yi ti zahim zahindi yuŋ’ mahig’ omaŋa, dindina ŋun yim’ sansani maa ni, ka di lan kpe sansani maa ni na.

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: Amaa zaawuni yi ti paai, ŋun’ sum’ kom, ka wuntaŋ’ yi ti lu, o ni tooi lan labi sansani maa ni na.

english_verse: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.
translation_verse: Di simdi ka yi mali luɣ’ shɛli yi sansani maa kpaŋa n-chani nimaani ti damdiri yɔɣuni.

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni yi bo kulagaa niŋ yi nɛma ni, ka yi yi ti yi kpaŋa ni yi ti damdi yɔɣuni, ka yi zaŋ li gbi bɔɣili pi yi bindi maa.

english_verse: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave. Runaway Slaves from Other Countries Moses said:
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani yi sansani maa ni chana ni o tiligi ya, ka zaŋ yi dimnim’ niŋ yi nuu ni. Dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi sansani maa ni be kasi din ni chɛ ka o ku nya binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani ka zo ka chɛn ya. Zaligu’ shɛŋa din pahi

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: Daba bɛn yi n-zo bɛ laamba sani n-ka yi sanna, yin’ di lan zaŋ ba labisi ti bɛ laamba maa.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: Bɛ ni be yi sani yi sunsuuni tin’ shɛli bɛ ni pii yi tinsi maa ni ka di nyɛ din viɛl’ bɛ sani. Miriya ka yi ti muɣisi ba.

english_verse: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him. Interest on Loans Moses said:
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ pagɔr’ liɣiri bee bɛ tuma liɣiri ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu na ti yo yi ni po pɔri shɛli samli, dama bina ayi ŋɔ zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Di yi nyɛla tinzun nira, yi ni tooi paŋ o binshɛli ka niŋ o nyɔri, amaa yi Izraɛl kpee ŋuna, miriya ka yi paŋ o binshɛli ka niŋ o nyɔri din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuuni kam ni yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti deei li su maa ni.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: Yi yi po pɔri ni yi niŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, yin’ di pihigi di palibu, dama biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɔhi di niŋbu yɛla yi sani ka di chɛ ka yi ku tum taali.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Amaa yi yi bi po pɔri, yi ku kpe taali ni.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Yi noli yi kuli yaa yɛli shɛli, yin’ palimiya li viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni kul yaai yi noli po pɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani shɛm maa.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee wain tihi puu ni chana, a ni tooi pɔhi di wala maa a suhu ni bɔri shɛm tariga di, amaa miri ka a pɔhi shɛli niŋ a nɛma ni.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee chi ni chana, a ni tooi zaŋ a nuu ŋmɛm kazuɣuri maa ŋubi, amaa miri ka a zaŋ sua ŋ-ŋmah’ a kpee chi.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: Di yi niŋ ka doo kpuɣi paɣa, amaa ka o nini ti bi lan tiɣ’ o, ka di nyɛla binshɛli ka o nya ka di bi viɛl’ o sani, ka dinzuɣu chɛ ka o sabi paɣ’ yihibu gbaŋ ti o, ka yih’ o o yiŋa ka o chaŋ

english_verse: Later she married another man,
translation_verse: ti kuli do’ so,

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: dindina o yidaan’ kuro ŋun daa tuui yih’ o la ka soli ni o lan kpuɣ’ o niŋ’ o paɣa o saɣimbu maa nyaaŋa, dama lala maa chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka di bi simdi ni yi bo taali niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi su maa ni. Zaligu shɛŋa din pahi

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Doo yi na yoli niŋ amiliya, di bi simdi ni yi chɛ ka o doli tɔbbihi chaŋ tɔb’ ni bee n-chɛ ka o tum tuma lala tatabo, amaa di simdi ni bɛ chɛ o ka o be yiŋ’ yuun’ yini, ka o min’ o ni kpuɣi paɣ’ so maa laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that they will pay back the loan. But don't take one or both of their millstones, or else they may starve. They need these stones for grinding grain into flour to make bread. Kidnapping Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Doo yi yɛn zaŋ binshɛli paŋ o kpee, ŋun di deeg’ o nɛli bee o nɛkaŋ’ sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi paŋ o li, dama o yi niŋ lala, nyɛvili ka o deei sɔŋ talima pabu ni maa.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: So yi sɔɣi gbaai o Izraɛl kpee n-zaŋ o leei dabili bee n-zaŋ o kɔhi, dindina ŋun gbaag’ o maa simdi kubu, ka lala chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ’ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: Gumiya yimaŋ’ viɛnyɛliŋga ka chɛ niŋgbuŋ dɔr’ biɛɣu, ka di ku lu yi zuɣu. Doliya Lɛvi maligumaaniba la ni wuhiri ya shɛlikam la viɛnyɛliŋga kaman n ni zali ba shɛm.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Miriam shɛm saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti m-be soli chanila yɛla.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: A yi yɛn deei nir’ binshɛli sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi paŋ’ o binshɛlikam, nyin’ di dol’ o kpe o yiŋ’ puuni ti deei’ li.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: Nyin’ ʒe samban’ ni, ka a ni yɛn paŋ so bini maa zaŋ a ni yɛn deei binshɛli ti sɔŋ maa yina ti ti a.

english_verse: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.
translation_verse: Ka dilan’ yi nyɛla faralana, nyin’ di chɛ ka o chinchin’ shɛli a ni deei sɔŋ maa gbe a sani.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Wuntaŋ’ yi ti lura, nyin’ zaŋmi li labisi ti ti o, ka o zaŋ o chinchini maa pili gbihi ka paɣ’ a, ka di ti a laara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ sani.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: Miri ka a vili tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba mini faranim’ yɔri gbibi. Bɛ yi nyɛla a Izraɛl taba bee bɛ yi nyɛla saamba bɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi tinsi maa tin’ shɛl’ ni,

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: di simdi ni a yo ba bɛ dabisili kam tuma yɔri, ka wuntaŋ’ naanyi lu, ; di yi pa lala bɛ ni fabili niŋ Yawɛ, ka a kpe taali ni.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di bi tu ni bɛ ku bihi laamba bɛ bihi zuɣu bee n-ku bihi bɛ laamba zuɣu; kulila sokam maŋmaŋ’ tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka bɛ ni ku o.

english_verse: Make sure that orphans and foreigners are treated fairly. And if you lend money to a widow and want to keep something of hers to guarantee that she will pay you back, don't take any of her clothes.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi mɔŋ sana bee kpibiga o yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ka miriya ka yi deei pakoli chinchini sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ binshɛli paŋ o.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa tiligi ya nimaani; dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋmi dimbɔŋɔ maa.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Yi yi chɛ yi chi ka tam kabɔbili sɔŋ yi puuni, yin’ di lan labiya ti zaŋ li; di ni leela sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli dini, ka lala chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti wɔbi yi olivi tiwala, yin’ di lan labi ti yihi din kpalim; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi pɔhi yi wain tihi wala, di nyaaŋa yin’ di lan chaŋ ti yihi di zaɣ’ yaha; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋdi dimbɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: di yi simdi ni bɛ bu ŋun mali taali maa, dindina sariakarita maa ŋun’ chɛ ka bɛ gbaag’ o sɔŋ n fiɛb’ o o ninni, ka o fiɛbbu kalinli yɛn dolila o taali ni nyɛ shɛm.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bɛ ni tooi fiɛb’ o bupihinahi, amaa di bi simdi ni di gari lala. Bɛ yi fiɛb’ o gari lala dindina yi ʒiʒiinikpee maa ni nya filiŋ yi ninni.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: A yi chɛ ka nahu buri a chi, nyin’ miri ka a zaŋ bini pɔb’ o noli. A ni yɛn tum tuun’ shɛli ti a mabia ŋun kpi

english_verse: Suppose two brothers are living on the same property, when one of them dies without having a son to carry on his name. If this happens, his widow must not marry anyone outside the family. Instead, she must marry her late husband's brother, and their first son will be the legal son of the dead man.
translation_verse: Ka paɣa maa yi ti tuui dɔɣi bidibiga, bɛn’ zaŋm’ o mabi’ so ŋun kpi maa yuli boli bia maa din ni chɛ ka o yuli maa ku kpihim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Amaa doo maa yi bi bɔri ni o kpuɣ’ o mabia pakoli maa, dindina o mabia maa pakoli maa ŋun’ cham’ dunɔdali shee kpamba sani nti yɛli ba, ‘N yidan’ mabia maa zaɣisiya ni o ku chɛ ka o mabia maa yuli na be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ni o ku tum n yidan’ mabia tuma n sani.

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Di saha doo maa ya kpamba maa ni boli doo maa na ti tɔɣis’ o yɛtɔɣa, ka o yi na kul vili ʒiɛla lala ka yɛli, ‘N je ni n kpuɣ’ o,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: dindina o mabia maa paɣa maa ŋun’ cham’ o sani kpamba maa ninni nti pirigi doo maa namdili o napɔŋ ni, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o ninni ka yɛli, ‘Lala ka bɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ’ so ŋun je ni o me o mabia yili.’

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, bɛ ni ti mi o niriba la, ‘Bɛ ni pirigi so namdili yiŋnima.’ Zaligu shɛŋa

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: Dɔbba yi zabira, ka do’ yino paɣa kana ni o ti fa o yidana ŋun bur’ o maa nuu ni bahi, ka zaŋ o nuu gbaag’ o tooni,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: dindina yin’ ŋmaam’ paɣa maa nuu, di zɔny’ o nambɔɣu.

english_verse: Don't try to cheat people by having two sets of weights or measures, one to get more when you are buying, and the other to give less when you are selling.
translation_verse: Miriya ka yi mali kuruwa balibu buyi din nyɛ zaɣ’ karili mini zaɣ’ bila yi yinsi puuni.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Kul zahimmiya binyɛra sania zuɣu ka di paara ni yɛlimaŋli, ka zaŋmiya kuruwa maŋli zahindi yi binyɛra ka di paana din ni chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Dama bɛnkam zaa tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim’ mini bɛnkam zaa bi gbibi yɛlimaŋli nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bi bɔri shɛba. Zaligu din wuhi ni bɛ kum Amalɛknima

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: Teemiya Amalɛknim’ ni daa niŋ ya shɛm yi ni daa yi Ijipti na m-be soli chanila yɛla.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Saha shɛli di ni daa wum ya ka gbarigi ya, ka bɛ liri ya n-ku yi ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaa daa be nyaaŋa la. Bɛ daa bi zo Naawuni.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi tin ya vuhim yi dimnim’ bɛn gili ya ŋɔ sani tiŋgbɔn shɛli ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya ni yi su li maa ni, yin’ kpihimmiya Amalɛknim’ maa birili dunia ŋɔ ni, Miriya ka yi ti tam.

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: yin’ ti piimiya yi ni yɛn tuui kpuɣi puu atam shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni zaa niŋ piɛri puuni n-zaŋ li chaŋ ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ’ shɛli ni o yuli be nimaani la.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Ka yi ti chaŋ maligumaana ŋun tumdi tuma di saha maa sani ti yɛl’ o, “Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n wuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni m paai ŋun’ Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannim’ ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti la ni.”

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Maligumaana maa yi ti deei piɛɣu maa yi nuu ni n-zaŋ li zali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbini gbini,

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: yin’ yɛlimiya: ‘Ti yab’ daa nyɛla Aram nira ŋun chani ginda, ka o daa ti chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti n-nyɛ sana, bɛ kalinli daa bi yaɣi lala. Nimaani ka o zuliya daa ti nabi n-galisi ka mali yaa pam.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Ka Ijiptinim’ maa daa ti niŋdi ti putɔɣu, ka muɣisiri ti n-chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun’ kpɛma.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Ka ti daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim’ Naawuni ŋɔ, ka Yawɛ daa wum ti kuhigu maa, ka nya ti wahala mini ti tuun’ kpɛma tumbu ni ti muɣisigu maa.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: n-zaŋ ti tahi kpe na nti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋla nyin’ Yawɛ ni ti ma tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni atam din daŋ niŋbu na ti ti a.’ “Ka a zaŋ li zali tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka kurim tiŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Di saha a mini Lɛvinim’ ni saan’ shɛb’ bɛn be yi sani zaa ni puhi chuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a min’ a yiŋnim’ binshɛŋa zaa o nirilim puuni maa zuɣu.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: “Ka yi yi ti yo yi puri atam pirigibu bupia kam zuɣu yim naai yuuni din pahir’ ata, ka nyɛ yuun’ shɛli puuni yi ni yɔri pirigibu bupia kam zuɣu yim tiri Lɛvinim’ mini saamba ni kpibisi ni pakoya ni bɛ gba di n-tiɣi yi tinsi ni la,

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: di saha ka yi ni ti yɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ‘Ti yihi a tarili din nyɛ kasi maa ti yinsi, ka zaŋ li ti Lɛvinim’ mini saamba bɛn be ti sani ni kpibisi ni pakoya kaman a zaligu shɛŋa zaa a ni zali ti la ni wuhi shɛm. Ti bi birigi a zaligu shɛli bee n-tam di yɛla.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Saha shɛli n ni daa kumdila, n daa bi di li; saha shɛli n ni daa be daɣiri ni la, n daa bi pii di shɛli. Ka m mi daa bi zaŋ li mali kpiimba. Ti deei nyin’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ noli. Ti tum a ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛm zaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Be a biɛhigu shee din be kasi alizanda ni ka lihi tiŋ’ na n-niŋ alibarika niŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim’ min’ a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ŋɔ ni kaman a ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannima ni di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam la.’ Naawuni maŋmaŋ’ niriba

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: “Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ya ni yi doli zaligunim’ ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, dinzuɣu doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi deei Yawɛ daalikauli ni o nyɛ yi Naawuni ka yi ni dol’ o soli ka gbib’ o fukumsi zaligunim’ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka deeg’ o noli.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ mi deei yi daalikauli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi nyɛla omaŋmaŋ’ niriba kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni di simdi ni yi dol’ o zaligunim’ la

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: din ni chɛ ka o duhi ya, ka yi nyari paɣibu mini yudua ni jilima n-gari o ni nam zuliya shɛb’ zaa, ka chɛ ka yi ti niŋ zuliya kasi ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa mini Izraɛl kpamba daa yɛli niriba maa zaa. “Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa tin ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.

english_verse: Soon you will enter the land that the Lord your God is giving to you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped, and he has promised that this land is rich with milk and honey. After you cross the Jordan River, go to Mount Ebal. Set up large slabs of stone, then cover them with white plaster and write on them a copy of these laws.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu yi yi ti baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili maa, yin’ zaŋmiya n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni be kuɣu shɛŋa ni ŋɔ ti sa Ɛbal zoli zuɣu, ka niŋ tari ta li,

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: ka mɛnya kuɣa sara maligu bimbini nimaani n-ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; di ti yɛn nyɛla kuɣa sara maligu bimbini, ka pa yi ni zaŋ kurugu bini shihi kuɣ’ shɛŋa.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋla kuɣ’ shɛŋa bɛ ni bi kpe m-me sara maligu bimbini maa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di li nimaani, ka mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ka Musa mini Lɛvinim’ bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim’ zaa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, “Izraɛlnima, chɛliya vuri ka wum, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi leei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba.

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Musa daa lan zali niriba maa zaligu dindali maa yɛli:

english_verse: After you cross the Jordan River, you will go to Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal. The tribes of Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Benjamin will go up on Mount Gerizim, where they will bless the people of Israel. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali will go up on Mount Ebal where they will agree to the curses.
translation_verse: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim’ mi n-ni ti zani Ɛbal zoli zuɣu n-yɛli noli dibu yɛtɔɣa maa. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni Asha zuliya niriba ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba ni Dan zuliya niriba ni Naftali zuliya niriba.

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Alibarika ni ti be yi tinsi ni mini yi puri ni.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Alibarika ni ti be yi bihi ni. Alibarika ni ti be yi puri atam ni, alibarika ni ti be yi biŋkɔbiri bihi ni. Yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi ni ti nabi.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: Alibarika ni ti be yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔriti ŋmana ni.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi kambɔna mini yi tuma zaa ni; o ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni ŋun’ Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Yi yi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligunima, ka dol’ o soli, ŋun’ Yawɛ ni zaŋ ya leeg’ o niriba bɛn be kasi kaman o ni daa po pɔri yɛli ya shɛm la.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Dunianim’ zaa ni ti nya ka bɛ zaŋla Yawɛ yuli booni ya, ka bɛ ti zɔri ya.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi tɔŋ pam yi bihi dɔɣibu ni mini yi biŋkɔbiri dɔɣibu ni ni yi puri atam ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ŋun’ Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim’ sani ni o ni zaŋ tin ya la ni.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti yoog’ o daazichi duu din nyɛ zuɣusaa ŋɔ tin ya saa yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni saa mibu saha, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni; ka yi ti dihi zuliya pam samli, amaa yinim’ ti ku di so samli.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya leei zuɣu, ka pa ni zuli, ka chɛ ka yi kul chani tooni ka ku lab’ nyaaŋa, yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm viɛnyɛliŋga,

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Yi niŋgbuna ni ti leei noombil’ kam mini dunia ŋɔ ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu, ka so ti ku beni ŋun ni kari ba.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Di ni ti nyɛla shihirili ni alahiziba yɛlli yi mini yi zuliya sani sahakam.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: Amaa yi yi ku deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli bee n-doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zaligunim’ ŋɔ min’ o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, dindina noli dibu ŋɔ zaa ni lu yi zuɣu din ya.

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: Noli ni ti di yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔritiŋmana.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Noli ni ti di yi bihi mini yi puu atam ni yi niɣi bɛn yɛligi ni yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo mini suhusaɣiŋgu ni birimbu lu yi zuɣu yi ni bɔri ni yi niŋ shɛlikam puuni hal ka yi ti kpi yomyom naai zaa yi tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, dama yi zaɣisi ma.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni sakom leei taŋkpa’ zim ka duɣiduɣi kɔŋko yiri sagbana ni luri yi zuɣu na hal ti kun ya.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi dimnim’ nyaŋ ya. Yi ni ti doli so’ yini chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi ba, amaa ka ni ti ŋmaligi bɛ sani n-zo n-doli soya ayopɔin. Yi ni ti leei dunia nanim’ zaa ni je shɛba.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bimmɔrima mini yuma ni nyinvɔɣu ni saŋkpana la lu yi zuɣu, ka yi ku kpaŋ.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yinyari mini zoontali ni suhufuŋbo be yi suhuri ni;

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: ka yi ti bɔbindi gindi wuntaŋ’ ni kaman zoma ni bɔbindi gindi zibisim ni shɛm la, amaa ka ku nya soli ka bɛ naɣ’ ti kul filindi ya mi, ka fari yi nɛma waawaayili, ka so ku beni ŋun ni sɔŋ ya.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ paɣa n-tin ya, amaa ka do’ so zaŋ o dɔni, yi ni ti me yi yili ka bi kpe di ni. Yi ni ti sa yi wain tihi, ka ku di di wala.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ti ku yi nahu sɔŋ yi ninni, amaa ka yi ku ŋub’ o nimdi, ka bɛ ti fa yi buŋa yi ninni chaŋ, ka ku lan zaŋ o labisina ti tin ya. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi piɛri ti yi dimnima, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ya.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti ninvuɣ’ shɛba yi ninni, ka yi yuli ba soli ka yi nina ti fulim dindali maa zaa, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tooi niŋ shɛli.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni bi mi ninvuɣ’ shɛba ni ti di yi puri ni bindira ni yi tuma zaa daanfaani. Yi ti kul ni bela turi mini nahiŋgu ni sahakam,

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: ka yi nina ni ti yɛn nya shɛli ni ti kpɛhi ya yinyari.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ yi mini yi ni pii yi na’ so ka o sun ya maa n-tahi yi mini yi yaannim’ ni daa bi mi zuliya shɛb’ sani, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Ka yi ti leei bɛ ni je ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ mini bɛ ni turi ninvuɣ’ shɛba ni bɛ ni maani ninvuɣ’ shɛba ansarisi Yawɛ ni yɛn zaŋ ya tahi zuliya shɛb’ zaa sani maa.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Yi ni ti zaŋ bimbira pam chaŋ yi puri ni, amaa ka ti kpuɣila atam biɛla, dama toli ni ti ŋub’ di zaa.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Yi ni ti sa wain tihi ka mali di ni, amaa yi ti ku pɔhi di wala bee n-nyu di wain, dama zunzuya ni ti ŋubi di zaa.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Yi ni ti mali olivi tihi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, amaa yi ti ku ʒe di kpam, dama di wala zaa ni ti wɔbi lu.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Yi tihi mini yi puri atam zaa ni ti leei toli bindirigu.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Saamba bɛn be yi sani biɛhigu ni ti du pam gari ya, amaa ka yinim’ biɛhigu ti labi nyaaŋa pam.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ti zaŋdi binyɛra paŋdi ya, amaa yinim’ ti ku zaŋ shɛli paŋ ba. Bɛna nti yɛn nyɛ zuɣu, ka yi nyɛ zuli.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Noli ŋɔ zaa ni ti doli ya n-din ya hal ti kun ya, yi ni zaɣisi ni yi ku doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa min’ o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: Yi ni daa bi jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni suhupiɛlli yi ni mali binshɛɣukam pam la zuɣu.

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi dimnim’ kana ka yi ti jɛmdi ba, ka kum mini kɔnyuri mali ya, ka gbinfini gba mali ya, ka yi kɔŋ binshɛlikam. O ni ti zaŋ naɣikɔra dapua din nyɛ kurugu pa yi nyiŋgoya zuɣu hal ti kun ya.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka zuliya shɛli niriba yi katiŋa dunia ŋɔ tariga n-kabina ti lu yi zuɣu kaman tɔrili la, bɛ ni ti nyɛla yi ni bi wumdi zuliya shɛb’ yɛtɔɣa.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ti nyɛla zuliya shɛb’ bɛn mali ninkuunsi ka ku tiri ninkura jilima bee n-niŋ bipola nirilim.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Bɛ ni ti kana ti teei gili yi fɔntinsi zaa hal ka yi goon’ wɔɣila shɛŋa din gili ya, ka yi niŋ li naani ŋɔ ti lu yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa. Bɛ ni ti teei gili ya yi fɔntinsi zaa ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: Yi ni ti ŋubirila yimaŋmaŋ’ bidɔɣirisi, yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣin’ shɛb’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tin ya la nimdi yi dimnim’ maa ni ti yɛn teei gili ya n-niŋdi ya alaka shɛli maa zuɣu.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: O ti ku zaŋ o ni ŋubiri o bi’ shɛb’ maa nim’ shɛli ti bɛ ni so, dama o ti ku lan mali binshɛli yaha yi dimnim’ maa ni teei gili ya, ka niŋdi ya alaka shɛli yi fɔntinsi zaa ni maa zuɣu.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: O ni ti ŋub’ o ni dɔɣi biliɛ’ shɛba n-tabili bɛ zoya: dama o ni ti sɔɣimi ŋub’ ba, yi dimnim’ ni ti yɛn teei gili ya ka niŋdi ya alaka shɛli yi fɔntinsi ni la zuɣu.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: Ka yi yi bi doli zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa din sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni ŋɔ n-luri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli din mali jilima mini dabiɛm ŋɔ sizuura,

english_verse: he will punish you and your descendants with incurable diseases,
translation_verse: dindina Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dɔr’ biɛri ni alahiziba dɔriti din ku naai lu yi mini yi bihi zuɣu.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni lan chɛ ka dɔro balibu kam mini alaka balibu kam din yɛla bi sabi zaligu kundi ŋɔ ni lu yi zuɣu hal ti naai yi balibu.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Ka yi ni daa galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ la, yi kalinli ni ti kpalimla biɛla yi ni bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nol’ la zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Di ni daa niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o bɔri ni yi nabi ka tɔŋ la, lala ka di ni lan niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o chɛ ka yi lu m-bahi yoli zaa, ka bɛ ti yihi ya yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti deei li su maa ni.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya kam ni dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa nimaani, yi mini yi yaannim’ ni daa pun bi mi buɣ’ shɛŋa.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Di yi ti nyɛ asiba, yi ni yɛli, ‘Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla zaawuni.’ Ka zaawuni yi ti paai, yi ni yɛli, ‘Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla asiba.’ Dabiɛm din ti yɛn be yi suhuri ni mini yi nina ni ti yɛn nya binshɛŋa zuɣu.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya niŋ ŋarima ni n-labisi Ijipti; n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni yi nini ku lan nya luɣ’ shɛl’ la. Ka yi ti zaŋ yimaŋ’ ni yi kɔhi yi dimnim’ maa zuɣu nimaani n-leei bɛ dabidɔbba mini bɛ dabipaɣiba, amaa ka ŋun ni dan ya ku beni.

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ alikauli yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa lo Izraɛlnim’ alikauli Mɔabnim’ tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-pah’ o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli Sinai Zoli gbin’ la m-bɔŋɔ.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Yi ni daa paai kpe na, Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi daa kana ti liri ti n-tuhi ti, amaa ka ti daa nyaŋ ba.

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: Ti daa fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ n-zaŋ li ti Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu doliya alikauli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi di nasara yi tuuni kam ni.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Yi daa lan nya bɛ binyoya din nyɛ buɣa din mali daɣiri ka nyɛ dari mini kuɣa ni anzinfa ni salima din daa be bɛ san’ la.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Di pa shɛli ka yi ni doo bee paɣa bee yili shɛli niriba bee zuliya muni niriba be yi ni ka bɛ suhuri yi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu ni, ka ŋmaligi ni bɛ jɛm zuliyanim’ maa buɣa maa. Di pa shɛli ka ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ ti be yi ni ka barina mini putɔɣu ba nyaɣa bɛ ni.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Ka bɛnkam wum pɔri ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka tɛhi ni bɛ mali alibarika ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, “Ti tiligiya, hal ti ni kul doli ti tipawumli soya ŋɔ zaa yoli,” ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ashaara lu ninvuɣ’ biɛri mini ninvuɣ’ suma zuɣu.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni ti woligi ba bɛ ko Izraɛl zuliyanim’ zaa ni n-chɛ ka zaɣ’ biɛɣu paai ba kaman noli yɛlibu zaa din be alikauli puuni, ka sabi be zaligu kundi ŋɔ puuni la.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: Ka ʒiɛman’ shɛli din dolina puuni, yi bihi yi ti yiɣisina yi kalinsi nyaaŋa bee saan’ so yi ti yi tinshee katiŋ’ na n-nya Yawɛ ni chɛ ka zaɣ’ biɛ’ shɛli mini nahiŋgu shɛli paai tiŋgbani maa,

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: ka tiŋgbani maa zaa leei chilibi mini yalim, ka binshɛli ku biri nimaani ka binshɛli mi ku bili nimaani, luɣ’ shɛli mɔri ni ku bili. Di ni ti saɣim kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni Adima mini Zɛbɔiim, Yawɛ ni daa saɣim shɛli o suhuyiɣisili puuni la.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ mini zuliya kam ni ti bɔhi, ‘Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ lee niŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ? Bɔ n-daa lee chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam lala?’

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Di saha niriba ni ti yɛli, ‘Bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim’ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli saha shɛl’ o ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la zuɣu.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: Bɛ daa ŋmaligi dolila buɣa n-jɛmdi li. Di nyɛla buɣ’ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa pun bi mi ni o ni daa bi zaŋ buɣ’ shɛŋa ti ba.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o yihi ba bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni suhuyiɣisili tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛl’ ni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: Binshɛŋa din be ashilɔni nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ dini, amaa binshɛŋa din yi zahira nyɛla ti mini ti bihi dini sahakam ni di chɛ ka ti doli yɛtɔɣ’ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: N ni zaŋ alibarika shɛli mini noli yɛlibu shɛli zali yi tooni ŋɔ yi ti niŋdi ya, ka yi teeri di yɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn kari ya tahi zuliya shɛba zaa ni ŋɔ sani,

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: ka yi ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani ka yi mini yi bihi ti deeg’ o noli ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa kaman n ni zaani ya shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Hal bɛ yi kari ya tahi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni laɣim ya nimaani n-zaŋ ya nimaani labisina.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ ya ti ʒili yi yaannim’ ni daa su tiŋgbɔn shɛli la ni, ka yi ti su li, ka o chɛ ka yi tɔŋ, ka yi kalinli galisi gari yi yaannim’ maa kalinli.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni taɣi yi mini yi bihi suhuri din ni chɛ ka yi yuri ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa, ka lala ti chɛ ka yi be.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti chɛ ka noli yɛlibu yɛla ŋɔ zaa di yi dimnim’ bɛn daa nahim ya la.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti chɛ ka yi tɔŋ yi tuma zaa ni, ka yi bihi nabi, ka yi biŋkɔbiri nabi, ka yi puri atam gba nabi. Dama Yawɛ ni lan chɛ ka o zaɣa be yi ni, ka yi tɔŋ kaman o zaɣa ni daa be yi yaannim’ ni ka bɛ tɔŋ shɛm la.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yinim’ dee yi ti deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol’ o fukumsi zaligunim’ mini zaligu shɛŋa din sab’ zaligu kundi ŋɔ puuni ŋɔ, ka ŋmaligi labi ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: Yɛlimaŋli, n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ pala din kpɛm’ pam yi sani bee din be katiŋ’ ha.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Di pala din be zuɣusaa ka yi ni yɛli, ‘Ŋuni n-lee ni du zuɣusaa nti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol’ li?’

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Di mi pala din be teeku duli ka yi ni yɛli, ‘Ŋuni n-lee ni du teeku duli ti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol’ li?’

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Aai, yɛligu maa kul bela yi sani, di bela yi noya ni mini yi suhuri ni ni yi dol’ li.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: Nyamiya, n zaŋla nyɛvili mini tɔŋsim ni kum mini ashaara n-zali yi tooni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: M bɔri ni zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani din ya shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni n zaŋla nyɛvili mini kum ni alibarika mini noli dibu zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu piimiya nyɛvili, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi mini yi zuliya be.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Yi yi yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol’ o noli, ka zaŋ yimaŋ’ tabil’ o, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri n-zaŋ ti yi yaannim’ bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni.

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Musa ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli Izraɛlnim’ zaa naai saha shɛli ka o daa yɛli ba,

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Maliya kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni pam, di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri bɛ zuɣu, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni be yi sani; o ku chɛ ka yi kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛn ya bahi.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa daa boli Jɔshua na ti yɛl’ o Izraɛlnim’ zaa ninni, “Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, dama nyini n-yɛn zaŋ niriba ŋɔ chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri bɛ yaannim’ sani ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni nti chɛ ka bɛ dee’ li su.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn be a tooni, o ni be a sani, o ku chɛ ka a kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛ a bahi. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. Di simdi ni yi karindi zaligu maa yuma ayopɔin kam puuni

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ ti Lɛvi bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka nyɛ bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka la mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa.

english_verse: Moses told these priests and leaders: Each year the Israelites must come together to celebrate the Festival of Shelters at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. You must read these laws and teachings to the people at the festival every seventh year, the year when loans do not need to be repaid.
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ zaa yi ti laɣim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni luɣ’ shɛl’ o ni pii ni bɛ jɛmd’ o la, yin’ karimmi zaligu ŋɔ ka Izraɛlnim’ zaa wum.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Ka bɛ bihi bɛn na bi mi li ni wum li, ka bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn gbaai Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili du nti deei li su la ni.” Naawuni wuhi Musa wuhibu din bahindi nyaaŋa

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Nyama, a kum dabisa miriya, bolimi Jɔshua ka yi ka man’ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni na ka n ti zaŋ tuma maa ti o.” Ka Musa mini Jɔshua daa chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
