translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa ka bɛ sanna sagban’ wɔɣinli puuni. Sagban’ wɔɣinli maa daa zanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol’ ni.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, “Di ku lan yuui ka a dɔni pah’ a yaannim’ zuɣu, di nyaaŋa niriba ŋɔ ni ti saɣim bɛmaŋa n-jɛmdi tinzun buɣa din be bɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni chani tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni buɣa. Bɛ ni ti zaɣisi ma ka saɣim n ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛl’ la.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu dindali maa, ka n ti chɛ ba bahi, ka ŋmaligi n nini labi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, ka bɛ leei bɛn gbahibu ku to. Yɛlibiɛri pam ni ti paai ba. Dindali maa bɛ ni ti bɔhi, “Pa ti Naawuni maa ni lan ka ti sani zuɣu n-chɛ ka yɛlibiɛri ŋɔ paai ti maa?”

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Dindali maa n shiri ni ti ŋmaligi n nini lab’ kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, bɛ ni tum zaɣ’ biɛ’ shɛŋa zaa din nyɛ bɛ ni jɛmdi wuna la zuɣu.

english_verse: Moses and Joshua, I am going to give you the words to a new song. Write them down and teach the song to the Israelites. If they learn it, they will know what I want them to do, and so they will have no excuse for not obeying me.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, sabimi yilli ŋɔ n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnima, zaŋm’ li niŋ bɛ noya ni din ni chɛ ka yilli ŋɔ leei shɛhira n sani n-jɛndi Izraɛlnima.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Dama n yi ti zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam maa ni, n ni daa po pɔri bɛ yaannim’ sani ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni, ka bɛ ti di n-tiɣi ŋmɛlim, bɛ ni yuli ʒiɛm ma, ka saɣim m-mini ba daalikauli maa, ka chaŋ ti jɛm wuna.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Ka yɛlibiɛri pam yi ti paai ba, yilli ŋɔ nyɛla din ni be bɛ sani n-nyɛ shɛhira, dama di kul ti yɛn bela bɛ bihi noya ni ka bɛ yiini li, dama m pun mi bɛ ni lo ni bɛ niŋ shɛm pɔi ka n naanyi zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa po pɔri lo ba alikauli ni n ni zaŋ ti ba maa ni.

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa daa sabi yilli ŋɔ dindali maa n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnim’ maa.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ Nan bia Jɔshua zali ka yɛl’ o, “Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, dama nyini n-yɛn zaŋ Izraɛlnim’ ŋɔ tahi n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni, n ni be a sani.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Musa ni daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa niŋ kundi ni naai zaa,

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Musa daa zalila Lɛvinim’ bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la zaligu yɛli,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Zaŋmiya zaligu kundi ŋɔ ti sɔŋ baɣili Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka la, ka di be nimaani nyɛ shɛhira jɛndi ya.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Dama m mi yi tipawumli mini yi noli zaɣisibu yɛla. Yi yi pun nyɛla bɛn zaɣisiri Yawɛ noli saha shɛli n ni na be n nyɛvili ni m-be yi sani ŋɔ, wula nti yɛn nyɛ li n kum nyaaŋa?

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Laɣimmiya yi zuliya ni kpamba mini yi sapashin’ kpamba zaa n sanna, ka n ti yɛli ba yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka bɛ wum, ka n chɛ ka zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani di shɛhira jɛndi ba.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Dama biɛhiŋ kani, m mi ni n kum nyaaŋa, yi ni tum tuumbiɛri, ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ n ni zali ya ni yi doli so’ shɛli ŋɔ, di nyaaŋa zaɣ’ biɛɣu ni ti lu yi zuɣu, dama yi ni ti tum zaɣ’ biɛɣu Yawɛ ninni, ka chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam yi nuhi tuma zuɣu.” Musa yilli

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ yilli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli hal ti paai di tariga, ka Izraɛl laɣiŋgu maa zaa wum li.

english_verse: Earth and Sky, listen to what I say!

translation_verse: Teemiya kurimbuni ha yɛla. Tɛhimiya yuun’ gbaliŋ din gari la yɛla. Bɔhimiya yi ba, o ni wuhi ya, ka bɔhi yi dɔɣirikpamba, bɛ ni yɛli ya.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: O daa zaŋ o zali tiŋgbani luɣ’ shɛŋa din du zuɣu; ka daa zaŋ puri ni bindira dihir’ o. O daa zaŋ tampima voya ni shiri mini chɛribo kuɣa voya ni kpam dih’ o.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.

translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa nya lala ka o suhu yiɣisi, ka o tabig’ o bidibisi min’ o bipuɣinsi bahi.

translation_verse: Biɛri bɔhibu mini sanyoo nyɛla n dini, saha shɛli bɛ napɔna yi ti sarigi; dama bɛ zaɣ’ biɛɣu nyabu dabisili saha miriya, ka bɛ bahi yoli saha kanna yomyom.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ ni tilig’ o niriba, ka zo o daba nambɔɣu, o yi ti nya ka bɛ lan ka yiko, ka bɛ ni lo so bee bɛ ni bi lo so ti ku lan kpalim.

translation_verse: Bɛn daa ŋubi bɛ sara maligu biŋkɔbiri kpam ka nyu bɛ sara maligu wain la lee be ya? Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi zani sɔŋ ya, chɛ ka bɛ guli ya.

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *

translation_verse: O daa yɛli Asha zuliya mi: “Asha bidibisi mali alibarika pam. Chɛ ka bɛ mabihi zaa yuri ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ naba siɣi kpam ni.

translation_verse: Ŋuna n-filim kurimbuni ha wuna la, ka o nuhi din ka bahigu ŋɔ gbibi ya. O ni kari yi dimnim’ bɛn be yi tooni la bahi ka yɛli, “Kumiya ba.”

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim’ daa beni ka barina shɛli kani. Yaakubu zuliya kɔŋko n-daa be tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bindira mini wain; ni luɣ’ shɛli maligim ni yiri zuɣusaa luri tiŋ’ na.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Yinim’ Izraɛlnima, yi mali suhupiɛlli. Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani ya, yinim’ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ Yawɛ ni daa tiligi ŋɔ! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi nyɔtaɣirigu n-sɔŋ ya, ka nyɛ yi takɔbi din tin ya nasara! Yi dimnim’ ni ti kani yi sanna ka bɛ ni sɔhira; ka yi ti wurim bɛ buɣa jɛmbu shee zaa.

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yi Mɔab bɔpiɛligu maa ni n-du Nɛbo Zoli nti paai Pisiga Zo’ shɛli din be Jɛriko tooni polo la zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa wuh’ o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa, zaŋ Giliad hal ni Dan.

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Naftali tiŋgbani zaa mini Ifriim tiŋgbani ni Manaasa tiŋgbani ni Juda tiŋgbani zaa zaŋ hal ni wulinluhili polo teeku noli,

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: zaŋ Nɛgɛb mini bɔpiɛligu din nyɛ Jɛriko vinvamli, ka nyɛ tin’ shɛli din mali dɔbino tihi la hal ni Zɔa.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl’ o, “Tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ka n daa po pɔri yɛli Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu, ‘N zaŋ li ti yi Zuliya.’ N chɛ ka a nini nya li, amaa a ku paai nimaani.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Musa ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ dabili maa daa kpi nimaani Mɔabnim’ tiŋgbɔŋ ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali shɛm maa.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ’ o Mɔabnim’ tiŋgbɔŋ maa vinvamli din be Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la. Amaa so bi mi bɛ ni daa sɔɣ’ o luɣ’ shɛli maa hal ni zuŋɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ daa kum Musa kuli Mɔabnim’ bɔpiɛligu maa ni hal ni biɛɣu pihita, di nyaaŋa ka Musa kuli maa kumbu daa naai.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Ka yɛm shia daa pali Nan bia Jɔshua, dama Musa daa zaŋla o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu, dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim’ maa daa deeg’ o noli, ka niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Anab’ so daa bi lan yiɣisi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋ-ŋmani Musa, ka Yawɛ min’ o nini daa nya taba.

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: Ka so daa bi tooi wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tuma kaman Yawɛ ni daa tim o ka o ti tum tuun’ shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-jɛndi Firawuna min’ o kpambaliba ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim’ zaa la

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: ni o ni daa chɛ ka Musa tum tuun’ kar’ shɛŋa zaa ni o ni daa wuhi yiko din mali dabiɛm Izraɛlnim’ zaa ninni shɛm la.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yawɛ dabili Musa kum nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Nan bia Jɔshua, ŋun daa nyɛ Musa sɔŋda la,

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: “N dabili Musa kpiya, dinzuɣu a mini niriba ŋɔ zaa yiɣisim’ pumpɔŋɔ n-chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yinim’ Izraɛlnim’ ŋɔ ni.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: Yi tintarisi ti yɛn nyɛla nudirigu polo tiŋgban’ nɛli tiŋgbɔŋ la zaŋ hal ti paai Lɛbanɔn nuzaa polo zoya la shee mini Yufretiiz Mɔɣ’ titali din be wulimpuhili polo la noli zaŋ tabili Hitinim’ tiŋgbɔŋ la zaa m-mali hal ti paai wulinluhili polo Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku tital’ la noli.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Ka so ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo a hal ni a nyɛvili tariga. N ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la. N ku chɛ ka a ti bɔri ma ka bi nya ma, m mi ku chɛ a.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Chɛ ka zaligu litaafi ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa kul be a nol’ ni sahakam, kul bɔhimmi li wuntaŋ’ ni ni yuŋ din ni chɛ ka a tooi doli din sab’ di ni maa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka di chɛ ka a tɔŋ a sol’ ni, ka lan chɛ ka a di nasara viɛnyɛliŋga.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Mani n-zal’ a ni a kul mali yaa mini suhukpeeni pam. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, dama man’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ kul be a sani luɣ’ shɛlikam a ni chana.” Jɔshua wuh’ o niriba bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛl kpamba,

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Yiɣisimiya chaŋ gili yɛli niriba maa ni bɛ bom’ bindira m-mali shili gu, dama ni di kpalim daba ata ni bɛ gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ tin ya la ni.”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la,

english_verse: The Lord's servant Moses said that the Lord our God has given you land here on the east side of the Jordan River, where you could live in peace. Your wives and children and your animals can stay here in the land Moses gave you. But all of you that can serve in our army must pick up your weapons and lead the men of the other tribes across the Jordan River. They are your relatives, so you must help them
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu yi paɣiba mini yi bihi ni yi biŋkɔbiri ni kpalim be tiŋgbɔn shɛl’ ni Musa ni daa zaŋ tin ya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili yaɣili ŋɔ na. Amaa ka yi ni tɔbbihi bɛn lo kpara zaa pahi yi mabihi maa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti sɔŋ ba

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: hal ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka bɛ gba deei ŋun’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa, ka yi naanyi labi Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ŋɔ n-tin ya ŋɔ ni na ti ʒini.”

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, “Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛl’ ti shɛlikam maa zaa, ka ni chaŋ a ni kul yɛl’ ti ni ti cham’ luɣ’ shɛlikam.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Ka ŋunkam zaɣis’ a zaligu dolibu bee n-zaɣis’ a yɛligu wumbu, a ni zali ni o niŋ shɛlikam ni, bɛn’ kum’ o. Kul malila yaa mini suhukpeeni pam.”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Nan bia Jɔshua daa tim tuumba ayi ashilɔni n-yɛli ba, “Chamiya ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni be shɛm, di bamdi Jɛriko.” Ka bɛ daa yi Akasia chaŋ ti kpe pagɔr’ so ŋun yuli daa booni Reehab la yiŋa.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɛriko naa, “Nyama, Izraɛlnim’ shɛb’ ka kpe na yuŋ ŋɔ ni bɛ ti puɣisi nya ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni be shɛm.”

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Tuumba ayi maa ni daa ti yɛn dɔni gbihi saha shɛli, ka Reehab du bɛ sani dufahirili maa zuɣusaa

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: nti yɛli ba, “M mi ni Yawɛ zaŋ ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka dabiɛm pun gbahi ti pam yi zuɣu; ka bɛnkam zaa be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni suhuri fuŋmi.

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Dama ti pun wum yi ni daa yi Ijipti na, ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom pirigi buyi m-mali soli tin ya la yɛla; ka lan wum yi ni daa niŋ Amɔri nanim’ ayi bɛn yuya booni Sihɔn mini Ogi la gba shɛm ku ba Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo la yɛla.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Ti ni daa kul wum li; ti suhuri zaa daa dii fuŋmi, ka suhukpeeni lan ka ti ni so suhu ni yi zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani Naawuni.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu n ni niŋya nirilim shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, pomiya ni yi gba ni ti niŋ m mini m ba yiŋnim’ nirilim lala, ka wuhi ma di shihirili

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: ni yi ni ti tiligi m ba mini m ma ni m mabihi ni bɛ ni su shɛb’ zaa, ka fa ti nyɛviya kum ni bahi.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Reehab, “Ti yɛn zaŋla ti nyɛviya n-taɣ’ a dini. A yi bi zaŋ ti ni lo ni ti niŋ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla yɛli so, ka Yawɛ ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, ti ni niŋ a nirilim.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Reehab daa zaŋ mii tir’ o yiŋ’ maa takɔro ni n-chɛ ka tuumba maa dol’ li yi tiŋ’ maa ni, dama o yiŋ’ maa daa me n-tabilila tiŋ’ maa gooni.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, “Kpamiya zoya ŋɔ polo, ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ku chirigi ya; kul sɔɣimiya be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ti labina pɔi ka yi naanyi yiɣisi kuli.”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, “Chɛliya ka yi ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ lala.” Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ ni daa chaŋ maa nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ mi’ ʒee maa lo n-tabil’ o takɔro maa.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua tuumba maa daa kpa zoya maa polo nti be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn daa biɛhi bɛ naba la ti lab’ kuli; dama bɛ daa vihimi m-bo ba sol’ ni zaa ka bi nya ba.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɔshua tuumba ayi maa daa yi zoya maa polo labina chaŋ ti du mɔɣili n-labi Nan bia Jɔshua sani n-daa ti yɛl’ o dinkam zaa niŋ ba.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Bɛ daa lan yɛli Jɔshua, “Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti. Ka din pahi nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim’ zaa suhuri fuŋmi ti zuɣu.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim’ zaa daa ti yiɣisi asibaasi n-yi Akasia chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti dɔn’ nimaani ni bɛ gbaai li du.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Di daba ata dali ka Izraɛl kpambaliba daa yiɣisi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni chani gindi

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ yi ni yɛn doli so’ shɛli, dama yi na ʒi n-doli soli maa. Amaa lee miriya ka yi miri Alikauli Adaka maa. Doliya di nyaaŋa m-be li larigim kaman kilomita yini laasabu.”

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnim’ maa, “Malimiya yimaŋa, dama biɛɣuni Yawɛ sa ni tum alahiziba tuma yi sani.”

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli maligumaaniba, “Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana.” Ka bɛ daa kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, “N ni duh’ a Izraɛlnim’ zaa ninni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ; ka bɛ baŋ ni n ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Yɛlim’ maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni bɛ yi ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, bɛn’ kpalimmi zani di kom maa ni baalim.”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, “Kamiya kpe na nti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm.”

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa lan yɛli, “Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka yi ni baŋ ni Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ be yi sani, ka ni kari Keenannim’ mini Hitinim’ ni Hivinim’ ni Pɛrizinim’ ni Gɛrigashinim’ ni Amɔrinim’ ni Jɛbusinima.

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ dunia zaa Duuma Daalikauli Adaka maa naba yi ti kul shihi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kom, di kom maa ni chɛ zɔbu, ka di kom din zɔri yiri mɔɣili maa zuɣusaa polo n-sirigirina la mi fo n-zani n-tiɣisi dɔni luɣ’ yini.”

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni n-zaŋ bɛ naba siɣi di kom ni saha shɛli, ,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Niriba maa ni daa duri maa, maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la daa kul kpalim ʒiɛla mɔɣili maa sunsuuni tiŋkuŋ zuɣu hal ka niriba maa zaa ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa naai.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ zaa ni daa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-naai saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua,

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: n-yɛli ba, ‘Siɣimiya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni ti pii kuɣa pinaayi maligumaaniba la ni ʒe luɣ’ shɛl’ la n-ʒi li ti sɔŋ yi ni ti yɛn gbe luɣ’ shɛli yuŋ ŋɔ.’ ”

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: nti yɛli ba, “Chamiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Daalikauli Adaka maa gbini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ sunsuuni, ka yi zaa yinoyino ti pii kuɣ’ yiniyini m-pa yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu, ka di kalinli saɣisi yi Izraɛlnim’ zuliya pinaayi ŋɔ kalinli,

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: Di saha yin’ ti yɛlimiya ba ni bɛ daa ʒila Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka di kom pirigi buyi dɔni. Dinzuɣu kuɣa ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ kul teeri yɛlli ŋɔ yɛla sahakam.”

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ daa shiri niŋ Jɔshua ni wuhi shɛm maa, ka daa pii kuɣa pinaayi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni, ka di saɣisi Izraɛlnim’ zuliya kalinli kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɔshua shɛm. Ka bɛ daa ʒi kuɣa maa mali chaŋ bɛ ni daa yɛn gbe luɣ’ shɛli nti zaŋ li sɔŋ nimaani.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa lan chɛ ka bɛ pii kuɣ’ pinaayi n-sɔŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni luɣ’ shɛli maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa ʒiɛya la. Ka kuɣa maa na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.

english_verse: “Joshua,” the Lord said, “tell the priests to come up from the Jordan and bring the chest with them.” So Joshua went over to the priests and told them what the Lord had said. And as soon as the priests carried the chest past the highest place that the floodwaters of the Jordan had reached, the river flooded its banks again. That's how the Lord showed the Israelites that Joshua was their leader. For the rest of Joshua's life, they respected him as they had respected Moses.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa yi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni na. Maligumaaniba maa naba ni daa kul mali ti tam taŋkpa’ kuŋ zuɣu saha shɛli ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kom maa gba daa dii piligi n-lan zɔri chani kaman di ni daa pun chani shɛm n-lan kpe m-pali yaha.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pia dali ka Izraɛlnim’ daa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli n-chaŋ ti dɔni Giligal din daa be Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo la.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa pii kuɣ’ pinaayi shɛŋa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni la na n-sɔŋ Giligal maa.

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, “Yi bihi yi ti bɔhi bɛ banim’ dahin’ shɛli ha, ‘Ka kuɣ’ bɔnima n-lee bɔŋɔ?’

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kom vuui ka chɛ soli tin ya hal ka yi ti gbaai li du. Di daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom vuui ka chɛ soli ti ti hal ka ti ti gbaai li du shɛm la.

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ ni ninsalinim’ zaa baŋ Yawɛ yiko ni galisi shɛm. Ka di chɛ ka yi lu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura sahakam.”

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Ka Amɔri nanim’ zaa bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo mini Keenan nanim’ zaa bɛn ʒi m-baɣi teeku daa wum ni Yawɛ chɛ ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kom vuui ka chɛ soli ti Izraɛlnima ka bɛ gbaai li du. Ka bɛ suhuri daa fuŋ, ka bɛ ni so lan ka suhukpeeni Izraɛlnim’ maa zuɣu. Jɔshua guni Izraɛlnima

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, “Zaŋm’ chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnima, ka di niŋ din pahi napɔŋ buyi.”

english_verse: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa shiri zaŋ chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnim’ luɣ’ shɛli bɛ ni booni Gibiatihaaralɔt la.

english_verse: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa guni ba naai, Izraɛlnim’ zaa daa kpalim dola luɣ’ yini hal ka bɛn guni maa yuma ti naai zaa.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, “Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n yihi Ijipti vi shɛli yi ni diri la ka chɛn ya.” Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Giligal, ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Saha shɛli Izraɛlnim’ ni daa do Giligal bɔpiɛligu ni Jɛriko maa, ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di goli maa biɛɣ’ pinaanahi dali zaawuni.

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindira maa neei biɛɣu, ka manna la daa chɛ lubu na. Ka Izraɛlnim’ daa bi lan nya li di yaha, amaa ka daa kpalim dirila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindira di yuuni maa ni. Jɔshua mini do’ so ŋun gbibi takɔbi

english_verse: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, “Are you on our side or on our enemies' side?”
translation_verse: Jɔshua ni daa be luɣ’ shɛli din miri Jɛriko maa, ka o daa ti kpuɣ’ o zuɣu n-lihi nya do’ so ka o ŋooi takɔbi gbib’ o nuu ni ʒe o tooni. Ka Jɔshua daa chaŋ o sani ti bɔh’ o, “A lee bela ti polo bee a bela ti dimnim’ polo?”

english_verse: “Neither,” he answered. “I am here because I am the commander of the Lord's army.” Joshua fell to his knees and bowed down to the ground. “I am your servant,” he said. “Tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Ka o garigi yɛl’ o, “Aai, n nyɛla Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin’ kpɛma, dina n-chɛ ka n kana maa.” Ka Jɔshua daa lu n-gbani zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu o sizuura ka bɔh’ o, “N dana, ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni man’ ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ niŋ?”

english_verse: “Take off your sandals,” the commander answered. “This is a holy place.” So Joshua took off his sandals.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin’ kpɛm’ maa daa yɛl’ o, “Pirigim’ a namda ŋɔ, dama a ni ʒe luɣ’ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ’ kasi shee.” Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ lala.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Jericho had been locking the gates in their town wall because they were afraid of the Israelites. No one could go out or come in.
translation_verse: Jɛrikɔnim’ daa kparila Jɛriko goondaa dunoya Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu; ka so ku tooi gari yi bee n-gari kpe di ni.

english_verse: The Lord said to Joshua: With my help, you and your army will defeat the king of Jericho and his army, and you will capture the town. Here is how to do it: March slowly around Jericho once a day for six days.
translation_verse: A mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa cham’ gilimi Jɛriko goondaa maa napɔŋ yim dahin yini kam n-niŋ lala hal ti paai daba ayɔbu.

english_verse: Take along the sacred chest and tell seven priests to walk in front of it, carrying trumpets. But on the seventh day, march slowly around the town seven times while the priests blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Chɛ ka maligumaaniba ayopɔin gbib’ piɛla’ yila kikah’ ayopɔin m-be Alikauli Adaka la tooni. Ka dabisi’ shɛli din ti pahir’ ayopɔin dali, nyin’ chɛ ka maligumaaniba maa zaŋ kikahi m-piɛbira, ka yi chaŋ gili Jɛriko maa napɔŋ buyopɔin.

english_verse: Then the priests will blast on their trumpets, and everyone else will shout. The wall will fall down, and your soldiers can go straight in from every side.
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ piɛbiri piɛla’ yila kikahi maa ka di kumdi yuui, yinim’ bɛn nyɛ tɔbbihi maa zaa yin’ duhimi yi yee n-kul tahiri pampam, di saha tiŋ’ maa goondaa maa ni kab’ lu, ka yi zaa kab’ ti kpe di ni.”

english_verse: Joshua called the priests together and said, “Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.”
translation_verse: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua maa daa boli maligumaaniba na nti yɛli ba, “Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka la, ka chɛ ka maligumaaniba ayopɔin gbibi piɛla’ yila kikah’ ayopɔin be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni.”

english_verse: They obeyed Joshua's orders and carried the chest once around the town before returning to camp for the night.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa n-chaŋ gili tiŋ’ maa napɔŋ yim, ka zaŋ li lab’ bɛ sansani maa ni ti gbe.

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.
translation_verse: Ka dabisi’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin dali biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka bɛ daŋ yibu ti chaŋ gili tiŋ’ maa kaman bɛ ni daa yi pun gindi li shɛm la napɔŋ buyopɔin. Kulla dindali maa kɔŋko ka bɛ daa gil’ li napɔŋ buyopɔin maa.

english_verse: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua yelled: Get ready to shout! The Lord will let you capture this town.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa gindi napɔŋ din pahir’ ayopɔin maa ka maligumaaniba piɛbiri kikahi saha shɛli, ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa, “Tahimiya! Dama Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋ’ maa niŋ yi nuu ni.

english_verse: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord. The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.
translation_verse: Tiŋ’ maa mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni leela yi ni yɛn saɣim shɛli ti Yawɛ. Kulla Reehab ŋun nyɛ pagɔrili la mini ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn be o yiŋ’ kɔŋko ka di simdi ni yi tiligi, o ni daa zaŋ ti tuumba la sɔɣi la zuɣu.

english_verse: The silver and gold and everything made of bronze and iron belong to the Lord and must be put in his treasury. Be careful to follow these instructions, because if you see something you want and take it, the Lord will destroy Israel. And it will be all your fault.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ anzinfa mini salima m-mali binshɛŋa ni daanya lahi ni kuriti binyara din’ nyɛla binshɛŋa din be kasi Yawɛ sani. Ti ni zaŋ dina nti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.”

english_verse: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa piɛbi kikahi; ka niriba maa tahira. Niriba maa ni daa kul wum kikahi maa kumsi; bɛ daa duhila bɛ yee tahiri pampam, ka tiŋ’ maa goondaa maa dii kabi ti lu tiŋa; ka niriba maa dii zɔri tuhi bɛ tooni dɛde n-kab’ kpe tiŋ’ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li.

english_verse: After Jericho was destroyed, Joshua warned the people, “Someday a man will rebuild Jericho, but the Lord will put a curse on him, and the man's oldest son will die when he starts to build the town wall. And by the time he finishes the wall and puts gates in it, all his children will be dead.”
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa po pɔri di saha maa ha yɛli, “Ŋunkam ti yiɣisi ni o lab’ me Jɛriko zali, Yawɛ ŋun’ yɛlim’ noli ti o ka di di o.” Ŋunkam ti zali di tanzaa, o bidib’ kpɛm’ ni kpi; Ŋunkam mi ti mali di duno’ yɔriti, o bidibiga ŋun nyɛ biasani ni kpi.

english_verse: The Lord helped Joshua in everything he did, and Joshua was famous everywhere in Canaan.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa be Jɔshua sani; ka o yuli daa du pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.

english_verse: The Lord had said that everything in Jericho belonged to him. But Achan from the Judah tribe took some of the things from Jericho for himself. And so the Lord was angry with the Israelites, because one of them had disobeyed him.
translation_verse: Amaa Izraɛlnim’ daa birigiya zaŋ chaŋ binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa woligi ti Yawɛ la polo, dama Karimi bia Ɛkan ŋun daa nyɛ Zabidi yaaŋa, ka nyɛ Zɛra yaantibichee, ka yi Juda zuliya ni na la ni daa kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa woligi ti Yawɛ maa; ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu.

english_verse: Joshua and the leaders of Israel tore their clothes and put dirt on their heads to show their sorrow. They lay facedown on the ground in front of the sacred chest until sunset.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl kpamba daa darigi chɛhi bɛ binyɛra, ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri n-doya ni suhugarigu hal ni zaawuni.

english_verse: Then Joshua said: Our Lord, did you bring us across the Jordan River just so the Amorites could destroy us? This wouldn't have happened if we had agreed to stay on the other side of the Jordan.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli; “Mbaye! Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, bɔzuɣu ka a daa zaŋ ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ na? A zaŋ ti mi na ni a ti ti Amɔrinim’ ka bɛ ku ti? Ti yi di daa chɛ ka ti nini tiɣi Jɔɔdɛn yaɣili wulimpuhili polo la ka kpalim nimaani di di so.

english_verse: I don't even know what to say to you, since Israel's army has turned and run from the enemy.
translation_verse: Yaa n Duuma, Izraɛlnim’ yi ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ka ti dimnim’ nya ti kpaya, wula ka n lee lan yɛn yɛli?

english_verse: Everyone will think you weren't strong enough to protect your people. Now the Canaanites and everyone else who lives in the land will surround us and wipe us out.
translation_verse: Dama Keenannim’ mini bɛnkam be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yi wum li, bɛ ni kana ti teei gil’ ti, ka kpihim ti birili dunia ŋɔ ni; ka di yi niŋ lala, wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ a yuli din galisi ŋɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord answered: Stop lying there on the ground! Get up!
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Jɔshua, “Bɔ n-niŋ ka a teei doya zaŋ a nina kpa tiŋa? Yiɣisima!

english_verse: I said everything in Jericho belonged to me and had to be destroyed. But the Israelites have kept some of the things for themselves. They stole from me and hid what they took. Then they lied about it.
translation_verse: Izraɛlnima n-tum alahichi; bɛ zaɣisila n ni zali ba zaligu shɛl’ la dolibu; ka kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa woligi ti Man’ Yawɛ la. Bɛ zu n-kpuɣ’ li pahi bɛ nɛma ni, ka ŋma ʒiri.

english_verse: What they stole was supposed to be destroyed, and now Israel itself must be destroyed. I cannot help you anymore until you do exactly what I have said. That's why Israel turns and runs from its enemies instead of standing up to them.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim’ bi tooi zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo bɛ dimnim’ maa. Din chɛ ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ bɛ dimnim’ maa nyɛla, bɛmaŋmaŋ’ ni leei bɛ ni yɛm bahi shɛb’ yol’ la zuɣu. Ka yi yi bi yihi binshɛli yi ni kpuɣi maa yi kɔbili ni n-saɣim li, n ku lan be yi sani.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel, “Tomorrow you will meet with the Lord your God, so make yourselves acceptable to worship him. The Lord says that you have taken things that should have been destroyed. You won't be able to stand up to your enemies until you get rid of those things.
translation_verse: Yiɣisima m-mali niriba maa ka bɛ be kasi. Yɛlim’ ba, Malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi gu biɛɣu ni. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim’ Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, ‘Izraɛlnima, yi kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni woligi ti man’ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ la ka di be yi sani. Ka yi mi ku tooi zaŋ yi nyɔri yo yi dimnima, ka pa ni yi yihila lala bina maa yi kɔbili ni.’

english_verse: “Tomorrow morning everyone must gather near the place of worship. You will come forward tribe by tribe, and the Lord will show which tribe is guilty. Next, the clans in that tribe must come forward, and the Lord will show which clan is guilty. The families in that clan must come, and the Lord will point out the guilty family. Finally, the men in that family must come,
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu biɛɣuni asiba, sa chɛ ka daŋ kam niriba yina ti zani tooni, ka Yawɛ ni ti yɛn pii dan’ shɛli niriba maa puuni sokam ni o malibu ni yirina ti zaana, ka Yawɛ ni ti yɛn yaai yili shɛlinim’ mi puuni doo kam ni yirina yinoyino ti zaani tooni.

english_verse: and the Lord will show who stole what should have been destroyed. That man must be put to death, his body burned, and his possessions thrown into the fire. He has done a terrible thing by breaking the sacred agreement that the Lord made with Israel.”
translation_verse: Ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋun kpuɣi binshɛŋa din nyɛ man’ Yawɛ dini maa, bɛ nyom’ o min’ o ni su binshɛɣukam zaa buɣim, o ni saɣim Yawɛ zaligu min’ o ni tum tuun’ shɛli n-dihi Izraɛlnim’ vi la zuɣu.”

english_verse: Joshua got up early the next morning and brought each tribe to the place of worship, where the Lord showed that the Judah tribe was guilty.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-zaŋ Izraɛlnim’ daŋ kam niriba na ti zaani tooni, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Juda zuliya.

english_verse: Then Joshua brought the clans of Judah to the Lord, and the Lord showed that the Zerah clan was guilty. One by one he brought the leader of each family in the Zerah clan to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Zabdi's family was guilty.
translation_verse: Ka o daa zaŋ Juda zuliya maa daŋ kam na ti zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zɛra daŋ; ka o daa zaŋ Zɛra daŋ maa ni sokam ni o malibu zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zabidi yiŋnima.

english_verse: Finally, Joshua brought each man in Zabdi's family to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Achan was the guilty one.
translation_verse: Ka o daa zaŋ o yiŋnim’ dɔbba yinoyino zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Karimi bia Ɛkan ŋun daa nyɛ Zabidi mini Zɛra yaaŋa ka yi Juda zuliya ni na la.

english_verse: “Achan,” Joshua said, “the Lord God of Israel has decided that you are guilty. So tell me what you did, and don't try to hide anything.”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Ɛkan, “M bia, paɣimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim’ Naawuni ŋɔ, ka ti o jilima, ka yɛli ma a ni tum tuun’ shɛli, ka di sɔɣi ma shɛli.”

english_verse: “It's true,” Achan answered. “I sinned and disobeyed the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Ɛkan daa yɛli Jɔshua, “Yɛlimaŋli, n tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim’ Naawuni ŋɔ sani; N ni tum alahichi shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ:

english_verse: They brought them back and put them in front of the sacred chest, so Joshua and the rest of the Israelites could see them.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa yihi li suɣili maa ni n-zaŋ li na ti ti Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim’ zaa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.

english_verse: Then everyone took Achan and the things he had stolen to Trouble Valley. They also took along his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys, and sheep, his tent, and everything else that belonged to him.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim’ zaa daa zaŋ Zɛra yaaŋa Ɛkan maa mini anzinfa ni binyɛrigu maa ni salin’ kpilli maa ni o bidibisi min’ o bipuɣinsi ni o niɣi ni o bunsi ni o piɛri ni o suɣili ni o ni su binshɛɣukam zaa n-chaŋ Akɔr Vinvamli ni.

english_verse: Joshua said, “Achan, you caused us a lot of trouble. Now the Lord is paying you back with the same kind of trouble.” The people of Israel then stoned to death Achan and his family. They made a fire and burned the bodies, together with what Achan had stolen, and all his possessions.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa bɔhi Ɛkan, “Bɔzuɣu ka a bo wahala ti ti? Yawɛ ni ti a wahala zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.” Ka Izraɛlnim’ zaa daa lab’ o kuɣa, ka lab’ o malibu gba kuɣa, ka niŋ buɣim nyo ba.

english_verse: They covered the remains with a big pile of rocks, which is still there. Then the Lord stopped being angry with Israel. That's how the place came to be called Trouble Valley.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa kahi kuɣa m-pa Akan zuɣu hal ti duhi li sɔŋ, ka di na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Akɔr Vinvamli hal ni zuŋɔ. Ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa naanyi maai.

english_verse: The rest of the army will come with me and attack near the gate. When the people of Ai come out to fight, we'll run away and let them chase us. They will think we are running from them just like the first time. But when we've let them chase us far enough away,
translation_verse: Bɛ ni yi bɛ tiŋ’ maa ni na n-kari dol’ ti hal ka ti ti zaŋ ba yi kpaŋ’ ha ka chɛ bɛ tiŋ’ maa; dama bɛ ni yɛli, ‘Bɛ yaai ŋmaligi guuri kaman bɛ ni daa pun niŋ shɛm la.’ Ka ti yi ti ŋmaligi guui ka bɛ kariti dol’ ti, di saha maa yin’ yiɣisimiya yi sɔɣibu maa shee

english_verse: you come out of hiding. The Lord our God will help you capture the town.
translation_verse: n-kpe bɛ tiŋ’ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li; dama yi Duuma NAAWUNI ni zaŋ li niŋ yi nuu ni.

english_verse: Then set it on fire, as the Lord has told us to do. Those are your orders,
translation_verse: Ka yi yi ŋme n-deei tiŋ’ maa, yin’ nyomiya li buɣim kaman Naawuni ni zali ya shɛm. N ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bala.”

english_verse: Early the next morning he got his troops ready to move out, and he and the other leaders of Israel led them to Ai.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-laɣim tɔbbihi pahi Izraɛlnim’ kpamba zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ Ai.

english_verse: They set up camp in full view of the town, across the valley to the north.
translation_verse: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be o sani chaŋ ti dɔni Ai nuzaa polo m-miri li, ka vinvamli do bɛ mini Ai sunsuuni.

english_verse: Now all his troops were in place. Part of the army was in the camp to the north of Ai, and the others were hiding to the west, ready to make a surprise attack. That night, Joshua went into the valley.
translation_verse: Lala ka bɛ daa piri tɔbbihi maa sɔŋ n-gu tɔbu maa. Bɛ daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam dola tiŋ’ maa nuzaa polo, ka chɛ ka bɛn kpalim mi do tiŋ’ maa wulinluhili polo. Amaa ka’ Jɔshua daa gbe vinvamli maa ni.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord told Joshua, “Point your sword at the town of Ai, because now I am going to help you defeat it!” As soon as Joshua pointed his sword at the town,
translation_verse: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, “Zaŋmi kpani din be a nuu ni ŋɔ tiri Ai; n ni zaŋ li niŋ a nuu ni.” Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ kpani din be o nuu ni maa tiri.

english_verse: the soldiers who had been hiding jumped up and ran into the town. They captured it and set it on fire.
translation_verse: O ni daa kul kpuɣ’ o nuu maa tiri saha shɛli maa, ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi bɛn daa sɔɣ’ doya la dii vaai yiɣisi bɛ dooshee ti kpe tiŋ’ maa ni n-deei li ka niŋ buɣim nyo li yomyom bahi.

english_verse: When Joshua and his troops saw smoke rising from the town, they knew that the other part of their army had captured it. So they turned and attacked. The men of Ai looked back and saw smoke rising from their town. But they could not escape, because the soldiers they had been chasing had suddenly turned and started fighting.
translation_verse: Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim’ zaa ni daa nya ka bɛ tɔbbi’ shɛb’ bɛn daa sɔɣ’ doya la deei tiŋ’ maa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligina n-lu Ainim’ maa zuɣu n-dii ŋmɛri kuri ba.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the other Israelite soldiers had come from the town and attacked the men of Ai from the rear. The Israelites captured the king of Ai and brought him to Joshua. They also chased the rest of the men of Ai into the desert and killed them. The Israelite army went back to Ai and killed everyone there.
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ ni daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku Ainim’ maa zaa naai bɛ ni daa kari ba ti zali mɔɣu ni luɣ’ shɛl’ la, bɛ zaa daa labila Ai tiŋ’ puuni nti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn be di ni zaa.

english_verse: Joshua made sure every building in Ai was burned to the ground. He told his men to kill the king of Ai and hang his body on a tree. Then at sunset he told the Israelites to take down the body, throw it in the gateway of the town, and cover it with a big pile of rocks. Those rocks are still there, and the town itself has never been rebuilt. Joshua Reads the Blessings and Curses (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Ai naa yili tia n-chɛ o yili tia maa zuɣu hal ni zaawuni. Ka wuntaŋ’ daa ti yɛn lu ka o chɛ ka bɛ yilig’ o tia maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ o ti bahi bɛ tiŋ’ maa dunoli shee n-kahi kuɣa pa o zuɣu hal nti duhi li zaɣ’ du’ titali sɔŋ, ka di na kul do nimaani lala hal ni zuŋɔ. english_verse: The people of Gibeon had also heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.
translation_verse: Amaa Gibiɔnnim’ ni daa wum Jɔshua ni niŋ Jɛriko mini Ai shɛm la zuɣu.

english_verse: So they decided that some of their men should pretend to be messengers to Israel from a faraway country. The men put worn-out bags on their donkeys and found some old wineskins that had cracked and had been sewn back together.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa woligi n-kpuɣi yɛŋkiŋkabina soli. Bɛ daa bola bindira niŋ bɔto kura din chahi ka bɛ liɣiliɣi li ni n-zaŋ pa bunsi zuɣu; ka zaŋ wain kol’ kura din chahi ka bɛ liɣiliɣi li pahi;

english_verse: Their sandals were old and patched, and their clothes were worn out. They even took along some dry and crumbly bread.
translation_verse: ka zaŋ namda kura din chahi ka bɛ shɛnshe li piri; ka zaŋ binyɛr’ chɛra ye, ka bɛ bindira zaa kul kuui mili ka kpe yue.

english_verse: Then they went to the Israelite camp at Gilgal, where they said to Joshua and the men of Israel, “We have come from a country that is far from here. Please make a peace treaty with us.”
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Jɔshua sani Giligal sansani la ni nti yɛl’ o mini Izraɛlnima. “Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ’ na ni ti mini ya ti lo tab’ alikauli.”

english_verse: We are your servants, and we live far from here. We came because the Lord your God is so famous. We heard what the Lord did in Egypt
translation_verse: Ka bɛ yɛl’ o, “Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ’ na. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la yuli duya pam. Ti pun wum o yɛla; ka wum o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa Ijipti la yɛla;

english_verse: and what he did to those two Amorite kings on the other side of the Jordan: King Og of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, and King Sihon of Heshbon.
translation_verse: ka lan wum o ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim’ nanima ayi la shɛlikam zaa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la. Nanima ayi maa n-nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn mini Bashan naa Ogi ŋun daa be Ashitarɔt la.

english_verse: Our leaders and everyone who lives in our country told us to meet with you and tell you that all of us are your servants. They said to ask you to make a peace treaty with our people. They told us to be sure and take along enough food for our journey.
translation_verse: Ti kpamba mini ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim’ zaa daa yɛlimi, “Bomiya bindira niŋ yi nuu ni n-gbaai soli chaŋ ti nya ba yɛli ba, ‘Ti nyɛla yi daba, ka chɛ m-bɔri ni ti mini ya lo tab’ alikauli.’

english_verse: See this dry, crumbly bread of ours? It was hot out of the oven when we packed the food on the day we left our homes.
translation_verse: Nyam’ ti bɔrɔbɔro, di daa na kul tulimi ka ti zaŋ li yi yiŋ’ na ti ni daa yiɣisina dahin’ shɛli ni ti ti diri sol’ ni, amaa nyam’ di ni kuui ka kpe yue shɛm pumpɔŋɔ.

english_verse: These cracked wineskins were new when we filled them, and our clothes and sandals are worn out because we have traveled so far.
translation_verse: Wain kola ŋɔ daa nyɛla zaɣ’ pala ka ti yi yiŋ’ na, ka nyam’ di ni chahi shɛm. Ka ti binyɛra ŋɔ mini ti namda ŋɔ gba chahila so’ wɔɣinli maa chandi ni.”

english_verse: The Israelites tried some of the food, but they did not ask the Lord if he wanted them to make a treaty.
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ daa deei bɛ bindira maa shɛli di, ka bi suhi Yawɛ n-niŋ o saawara di zuɣu.

english_verse: So Joshua made a peace treaty with the messengers and promised that Israel would not kill their people. Israel's leaders swore that Israel would keep this promise.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka o mini ba naai noli, ka o lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ku ku ba. Ka Izraɛl kpamba gba daa lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ni ʒe alikauli maa nyaaŋa.

english_verse: A couple of days later, the Israelites found out that these people actually lived in the nearby towns of Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-Jearim. So the Israelites left the place where they had camped and arrived at the four towns two days later.
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ daa yiɣisi n-gbaai chandi, zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali ka bɛ paai Gibiɔnnim’ ni daa be tin’ shɛŋa maa ni. Bɛ tinsi maa n-nyɛ Gibiɔn mini Chɛfira ni Bɛrɔt ni Kiriatijiarim.

english_verse: But they did not attack the towns, because the Israelite leaders had sworn in the name of the Lord that they would let these people live. The Israelites complained about their leaders' decision not to attack,
translation_verse: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim’ daa bi ku ba Izraɛl kpamba ni daa pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim’ Naawuni, ka lo ba alikauli shɛl’ la zuɣu. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim’ maa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni n-niŋdi bɛ kpamba maa.

english_verse: but the leaders reminded them, “We promised these people in the name of the Lord God of Israel that we would let them live, so we must not harm them. If we break our promise, God will punish us. We'll let them live, but we'll make them cut wood and carry water for our people.”
translation_verse: Ka kpamba maa daa lan yɛli ba, “Chɛliya ba, amaa ka bɛ lee kabiri dari ka ŋɔŋdi kom tiri Izraɛlnim’ zaa.” Kpamba maa ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bala.

english_verse: Joshua told some of his soldiers, “I want to meet with the Gibeonite leaders. Bring them here.” When the Gibeonites came, Joshua said, “You live close to us. Why did you lie by claiming you lived far away?
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ boli Gibiɔnnim’ maa na ka o ti bɔhi ba. “Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɔhim ti yɛli, ‘Ti mini ya shee wɔɣ’ pam.’, ka kul bela ti sani kpe ŋɔ?

english_verse: So now you are under a curse, and from now on your people will have to send workers to cut wood and carry water for the place of worship.”
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu Naawuni noli ni din ya; ka yi ni shɛb’ kul ni nyɛla daba sahakam; ka kabiri dari, ka ŋɔŋdi kom niŋdi n Naawuni jɛmbu duu.”

english_verse: The Gibeonites answered, “The Lord your God told his servant Moses that you were to kill everyone who lives here and take their land for yourselves. We were afraid you would kill us, and so we tricked you into making a peace treaty. But we agreed to be your servants,
translation_verse: Ka bɛ garigi yɛli Jɔshua, “Din chɛ ka tinim’ bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ niŋ lala maa nyɛla, ti pun wum ka biɛhiŋ kani ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli Musa ni o zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa tin ya; ka ni ku ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaa be di ni; ka ti ni zɔri dabiɛm ti nyɛviya zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi sani la zuɣu ka ti niŋ lala maa.

english_verse: and you are strong enough to do anything to us that you want. We just ask you to do what seems right.”
translation_verse: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ti bela yi nuu ni; niŋmiya ti yi ni nya ka di simdi ni yi niŋ ti shɛm.”

english_verse: Joshua did not let the Israelites kill the Gibeonites,
translation_verse: Lala ka Jɔshua daa niŋ tiligi Gibiɔnnim’ maa Izraɛlnim’ nuu ni, ka bɛ bi ku ba.

english_verse: but he did tell the Gibeonites that they would have to be servants of the nation of Israel. They would have to cut firewood and bring it for the priests to use for burning sacrifices on the Lord's altar, wherever the Lord decided the altar would be. The Gibeonites would also have to carry water for the priests. And that is still the work of the Gibeonites.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Jɔshua daa lee chɛ ka bɛ leei dakabiriba ni kɔŋɔŋdiba dindali maa. Ka bɛ kabiri dari ka ŋɔŋdi kom tiri Izraɛlnima, ka niŋdi lala tahiri Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini gba gbini. Ka bɛ na kul niŋdi lala luɣ’ shɛlikam Yawɛ ni pii leeg’ o jɛmbu shee hal ni zuŋɔ.

english_verse: King Adonizedek of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured and destroyed the town of Ai, and then killed its king as he had done at Jericho. He also learned that the Gibeonites had signed a peace treaty with Israel.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɛrusalɛm naa Adɔnizɛdɛk daa wum Jɔshua ni ŋme n-deei Ai ka ŋme n-saɣim li zaa, ka ku di naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko mini di naa shɛm la. O daa lan wum Gibiɔnnim’ ni daa chaŋ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ Izraɛlnima, ka chɛ ka bɛ mini ba bela yɛla.

english_verse: This frightened Adonizedek and his people. They knew that Gibeon was a large town, as big as the towns that had kings, and even bigger than the town of Ai had been. And all of the men of Gibeon were warriors.
translation_verse: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe o pam; dama Gibiɔn daa nyɛla tin’ titali kaman tin’ titali kam din mali naa. Di daa galisi gari Ai, ka di dɔbba mali kpiɔŋ.

english_verse: So Adonizedek sent messages to the kings of four other towns: King Hoham of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King Debir of Eglon. The messages said,
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛrusalɛm Naa Adɔnizɛdɛk daa tim ti yɛli Hiburɔn Naa Hɔham mini Jarimut naa Piram ni Lakishi Naa Jafia ni Ɛgilɔn Naa Dɛbir,

english_verse: “The Gibeonites have signed a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelites. Come and help me attack Gibeon!”
translation_verse: “Kamiyana nti sɔŋ ma ka ti chaŋ ti liri Gibiɔnnima n-ku ba, bɛ ni chaŋ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim’ la zuɣu.”

english_verse: the Gibeonites sent a message to the Israelite camp at Gilgal: “Joshua, please come and rescue us! The Amorite kings from the hill country have joined together and are attacking us. We are your servants, so don't let us down. Please hurry!”
translation_verse: Ka Gibiɔnnim’ daa tim Giligal sansan’ la ni ti yɛli Jɔshua, “Di chɛ tinim’ bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ bahi. Kamina yomyom ti sɔŋ ti tiligi ti; dama Amɔri nanim’ zaa bɛn be zoya polo tinsi la ni laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi kana ti teei gili Gibiɔn n-doya ni bɛ tuhi ti.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army, including his best warriors, left Gilgal.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa zaŋ tabili tɔbutuhiri’ biinsi zaa daa yiɣisi Giligal chaŋ.

english_verse: “Joshua,” the Lord said, “don't be afraid of the Amorites. They will run away when you attack, and I will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, “Di zɔri ba, dama m pun zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni. Ka bɛ ni so ku tooi zani yi tooni.”

english_verse: Joshua marched all night from Gilgal to Gibeon and made a surprise attack on the Amorite camp.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua min’ o tɔbbihi daa yiɣisi Giligal lu soli n-gbaai chandi yuŋ hal ti kab’ ti liri ba libigi ba.

english_verse: The Lord made the enemy panic, and the Israelites started killing them right and left. They chased the Amorite troops up the road to Beth-Horon and kept on killing them, until they reached the towns of Azekah and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ bɛ ni daa nya Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zuɣu, ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa daa ku ba pam Gibiɔn, ka kari doli bɛn kpalim hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn zolɔŋni n-kul kuri ba hal ti paai Azɛka mini Makɛda.

english_verse: And while these troops were going down through Beth-Horon Pass, the Lord made huge hailstones fall on them all the way to Azekah. More of the enemy soldiers died from the hail than from the Israelite weapons.
translation_verse: Amɔrinim’ maa ni daa ŋmaligi Izraɛlnim’ tooni guuri kpari Bɛtihɔrɔn zolɔŋ polo saha shɛli maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka sakuɣ’ kara yi zuɣusaa lu bɛ zuɣu na hal ni Azɛka ka bɛ kpi. Ka sakuɣa maa ni daa luna n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ daa gari Izraɛl tɔbbihi ni daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku shɛba.

english_verse: The Lord was helping the Israelites defeat the Amorites that day. So about noon, Joshua prayed to the Lord loud enough for the Israelites to hear: “Our Lord, make the sun stop in the sky over Gibeon, and the moon stand still over Aijalon Valley.” So the sun and the moon stopped and stood still until Israel defeated its enemies. This poem can be found in The Book of Jashar. The sun stood still and didn't go down for about a whole day.
translation_verse: Ka wuntaŋ’ daa shiri kpalim zani luɣ’ yini, ka goli gba kpalim zani hal ka Izraɛlnim’ ti bɔhi bɛ dimnim’ maa biɛri naai. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛla sab’ be Jashar Litaafi ni. Wuntaŋ’ daa kpalim zani zuɣusaa dɛde ka bi bɔri yomyom ni o lu hal ti paai dabisi muni.

english_verse: Never before and never since has the Lord done anything like that for someone who prayed. The Lord was really fighting for Israel.
translation_verse: Dabisili ŋɔ kpee daa na ʒi n-niŋ, ka mi bi lan niŋ di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ. Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa wum ninsal’ ni yɛli shɛm, dama Yawɛ daa tuhi ti Izraɛlnima.

english_verse: After the battle, Joshua and the Israelites went back to their camp at Gilgal. Joshua Kills the Five Enemy Kings
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zaa daa labi Giligal sansani maa ni. Jɔshua gbahi Amɔri nanima anu

english_verse: While the enemy soldiers were running from the Israelites, the five enemy kings ran away and hid in a cave near Makkedah.
translation_verse: Amɔri nanima anu la daa zo nti sɔɣi bela vol’ ni Makɛda.

english_verse: Joshua's soldiers told him, “The five kings have been found in a cave near Makkedah.”
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, “Bɛ nya nanima anu la ka bɛ sɔɣi bela vol’ ni Makɛda.”

english_verse: Joshua answered, “Roll some big stones over the mouth of the cave and leave a few soldiers to guard it.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli, “Bilimmiya kuɣ’ kara ti ŋari voli maa noli, ka bo niriba zali di gbini ka bɛ gul’ li,

english_verse: But you and everyone else must keep going after the enemy troops, because they will be safe if they reach their walled towns. Don't let them get away! The Lord our God is helping us get rid of them.”
translation_verse: yimaŋmaŋ’ di ʒiɛnya nimaani, amaa yinim’ karimiya doli yi dimnim’ maa nyaaŋa nti liri ba, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ zo m-paai bɛ ya, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni.”

english_verse: So Joshua and the Israelites almost wiped out the enemy soldiers. Only a few safely reached their walled towns.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa daa ku bɛ dimnim’ maa pam hal ti naai, ka bi lan nyari so, dama bɛ ni shɛb’ daa zomi ti kpe bɛ tin’ shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gil’ ni.

english_verse: The Israelite army returned to their camp at Makkedah, where Joshua was waiting for them. No one around there dared say anything bad about the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ zaa daa ŋmaligi lab’ Jɔshua sani Makɛda sansan’ la ni ni alaafee. Ka so daa bi tooi yaar’ o noli yɛri shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim’ maa polo.

english_verse: Joshua told his soldiers, “Now, move the rocks from the entrance to the cave and bring those five kings to me.”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛl’ o niriba maa, “Yoomiya vol’ maa yihi nanima anu la ti ma na.”

english_verse: The soldiers opened the entrance to the cave and brought out the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala yihi nanima anu maa vol’ maa ni na ti ti o. Nanim’ maa n-daa nyɛ: Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Hiburɔn naa ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa ni Ɛgilɔn naa.

english_verse: After Joshua had called the army together, he forced the five kings to lie down on the ground. Then he called his officers forward and told them, “You fought these kings along with me, so put your feet on their necks.” The officers did this,
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ nanima anu maa ka Jɔshua sanna, Jɔshua daa bolila Izraɛlnim’ zaa na ti yɛli tɔbbihi sapashinnim’ shɛb’ bɛn min’ o daa chaŋ tɔb’ maa ni maa, “Kamiyana ti zaŋ yi naba tam nanim’ maa nyingoya zuɣu.” Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti zaŋ bɛ naba tam bɛ nyingoya maa zuɣu.

english_verse: and Joshua continued, “Don't ever be afraid or discouraged. Be brave and strong. This is what the Lord will do to all your enemies.”
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, “Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira. Maliya yaa ni suhukpeeni pam, dama lala ka Yawɛ yɛn niŋ yi ni yɛn tuhi yi dimnim’ shɛb’ zaa.”

english_verse: Joshua killed the five kings and told his men to hang each body on a tree. Then at sunset
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku nanim’ maa n-zaŋ ba yili tih’ anu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa yili tihi maa zuɣu hal ti paai zaawuni.

english_verse: he told some of his troops, “Take the bodies down and throw them into the cave where the kings were found. Cover the entrance to the cave with big rocks.” Joshua's troops obeyed his orders, and those rocks are still there. Joshua Continues the Fighting
translation_verse: Ka wuntaŋ’ daa ti yɛn lu, ka Jɔshua bahi noli ka bɛ siɣisi ba tihi maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ ba bahi vo’ shɛl’ ni bɛ ni daa zo nti sɔɣ’ la ni, ka bilim kuɣ’ kara ti ŋari di noli, ka di na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ. Jɔshua ŋme n-deei Amɔrinim’ tiŋgbɔna pahi

english_verse: Later that day, Joshua captured Makkedah and killed its king and everyone else in the town, just as he had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei Makɛda dindali maa, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku di naa min’ o niriba. O daa ku sokam zaa, ka bi chɛ hal ninvuɣ’ yino gba; ka daa niŋ Makɛda naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko naa shɛm la.

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Makkedah and attacked the town of Libnah.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim’ zaa daa yi Makɛda n-gari chaŋ Libina ti liri Libinanima.

english_verse: The Lord let them capture the town and its king, and they killed the king and everyone else, just as they had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ di gba mini di naa niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku niriba bɛn zaa be di ni, ka so daa bi kpalim; ka daa niŋ di naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko naa shɛm la.

english_verse: Joshua then led his army to Lachish, and they set up camp around the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim’ zaa daa lan yi Libina n-gari chaŋ Lakishi ti teei gil’ li n-liri ba.

english_verse: King Horam of Gezer arrived to help Lachish, but Joshua and his troops attacked and destroyed him and his army.
translation_verse: Ka Gɛza naa Hɔram daa kana ti sɔŋ Lakishinim’ maa, amaa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku o min’ o tɔbbihi zaa hal ka bɛ ni so bi tiligi.

english_verse: From Lachish, Joshua took his troops to Eglon, where they set up camp surrounding the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Lakishi gari chaŋ Ɛgilɔn ti teei gil’ li n-liri ba

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Eglon and attacked Hebron.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Ɛgilɔn gari chaŋ Hiburɔn ti liri ba

english_verse: Joshua and the Israelite army turned and attacked Debir.
translation_verse: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa ŋmaligi lab’ Dɛbir ti liri ba

english_verse: They captured the town, and its nearby villages. Then they destroyed Debir and killed its king, together with everyone else, just as they had done with Hebron and Libnah.
translation_verse: ŋ-ŋme n-deei li tabili di fɔndi zaa, ka gbahi di niriba zaa mini di naa n-zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba. Bɛ daa ku ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn zaa be di ni, ka ninvuɣ’ yino gba bi kpalim. Bɛ ni daa niŋ Hiburɔnnim’ mini Libinanim’ ni bɛ naa shɛm la, lala ka bɛ daa niŋ Dɛbirinim’ gba mini bɛ naa.

english_verse: Joshua captured towns everywhere in the land: In the central hill country and the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert and the region that slopes down toward the Dead Sea. Whenever he captured a town, he would kill the king and everyone else, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
translation_verse: Lala ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa nima. O daa nyaŋ zoya zuɣu tinsi mini Nɛgɛb polo tinsi ni tintan’ ni tinsi ni naɣilima ni tinsinim’ ni di nanim’ zaa. Bɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ ni so; bɛ daa ku bɛ zaa kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim’ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm.

english_verse: Joshua wiped out towns from Kadesh-Barnea to Gaza, everywhere in the region of Goshen, and as far north as Gibeon.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ ba lala hal ni Kadɛshibarinia zaŋ ti paai Gaza zaŋ tabili Goshɛn tiŋgbɔŋ zaa m-mali lala hal ti paai Gibiɔn.

english_verse: King Jabin of Hazor heard about Joshua's victories, so he sent messages to many nearby kings and asked them to join him in fighting Israel. He sent these messages to King Jobab of Madon, the kings of Shimron and Achshaph,
translation_verse: Yɛlli ŋɔ lahibali ni daa ti nti to Hazɔr Naa Jabin saha shɛli, ka o daa tim ti yɛli Madɔn Naa Jɔbab mini Shimrɔn naa ni Akishaf naa

english_verse: the kings in the northern hill country and in the Jordan River valley south of Lake Galilee, and the kings in the foothills and in Naphath-Dor to the west.
translation_verse: ni nanim’ shɛb’ bɛn daa be nuzaa polo zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la ni Araba din daa be Kinɛrɔt nudirigu polo la ni tintan’ ni tinsi la nima ni Nafɔtido din daa be wulinluhili polo la nima

english_verse: He sent messages to the Canaanite kings in the east and the west, to the Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, and Jebusite kings in the hill country, and to the Hivite kings in the region of Mizpah, near the foot of Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: ni Keenannim’ bɛn daa be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo la nim’ zaŋ tabili Amɔrinim’ mini Hitinim’ ni Pɛrizinim’ ni Jɛbusinim’ bɛn daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la nima ni Hivinim’ bɛn daa be Hɛrimɔn zolɔŋni Mizipa tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't let them frighten you! I'll help you defeat them, and by this time tomorrow they will be dead. When you attack, the first thing you have to do is to cripple their horses. Then after the battle is over, burn their chariots.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, “Di zɔri ba, dama biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n sa ni ku bɛ zaa ti Izraɛlnima; ka yi sa chɛ n-chihi bɛ yuri napɔn’ jila, ka nyo bɛ chɛchɛbunsi buɣim.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army made a surprise attack against the enemy camp at Merom Pond
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua min’ o tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti liri ba Mɛrom kulibɔŋ maa ni libigi ba.

english_verse: Up to this time, the king of Hazor had controlled the kingdoms that had joined together to attack Israel, so Joshua led his army back and captured Hazor. They killed its king
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa labina di saha maa ti ŋme n-deei Hazɔr, ka zaŋ takɔb’ ku di naa, dama Hazɔr n-daa nyɛ nama maa zaa tin’ zuɣu.

english_verse: Joshua captured all the towns where the enemy kings had ruled. These towns were built on small hills, and Joshua did not set fire to any of these towns, except Hazor. The Israelites kept the animals and everything of value from these towns, but they killed everyone who lived in them, including their kings. That's what the Lord had told his servant Moses to do, that's what Moses had told Joshua to do, and that's exactly what Joshua did.
translation_verse: Yawɛ ni daa zal’ o dabili Musa shɛm, lala ka Musa gba daa zali Jɔshua; ka Jɔshua mi daa niŋ kaman o ni zal’ o shɛm. O daa niŋ Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka bi chɛ di shɛli bahi.

english_verse: Joshua and his army took control of the northern and southern hill country, the foothills to the west, the Southern Desert, the whole region of Goshen, and the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa. O daa deei zoya zuɣu tinsi mini Nɛgɛb polo tinsi zaa ni Goshɛn tiŋgbani zaa ni tintan’ ni tinsi ni Araba ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zoya zuɣu tinsi la

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he wanted the towns in this region destroyed and their people killed without mercy. That's why the Lord made the people in the towns stubborn and determined to fight Israel. The only town that signed a peace treaty with Israel was the Hivite town of Gibeon. The Israelite army captured the rest of the towns in battle.
translation_verse: Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ niŋ tipawumli, ka lo tɔbu kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima ni di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ ku bɛ zaa n-kpihim bɛ birili, ka ku zo ba nambɔɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm la.

english_verse: During this same time, Joshua and his army killed the Anakim from the northern and southern hill country. They also destroyed the towns where the Anakim had lived, including Hebron, Debir, and Anab.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa kana di saha maa ti ku Anakinim’ zaa bɛn daa be zoya tinsi ni la. Bɛ daa bela Hiburɔn mini Dɛbir ni Anab ni zoya zuɣu tinsi din zaa daa be Juda mini Izraɛl tiŋgbɔna ni la. Jɔshua daa ku niriba maa zaa, ka saɣim bɛ tinsi.

english_verse: There were not any Anakim left in the regions where the Israelites lived, although there were still some in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.
translation_verse: Ka Anakinim’ maa ni so daa lan ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, naɣila Gaza mini Gaat ni Ashidɔd ka bɛ ni shɛb’ daa be.

english_verse: That's how Joshua captured the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and Joshua divided it up among the tribes. Finally, there was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔshua daa deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la zaa m-pirigi li tinti Izraɛlnima kaman bɛ zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm ni di nyɛ bɛ fali. Ka tɔb’ tuhibu daa chɛ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka bɛ nya nyee vuhi.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he and the people of Israel had defeated two kings east of the Jordan River. These kings had ruled the region from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, including the eastern side of the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Izraɛlnim’ daa pun nyaŋ na’ shɛba ka deei bɛ tiŋgbana din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la. Bɛ ni daa deei luɣ’ shɛŋa maa n-nyɛ Arinɔn Vinvamli zaŋ hal ti paai Hɛrimɔn Zoli zaŋ tabili Araba tiŋgbana din zaa daa be wulimpuhili polo maa.

english_verse: The first king that Moses and the Israelites defeated was an Amorite, King Sihon of Heshbon. The southern border of his kingdom ran down the middle of the Arnon River gorge, taking in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the gorge. The Jabbok River separated Sihon's kingdom from the Ammonites on the east. Then the Jabbok turned west and became his northern border, so his kingdom included the southern half of the region of Gilead.
translation_verse: Nanim’ maa ni yino n-nyɛ Amɔrinim’ naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn, ka su Aroa din daa baɣi Arinɔn Vinvamli la mini vinvamli maa sunsuuni zaŋ hal ti paai Jabok Mɔɣili din nyɛ Ammɔnnim’ tintariga ka nyɛ Giliad pirigili la

english_verse: Sihon also controlled the eastern side of the Jordan River valley from Lake Galilee south to Beth-Jeshimoth and the Dead Sea. In addition to these regions, he ruled the town called Slopes of Mount Pisgah and the land south of there at the foot of the hill.
translation_verse: ni Araba zaŋ hal ti paai Kinɛrɔt Teeku din daa be wulimpuhili polo la ni Bɛtijɛshimɔt polo zaŋ kpa Araba Teeku din nyɛ Yalim Teeku n-do n-lab’ nudirigu polo Pisiga tintan’ ni la.

english_verse: Next, Moses and the Israelites defeated King Og of Bashan, who lived in the town of Ashtaroth part of each year and in Edrei the rest of the year. Og was one of the last of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: Na’ so ŋun pahi n-nyɛ Bashan Naa Ogi ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛfaimnim’ ni yino ŋun kpalim ka be Ashitarɔt mini Ɛdirɛi;
