translation_verse: Jɛhɔram ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa pahi min’ o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: Jehoram died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Ahaziah then became king. King Ahaziah of Judah (
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhɔram daa ti leei Naawuni dini, ka bɛ sɔɣ’ pah’ o yaannim’ zuɣu Dauda tiŋ’ la ni, ka o bia Ahazia daa di nam zan’ o zaani. Juda Naa Ahazia yɛla (

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah in the twelfth year of Joram's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛhab bia Izraɛl Naa Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pinaayi saha, ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia gba daa di nam.

english_verse: Since Ahaziah was related to Ahab's family, he acted just like them and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ahazia gba daa dolila Ɛhab daŋ niriba naba n-tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa ni daa tum shɛm la, dama o daa nyɛla Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa deemba.

english_verse: Ahaziah went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Ka ŋun’ Ahazia daa pahi Ɛhab bia Jɔram la zuɣu, ka bɛ lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Siria Naa Hazaɛl Ramɔtigiliad, ka Sirianim’ daa ti ti Jɔram daŋa.

english_verse: One day, Elisha called for one of the other prophets and said: Take this bottle of olive oil and get ready to go to the town of Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Di saha ka anabi Ilaisha daa bol’ anab’ bil’ so na nti yɛl’ o, “Malim’ shili n-zaŋ kpa’ luɣuluɣu ŋɔ gbib’ a nuu ni chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.

english_verse: When you get there, find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Take him to a place where the two of you can be alone,
translation_verse: A yi paai nimaani, nyin’ lihim’ bo Jɛhɔshafat bia Jɛhu ŋun nyɛ Nimshi yaaŋa la shee n-kpe nti bol’ o o tab’ sani n-zaŋ o kpe duu ashilɔni

english_verse: then pour olive oil on his head to show that he is the new king. Say to him, “The Lord has chosen you to be king of Israel.” Then leave quickly—don't wait around for anything!
translation_verse: nti zaŋ kpa’ luɣuluɣu maa m-booi di ni kpam bah’ o zuɣu ni ka yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, ‘M boola kpam ŋɔ bah’ a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa;’ ” ka yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi, ka di niŋ zinchili.

english_verse: The young prophet left for Ramoth.
translation_verse: Ka nachimbil’ ŋun daa nyɛ anab’ maa daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.

english_verse: When he arrived, the army officers were meeting together. “Sir, I have a message for you,” he said. “For which one of us?” Jehu asked. “You, sir,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: O ni daa ti paai nimaani n-nya ka sapashinnim’ ʒiya tɔri jina, ka o yɛli, “Sapashini, m malila yɛtɔɣ’ shɛli ni n yɛl’ a.” Ka Jɛhu bɔh’ o, “Ti ni ŋuni ka a lee yɛri maa?” Ka o yɛli Jɛhu, “N dana, nyini ka n yɛri maa.”

english_verse: So Jehu got up and went inside. The prophet poured olive oil on Jehu's head and told him: The Lord God of Israel has this message for you: “I am the Lord, and I have chosen you to be king of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu daa yiɣisi kpe duu, ka anab’ bil’ maa ti booi kpam maa bah’ o zuɣu ni ka yɛl’ o, “Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, ‘M boola kpam ŋɔ bah’ a zuɣu ni ni a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim’ naa;

english_verse: I want you to wipe out the family of Ahab, so Jezebel will be punished for killing the prophets and my other servants.
translation_verse: ka a ku a dan’ Ɛhab daŋ niriba, ka di chɛ ka m bɔhi Jɛzibɛl biɛri o ni daa ku n daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim’ mini n dab’ shɛb’ zaa bɛn pahi la zuɣu.

english_verse: Every man and boy in Ahab's family must die, whether slave or free.
translation_verse: Dama Ɛhab daŋ niriba zaa ni kpi. N ni ku Ɛhab daŋ ni dɔbba bɛn nyɛ bilichinnim’ mini daba zaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.

english_verse: His whole family must be destroyed, just like the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.
translation_verse: N ni niŋ Ɛhab yiŋnim’ kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋnim’ mini Ahija bia Baasha yiŋnim’ shɛm la.

english_verse: As for Jezebel, her body will be eaten by dogs in the town of Jezreel. There won't be enough left of her to bury.” Then the young prophet opened the door and ran out.
translation_verse: Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl Jɛziriil tintariga, ka so ku sɔɣ’ o.’ ” Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka anab’ maa daa yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi.

english_verse: Jehu went back to his officers, and one of them asked, “What did that crazy prophet want? Is everything all right?” “You know him and how he talks,” Jehu answered.
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu daa yi n-lab’ o sapashin’ tab’ maa sani ka bɛ ti bɔh’ o, “Alaafee?” Ka lan bɔh’ o, “Ka bɔ ka yinyaa maa lee kana ti bɔr’ a sani?” Ka Jɛhu yɛli ba, “Yi pun mi o ni o yɛtɔɣ’ gbaliŋ.”

english_verse: “No, we don't. What did he say?” they asked. “He had a message from the Lord,” Jehu replied. “He said that the Lord has chosen me to be the next king of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ka bɛ yɛl’ o, “Di pala yɛlimaŋli, yɛlim’ ti o ni yɛli shɛm.” Ka o yɛli ba, “O yɛli ma mi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, ‘M boola kpam ŋɔ bah’ a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa.’ ”

english_verse: They quickly grabbed their coats and spread them out on the steps where Jehu was standing. Someone blew a trumpet, and everyone shouted, “Jehu is king!” Jehu Kills Joram and Ahaziah
translation_verse: Di saha maa ka bɛ zaa daa dii pirigi bɛ binyɛra n-yɛrigi sɔŋ dunɔdura zuɣu ni o no li gari, ka piɛb’ kikaa ka kuhi yɛli, “Jɛhu n-nyɛ naa!” Bɛ ku Izraɛl Naa Jɔram

english_verse: When the guard in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men riding up, he shouted to the king, “I see a large group of men coming this way.” Joram ordered, “Send someone out to ask them if this is a friendly visit.”
translation_verse: Ka tiŋgula ŋun daa tam Jɛziriil pii zuɣu daa ti lihi nya Jɛhu min’ o niriba ni kanna ka yɛli, “N nya niriba ka bɛ kanna.” Ka Jɔram yɛl’ o, “Timmi wɔribara ka o chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli m-bɔhi ba, ‘Alaafee?’ ”

english_verse: One of the soldiers rode out and said to Jehu, “King Joram wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just stay behind me with the rest of my troops!” About the same time the guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back.”
translation_verse: Ka wɔribar’ maa daa chaŋ ti tuhi Jɛhu soli yɛl’ o, “Naa ni n ti bɔh’ a, ‘Alaafee?’ ” Ka Jɛhu bɔh’ o, “Alaafee yɛla lee nya a ya? Garim’ doli n nyaaŋa!” Ka tiŋgul’ maa daa lan yɛli, “Tumo maa paai bɛ sani, amaa ka lee bi labirina.”

english_verse: So Joram sent out another rider, who rode up to Jehu and said, “The king wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just get behind me with the rest of my troops!”
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan tim wɔribar’ so ŋun pah’ ayi, ka o tuhi ba soli nti yɛli, “Naa ni n ti bɔh’ a nya ‘Alaafee?’ ” Ka Jɛhu bɔh’ o, “Alaafee yɛla lee nya a ya? Garim’ doli n nyaaŋa.”

english_verse: The guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back either. Wait a minute! That one man is a reckless chariot driver—it must be Jehu!”
translation_verse: Ka tiŋgul’ maa daa lan yɛli, “Tumo maa paai bɛ sani, amaa ka lee bi labirina. Ka ŋun kani maa na mi chandi ŋmanila Jɛhu, Nimshi yaaŋa la, dama o chandi maa ŋmanila yinyaa.”

english_verse: Joram commanded, “Get my chariot ready.” Then he and Ahaziah got in their chariots and rode out to meet Jehu. They all met on the land that had belonged to Naboth.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔram daa yɛli, “Malimiya n chɛchɛbuŋ’ shili ti ma.” Ka bɛ mal’ li shili ti o. Di saha ka ŋun’ Izraɛl Naa Jɔram mini Juda Naa Ahazia daa kpe bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛhu soli n-daa mali ti tuh’ o soli maa la Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir’ la puu ni.

english_verse: Joram asked, “Jehu, is this a peaceful visit?” “How can there be peace?” Jehu asked. “Your mother Jezebel has caused everyone to worship idols and practice witchcraft.”
translation_verse: Jɔram ni daa ti nya Jɛhu, o daa bɔh’ o mi, “Jɛhu, alaafee?” Ka Jɛhu garigi bɔh’ o, “Wula ka alaafee lee yɛn niŋ beni, ka a ma Jɛzibɛl sotali min’ o buɣijɛmbo tuma la na kul beni pam?”

english_verse: “Ahaziah, let's get out of here!” Joram yelled. “It's a trap!” As Joram tried to escape,
translation_verse: Ka Jɔram daa ŋmaligi guui ka kuhi yɛli Ahazia, “Nyaanyibo yɛtɔɣa m-bala!”

english_verse: Jehu shot an arrow. It hit Joram between his shoulders, then it went through his heart and came out his chest. He fell over dead in his chariot.
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ’ o tɔbu n-darigi li ni o kpiɔŋ zaa n-to Jɔram bɔɣusapima sunsuuni, ka piɛm maa chaŋ ti gbaag’ o suhu, ka o lɛb’ lu o chɛchɛbuŋ’ puuni.

english_verse: Jehu commanded his assistant Bidkar, “Get Joram's body and throw it in the field that Naboth once owned. Do you remember when you and I used to ride side by side behind Joram's father Ahab? It was then that the Lord swore to Ahab that he would be punished in the same field where he had killed Naboth and his sons. So throw Joram's body there, just as the Lord said.”
translation_verse: Yawɛ daa yɛliya: ‘Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni sa nya Nabɔt min’ o bihi ʒim sɔhila shɛm la, n ni bɔh’ a di biɛri puu ŋɔ ni labisi.’ Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm’ o bahi puu maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm maa.” Bɛ ku Juda Naa Ahazia

english_verse: Ahaziah saw all of this happen and tried to escape to the town of Beth-Haggan, but Jehu caught up with him and shouted, “Kill him too!” So his troops shot Ahaziah with an arrow while he was on the road to Gur near Ibleam. He went as far as Megiddo, where he died.
translation_verse: Juda Naa Ahazia ni daa nya din niŋ maa, ka o guui kpa Bɛtihagan polo. Ka Jɛhu daa kariti dol’ o ka yɛra, “Tomiy’ o gba!” Ka bɛ daa to o piɛm chɛchɛbuŋ’ ni o ni daa duri Gur din miri Ibiliam la. Ka o daa zo n-kuli Mɛgido nti kpi nimaani.

english_verse: Ahaziah's officers put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried him beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: Ka o kpambaliba daa zaŋ o niŋ chɛchɛbuŋ’ ni kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti sɔɣ’ o o siliga ni m-pah’ o yaannim’ zuɣu Dauda tiŋ’ la ni.

english_verse: Ahaziah had become king of Judah in the eleventh year of the rule of Ahab's son Joram. Jehu Kills Jezebel
translation_verse: Ɛhab bia Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ piniyini saha ka Ahazia daa di Juda nam. Bɛ ku napaɣ’ Jɛzibɛl

english_verse: Jehu headed toward Jezreel, and when Jezebel heard he was coming, she put on eye shadow and brushed her hair. Then she stood at the window, waiting for him to arrive.
translation_verse: Jɛhu ni daa paai Jɛziriil, ka Jɛzibɛl wum o yɛla, o daa bal’ la chilo, ka mal’ o zuɣu n-vɔbisi lihiri takɔro ni.

english_verse: As he walked through the city gate, she shouted down to him, “Why did you come here, you murderer? To kill the king? You're no better than Zimri!”
translation_verse: Jɛhu ni daa ti kpe n-zani dunol’ ni ha, ka Jɛzibɛl bɔh’ o, “Nyin’ Zimiri ŋun ku a dan’ ŋɔ, Alaafee?.”

english_verse: He looked up toward the window and asked, “Is anyone up there on my side?” A few palace workers stuck their heads out of a window,
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ’ o zuɣu lihi takɔro maa ni ka bɔhi, “Ŋuni n-lee be m polo?” Ka m ba namɔɣilis’ ayi bee ata ŋmaligi lih’ o na.

english_verse: and Jehu shouted, “Throw her out the window!” They threw her down, and her blood splattered on the walls and on the horses that trampled her body.
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli ba, “Daamiy’ o bahina.” Ka bɛ daa daai Jɛzibɛl bahina, ka o ʒim yiɣ’ vie dukpini mini yuri, ka bɛ du n-tam o zuɣu n-nɔnno o.

english_verse: Jehu left to get something to eat and drink. Then he told some workers, “Even though she was evil, she was a king's daughter, so make sure she has a proper burial.”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa kpe nti di ka nyu ka yɛli, “Zaŋmiya noli ni di paɣ’ so maa ti sɔɣi; dama o nyɛla nabipuɣiŋga.”

english_verse: But when they went out to bury her body, they found only her skull, her hands, and her feet.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ ni daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti zaŋ o sɔɣi, bɛ daa bi lan nya o, ka naɣ’ nyala o zuɣuŋmaŋ min’ o napɔnvari ni o nuchɛhi.

english_verse: They reported this to Jehu, and he said, “The Lord told Elijah the prophet that Jezebel's body would be eaten by dogs right here in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Bɛ ni daa lab’ ti yɛl’ o, ka o yɛli, “Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir’ yɛl’ la. O daa yɛliya, ‘Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl niŋgbuŋ Jɛziriil tintariga;

english_verse: And he warned that her bones would be spread all over the ground like manure, so that no one could tell who it was.”
translation_verse: ka o niŋgbuna ni ti do tiŋa Jɛziriil tintariga kaman saɣiri la; ka so ti ku tooi yɛli, Jɛzibɛl m-bɔŋɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Your town is strong, and you're protected by chariots and an armed cavalry. And I know that King Ahab's descendants live there with you. So as soon as you read this letter,
translation_verse: “To, yinima n-su Ɛhab bidibisi la fukumsi, ka su o chɛchɛbunsi min’ o yuri ni bidibbina ni bɛ ni me birini gili tin’ shɛŋa la, dinzuɣu yi yi deei gbaŋ’ ŋɔ,

english_verse: choose the best person for the job and make him the next king. Then be prepared to defend Ahab's family.
translation_verse: yin’ piimiya yi dan’ bidibisi maa ni ŋun be viɛnyɛla ka simdi ni o niŋ naa n-zaŋ o ʒil’ o ba nam ʒiishee; ka tuhi sɔŋ yi naa maa daŋ niriba.”

english_verse: The officials and leaders read the letters and were very frightened. They said to each other, “Jehu has already killed King Joram and King Ahaziah! We have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Amaa ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam, ka bɛ yɛli, “Nyama, nanima ayi bi tooi nyaŋ o, ka wula ka tinim’ ni tooi nyaŋ o?”

english_verse: The prime minister, the mayor of the city, as well as the other leaders and Ahab's supporters, sent this answer to Jehu, “We are your servants, Your Majesty, and we will do whatever you tell us. But it's not our place to choose someone to be king. You do what you think is best.”
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka ninvuɣ’ so ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi mini ŋun su tiŋ’ maa fukumsi ni kpamba ni bɛn gbibi nabihi maa daa tim ti yɛli Jɛhu, “Ti nyɛla a daba, ka ni niŋ a ni yɛli ni ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa. Ti ku zaŋ so leei naa, kul niŋm’ a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl’ a sani.”

english_verse: Jehu then wrote another letter which said, “If you are on my side and will obey me, then prove it. Bring me the heads of the descendants of Ahab! And be here in Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” The
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa lan sab’ ba gban shɛli din pah’ ayi yɛli, “Yi yi bela m polo, ka ni deei n noli, yin’ ŋmamiya yi dan’ bidibisi maa zuɣuri n-zaŋ li ka n sanna Jɛziriil biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha.” Naa bidibisi pisopɔin maa daa bela tiŋ’ maa ni ninvuɣ’ zuɣuri sani ka bɛ wumsiri ba.

english_verse: When Jehu was told what had happened, he said, “Put the heads in two piles at the city gate, and leave them there until morning.”
translation_verse: Tumo ni daa kana ti yɛl’ o, “Bɛ zaŋ naa bidibisi maa zuɣuri na,” o daa yɛlimi, “Zaŋmiya li sɔŋ duya ayi tiŋ’ ŋɔ dunol’ ni hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.”

english_verse: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood where everyone could hear him, and he said, “You people are not guilty of anything. I'm the one who plotted against Joram and had him killed. But who killed all these men?
translation_verse: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka o yi n-chaŋ ti zani ka yɛli niriba maa zaa, “Yi ka taali. Mani n-daa lo nia biɛɣu n-ku n dana, amaa ka ŋun mi n-lee ku bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa?”

english_verse: Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛhu daa bahi ku Ɛhab daŋ niriba min’ o ninvuɣ’ zuɣuri ni o zɔnim’ ni o tindaannim’ zaa bɛn daa kpalim be Jɛziriil, ka o ninvuɣ’ so daa bi kpalim. Bɛ ku Naa Ahazia dɔɣiriba

english_verse: Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered. “We're going to visit his family.”
translation_verse: n-tuhi Juda Naa Ahazia dɔɣiriba soli m-bɔhi ba, “Banima n-lee nyɛn ya?” Ka bɛ garigi yɛl’ o, “Ti nyɛla Naa Ahazia dɔɣiriba, ka kana ni ti ti kaai nabihi mini napaɣ’ Jɛzibɛl bidibisi.”

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Jehu said to his officers. So they grabbed them and led them to the well near the shepherds' meeting place, where they killed all
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu yɛl’ o niriba, “Gbahimiya ba zaɣ’ nɛma!” Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba zaɣ’ nɛma n-ku ba Bɛtɛkɛd bɔɣili gbini. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ’ pihinahinaayi. Ka bɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ ni zaɣ’ yino gba. Bɛ ku Ɛhab dɔɣiriba bɛn kpalim zaa

english_verse: As Jehu went on, he saw Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him, then said, “Jehonadab, I'm on your side. Are you on mine?” “Yes, I am.” “Then give me your hand,” Jehu answered. He helped Jehonadab into his chariot
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu daa lan yiɣisi nimaani n-chani ha ti tuhi Rɛkab bia Jɛhɔnadab soli m-puh’ o ka bɔh’ o, “A ʒe ma yim a suhu ni kaman n ni ʒe a yim n suhu ni shɛm?” Ka Jɛhɔnadab garigi yɛli, “Iin.” Ka Jɛhu yɛl’ o, “Di yi nyɛla lala, nyin’ gbaami n nuu.” Ka o daa gbaag’ o nuu maa; ka Jɛhu kpuɣ’ o niŋ ŋun Jɛhu chɛchɛbuŋ’ ni.

english_verse: and said, “Come with me and see how faithful I am to the Lord.” They rode together in Jehu's chariot
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu lan yɛl’ o, “Doli ma nti nya n suhu ni ye Yawɛ zuɣu shɛm,” ka daa chɛ ka o kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ’ maa ni pah’ o zuɣu.

english_verse: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah. Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
translation_verse: Jɛhu ni daa paai Samaria, o daa kula Ɛhab daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim Samaria zaa. Lala ka o daa niŋ hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Ilaija shɛm la. Bɛ ku Baal jɛmdiba

english_verse: Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said: King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa laɣim sokam zaa na nti yɛli ba, “Ɛhab daa jɛm Baal la biɛla, amaa man’ yɛn jɛm o la pam.

english_verse: I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed. But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ laɣimmiya Baal buɣibahi min’ o jɛmdiba ni o tindaannim’ zaa na, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ ni so kpalim, dama m bɔri ni n zaŋla maligu titali m-mali Baal; ka ŋunkam bi kana ni kɔŋ o nyɛvili.” Amaa yɛŋkiŋkabina soli ka Jɛhu daa doli ni o ku Baal jɛmdiba maa.

english_verse: He said, “Announce a day of worship for Baal!” After the day had been announced,
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu daa lan yɛli, “Molimiya Baal jɛmbu dabisili molo.” Ka bɛ daa moli di molo maa.

english_verse: Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other.
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu daa tim tuumba ka bɛ gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka Baal jɛmdiba zaa daa laɣimna, ka so daa bi kpalim ka bi kana. Ka bɛ daa kpe Baal duu maa ni hal ti pal’ li, ka di luɣilikam zaa ti nyɛla niriba.

english_verse: Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu daa yɛli ŋun su bɛ kpariti biɛhigu shee fukumsi, “Zaŋm’ kpariti na nti ti Baal jɛmdiba maa zaa.” Ka o daa zaŋ kpariti maa na nti ti ba.

english_verse: Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, “Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɛhu mini Rɛkab bia Jɛhɔnadab daa kpe Baal duu maa ni, ka o yɛli Baal jɛmdiba maa, “Di chɛliya ka Yawɛ jɛmda be yi ni, amaa chɛliya ka di kul nyɛla yinim’ bɛn nyɛ Baal jɛmdiba maa kɔŋko.”

english_verse: As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu Jɛhu ni daa kul mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa naai saha shɛli, ka o daa yɛli bɛn guli nimaani mini sapashinnima, kpɛmiya nti ku ba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ni so tiligi. Bɛ ni daa ku ba naai, ka bɛn daa guli nimaani mini sapashinnim’ maa daa vu ba yihi samban’ ni ka kpe Baal duu maa ni du’ shɛli din be puuni ha ni

english_verse: and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it
translation_verse: nti kpuɣi Baal jɛmbu binnan’ shɛli din be di ni na nti nyo li buɣim.

english_verse: and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa ŋme ŋ-ŋma Baal binnan’ la, ka ŋme n-wurim o duu maa, ka zaŋ nimaani leei bimbɔɣili hal ni zuŋɔ.

english_verse: But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi chɛ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam daalahichi tumbu so’ shɛli o ni daa doli n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ tum alahichi la dolibu. Dina n-nyɛ salima naɣibihi shɛb’ bɛn daa be Bɛtɛl mini Dan la jɛmbu.

english_verse: Later the Lord said, “Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.”
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛhu, “A ni tum din tuhi n sani, ka niŋ Ɛhab daŋ niriba kaman n suhu ni daa yu shɛm zaa la zuɣu, a daŋ ni bidibisi kul ni diri Izraɛl nam hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir’ anahi ni.”

english_verse: But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do. Jehu Dies
translation_verse: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu ni o suhu zaa. O daa bi chɛ Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ tum alahichi la soli dolibu. Jɛhu kum yɛla

english_verse: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control
translation_verse: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ daa piligi ŋ-ŋmaari Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ bahira. Hazaɛl daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnim’ bɛn daa be bɛ tintarisi tinsi la ni zaa.

english_verse: of the regions of Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan River and north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River. This was the land where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh had once lived.
translation_verse: Zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo hal ti paai Giliad tiŋgbani ni Gaad niriba mini Rubin niriba ni Manaasa niriba tiŋgbana zaa n-lan zaŋ Aroa din baɣi Arinɔn Vinvamli la hal ti paai Giliad mini Bashan tiŋgbana.

english_verse: Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jɛhu ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa pahi min’ o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa ni o kpiɔŋ yɛla zaa, bɛ sab’ li niŋ Izraɛl nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: Jehu died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz became king.
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhu daa ti niŋ ŋun kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ’ o Samaria. Ka o bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di nam zan’ o zaani.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ kpana mini nyɔtaɣirisi din daa nyɛ Naa Dauda dini, ka be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-ti sapashinnim’ maa.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ nabia Jɔash n-yina ti booi kpam bah’ o zuɣu ni n-leeg’ o nam; ka zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil’ o; ka zaŋ Naawuni kundi ti o; ka bɛ kpahi bɛ nuhi ka yɛli, “Naawuni dolim’ naa ŋɔ nyɛvili!”

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah. Jehoiada Makes Joash King of Judah (
translation_verse: Ka Jɔash daa kpalim be Jɛhɔshɛba sani n-sɔɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni hal ti paai yuma ayɔbu, ka Atalia daa diri nam su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.

english_verse: Joash was only seven years old when this happened.
translation_verse: Jɔash yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin o ni daa di nam saha shɛli maa.

english_verse: Joash son of Ahaziah had hidden in the Lord's temple six years. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the king's special bodyguards and the commanders of the palace guards. translation_verse: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ayopɔin ni, ka Jɛhɔiada daa tim ti boli sapashinnim’ shɛb’ bɛn daa guli naa mini nayil’ la n-chɛ ka bɛ ka o sanna Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka o ti chɛ ka o mini ba lo tab’ alikauli, ka chɛ ka bɛ po pɔri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka o daa zaŋ nabia maa wuhi ba.

english_verse: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.
translation_verse: Di saha ka o daa zali ba zaligu yɛli, “Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim’ bɛn ti ka tuma ni na Vuhim Dabisili dali pirigibu buta zuɣu yim n-yɛn guli nayili,

english_verse: Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.
translation_verse: ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim guli Sur Dunɔdal’ la, ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim be dunɔdali din be guliba nyaaŋa la zaa n-guli nayili.

english_verse: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.
translation_verse: Ka pirigibu buyi zuɣu bɛn bi kanna tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali la mi ni guli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.

english_verse: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
translation_verse: Bɛ zaa yinoyino gbib’ bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-ʒe n-gil’ naa, ka ŋunkam kani bɛ sanna, bɛn’ kum’ o. Naa yi ti chani luɣ’ shɛlikam, bɛn’ kul be o sani.”

english_verse: Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.
translation_verse: Ka guliba maa zaa daa gbib’ bɛ bidibbina n-ʒiɛya gu Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo zaŋ ti kpa nuzaa polo m-mali ti gili sara maligu bimbini mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.

english_verse: Queen Athaliah heard the crowd and went to the temple.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns, which was the usual place for the king. translation_verse: nti nya ka naa maa ʒe n-tabi daantaliga kaman bɛ kali ni daa nyɛ shɛm; ka sapashinnim’ mini kikapiɛbiriba ʒe m-baɣ’ o. Ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim’ zaa daa mali suhupiɛlli, ka piɛbiri kikahi. Ka Atalia daa darigi toog’ o chinchini ka kuhi yɛli, “Nyaanyibo! Nyaanyibo!”

translation_verse: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa yɛli sapashinnim’ bɛn su tɔbbihi fukumsi la, “Zaŋmiy’ o doli guliba maa sunsuuni gari, ka zaŋ takɔb’ ku ŋunkam be o polo.” Dama maligumaana maa daa yɛlimi, “Di kuny’ o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni.”

english_verse: So the commanders dragged her to the gate where horses are led into the palace, and they killed her there.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa gbaag’ o n-zaŋ o doli yuri dunoli polo nti kpe nayili n-ku o nimaani. Jɛhɔiada ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa (

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa chɛ ka Naa Jɔash mini niriba lo Yawɛ alikauli ni bɛ ni nyɛla ŋun’ Yawɛ niriba; ka lan chɛ ka niriba maa mini naa gba lo tab’ alikauli.

english_verse: Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars. After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Di saha ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa daa chaŋ Baal jɛmbu duu nti ŋme n-wurim li, ka wurim di bimbina, ka ŋme n-wurim di binnana, ka ku Matan ŋun daa nyɛ Baal tindan’ la bimbina maa tooni. Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa bo guliba n-zali, ka bɛ guli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.

english_verse: he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah.
translation_verse: Ka o daa zaŋ sapashin’ kpamba mini bɛn guli naa ni nayili guliba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba zaa m-pa omaŋ’ zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋ naa maa yi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-gam giŋgaani ti gari guliba dunol’ la ni n-chaŋ ti kpe nayili, ka o ti ʒin’ o nam ʒiishee din nyɛ nanim’ ʒiishee la.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔash daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani hal ni o nyɛvil’ tariga, maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ni daa wuh’ o di sol’ la zuɣu.

english_verse: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
translation_verse: Ka laɣ’ shɛli din daa nyɛ taali tumbu sanyoo liɣiri mini alahichi sanyoo liɣiri, bɛ daa bi zaŋ li tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, dama din’ daa nyɛla maligumaaniba dini.

english_verse: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Amaa o daa lee bi chɛmi ka bɛ wurim bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ’ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani ti maani maligunim’ ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.

english_verse: and use it to repair the temple whenever you see the need.”
translation_verse: maligumaaniba deemi li bɛn zaŋdi li tahirina maa sani m-mal’ li maani Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣ’ shɛŋa din bɔri malibu la.”

english_verse: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule,
translation_verse: Amaa ka di daa mali ti paai Naa Jɔash nam dibu yuun’ pisinaata saha ka maligumaaniba maa na bi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa luɣ’ shɛli.

english_verse: Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.”
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Jɔash daa boli maligumaana Jɛhɔiada mini maligumaaniba shɛb’ bɛn pahi na nti bɔhi ba, “Bɔzuɣu ka yi na kul bi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa? Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di lan deeya liɣiri yi ni su ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ maa sani; amaa zaŋmiya li ti ka bɛ mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.”

english_verse: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaaniba maa daa saɣi ni bɛ ku lan deei liɣiri niriba maa sani; ka lan saɣi ni bɛn’ maligumaaniba maa ku mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.

english_verse: Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box.
translation_verse: Di saha ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa bɔ adaka n-chib’ di liŋ’ voli n-zaŋ li zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo dunol’ ni bimbini luɣili ni, ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa guli dunoli maa zaŋ laɣ’ shɛli zaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa na nti niŋ adaka maa puuni.

english_verse: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa yi ti nya ka liɣiri din be adaka maa ni zooi, naa gbaŋsabira mini maligumaaniba zuɣulana kanimina nti kal’ li, ka zaŋ bɛ ni nya laɣ’ shɛli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-niŋ kpalansi ni lo.

english_verse: Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers,
translation_verse: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zahim laɣ’ shɛli tibisim sania zuɣu n-ti ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa fukumsi ni bɛ mal’ li yɔri kapintanim’ mini tammɛriba zuɣulaannim’ bɛn tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu tuma

english_verse: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
translation_verse: ni tammɛriba ni kuɣikpɛriba, ka da dari mini nyolimbɔɣa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa, ka lan zaŋ di shɛli mi mali duu maa luɣ’ shɛlikam din simdi ni bɛ dihi li nachiinsi.

english_verse: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.
translation_verse: Amaa bɛ daa bi zaŋ bɛ ni daa tahi laɣ’ shɛli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa na m-mali anzinfa taha mini firilakpihindi’ bina ni lahi ni kikahi bee salima bee anzinfa lahi n-zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni,

english_verse: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Di saha maa ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Gaatinima, ka deei bɛ tiŋ’ maa. Amaa Naa Hazaɛl ni daa chani ni o ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima,

english_verse: So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
translation_verse: ka Juda Naa Jɔash daa zaŋ wumpaɣibo pin’ shɛŋa zaa Jɛhɔshafat mini Jɛhɔram ni Ahazia bɛn daa nyɛ o yaannim’ bɛn nyɛ Juda nanim’ ni daa zaŋ shɛli n-ti Naawuni la min’ omaŋmaŋ’ wumpaɣibo pina zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa nya salima shɛli zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni nɛma duu mini nayili la zaa n-tim ti ti Siria Naa Hazaɛl, ka o daa ŋmaligi labi ka chɛ Jɛrusalɛmnima.

english_verse: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Jɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa pahi min’ o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_verse: Shimiat bia Jɔzaka mini Shoma bia Jɛhɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ o kpambaliba la n-daa ŋme o luhi, ka o kpi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣi pah’ o yaannim’ zuɣu Dauda tiŋ’ la ni. Ka o bia Amazia daa di nam zan’ o zaani.

english_verse: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash's rule in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled
translation_verse: Juda Naa Ahazia bia Naa Jɔash ni daa di Juda nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pisinaata saha, ka Jɛhu bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di Izraɛl nam n-ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ la o nam maa ni yuun’ pinaayopɔin.

english_verse: and said, “Open the window facing east.” When it was open, Elisha shouted, “Now shoot!” Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, “That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.”
translation_verse: ka yɛl’ o, “Yoom’ wulimpuhili polo takɔro ŋɔ;” ka o yoo’ li. Ka Ilaisha yɛl’ o, “Toma,” ka o to li. Ka Ilaisha yɛli, “Yawɛ nasara dibu piɛm m-bɔŋɔ, nasara dibu piɛm din yɛn nyaŋ Sirianima m-bala! Dama a ni tuhi Sirianim’ Afɛk hal nti ku n-naai ba.”

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka doli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ tum alahichi la naba, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl min’ o bia Bɛnhadad kul tuhiri nyandi ba waawaayili.

english_verse: Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ deeg’ o suhigu, dama o daa nya nahiŋgu shɛli Siria naa ni nahindi Izraɛlnim’ maa.

english_verse: by sending Israel a leader who rescued them from the Syrians, and the Israelites lived in peace as they had before.
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ti Izraɛlnim’ maa ninvuɣ’ so ka o fa ba Sirianim’ maa nuu ni bahi; ka Izraɛlnim’ daa lan ʒi bɛ yinsi ni suhudoo kaman bɛ ni daa pun ʒiya shɛm.

english_verse: Jehoash became king of Israel in the thirty-seventh year of Joash's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Juda Naa Jɔash ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pihitanaayopɔin saha, ka Jɛhɔahaz bia Jɛhɔash daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun’ pinaayɔbu.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jɛhɔahaz ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min’ o ni daa tum shɛlikam ni o kpiɔŋ tuma zaa, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash became king. King Jehoash of Israel
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ’ o Samaria; ka o bia Jɛhɔash daa di nam zan’ o zaani. Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash

english_verse: “Grab a bow and some arrows,” Elisha told him, “and hold them in your hand.” Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand
translation_verse: Ka o yɛli Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash, “Malim’ shili n-vooi tɔb’ maa to;” ka o vooi li. Ka Ilaisha zaŋ o nuhi pa naa maa nuhi zuɣu;

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min’ o kpiɔŋ tuun’ shɛŋa zaa o ni daa zaŋ tuhi Juda Naa Amazia la, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king. Elisha the Prophet Dies
translation_verse: Ka Jɛhɔash daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pahi Izraɛl nanim’ zuɣu Samaria; ka o bia Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam ʒin’ o nam ʒiishee. Ilaisha kpiya

english_verse: Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, “Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you?”
translation_verse: Ilaisha kum dɔro ni daa ti gbaag’ o saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ o sani nti ʒi o tooni kumdi yɛra, “M ba! M ba! Izraɛl chɛchɛbunsi ni di wɔribariba!”

english_verse: Elisha said, “Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them.” Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped.
translation_verse: Ka Ilaisha daa lan yɛli Naa Jɛhɔash, “Kpuɣim’ piɛma;” ka o kpuɣ’ li. Ka Ilaisha yɛl’ o, “Zaŋm’ li fiɛb’ tiŋa;” ka o zaŋ li fiɛb’ tiŋ’ buta ka chɛ lala.

english_verse: Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, “If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa je suli niŋ o, ka yɛli, “Di di simdi ni a zaŋ li fiɛbila siɣimsiɣim bunu bee buyɔbu; dindina a naan ŋme Sirianim’ hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili, amaa a ni bi niŋ lala maa zuɣu, a ni ŋme n-nyaŋ ba la siɣimsiɣim buta kɔŋko.”

english_verse: Elisha died and was buried. Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel.
translation_verse: Ka Ilaisha daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ’ o. Mɔabnim’ daa kul chanila Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛɣuni nti fari bɛ bindira yuuni kam.

english_verse: Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up. Israel Defeats Syria
translation_verse: Ka do’ so daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o chani ni bɛ ti sɔɣi, ka nya Mɔab ŋmɛnditoya ka zaŋ kpim’ maa bahi Ilaisha siliga ni ka zo. Kpim’ maa ni daa kul lu siliga maa ni ha n-shihi Ilaisha kɔba, o dii neemi yiɣisi zani. Izraɛlnim’ mini Sirianim’ tuhi tɔbu

english_verse: Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa kul nahindila Izraɛlnima Naa Jɛhɔahaz ʒiɛman’ ni zaa.

english_verse: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa zo Izraɛlnim’ nambɔɣu ka niŋ ba nirilim; ka sɔŋ ba; o ni daa lo Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli shɛl’ la zuɣu ka o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ zaa kpi. O mi daa bi zaɣisi ba hal ni zuŋɔ.

english_verse: Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria.
translation_verse: Ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa ti kani, ka o bia Bɛnhadad di nam zan’ o zaani.

english_verse: King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia la daa lab’ deei tin’ shɛŋa Naa Bɛnhadad Hazaɛl bia ni daa tuh’ o ba Jɛhɔahaz ka fa la. Siɣimsiɣim buta ka Jɛhɔash daa tuhi nyaŋ Bɛnhadad ka fa Izraɛlnim’ tinsi o sani.

english_verse: Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher.
translation_verse: O daa tuhi deei Izraɛl tintariga tinsi Lɛbohamat dunol’ shee zaŋ hal ti paai Araba Teeku ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka o dabili anabi Jona Amitai bia ŋun daa yi Gatihɛfa la na yɛli shɛm la.

english_verse: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha ka Juda Naa Jɔash bia Naa Amazia daa di Juda nam.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ tum alahichi la.

english_verse: Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David.
translation_verse: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi be kaman o yab’ Dauda. O daa niŋ o ba Jɔash ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa la.

english_verse: Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Amaa o daa bi wurim buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul maani maligu nimaani, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.
translation_verse: Ka Amazia nam yiko ni daa ti ba jila zaa, di daa bi yuui ka o ku o kpambal’ shɛb’ bɛn daa ku o ba la.

english_verse: But the children of those officers were not killed. The Lord had commanded in the Law of Moses that only the people who sinned were to be punished, not their parents or children.
translation_verse: Amaa o daa bi ku ninvuɣ’ kuriba maa bihi. O ni daa niŋ shɛm maa daa dolila di ni daa sab’ shɛm Musa zaligu ni luɣ’ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, “Banim’ ku deei bɛ bihi kum kpi, ka bihi gba ku deei bɛ banim’ kum kpi, amaa sokam ni kpila omaŋmaŋ’ ni tum alahichi shɛli zuɣu.”

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. Go ahead and celebrate—but stay at home. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Yɛlimaŋli, a nyaŋ Ɛdomnima, ka karimbaani kpe a suhu ni n-chɛ ka a duh’ amaŋa. Chɛ ka a nini tiɣ’ a jilima, ka ʒi a yiŋa. Bee bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri vuri ni a chɛ ka bɛ ku a tabili Judanima?”

english_verse: One day, Amaziah sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Amazia daa tim tuumba nti yɛli Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl Naa Jɛhu yaaŋa la, “Kamina ka ti ti zaŋ ti gbɛri kpa taba.”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back this reply: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chɛ ka bɛ lab’ ti yɛli Juda Naa Amazia ni dahin’ shɛli ka Lɛbanɔn goo tutuɣu daa ti tim ti yɛli Lɛbanɔn sida, “Zaŋm’ a bipuɣiŋga ti ma ka n-niŋ m paɣa; ka Lɛbanɔn mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb’ so daa kana ti no goo tutuɣu maa sɔŋ tiŋa.

english_verse: But Amaziah refused to listen. So Jehoash and his troops marched to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Amaa ka Amazia daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ ka o mini Juda Naa Amazia ti zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo taba tɔbu ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ daa nyaŋ Judanima, ka bɛ zaa ŋmaligi zo n-kuli bɛ yinsi.

english_verse: He took the gold and silver, as well as everything of value from the Lord's temple and the king's treasury. He took hostages, then returned to Samaria.
translation_verse: Ka o daa kpuɣi salima mini anzinfa ni la’ shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili, ka gbahi bɛ ninvuɣ’ shɛba n-zaŋ ba kuli Samaria ti leei daba.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he defeated King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa zaa pahi min’ o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi Juda Naa Amazia shɛm la, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: After his death the people of Judah made his son Azariah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Ka Judanim’ zaa daa zaŋ o bia Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ yuun’ pinaayɔbu bia la n-leei naa zal’ o ba Amazia zaani.

english_verse: Azariah was the one who later recaptured and rebuilt the town of Elath. King Jeroboam the Second of Israel
translation_verse: Ka Naa Azaria daa me Ɛlat n-labisi li ti Judanima, o ba kum maa nyaaŋa. Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun pah’ ayi

english_verse: The Lord helped Jeroboam do this because he had seen how terribly the Israelites were suffering, whether slave or free, and no one was left to help them.
translation_verse: Dama Yawɛ daa nya Izraɛlnim’ ni nyari nahiŋgu shɛm, ka so daa kani n-nyɛ dabili bee bilichina ka bi nya nahiŋgu ŋɔ; ka so mi daa kani din ni sɔŋ Izraɛlnima.

english_verse: And since the Lord had promised that he would not let Israel be completely destroyed, he helped Jeroboam rescue them.
translation_verse: Amaa Yawɛ mi daa bi yɛli ni o ni kpihim Izraɛl yuli dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam tiligi ba.

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he recaptured the towns of Damascus and Hamath, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa zaa pahi min’ o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi tɔb’ shɛm min’ o ni daa deei Damaskus mini Hamat din nyɛ Judanim’ ni su shɛl’ la shɛm, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: Everything else Pekahiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Pekah of Israel
translation_verse: Ka Pɛkahia ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa pahi min’ o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni. Izraɛl Naa Pɛka yɛla

english_verse: Pekahiah became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pihinu saha ka Mɛnahɛm bia Pɛkahia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma ayi.

english_verse: Azariah obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Amazia ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.

english_verse: But Azariah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ’ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.

english_verse: The Lord punished Azariah with leprosy for the rest of his life. He wasn't allowed to live in the royal palace, so his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔro gbaai Naa Uzia m-mal’ o hal ka o ti kpimi ni dina. O daa yi nayili n-taɣi ti bela yil’ shɛli. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa be nayili n-lihiri li, ka gbibi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba.

english_verse: Everything else Azariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Naa Uzia ni daa tum tuun’ shɛli zaa pahi min’ o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: Azariah died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Jotham then became king. King Zechariah of Israel
translation_verse: Ka Naa Uzia daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah’ o yaannim’ zuɣu Dauda tiŋ’ la ni, ka o bia Jɔtam daa di nam zan’ o zaani. Izraɛl Naa Zakaria

english_verse: Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, but he ruled only six months from Samaria.
translation_verse: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pihinahaayika saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam bia Zakaria daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la chira ayɔbu.

english_verse: Shallum son of Jabesh plotted against Zechariah and killed him in public. Shallum then became king.
translation_verse: Ka Shallum Jabɛshi bia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo n-daa ŋme o luhi Ibiliam n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan’ o zaani.

english_verse: So the Lord had kept his promise to Jehu that the next four kings of Israel would come from his family. Everything else Zechariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Shallum of Israel
translation_verse: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa lo Jɛhu alikauli shɛli yɛli, “A bihi ni ti diri Izraɛl nam zaŋ hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir’ anahi ni la niŋ pali.”

english_verse: Shallum became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah's rule in Judah. But only one month after Shallum became king,
translation_verse: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pihinahiyinika saha ka Jabɛshi bia Shallum daa di nam maa. O mi daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la gol’ yini Samaria.

english_verse: Menahem became king of Israel in Azariah's thirty-ninth year as king of Judah, and he ruled Israel ten years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pihinahiyinika saha ka Gadi bia Mɛnahɛm daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun’ pia.

english_verse: He constantly disobeyed the Lord by following the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ tum alahichi la. Lala ka o daa kul niŋdi hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.

english_verse: During Menahem's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria invaded Israel. He agreed to help Menahem keep control of his kingdom, if Menahem would pay him over
translation_verse: Ka Asiria Naa Pul daa ti kana ni o ti tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka Naa Mɛnahɛm daa zaŋ anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi’ pihitanaanahi n-ti Asiria Naa Pul ni o sɔŋ o ka o kul su o nam maa.

english_verse: Jotham followed the example of his father by obeying the Lord and doing right.
translation_verse: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Uzia ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.

english_verse: Everything else Menahem did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɛnahɛm ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa zaa pahi min’ o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: Menahem died, and his son Pekahiah became king. King Pekahiah of Israel
translation_verse: Ka Mɛnahɛm daa ti kani, ka o bia Pɛkahia di nam zan’ o zaani. Izraɛl Naa Pɛkahia

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and caused the Israelites to sin, just as Jeroboam son of Nebat had done.
translation_verse: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Jɛrɔbɔam Nɛbat bia la ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ tum alahichi la.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and followed the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Jɛrɔbɔam Nɛbat bia la ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim’ tum alahichi la.

english_verse: During Pekah's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria marched into Israel. He captured the territories of Gilead and Galilee, including the towns of Ijon, Abel-Bethmaacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor, as well as the entire territory of Naphtali. Then he took Israelites from those regions to Assyria as prisoners.
translation_verse: Izraɛl Naa Pɛka ʒiɛman’ ni ka Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza daa kana nti tuhi fa Ijɔn mini Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni Janɔa ni Kɛdɛshi ni Hazɔr ni Giliad ni Galili ni Naftali tiŋgbani zaa, ka gbahi di niriba kuli Asiria ti leei daba.

english_verse: In the twentieth year of Jotham's rule in Judah, Hoshea son of Elah plotted against Pekah and murdered him. Hoshea then became king of Israel.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Ila bia Hɔshia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Rɛmalia bia Pɛka polo ŋ-ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan’ o zaani, Uzia bia Jɔtam ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pisi saha.

english_verse: Everything else Pekah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Jotham of Judah (
translation_verse: Pɛka ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa pahi min’ o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa la, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni. Juda Naa Jɔtam yɛla (

english_verse: Jotham son of Azariah became king of Judah in the second year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha, ka Uzia bia Jɔtam mi daa di Juda nam.

english_verse: It was Jotham who rebuilt the Upper Gate that led into the court around the Lord's temple. But the local shrines were not destroyed, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla luɣ’ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim. Jɔtam n-nyɛ ŋun daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa polo dunol’ la.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Jɔtam ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa zaa pahi min’ o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: During his rule, the Lord let King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel start attacking Judah.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Siria Naa Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa kana ti tuhi Judanima.

english_verse: Jotham died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Ka Jɔtam daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah’ o yaannim’ zuɣu o yab’ Dauda tiŋ’ la ni; ka o bia Ahaz daa di nam zan’ o zaani.

english_verse: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pinaayopɔin saha ka Jɔtam bia Naa Ahaz mi daa di Juda nam.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Hezekiah became king.
translation_verse: Ka Naa Ahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah’ o yaannim’ zuɣu Dauda tiŋ’ la ni; ka o bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam zan’ o zaani.

english_verse: and was even more sinful than the kings of Israel. He sacrificed his own son, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: amaa o daa naɣ’ dolila Izraɛl nanim’ ni daa doli so’ shɛl’ la. Hal’ o daa zaŋla omaŋmaŋ’ bidibiga m-mali maligu n-zaŋ o nyo buɣim kaman ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni daa niŋdi shɛm ka di nyɛ din chihira, ka Yawɛ daa ti kari ba ka dee’ li ti bɛn’ Izraɛlnim’ la.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: O daa kul chanila buɣa jɛmbu shee mini zoya zuɣu ni ti’ mahili kam gbini nti maani maligu ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.

english_verse: While Ahaz was ruling Judah, the king of Edom recaptured the town of Elath from Judah and forced out the people of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath, and they still live there. About the same time, King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel marched to Jerusalem and attacked, but they could not capture it.
translation_verse: Di saha ka Ɛdom naa daa lab’ ŋme n-deei Ɛlat n-ti Ɛdomnima, ka daa kari Judanim’ yihi Ɛlat maa; ka Ɛdomnim’ maa daa kana ti be Ɛlat hal ni zuŋɔ.

english_verse: Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria that said, “Your Majesty, King Rezin and King Pekah are attacking me, your loyal servant. Please come and rescue me.”
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Ahaz daa tim tuumba Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza sani nti yɛl’ o, “N nyɛla a bia ni a dabili, kamina nti fa ma Siria naa mini Izraɛl naa bɛn kana ti liri ma ŋɔ nuu ni bahi.”

english_verse: Along with the message, Ahaz sent silver and gold from the Lord's temple and from the palace treasury as a gift for the Assyrian king.
translation_verse: Ka Ahaz daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili azichi biɛhigu shee la n-tim ti ti Asiria naa pini.

english_verse: As soon as Tiglath Pileser received the message, he and his troops marched to Syria. He captured the capital city of Damascus, then he took the people living there to the town of Kir as prisoners and killed King Rezin.
translation_verse: Ka Asiria naa daa wum Ahaz ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ Damaskus nti ŋme n-nyaŋ ba, ka ku Rɛzin; ka gbahi di niriba n-kuli Kɛɛr nti leei daba.

english_verse: Later, Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser. And while Ahaz was there, he saw an altar and sent a model of it back to Uriah the priest, along with the plans for building one.
translation_verse: Naa Ahaz ni daa chaŋ Damaskus ni o ti nya Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza, ka o daa nya bimbin’ shɛli Damaskus maa. Ka ŋun’ Naa Ahaz daa zaŋ bimbini maa biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni di yɛlli kam zaa n-tim ti ti maligumaana Yuria.

english_verse: Uriah followed the plans and built an altar exactly like the one in Damascus, finishing it just before Ahaz came back.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa kaman Naa Ahaz ni daa be Damaskus ka tim ti wuh’ o shɛm zaa la. Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa naai pɔi ka Naa Ahaz naanyi yi Damaskus kuna.

english_verse: When Ahaz returned, he went to see the altar and to offer sacrifices on it. He walked up to the altar
translation_verse: Naa Ahaz ni daa yi Damaskus kuna, o daa chaŋmi ti nya bimbini maa. Di saha ka o daa vu m-miri bimbini maa nti du n-tam di zuɣu

english_verse: and poured wine over it. Then he offered sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessings.
translation_verse: m-mali maligu zaŋ li nyo buɣim, ka zaŋ chi mali maligu di zuɣu; ka booi binnyura mali sara di zuɣu; ka lan kɔrig’ o suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu n-yih’ o ʒim bahi bimbini maa zuɣu.

english_verse: After that, he had the bronze altar moved aside, so his new altar would be right in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Ka ŋun’ Naa Ahaz daa vuui daanya bimbin’ shɛli din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tooni la. O daa vuui li la omaŋmaŋ’ bimbin’ la mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu bimbin’ la sunsuuni n-zaŋ li zal’ omaŋmaŋ’ bimbini maa nuzaa polo.

english_verse: He told Uriah the priest: From now on, the morning and evening sacrifices as well as all gifts of grain and wine are to be offered on this altar. The sacrifices for the people and for the king must also be offered here. Sprinkle the blood from all the sacrifices on it, but leave the bronze altar for me to use for prayer and finding out what God wants me to do.
translation_verse: Ka Naa Ahaz daa yɛli maligumaana Yuria, “Bimbin’ titali ŋɔ zuɣu ka a yɛn maani asibaasi sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini zaawuni chi sara ni naa sara shɛli o ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la min’ o chi sara ni tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba zaa sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim mini bɛ chi sara ni di binnyura sara; ka zaŋ sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la biŋkɔbiri ʒim zaa ni sara maligu biŋkɔbiri ʒim zaa n-vie bimbini maa, amaa daanya bimbini ŋɔ yɛn nyɛla mmaŋmaŋ’ dini, ka m mal’ li bɔhiri baŋdi binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ.”

english_verse: Ahaz also had the side panels and the small bowls taken off the movable stands in the Lord's temple. He had the large bronze bowl, called the Sea, removed from the bronze bulls on which it rested and had it placed on a stand made of stone.
translation_verse: Ka Naa Ahaz daa wurim tɔroko shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu la naba, ka yihi tahi’ shɛŋa din tamtam di zuɣu; ka yihi kɔniŋdi bini din daa tam daanya naɣilahi bɛn be di lɔŋni zuɣu n-zaŋ li tam tanzaa kuɣili zuɣu.

english_verse: He took down the special tent that was used for worship on the Sabbath and closed up the private entrance that the kings of Judah used for going into the temple. He did all these things to please Tiglath Pileser.
translation_verse: Ka o daa lan wurim bɛ ni daa me binshɛli zali nayili Vuhim Dabisili zuɣu la, ka ŋari Yawɛ jɛmbu duu sambani polo duno’ shɛli bɛ ni daa chib’ ti naa ni o doli kpɛr’ la. Asiria naa zuɣu ka o daa niŋ shɛm maa.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Naa Ahaz ni daa tum tuun’ shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab’ di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim’ litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.

english_verse: Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in the twelfth year of Ahaz's rule in Judah, and he ruled nine years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Juda Naa Ahaz ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pinaayi saha ka Ɛla bia Hɔshia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma awɛi.

english_verse: Hoshea disobeyed the Lord and sinned, but not as much as the earlier Israelite kings had done.
translation_verse: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi tumla alahichi paai Izraɛl na’ shɛb’ bɛn daa daŋ o tooni la.

english_verse: During Hoshea's rule, King Shalmaneser of Assyria invaded Israel; he took control of the country and made Hoshea pay taxes.
translation_verse: Ka Asiria Naa Shalimanɛsa daa ti lo tɔbu kana ni o ti tuh’ o. Ka Hɔshia daa zaŋ omaŋ’ ti Asiria naa maa ka yɔr’ o farigu.

english_verse: But later, Hoshea refused to pay the taxes and asked King So of Egypt to help him rebel. When Shalmaneser found out, he arrested Hoshea and put him in prison. Samaria Is Destroyed and the Israelites Are Taken to Assyria
translation_verse: Amaa ka Asiria naa maa daa ti kpahim nya nyaanyibo tuun’ shɛli Hɔshia sani. Dama o daa timla tuumba Ijipti Naa ŋun yuli daa booni Soo la sani, ka bi lan yɔri Asiria naa maa farigu kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm yuuni kam la; dinzuɣu ka Asiria naa maa daa gbaai Naa Hɔshia kpɛhi duu nti ba o bandi. Samaria luya

english_verse: before capturing it in the ninth year of Hoshea's rule. The Assyrian king took the Israelites away to Assyria as prisoners. He forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Hɔshia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma awɛi saha ka Asiria naa daa ŋme n-deei Samaria. O ni daa deei li maa ka o gbahi Izraɛlnim’ kuli Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti zaŋ ba ʒili tin’ shɛli din yuli daa booni Hala mini Habɔr Mɔɣili duli din be Gɔzan yaɣili polo ni Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ tinsi ni la.

english_verse: All of this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had rescued them from Egypt, where they had been slaves. They worshiped foreign gods,
translation_verse: Ka din daa chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ ti niŋ maa nyɛla Izraɛlnim’ ni daa tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la sani zuɣu. Ŋuna n-daa yihi ba Ijipti Naa Firawuna nuu ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka bɛ ti kpalim jɛmdila buɣa,

english_verse: followed the customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel, and were just as sinful as the Israelite kings.
translation_verse: ka doli Naawuni ni daa kari zuliya shɛb’ ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ti bɛn’ Izraɛlnim’ la kaya mini Izraɛl nanim’ ni daa zaŋ ka’ shɛŋa wuhi ba la.

english_verse: Even worse, the Israelites tried to hide their sins from the Lord their God. They built their own local shrines everywhere in Israel—from small towns to large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Ka Izraɛlnim’ daa lan niŋdi binshɛŋa ashilɔni ka di nyɛ din bi tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa sani. Ka bɛ daa lan me buɣijɛmbo shee zali bɛ fɔntinsi zaa ni mini tiŋkpan’ bihi ni ni bɛ ni me birini gili fɔntin’ shɛŋa ni;

english_verse: They also built stone images of foreign gods and set up sacred poles for the worship of Asherah on every hill and under every shady tree.
translation_verse: ka daa me binwɔɣila mini Ashɛra binnana zalizali zoya zuɣu ni ti’ mahili kam gbini.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices at the shrines, just as the foreign nations had done before the Lord forced them out of Israel. They did sinful things that made the Lord very angry.
translation_verse: Nimaani ka bɛ daa tuɣindi tulaale zim kaman Yawɛ ni daa kari zuliya shɛb’ ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba la ni daa niŋdi shɛm la. Bɛ daa tum tuumbiɛri pam n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi;

english_verse: Even though the Lord had commanded the Israelites not to worship idols, they did it anyway.
translation_verse: ka daa jɛm buɣ’ shɛŋa Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli ba, “Miriya ka yi jɛm li la.”

english_verse: So the Lord made sure that every prophet warned Israel and Judah with these words: “I, the Lord, command you to stop doing sinful things and start obeying my laws and teachings! I gave them to your ancestors, and I told my servants the prophets to repeat them to you.”
translation_verse: Amaa Yawɛ daa pun chɛ ka anabinim’ mini tuumba kpahi Izraɛlnim’ mini Judanim’ zuɣu ni yɛli, “Ŋmaligimiya ka chɛ yi tuumbiɛri soya la, ka doli n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi kaman n ni daa zali yi yaannim’ zaligu shɛŋa ka daa tim n daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim’ ka bɛ zaŋ li na ti tin ya la.”

english_verse: But the Israelites would not listen; they were as stubborn as their ancestors who had refused to worship the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu ka leei tipawumlinim’ kaman bɛ yaannim’ ni daa nyɛ tipawumlinim’ shɛm ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛda la.

english_verse: They ignored the Lord's warnings and commands, and they rejected the solemn agreement he had made with their ancestors. They worshiped worthless idols and became worthless themselves. The Lord had told the Israelites not to do the things that the foreign nations around them were doing, but Israel became just like them.
translation_verse: Bɛ daa zaɣis’ o zaligunim’ din pahi maa dolibu, ka yi o daalikauli nyaaŋa; ka lan zaɣis’ o ni daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ba shɛm wumbu. Bɛ daa kul jɛmdila buɣa din ka buchi ŋɔ, ka gba leei ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn ka buchi. Bɛ daa kul dolila zuliya shɛb’ bɛn gili ba naba. Ka Yawɛ mi daa pun yɛli ba ni bɛ miri ka bɛ niŋdi kaman lala zuliyanim’ maa ni niŋdi shɛm maa.

english_verse: The people of Israel disobeyed all the commands of the Lord their God. They made two gold statues of calves and set up a sacred pole for Asherah; they also worshiped the stars and the god Baal.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zaligunim’ maa zaa dolibu, ka nyɛligi binyara malila naɣibih’ ayi kɔtomsi zali; ka lan mali Ashɛra binnana zali, ka daa jɛmdi saŋmarisi mini Baal.

english_verse: They used magic and witchcraft and even sacrificed their own children. The Israelites were determined to do whatever the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi mali buɣa n-zaŋ ba nyo buɣim, ka tumdi bukpahigu tuma, ka buɣiri baɣisi, ka saɣim bɛmaŋa n-tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.

english_verse: The Lord became so furious with the people of Israel that he allowed them to be carried away as prisoners. Only the people living in Judah were left,
translation_verse: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim’ zuɣu, ka o lɛb’ o nyaaŋa biri ba, ka chɛla Juda zuliya kɔŋko.

english_verse: but they also disobeyed the Lord's commands and acted like the Israelites.
translation_verse: Judanim’ gba daa bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zalikpana la, amaa ka daa dolila Izraɛlnim’ ni daa zali ka’ shɛŋa la.

english_verse: So the Lord turned his back on everyone in Israel and let them be punished and defeated until no one was left.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa zaɣisi Izraɛl daŋ niriba zaa, ka daa nahim ba, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛn yɛn bahi ba yoli nuu ni hal ti kari ba o sani bahi.

english_verse: Earlier, when the Lord took the northern tribes away from David's family, the people living in northern Israel chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king. Jeroboam caused the Israelites to sin and to stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: O ni daa woligi Izraɛlnim’ bahi ka chɛ Juda zuliya saha shɛli maa ka Izraɛlnim’ maa daa zaŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam leei bɛ naa. Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa yihi Izraɛlnim’ Yawɛ jɛmbu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ tum alahichi pam.

english_verse: until the Lord got rid of them, just as he had warned his servants the prophets. That's why the people of Israel were taken away as prisoners to Assyria, and that's where they remained. Foreigners Are Resettled in Israel

english_verse: The king replied, “Get one of the Israelite priests we brought here and send him back to Israel. He can live there and teach them about the god of that country.”
translation_verse: Di saha ka Asiria naa maa daa yɛl’ o niriba, “Zaŋmiya maligumaaniba shɛb’ yi ni daa ʒi nimaani na la yino n-labisi ni, ka o ti be nimaani wuhiri ba tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋgbani zaligu.”

english_verse: One of the Israelite priests was chosen to go back to Israel. He lived in Bethel and taught the people how to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ka maligumaaniba shɛb’ bɛ ni daa zaŋ yi Samaria chaŋ maa ni yino daa labi nti ʒini Bɛtɛl n-wuhiri ba Yawɛ jɛmbu.

english_verse: But in towns all over Israel, the different groups of people made statues of their own gods, then they placed these idols in local Israelite shrines.

english_verse: The people from Babylonia made the god Succoth-Benoth; those from Cuthah made the god Nergal; those from Hamath made Ashima;
translation_verse: Babilɔnnim’ daa mɛla Sukɔtibɛnɔt buɣili zali, ka Kutinim’ me Nɛrigal buɣili zali, ka Hamatinim’ me Ashima buɣili zali,

translation_verse: Hɛzɛkia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab’ Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm la.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines, then tore down the images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. He also smashed the bronze snake Moses had made. The people had named it Nehushtan and had been offering sacrifices to it.
translation_verse: O daa wurim bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ’ shɛŋa, ka ŋme n-wurim binwɔɣila la, ka chɛ n-kabi Ashɛra bimbina luhi. english_verse: Hezekiah trusted the Lord God of Israel. No other king of Judah was like Hezekiah, either before or after him.

english_verse: He was completely faithful to the Lord and obeyed the laws the Lord had given to Moses for the people.

english_verse: The Lord helped Hezekiah, so he was successful in everything he did. He even rebelled against the king of Assyria, refusing to be his servant.
translation_verse: Ka Yawɛ daa be o sani, ka o daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ’ shɛlikam zaa o dirila nasara. O daa zaɣisi Asiria naa jɛmbu.

english_verse: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah's rule in Judah, King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded the country and captured every walled city, except Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun’ pinaanahi saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Judanim’ ni daa me birininim’ gili fɔntin’ shɛŋa zaa n-tuhi deei li.

english_verse: Hezekiah sent this message to Sennacherib, who was in the town of Lachish: “I know I am guilty of rebellion. But I will pay you whatever you want, if you stop your attack.” Sennacherib told Hezekiah to pay ten tons of silver and one ton of gold.
translation_verse: Ka Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia daa tim Lakishi nti yɛli Asiria naa maa, “N tum taali; ŋmaligim’ labi ka chɛ ma; a yi yɛli ni n niŋ shɛlikam, n ni niŋ li.” Ka Asiria naa maa daa yɛli Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia ni o tim’ o anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi’ pia mini salima din mi tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhili.

english_verse: So Hezekiah collected all the silver from the Lord's temple and the royal treasury.

english_verse: The king of Assyria ordered his three highest military officers to leave Lachish and take a large army to Jerusalem. When they arrived, the officers stood on the road near the cloth makers' shops along the canal from the upper pool.

english_verse: He told Prime Minister Eliakim, Assistant Prime Minister Shebna, and the senior priests to dress in sackcloth and tell the prophet Isaiah:

english_verse: These are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti yɛl’ o, “Hɛzɛkia yɛliya, ‘Zuŋɔ nyɛla nandahima mini ti zuɣu ni kpahibu ni vi dihibo dabisili. Bihi dɔɣibu saha paaya ka yaa kani n-dɔɣiri ba.

translation_verse: Naa Hɛzɛkia tuumba maa ni daa paai Aizaia sani,

translation_verse: “Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla din ti yɛn niŋ maa shihirili. Yuuni ŋɔ mini yuuni din paya na, kayari chi ka yi yɛn dira; ka yuun’ shɛli din pahir’ ata ni mi, yi ni biri ka chɛ, ka sa wain tihi n-di di wala.
